briefs.name: 環境科學與工程
briefs.tags: 生態系統; 水品質管理: 水處理; 廢水處理; 空氣汙染; ecosystem; water quality management; water treatment; wastewater treatment; air pollution
briefs.desc: The objectives of this course are to introduce the application of certain necessary principles of engineering and science that are required for any quantitative treatment of environmental problems. The basic, traditional materials on water supply, wastewater treatment, air pollution control, and solid and hazardous waste management will be covered. Some of the significant environmental problems of the day will be presented as well.

briefs.tags: 批判思考（critical thinking), 邏輯訓練(logistic training), 時間管理(time management), 資料整理（Literature Review), 專業養成(Professional Training)
briefs.desc: 此課程主要培養碩博士班研究生對各領域新知的批判思考能力。藉由邀請國內外優秀學者前來進行近年來不同領域的新知演講， 除讓研究生瞭解各領域重要的學術發展新知，也培養學生對於新知的學習與批判思考能力。 This course is designed for master and Ph.D. students to strengthen their advanced knowledge and critial thinking skills. The professional training, time management, and logistic training abilities will also be emphasized in this course.

briefs.name: 綠色科技
briefs.tags: renewable energy, green catalysis, green materials, circular economy
briefs.desc: Green technology is a novel multidisciplinary science, including chemistry, physics, biology as well as material sciences, to not only monitor, model and conserve the natural environment and resources, but also curb the negative impacts of human activities. In this course, basic concepts and applications of green technology are discussed; furthermore, circular economy for sustainable environment is also introduced to provide students a picture that how green technology utilize to our daily life in the future.

briefs.name: 環境生物技術
briefs.tags: 環境污染生物治理技術, 環境污染生物修復技術, 環境污染預防生物技術, 生物復育, 環境生態修復工程 Keywords: Environmental Pollution Biological Treatment Technology, Environmental Pollution Bioremediation Technology, Environmental Pollution Prevention Biotechnology, Bioremediation, Environmental Ecological Remediation Project
briefs.desc: 地球上的自然環境是我們和所有生物生存的唯一空間。 然而，隨著工業文明的推進，人類社會不斷擴張，如今地球環境對人類 和生物構成了巨大威脅，已成為世界各國面臨的一個極具挑戰性的議題。 根據1919年生物技術歐洲協會（European Federation of Biotechnology）的定義，「環境生物技術是將生物化學、微生物 學和工程技術結合的綜合科學，其主要目的在於利用微生物、動植物應用於農業、環境 、工業和健康護理等領域，以推動永續 發展。」 因此，「環境生物技術」是一門新興學科，將現代生物技術與環境科學工程緊密結合發展而成。 它已經成為一個系統 工程技術，以可持續利用環境資源為目標，涵蓋上下游技術集成，是全球經濟發展中新的成長點。 因此，希望修課學生可以隨著現代生物技術的快速發展，以不斷延伸和拓展對生物環保產業的滲透式學習。這門課程重點介紹環 境污染生物治理技術、環境污染生物修復技術以及環境污染預防生物技術。 課程內容涵蓋理論分析，並介紹國內外最新研究進 展與發展趨勢。

briefs.name: 空氣品質量測
briefs.desc: 本課程主要介紹空氣品質相關國內外環境法規、空氣污染物量測技術、空氣品質監測數據檢核評估。 課程進行方式包含(1)簡報式主題講述，(2)氣體量測實驗室參訪，及(3)互動型態專題討論。 互動型態專題討論內容由修課同學選定主題，經與授課老師討論後即可開始進行。可自行決定以小組型態或個人方式展開專題研 究，研究成果可由各專題自行提議報告展現的型式。

Three-hour lecture per week for one semester. Aims and objectives 1. To describe the fundamental concepts of biomacromolecules. 2. To impart the basic understanding of spectroscopic measurements and the fundamental principles of separation of biomacromolecules. 3. To introduce the tools of chromatography and spectroscopy for quantitative bioanalysis. 4. To impress upon the students the wide importance and the applicability of analytical chemistry and its relation to biochemistry and biotechnolog

briefs.name: 分子光譜學
briefs.tags: Molecular symmetry, light-matter interaction, vibrational spectroscopy, electronic spectroscopy, photoelectron spectroscopy
briefs.desc: The atomic and molecular spectroscopy is an important technique used in the field of physics, chemistry as well as biology. This course provides an introduction to the principle of spectroscopy, molecular symmetry and light-matter interaction. In addition, different types of spectroscopies, including vibrational, electronic and photoelectronic type, will also be discussed. After studying this course, the students should be able to apply the atomic and molecular spectroscopy to their research.

briefs.name: 人工智慧倫理--東海
briefs.tags: 機器學習,哲學倫理學,AI模型,倫理、風險與社會議題
briefs.desc: 本課程旨在帶領學生認識及反思AI這項技術及其應用所涉及的倫理、風險與社會議題。首先，將簡介學習機器學習AI的發展歷 史以及國際倫理規範，以及哲學倫理學的基本概念。其次，將說明AI的資料來源和分類如何影響AI的預測或決策。接著，將探 討AI模型和演算法的設計，並分析AI技術所涉及的社會性與政治性等問題。另外，本課程亦討論AI應用之後所帶來的人類生存 危機感、偏誤與歧視、加劇既有的社會不平等、性別刻板印象、以及勞動產業鍊及剝削等倫理與社會爭議。最後，本課程期待 修課學生能針對目前已知發生倫理社會爭議的AI專案提出可行的解決方案。

briefs.name: 智慧製造執行系統--成大
briefs.tags: 人工智慧(AI),深度學習,大數據分析,雲端運算,生成式人工智慧(GAI)
briefs.desc: 智慧製造執行系統(Intelligent Manufacturing Execution System, iMES)為「智慧製造」核 心之一。iMES運用聯網(IoT)、人工智慧(AI)、深度學習、大數據分析、雲端運算、數位孿生 (Digital Twin)及生成式人工智慧(GAI) 等先進技術,實現對生產過程中各項關鍵要素的智 慧化監控、決策支援與成效評量。 智慧製造執行系統的核心功能不僅在於運用數據驅動,即時掌握生產狀況、偵測與預測潛 在異常,並進行診斷與預防,更能動態調整生產計畫、優化排程、降低能源消耗,以持續提 升製程效能與產品品質。 本課程首先從系統觀點出發,結合生產 PDCA 循環、製造作業管理(Manufacturing Operation Management, MOM)、製造資源管理(Manufacturing Resource Management, MRM)及精實生產理念,介紹「製造系統」的整體架構。接著,針對工業 4.0 的智慧製造需 求,說明「產業生態系」下的智慧製造系統發展脈絡,以及智慧製造執行系統的功能與技術 架構。同時,課程將探討支撐智慧製造執行系統的關鍵技術,包括資料科學、人工智慧、深 度學習、數位孿生與生成式人工智慧(GAI)之原理與應用。此外,課程將透過實際案例分析 ,參考系統工程之觀念與程序,說明製造執行之智慧化轉型的方法論與實踐程&

briefs.name: 大型語言模型與資訊安全系統--台科大
briefs.nameEn: Applying Large Language Models in Cybersecurity Systems--NTUST
briefs.tags: AI,data curation,machine learning,Project-based Learning (PBL) track,
briefs.desc: Applying Large Language Models in Cybersecurity Systems introduces students to the rapidly evolving intersection of artificial intelligence and cyber defense. The course explores how large language models (LLMs) are transforming cybersecurity practice, from automated threat detection to intelligent defense solutions, while also addressing the unique security challenges AI itself introduces. Students will begin by examining the question “Can AI defend with us?”—a guiding theme that frames the role of AI as both an ally and a potential risk in digital security. The course then surveys the evolution of AI with a cybersecurity focus, real-world case studies, and the key terminology that shapes the field. Practical skills are emphasized through modules on effective prompting, data curation for threat intelligence, and applying machine learning techniques to security problems. Students will gain hands-on experience in designing, developing, and evaluating AI-powered

briefs.desc: 本課程以「生成式 AI 應用系統」開發為核心,帶領學生從需求分析、系統設計,到實作與部署,完成一個生成式 AI Web服務。 內容涵蓋軟體工程SDLC、前後端技術、資料流程與工作流、開源CI/CD與 MLOps/LLMOps工具、AWS 雲端環境、分散式 AI Infra、LLM 微調與 local LLM 評測、Agent 工作流與 MCP/ADK/agent-to-agent架構、LiteLLM/OpenRouter 等模型代 理工具,以及 token 經濟學、Prompt 優化、多輪對話設計、幻覺減少與 LLM 資安議題。 學生將透過至少六次程式作業與期末專題,實作一個具完整工程思維的生成式AI應用系統

briefs.name: 生成式AI的人文導論--台大
briefs.tags: 人本,語言與溝通,AI 模型的基礎與發展
briefs.desc: 隨著AI科技的迅速發展，人類社會的各個面向都開始受到了不同層面的衝擊。生成式 AI 迅速與多樣化產製內容的能力，不論 在知識傳承，或是實務創作上也帶給人文社會領域新的養分與挑戰。 本堂課是特別針對人文領域的學生設計的 AI 技術與應用入門課。在內容安排與講解上， 與一般純粹以技術入門的導論課有 許多不同。本堂課將以人本為核心關懷出發，以直觀概念與模擬技術來講解 AI 模型的基礎與發展，並搭配與人文主題相關的 實作練習，特別是文史哲議題、語言與溝通、藝術音樂與遊戲創作等等。

briefs.name: 深度學習--陽明交大
briefs.desc: 教師於課堂中引導式講授目前國際發展最先進之深度學習方法學及其應用，帶領學生原理介紹、數學推導實務應用，熟悉使用 深度學習。 The instructor will guide students through the latest international developments in deep learning methodologies and applications. The course will cover theoretical principles, mathematical derivations, and practical applications. Students will gain hands-on experience with deep learning tools.

briefs.name: 漢人社會與文化
briefs.nameEn: Society and Culture of Han Chinese
briefs.tags: 治理性 (Governmentality)、情感政治 (Politics of Affect)、本體論(Ontology)、技術（Technics)、重組與轉型（reconfiguration and transformation）
briefs.desc: 本課程旨在透過 2020-2025 年間出版的民族誌（並搭配一本2013年出版的對比之作），重新審視當代漢人社會的運作邏輯。課程將跳脫 傳統漢人研究將親屬、宗教、經濟視為靜態結構的視角，轉而關注這些傳統範疇在現代國家治理與全球資本主義下的結構性重組與轉型。 我們將透過微觀政治、中層結構與宏觀結構這幾個層次來貫穿本課程對當代漢人社會的探討。從國家的生命政治如何滲透家庭與身心，將 「孝道」轉化為監控與暴力的機制；到在高度不確定的風險社會中，人們如何透過「算命技術」與「儀式經濟」來建立理性的社會連結與公 民社會；再到面對社會主義歷史的幽靈與數位創新的許諾，被遺棄的工人與新興的創客如何在廢墟與原型中重塑生存倫理？ 本課程強調理論與民族誌的對話，將學習運用生命政治（Biopolitics）、情感結構（Structure of Feeling）、耗費理論 （Expenditure）與本體論（Ontology）等當代社會理論，批判性地分析漢人社會的最新變遷。

briefs.name: 人類學方法論
briefs.tags: 研究方法, 參與觀察, 田野工作, research methodology, participant-observation, fieldwork
briefs.desc: 本課程是國立清華大學人類學研究所的核心必修課程，包括兩個部分： （一）學理：探究人類學研究的知識內涵、民族誌、田野工作等各種面向。 （二）實作：研究計畫的構思、提案與撰寫。 學期課程分成四個單元： =548; 第一單元「人類學研究的開展」：發想初步的研究題目。 =548; 第二單元「人類學研究的內涵」：討論何謂民族誌、人類學知識生產與認識論/本體論的框架、田野調查典範的建立 與反省、田野工作的倫理、政治與規範。 =548; 第三單元「人類學研究的實踐」：討論田野調查的精神、步驟與技巧，包括參與觀察與深度訪談；檔案製作的程序與 技藝，包括訪談音譯與田野筆記；以及民族誌書寫的方法，包括場景描述、資料處理與敘事結構，以及人類學工作者作為作 者的寫作定位。 =548; 第四單元「人類學研究的創造力」：討論當前複雜處境的各種研究難題，包括歷史與敘事的時間面向、地點與移動的 空間面向，以及為了解決各種當代研究難題而設計出的創意研究方法。

briefs.name: 都市人類學
briefs.tags: city, modernity, everyday life, neighborhood, infrastructure, urban planning, public space, political life, mobility
briefs.desc: This course explores the city as both anthropological field site and object of study. Drawing on ethnographic studies and theoretical inquiries, it examines themes from foundational concepts to contemporary issues. It looks at how “the city” has been conceptualized – as locales of social life, nodes of circulation and exchange, sites of control, division, and exclusion, as well as arenas in which political imaginations and actions take place. It also explores urban materiality through infrastructure, spatial organization, and architecture in relation to perceptions and temporalities of the city. Moving through different scales, it aims to balance “anthropology in the city” and “anthropology of the city,” interrogating the methodological challenges of urban fieldwork as well as how ethnographic approaches can contribute to understanding the city.

briefs.name: 東南亞考古學
briefs.tags: 東南亞、東南亞考古、東南亞的舊石器時代、東南亞的新石器時代、東南亞的金屬器時代、東南亞的早期國家
briefs.desc: 無論是從自然環境或人類文化上來看，東南亞的一個主要特色即是分歧性。因此造就了東南亞非常複雜的人類歷史，其中許多有 待瞭解的課題，需要考古學的研究。本課程是東南亞考古學的導讀，其目的是要增加同學對東南亞考古學的認識與基本知識。講 授重點包括東南亞考古的發展、現狀與研究課題。

briefs.name: 考古學方法論
briefs.tags: 考古學, 物質文化, 方法論, 文化資產, 歷史 archaeology, material culture, methodology, cultural heritage, history
briefs.desc: 考古學是一門具有科學性、邏輯性與詮釋性的學門，不是個人主觀認知的推斷也必須避免成為狹隘偏見的利用工具。考古學研究需要透過跨 領域方法學的整合來達到科學性的目標；透過人文社會科學對人類文化的理解與自然科學對人類身處環境的認識，透過考古發掘資料與不同 學科理論的對話，來檢視考古學復原古代社會論述的合理性。本課程除了對考古學的資料與詮釋進行多方深入檢討之外，亦將藉由課程帶領 學生探索國內外考古學的發展情形，並初步規劃自身研究架構。

briefs.name: 台灣南島研究
briefs.tags: Austronesian speaking People, Austsronesian Expansion, Social Structure, State Relations, Indigenous Education,
briefs.desc: This seminar provides an overview of the studies on the Austronesian- speaking peoples in Taiwan, whose linguistic diversity has been described as “Taiwan’s Gift to the World." It will start briefly with the archaeological and linguistic importance of Taiwan in the theories of Austronesian Expansion, then explore themes that are common to indigenous peoples of Taiwan and the greater Austronesian world (e.g., house ideology, emplacement, status competition and precedence, origin and ancestry, etc.) and contemporary situations (dilemmas and opportunities). Students will be exposed to the Formosan cultural diversity and research potentials that are crucial and current to the life of indigenous peoples on the island.

briefs.name: 大洋洲民族誌
briefs.tags: Pacific, Oceania, Austronesian, 太平洋, 大洋洲, 南島
briefs.desc: Ethnographers working in Oceania have frequently been the driving force of anthropological theories. From Bronislaw Malinowski’s Argonauts of the Western Pacific (1922) that brought force the approach of functionalism, to Margaret Mead’s Coming of Age in Samoa (1928) that engaged with the nature/culture debate; from Marshall Sahlins’s Historical metaphors and Mythical Realities (1981) that put the dimension of history into structuralism, to Marilyn Strathern’s Gender of the Gift (1988) that revealed the significance of personhood in gendered activities. Prominent anthropologists such as Alfred Radcliffe-Brown, Raymond Firth, Gregory Bateson, Roy Rappaport, Alfred Gell, and Fredrik Barth have all conducted research in Oceania, advancing ideas of economic anthropology, cognitive anthropology, and environmental anthropology, etc. Even the great Marcel Mauss had found insight from Oceania ethnographic materials in The Gift (1925). In this course, we will be

briefs.name: 台灣考古學
briefs.tags: Taiwan 台灣, Archaeology 考古學, Prehistory 史前史, Neolithic period 新石器時代, Austronesian people 南島語族
briefs.desc: This course introduces students to the cultural history of Taiwan, archaeological topics, and contemporary practices in Taiwanese archaeology, while also drawing parallels with archaeological developments in other regions of the world. The first half of the course offers an overview of the development of the discipline of archaeology in Taiwan, followed by the cultural history from the Paleolithic period, Neolithic period, metal Age, to the historical periods through case studies. The later part of the course delves into various topics and current issues in Taiwan archaeology, exploring their connections to neighboring regions and global archaeological trends. By examining the historical and social contexts that have shaped Taiwanese archaeology, students will gain a comprehensive understanding of its development. Furthermore, the course addresses ethical considerations in contemporary archaeology, fostering an understanding of best practices in the field.

briefs.name: 書報討論：性別與宗教
briefs.desc: 根據同學各自的研究主題，安排選讀人類學討論性別與宗教之經典著作、當代論述發 展及民族誌案例為書目，以掌握該領域知識系譜並結合學位論文之研究方向，與指導 及授課教師進行討論。選讀書目內容涵蓋當代性別與宗教研究的理論背景與變遷、西 方女性主義與宗教批判、中國與臺灣漢人宗教的民族誌案例，以及身體、月經、靈媒 與儀式實踐等主題。

briefs.name: 書報討論：沉船考古學與戰爭
briefs.desc: 聚焦於了解船舶考古學的發展歷史、方法論與沉船經典案例。如何從船隻殘體進行結構分析與文化脈絡研究？臺灣所在的東亞海 域其造船傳統為何？如何利用戰爭考古學剖析沉船在戰爭下的歷史意義？這次的書報討論希望針對海洋考古學中的沉船遺址進行 研究，並透過戰爭考古學的視角深入理解東亞海域的沉船研究策略。

briefs.name: 數位人類學
briefs.tags: digital, culture, ethnography, logistics, labor, gender, 數位文化, 民族誌, 物流/後勤, 勞工, 性別
briefs.desc: This experimental seminar explores “the digital” from an anthropological perspective. This will take two forms: first, exploring ethnographic research on digital culture; and second, using anthropological theories and frameworks to explore the relationship between the digital and the human. We’ll examine core anthropological topics, such as culture, ethnography, self, and gender, as the digital becomes an essential part of both the global and the local. Moreover, we’ll discuss issues involved in the characteristics of the digital, such as the machine, infrastructure, labor, politics, logistics, and strangership. Students are required to participate in an international workshop as part of the course. 歡迎有興趣修課的同學（碩博士生及大四）直接 email 老師討論加簽 < cyhuang@mx.nthu.edu.tw>

briefs.name: 恆星與行星的形成(磨課師)
briefs.tags: 宇宙 (Universe), 太陽系 (solar system), 恆星 (stars), 行星 (planets)
briefs.desc: 你知道太陽與地球如何形成嗎？宇宙到底多大多老呢？本課程將透過真實的科學影像與圖片，介紹像太陽系一樣的恆星與行星系統的形成過 程，從宇宙的組成逐一介紹太陽系、星星的起源、恆星與行星形成以及系外行星等系列主題，並探討星球與人類之關係。

briefs.name: 黑洞天文物理導論
briefs.tags: Black holes, astrophysics, active galactic nuclei, relativistic jets, gravitational waves, 黑洞, 天文物理, 活躍星系核, 噴射流, 重力波
briefs.desc: Studying black holes is an important subject in astrophysics, including the newly discovered gravitational waves, and the evolution of galaxies in the universe. This course aims to provide students who are interested in astrophysics with fundamental knowledge about black holes. The lectures will cover stellar-mass black holes and supermassive black holes and their related phenomena, with a balance between theories and observations. We will start from the black hole properties predicted by Einstein's theory of general relativity, to major advancements and discoveries in recent years. 黑洞在天文物理的許多熱門研究領域中都是重要的課題，包括新興的重力波觀測、以及星系的形成與演化等等，因此開設本課程，希望能讓對天 文物理有興趣的物理系學生有機會學習各種與黑洞相關的基礎知識。課程內容會涵蓋太陽質量黑洞和超大質量黑洞的性質與相關現象，並同時著 重理論和觀測，從廣義相對論所預測的黑洞性質出發，隨後介紹近幾十年來的重要觀測證據與發現。

briefs.name: 專題演講二
briefs.tags: Colloquium, Seminar, Astronomy, Presentation Skills, Professional Development
briefs.desc: This is the weekly colloquium of the NTHU Institute of Astronomy. Talks in a wide range of fields in astronomy and astrophysics will be delivered by visiting speakers.

briefs.name: 天文物理的前沿二
briefs.tags: latest papers arxiv preprints cutting-edge
briefs.desc: It is an essential task for all researchers to stay current with the latest publications in their field. However, in the field of astronomy alone, nearly 40 new papers are published every day. It is a significant amount of work to stay abreast of such a flood of papers. The purpose of this course is to train students on how to efficiently read and comprehend the essence of new research papers within a limited timeframe. Students should aim to spend no more than one hour reading a paper of their choice and then take turns presenting a concise summary in 10 minutes. The focus should be on understanding the core ideas rather than delving into the details. It is not necessary to read every detail of the paper. Additionally, this format provides other students in the class with a valuable opportunity to learn about the latest papers while listening to the speaker. After each presentation, the instructor will teach a relevant physics concept related to the concep

briefs.name: 天文輻射物理
briefs.tags: astrophysics, astronomy
briefs.desc: This course, Astrophysical Radiative Processes (ASTR6200), is one of the core courses of the master program at the Institute of Astronomy, NTHU. It basically covers concepts and formalism of radiation transfer and various radiation mechanisms. These are important fundamentals of astronomy and astrophysics.

briefs.name: 高能天文物理
briefs.tags: astrophysics, high-energy astrophysics, radiation mechanisms, particle acceleration, astronomical accretion
briefs.desc: This course, High Energy Astrophysics (ASTR6350), is aiming at providing students a general introduction to the basics and topics in high energy astrophysics. It consists of two parts: The first is an overview on various physical processes relevant to phenomena in high energy astrophysics. The second is several selected topics.

briefs.name: 宇宙論
briefs.tags: cosmology, dark energy, dark matter, gravitiy
briefs.desc: This course reviews our current understanding of the Universe with emphasis on the observational evidence and theoretical background of individual subjects. We will explore topics in the geometry of the Universe, inflation, Big Bang, dark matter, dark energy and gravitational lensing. Our goal is to provide students with a summary of our current understanding of the Universe, and what topics remain to be explored. The material is presented without complex mathematics as much as possible. Previous knowledge of general relativity is not required. This course will be offered in English.

briefs.name: 星系動力學
briefs.tags: Potential Theory, Stability, Celestial Mechanics, Stellar Dynamics, Dynamical Astronomy
briefs.desc: 藉由解說重力場理論, 銀河系及各種星系的重力場, 恆星的運行軌道, 恆星系統的穩定性, 使同學了解恆星動力學及星系動力學, 並建立 天文動力學的基礎, 以利未來工作或研究之用。

briefs.name: 計算天文物理
briefs.tags: Astronomy, Astrophysics, Computation, Programming
briefs.desc: This is a graduate-level course offered by the Institute of Astronomy. The course will focus on developing practical computational skills (tools, algorithms and programming best practice) through applications to problems in modern astrophysics and cosmology. This course requires prior programming experience and familiarity with basic astrophysical concepts. It is research-oriented and not suitable as an introduction to computation, computational physics or astronomy. Undergraduate students should not sign up for this course unless they can demonstrate prior experience with computational physics.

briefs.tags: 科學, Science
briefs.desc: Purpose of this class - Nourish the awareness of and habit of scientific thinking and doing, motivated by why and purpose-driven doings.

briefs.name: 統計與機器學習概論二
briefs.nameEn: Introduction of Statistics and Machine Learning (II)
briefs.teacher: 楊立威,李旻軒,竹村和浩,李政霖
briefs.tags: Artificial Neural Network(類神經網路)， Convolutional Neural Network (卷積神經網路)，Support Vector Machines (支持向量機)， Explainable AI(可解釋人工智慧)，Generative AI(生成式 AI)
briefs.desc: 統計與機器學習概論二 (Introduction of Statistics and Machine Learning (II)) aims to introduce basic Machine Learning (ML) knowledge and technique based on mathematics and programming foundation laid in 統計與機器學習概論一 (Introduction of Statistics and Machine Learning (I)). Those ML foundation includes basic mathematic understanding of probability, statistics, vectors, coordinate systems, series, matrix/determinant operation, eigen problems as well as (basic) programming-based problem- solving skills with at least one programming language. The relevant mathematical concept and programming skills can help students understand the essence of to-be-taught supervised learning, decision tree, random forest, gradient boosting, multivariate analysis, dimension reduction, clustering, linear discriminant analysis, SVM, DNN, CNN, RNN etc, with real-world examples taken from biomedical field.

briefs.name: 實驗輪轉二
briefs.tags: Lab rotation, research culture
briefs.desc: 智慧生醫博士學位學程博一新生至少在2個實驗室做輪轉並繳交學習報告，每次輪轉時間至少為三個半月，最長 不應超過一 學期。輪轉指導 教師可以是學程核心教師（https://bai.site.nthu.edu.tw/p/426-1523-1.php），亦可是清華內相關專 業的任何老師。若選學程外老師，通知學程主任取得同意後，使得做實驗室輪轉。學生可以選擇做三次以上輪轉，但三次以上 （含三次）不算學分，雖然原則上不鼓勵超過三次，但若有特殊情況，經學生提出後，可由主任判斷是否同意實施這輪轉。 若該生進學程前曾經是受過某老師一個學期以上的指導 （所以已至少相處過一學期），在師生共同簽名同意下，可以免除該生 進行 Lab Rotation，但多出的兩學分要去選修其他的專業課程。 教學目的說明：我們的Lab Rotation及雙導師制可以幫助學生有深度地接觸超過一位指導教授及該老師的數位研究生，這對該生的學術文 化的認知形成有幫助。在不少歐美一流研究大學Lab Rotate是預設的選項，師生四至七年的相處時間相當長，一兩面之緣決定未來數年的 師生關係，或某個專業領域是否合適，能有個一個學期的緩衝與評估，對專業選擇及甚至畢業年線縮短都有幫助。

briefs.name: 分子模擬與建模二
briefs.tags: molecular simulation, molecular dynamics simulation, statistical mechanics, numerical methods, optimization, sampling methods, free energy, 分子模擬, 分子動力學模擬, 統計力學, 數值方法, 最適化, 取樣方法, 自由能
briefs.desc: “Molecular Simulation and Modeling II (MD II)” is part of a two-course sequence (MD I and MD II) designed for students who wish to develop a deep and fundamental understanding of biomolecular simulations. This course is a direct continuation of MD I and taking the first course is strongly recommended. MD II builds upon the theoretical concepts introduced in MD I and proceeds to topics that require that background knowledge. Because the pace of the course depends on the level of understanding of the class, the exact coverage may vary from year to year. In general, MD II discusses topics such as force fields, coarse-grained models, long-range interactions, free-energy calculations, and enhanced sampling methods. Together, these topics provide students with the theoretical and algorithmic foundation needed to understand how biomolecular simulations work and how various simulation techniques are applied in practice.

briefs.tags: Artificial intelligence, biomedical sensors, smart biomaterials, data science, bioimaging, structural biology, neural science, biomedical imaging.
briefs.desc: Brief Course Description (required) BAI Colloquium delves into the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) and high-performance computing across scientific and biomedical domains, e.g., brain-machine interfaces, biosensors, precision medicine. Domain experts (Scholars and key opinion leader from industry) will be invited to give a talk, followed by Q&A.

briefs.name: 高等醫材分析技術
briefs.tags: Instrumental analytical methods, Spectrochemical Analysis, Mass Spectroscopy, Gas Chromatography, Surface Characterization by Spectroscopy and Microscopy.
briefs.desc: This course is divided into 2 semesters, including basic analytical theory (I) and instrumental analytical methods (II). Semester Two introduces fundamental concepts of analytical chemistry with an emphasis on the approaches based on instrumental measurements for bio-materials. Topics include Spectrochemical Analysis, Mass Spectroscopy, Gas Chromatography, and Surface Characterization by Spectroscopy and Microscopy.

briefs.name: 重點照護檢驗
briefs.tags: Point-of-care Diagnostics, Microtechnology, Blood Chemistry, Disease, Biomedical Engineering
briefs.desc: How to achieve accurate diagnoses–the first step in both appropriate prevention and treatment of specific diseases–has been a longstanding but interesting issue in medicine. With recent technological advances in multiple research fields such as materials science, micro-/nano- technology, cellular and molecular biology and bioengineering, much attention is shifting toward the development of new diagnostic tools that address needs not only for high sensitivity and specificity but fulfill economic, environmental, and rapid point-of-care needs for groups and individuals with constrained resources and, possibly, limited training. Microtechnologies, in particular, are considered very powerful tools for the diagnosis and monitoring of human diseases. Miniaturized fluidics-based platforms that precisely manipulate tiny body fluid volumes can be used for medical or healthcare diagnosis in a rapid and accurate manner. These diagnostic technologies are potentially

briefs.name: 再生醫學與組織工程
briefs.tags: 再生醫學, 組織工程, 幹細胞, 生醫材料, 細胞區位, regenerative medicine, tissue engineering, stem cells, biomaterials, niche
briefs.desc: This course introduces the integration of biology and engineering in the fields of regenerative medicine and tissue engineering. Students will learn how scientific principles and engineering strategies are applied to restore, maintain, or replace damaged tissues and organs. The course covers foundational concepts, key methodologies, biomaterials, and cell-based technologies, along with current advances and emerging applications in regenerative medicine.

briefs.name: 分子生醫影像導論
briefs.tags: 分子影像, 電腦斷層, 磁振造影, 放射性影像, molecular imaging, CT, MRI, PET, SPECT
briefs.desc: 本門課程旨在介紹分子影像技術及其應用。在課程中將由淺入深依序介紹(1)分子影像基礎概念，(2)螢光與近紅外光分子 影像技術及治療，(3)X光分子影像技術及治療，(4)放射性分子影像技術及治療，(5)磁振造影， This class aims to introduce the molecular imaging and its application. The following topics will be taught and discussed in this class: (1) basic introduction to molecular imaging, (2) fluorescence & near infrared (NIR) molecular imaging & therapy, (3) X-ray molecular imaging & therapy, (4) radioactive molecular imaging & therapy, (5) magnetic resonance imaging

briefs.name: 磁性生醫材料
briefs.tags: 磁性材料, 磁振造影, 磁導引藥物載體, 過高熱, 生醫檢測, magnetic materials, MRI, magnetic-guided drug delivery, hyperthemia, biosensor
briefs.desc: 本門課程旨在介紹磁性材料及其於生物醫學工程方面的應用性。在課程中將由淺入深依序介紹(1)磁性材料，(2)磁性材 料於磁振造影的應用，(3)磁性材料於磁導引藥物載體的應用，(4)磁性材料於過高熱的應用，(5)磁性材料於生醫檢測的 應用。最後也將特別介紹具孔洞性的磁性材料及其應用。 This class aims to introduce the magnetic materials and their biomedical application. The following topics will be taught and discussed in this class: (1) magnetic materials, (2) application of magnetic materials in MRI, (3) application of magnetic materials in magnetic- guided drug delivery, (4) application of magnetic materials in hyperthemia, (5) application of magnetic materials in biosensor. Porous magnetic materials will also be discussed in this class.

briefs.nameEn: Numerical analysis of intelligent precision biomedical sensing and journal article writing
briefs.tags: Extracellular vesicle analysis, AI immunofluorescence generation, microfluidics, neuroimaging
briefs.desc: 本課程包含三項目，如何進行科學論文撰寫、生物奈米粒子分析及AI輔助醫療影像診斷之相關文獻閱讀分析，內容包括AI多重 免疫螢光生成、微流體、CRISPR感測、神經血管影像診斷效能、深度學習技術、外泌體分子指紋辨識等。

briefs.desc: This course aims to familiarize students with cutting-edge technologies and key challenges in cell-based regenerative therapies. In addition to lectures, weekly paper discussions will promote deeper engagement with the material. Furthermore, students will have the opportunity to present their weekly experimental findings related to cell therapy, enhancing their practical understanding and critical thinking skills.

briefs.name: 生醫高分子材料
briefs.tags: Polymer, Biomedical, Hydrogel, Tissue engineering, drug delivery
briefs.desc: Polymeric materials are widely used in diverse biomedical applications. Understanding the principles of polymer synthesis and characterization is essential for designing polymers tailored to specific biomedical needs. In this course, we will cover several classes of polymeric materials, including nanoparticles, coatings, and hydrogels. The primary goal is to understand how polymer structure and design influence material properties and, in turn, affect their interactions with biological systems. By exploring these relationships, we can better engineer polymers for applications such as drug delivery, tissue engineering, and biomedical device development.

In this class, we will essentially introduce geometrical optics and wave optics. In geometrical optics, ray-tracing, lens design, basic optical instruments will be covered. In wave optic, wave equations, interference, diffraction, image formation, coherence, polarization will be discussed.

This course will introduce those metabolic molecules and energy conversion methods in these organisms to help understand the basic operations of cellular metabolism. Students are required to have taken the class of Biochemistry I and Organic chemistry prior to register for this class.

Its concepts are used to explain and interpret observations on the physical and chemical properties of matter. Physical chemistry is also essential for developing and interpreting the modern techniques used to determine the structure and properties of matter. The course will focus on the topics of change and structure.

briefs.desc: 本課程旨在透過「聯合國氣候變化綱要公約」(UNFCCC) 於2025年11月第30屆峰會(COP30)，在巴西貝倫市重申落實《巴黎協 定》(Paris Agreement) 減碳救地球免於暖化威脅，唯減碳行動有共識卻毫無執行能力，僅期望於本世紀內的全球均溫較工業 革命前增加幅度不再超過1.5°C。目前因工業化排碳造成的全球暖化，較工業革命前的年均溫早已超過攝氏1.5°C

briefs.desc: The course aims to provide a multidisciplinary scope of biophotonics for health care. Basic knowledge is provided for students can rapidly acquire the necessary background for fundamental research, and the wide spectrum of biomedical applications will be discussed to strengthen the capacity of bioinstrument development. Course starts from fundamental optics, including geometrical optics and wave propagation. Basic cell biology is introduced from biophysical perspective. Various microscopies (FREP, LSCM, optical tweezers), optical biosensors (SPR, Fiber, fluorescence sensing), and photodynamic therapy in clinics will be covered.

briefs.name: 藥物控制釋放
briefs.tags: drug delivery, targeting, pharmacokinetics, cancer therapy, controlled release, nanomedicine
briefs.desc: This course is to provide the students an introduction to the fundamental concepts of controlled drug delivery systems, types of drug carriers that have been and/or are being developed and, particularly, detail descriptions in both the preparation approaches and mechanisms of their actions to achieve drug controlled delivery. For comprehensively understanding the rationales of drug delivery design with desired biodistribution profiles, pharmacokinetics and biopharmaceutics are partially introduced in this course.

briefs.name: 生醫高分子應用
briefs.tags: biomaterials, polymer, functional materials.
briefs.desc: The aim of the course is to provide detailed knowledge of the structure, function, properties and applications of biopolymers. Polymer Physics and chemistry for some biological structures such as collagen, soft tissue, silk, and artificial polymer is emphasized. The concept of nature as a model for polymeric materials is discussed. Thinking design ability established. Be a maker by your brain and head.

briefs.name: 分子影像藥物

briefs.desc: 利用正子放射藥物配合正子斷層掃描攝影，對病患進行正子斷層造影，得到的分子影像可以提供臨床醫師或基礎研究，分子層面 的資訊，進一步協助醫師及科學家瞭解致病的機轉，以訂定治療方針。 本課程從正子放射性同位素的生產到正子放射藥物的開發、正子放射藥物在臨床上的應用及正子放射藥物在的品管分析等，做一 一介紹。

briefs.desc: This course covers the process of designing and developing Medical devices, with a focus on Imaging Instruments. The goals are: 1) to provide a complete overview of the medical device life cycle; 2) to revise imaging principals for each main Medical imaging modalities; 3) to understand the role phantoms play in system characterization and image quality analysis, i.e. spatial resolution, contrast, FOV, homogeneity, temporal resolution etc.; 4) software analysis for each of these characteristics would be discussed, and the various assessment metrics considered. This course will be taught in English.

briefs.desc: 課程內容以熱量輸送及質量輸送之理論及相關之操作為主。熱量輸送部分，包括：傳導、對流與輻射。接著介紹與熱量輸送有關 之單元操作，包括：沸騰與冷凝、蒸發，以及熱輸送裝置。質量輸送部分，包括：擴散質量輸送與對流質量輸送。接著敘述質量 輸送之單元操作，包括吸收與氣提、調濕與涼水、蒸餾、萃取、乾燥、結晶，以及薄膜分離等。

briefs.name: 輸送現象及單元操作二
briefs.tags: 能量傳送、熱傳導、熱對流、質量傳送、邊界層理論 energy transport, heat conduction, convection, mass transport, boundary layer theory
briefs.desc: 一、課程說明(Course Description) 課程內容以能量與質量傳送之理論及相關之操作為主，包括：物質導熱度與擴散係數之介紹、shell energy and mass balances、非恆溫混合物系統之連續方程式、運動方程式、能量方程式及質量平衡方程式之建立、在turbulent flow 中之能量及質量傳送、邊界層理論、界面能量與質量傳送、熱傳與質傳係數及巨觀能量與質量平衡。 二、指定用書(Text Books) “Transport Phenomena”, R.B.Bird, E.N.Lightfoot, W.E.Stewart 三、參考書籍(References) 王茂齡”輸送現象”, S. Middleman, “An Introduction to mass and heat transfer” 四、教學方式(Teaching Method) 3/4 lecture, 1/4 discussion session 五、教學進度(Syllabus) Heat transfer, mass transfer 六、成績考核(Evaluation) Home Work 16% 3 exams 28% each

briefs.name: 電子構裝技術與材料
briefs.tags: 電子構裝, 材料, 積體電路, 封裝, 印刷電路板, 軟銲; electronic packaging, materials, IC, packaging, PCB, soldering
briefs.desc: Electronic packaging is to connect integrated circuits and other electronic components together in a system so that the designed functions of the system can be performed. The electronic packaging industry belongs to the latter part of the electronic industry, and is interdependent with the integrated circuit manufacturing industry. This course introduces the manufacturing processes and materials used in electronic packaging, so that students have an understanding of the field of electronic packaging. In the future, students can use this foundation, plus their own original expertise, as the starting point for entry and contribution to the field of electronic industry.

briefs.name: 光電材料與元件基礎
briefs.nameEn: Fundamentals of Optoelectronic Materials and Devices
briefs.tags: optoelectronics, device, LED, solar cells, laser
briefs.desc: 教育化工系的同學，使認識光電材料與光電元件的基礎及其製程，俾便未來運用化學工程技術在這些相關的產業之中。內容主 要分為三大部分: 光電材料與元件基本原理, 無機光電材料與元件、有機光電材料與元件。

briefs.name: 專題研究一
briefs.tags: 專題研究
briefs.desc: 在指導老師指導下，進行不同領域之研究工作，以建立對該領域知識與技術之深入瞭解。特別有興趣之同學可在三下暑假開始前 選定指導教授，以便利用課餘進行研究工作。同學應於當學期末提出研究成果報告。

briefs.name: 專題研究二
briefs.tags: 專題研究
briefs.desc: 在指導老師指導下，進行不同領域之研究工作，以建立對該領域知識與技術之深入瞭解。特別有興趣之同學可在三下暑假開始前 選定指導教授，以便利用課餘進行研究工作。同學應於當學期末提出研究成果報告。

briefs.name: 分子工程二
briefs.tags: 分子工程, 奈米材料, 奈米製程, 能源轉換, 元件製程, 軟性材料與電子, Molecular design, nanometer material, nanometer structure process, energy conversion technology, device fabrication, soft materials and electronics
briefs.desc: Molecular Engineering (I) and (II) are the required courses for the master program of Molecular Engineering Program in the College of Engineering. The comprehensive contents of this course are to introduce the four points, control structure for supermolecular, photoconductive molecular, molecular rheology with precision machining and molecular simulation. The course aims to integrate talents of students from various, particularly the molecular engineering science then develop the basis of the interdisciplinary or R & D talent. Molecular Engineering (I) includes Quantum principle and photoconductive properties. Molecular Engineering (II) is major Molecular design, nanometer material, nanometer structure process, energy conversion technology, and device fabrication from bottom-up and top-down.

briefs.name: 化工原理二
briefs.tags: thermodynamics, kinetics, catalysis, mass and energy balances, reactions
briefs.desc: 課程共分為兩個部份: 化工熱力學及反應工程。目的在於簡要介紹給非化工系同學, 使其了解化 學工程學科中間熱力學以及反應工程兩部分的基本原理與應用. 配合上學期的化工原理一建構 成化學工程的核心知識.

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: 專題演講，科技發展，尖端技術，能源議題，化工創新應用
briefs.desc: 本課程將邀請各領域的專家、學者、工商界人士到系上演講，並提供系上博士班學生公開演講的機會，期盼他人淬鍊出的寶貴經 驗，能強化學生思考之深度及廣度。

briefs.name: 電化學分析技術與應用
briefs.tags: 電化學, 電分析, 文獻導讀, 文獻報告, 電化學應用
briefs.desc: 本課程主要在介紹電化學與電化學分析方法, 首先藉由電化學基本觀念的說明，引導學生進入電化學與電化學分析相關之研 究；其次介紹各種電化學分析方法與技巧，最後希望透過文獻導讀與報告，讓學生瞭解電化學分析方法與應用 本課程無涉及AI使用。

briefs.name: 實驗設計與品質工程
briefs.tags: 統計, 變異數分析, 品質工程, 實驗設計, 研究與報告
briefs.desc: 由統計與變異數分析(ANOVA)的概念，引導學生進入品質工程與實驗設計之方法與規劃；最後透過實際進行實驗設計之研究 與報告，讓學生瞭解與體驗實驗設計之方法與規劃。 本課程無涉及AI使用 Not applicable

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文研究, Thesis
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 數據科學及AI的原理與應用
briefs.nameEn: Principles and Applications of Data Science and AI
briefs.tags: Machine Learning; Artificial Intelligence; Regression; Classification; Optimization; Image Modeling; Language Modeling; Generative AI;
briefs.desc: Introduces the modern machine learning methods used for numeric prediction, classification and generative AI. Key algorithms, performance metrics, and modeling issues as well as real-world applications will be covered. The first part of the course introduces modeling of structured data. The second part discusses modeling of unstructured data such as images, languages, and generative AI using deep learning neural networks. AI's impact on society, the latest development of AI Agents and AI's outlook in the near future will also be discussed.

briefs.name: 高分子分析技術
briefs.tags: Polymer Characterization; Molecular Weight Determination; Thermal Properties, Chemical Structures; Physical Structures
briefs.desc: This class aims to give the fundamentals of polymer characterization for the understandings of structure/property relationship so as to build up the strengths for the applications of polymer materials in different research areas.

briefs.name: 高等高分子物理
briefs.tags: 高分子鏈構形、高分子溶液熱力學、高分子玻璃轉化現象、高分子結晶學、高分子黏彈性 polymer chain conformation, polymer solution thermodynamics, glass transition, crystallization, viscoelasticity
briefs.desc: 本課程主要講解高分子的基本物理特性，內容包括：(1)高分子鏈構形統計力學、(2)高分子溶液熱力學、(3)高分子玻璃轉化 現象、(4)高分子結晶形態學、(5)高分子結晶熱力學與動力學、(6)高分子黏彈性 This course aims to assist students with little or no prior background in polymer science in developing a fundamental understanding of polymer physics. It will cover the essential principles that can be exploited to elucidate the structure-property relationships of polymers. We will also briefly discuss the recent developments in pertinent topics to ignite students' curiosity and motivate them to participate in the research within or related to the domain of polymer physics. This course will cover the essential concepts for understanding the physical properties of polymers. Specific topics to be covered include (1) conformational statistics of single chain, (2) polymer solution thermodynamics, (3) glass transition, (4) polymer crystallization, and (5) viscoelasticity.

briefs.name: 高分子加工
briefs.tags: 高分子加工 Polymer Processing, 輸送現象 Transport Phenomena, 押出成型 Extrusion Processing, 射出成型 Injection Molding, 尺度分析 Dimensional Analysis / Scaling
briefs.desc: 本課程旨在協助研究生建立高分子加工之核心理論基礎，並能將輸送現象與製程模型化技術有效連結至實際應用。課程將以高分 子材料在加工過程中的流動、加熱、熔融、固化與成形行為為主軸，從基礎的因次分析、尺度化思維，到高分子特有的本構關係 與動量、能量平衡式推導，循序帶領學生理解複雜製程背後的物理意涵。進一步將探討多種加工製程的模型化方法，包括單螺桿 押出、押出模頭、薄膜與膜片拉伸、壓延、射出成形、非等溫流動，以及熔融—固化行為之解析解建構。課程最終目標為培養學 生具備以科學及工程方法分析製程、理解材料行為、並能針對實際問題建立或簡化模型之能力。

briefs.name: 膠體界面科學與科技特論
briefs.nameEn: Introduction to Colloid and Interface Science & Technology
briefs.tags: colloid, aerosol, nanoparticle, stability, interface, nanotechnology
briefs.desc: The course is designed to provide basic understanding of colloid and interface science for students with interests of nanomaterial-manufactured products and their applications in the fields of chemical engineering.

briefs.name: 材料相平衡
briefs.tags: 材料, 相平衡, 熱力學, 相圖, 多元系統; materials, phase equilibria, thermodynamics, phase diagrams, multi-component system
briefs.desc: The objective of this course is understanding the principles and applications of multi-component phase equilibria of materials. The topics include phase diagrams of one, two and three component systems, thermodynamic principles governing phase equilibria, liquidus projection and applications of phase equilibria.

briefs.name: 金屬奈米材料
briefs.tags: metal nanomaterials; Nucleation Theory; Nanocrystal Structure and Property; Diffusion
briefs.desc: This course covers the fundamentals of noble-metal nanomaterials and their chemistry. It emphasizes the chemical synthesis, characterization, and applications of noble-metal nanomaterials. Students will learn the nucleation and growth processes involved in the synthesis of noble-metal nanomaterials; the structure-dependent property of noble-metal nanomaterials; the major properties that include physical, chemical, and catalytic properties of noble-metal nanomaterials. Students will also undertake more in- depth courses in specialized areas within nanomaterial science and engineering.

briefs.name: 電化學能源
briefs.tags: 電化學electrochemistry, 一次電池primary battery, 二次電池secondary battery,能源供應energy supply, 染料敏化電池dye-sensitized cell
briefs.desc: 介紹常見電化學電池組成、運作原理以及應用，並介紹台灣能源供給於使用的概況

briefs.name: 工業微生物學
briefs.tags: 細菌學，微生物分類，代謝，發酵，抗生素，基因，食品與環境應用
briefs.desc: 介紹關於微生物及生化學之基礎知識以利不熟悉生物科技領域的工程研究者可以深入淺出了解 生物化學工程體系和應用，內容包括微生物之基本特性包括分類，細菌、酵母及黴菌之簡介， 發酵生理及代謝、突變及育種。另外，簡介生物技術的傳統工業利用以及最新的發展概況。

briefs.name: 分子生物技術
briefs.tags: 分子生物學, 基因工程, 蛋白質表現系統、疫苗工程、基因治療及免疫療法, molecular biology, genetic engineering, protein expression system, vaccine engineering, gene therapy and immunotherapy
briefs.desc: 此課程將會介紹基本生物學, 分子生物學, 基因工程,、蛋白質表現系統、轉植基因動物、疫苗工程、基因治療及免疫療法等方 面之應用。期末將以期末報告代替考試，期許學生能整合上課所學知識，以口頭及簡報呈現完整之報告。 This course covers fundamental cell biology, molecular biology, genetic engineering as well as applications in protein expression, vaccine engineering, gene therapy and immunotherapy, etc.

briefs.desc: This course is a second semester, accelerated, first-year college chemistry course. The goals are: 1) to build your skills in problem-solving, mathematical, and analytical reasoning, and 2) to build your knowledge of the fundamental chemical principles of atomic and molecular structure, kinetics, and thermodynamics. In this class, we will apply these principles to condensation-hydrolysis reactions and acid-base reactions.

briefs.tags: 有機化學實驗，專業實作，專業儀器操作，Organic experiment, Techniques and Experiments for Organic Chemistry
briefs.desc: 本課程是有機化學專業實作科目，基於實作安全及難度考量，修習前須經過普化實驗之基礎訓練。本課程將連結實驗、儀器 及生活應用，目的在訓練學生獨立思考完成實作，將實驗結果利用儀器進行分析並和生活應用連結。 1.選擇新奇有趣及生活 化的教材：使用原文教學實驗課本，加強學生閱讀外語文章及熟悉化學專業用語。選新奇有趣及生活 化 的實驗(如從天然物 裡取得有用的純化物、生化藥物抗生素之全合成、化學鑑定所使用魯米諾的合成及放光等)，激發學生 做實驗的興趣並能更 有切身的體會。 2.嚴謹扎實的實驗訓練及經驗的傳承：有機實驗基本技巧是所有實驗的根本，加強訓練基礎技巧。督促學生 邊實驗邊思考問 題 及預判可能發展性，才能養成其從事研究之獨立思考能力。加強實作經驗的傳承，連想思考研究方向及 知道如何開始著 手解決問題。 3.藥品安全與增添特殊器材增廣見識：養成學生閱讀藥品性質的習慣，隨時閱讀該藥品性質 及知悉其危險性，增加使用藥品 安全性。

briefs.name: 物理化學二
briefs.tags: 量子化學、Quantum Chemistry, Schrodinger equation, hydrogen atom, perturbation theory.
briefs.desc: This course provides the foundation required for studies in physical chemistry. The content will include Quantum Chemistry, Schrodinger equation, particle in 1D and 3D box, hydrogen atom, many-electron atoms, and perturbation theory.

briefs.name: 物理化學實驗一
briefs.tags: Electrolyte Solution，Tension， Vapor Pressure，.Reaction Kinetics
briefs.desc: 本系所開設之”物理化學實驗”課，乃為配合大學部物理化學課程所開設的進階實驗課程。其宗旨為希望能藉由實際的實驗操作 到基本電學及光學儀器之使用，來印證課堂上所學習之理論，特別是肉眼無法看到又特別難以理解的量子力學現象，也可在實 驗中獲得驗證。因此在實驗設計上分別包括: 熱力學實驗、動力學實驗、電化學實驗及量子力學實驗，以期能提 升學生對未來 從事高等研究的創造力與觀察力。

briefs.name: 化學數學
briefs.tags: Ordinary differential equations (常微分方程), Fourier series (傅利葉級數), Integral transforms (積分變換)
briefs.desc: This course is a continuation of CHEM2930 Applied Mathematics. It covers a variety of topics in applied mathematics. The main topics include ordinary differential equations, systems of ordinary differential equations, Fourier series, and integral transforms. The goal is to prepare students for advanced studies in all areas of science and engineering. Examples will be drawn from a variety of scientific and mathematical areas.

briefs.name: 分析化學二
briefs.tags: chemical analysis, chromatography, mass spectrometry, optical spectrometry, instrumental analysis
briefs.desc: This course covers the main instrumental analysis techniques used by chemists in the 21st century.

briefs.name: 分析化學實驗二
briefs.desc: 同學組團合作一起學習儀器操作與應用

briefs.name: 分析化學實驗二
briefs.desc: 同學組團合作一起學習儀器操作與應用

briefs.name: 光譜分析
briefs.tags: 有機分子(organic molecules), 核磁共振光譜(Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy), 質譜(Mass Spectroscopy), 紫外光光譜(Ultraviolet Spectroscopy), 遠紅外光譜(Infrared Spectroscopy)
briefs.desc: 此選修課程內容為光譜分析，尤其著重在如何以光譜知識做為工具，對未知分子進行結構鑑定與分析。課程目標為使學生在習得 有機化學知識後，能對化合物的結構分析有更詳細深入的了解及實作經驗，以助於將來在化學相關領域之應用。

briefs.name: 當代化學論壇
briefs.tags: Organic Chemistry, Inorganic Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Physical Chemistry, Material Chemistry, Biochemistry
briefs.desc: 此課程每週安排2位化學系教授上課。課程內容為化學系專任與合聘教授講授各實驗室研究領域，並視情況安排參觀實驗室。讓 學生更了解系上教授研究領域以擬定未來實驗專題方向。

briefs.name: 光譜分析實驗
briefs.tags: 希夫鹼合成(Schiff base synthesis)、親核性醯基取代(acyl substitution)、環化加成(cyclopropanation)、耦合反應(Sonogashira cou[pling))
briefs.desc: Will focus on synthetic skill training and instruction. Isolation and purification of final products by column chromatography and/or re-crystallization. proton, carbon-13, 2-D correlation NMR analysis to characterize the structures. 31P NMR or 19F NMR may also be taken.

briefs.name: 無機化學二
briefs.tags: 過渡金屬、配位化學、配位化合物、有機金屬化學、有機金屬化合物、結構、鍵結理論、應用
briefs.desc: 無機化學二教授過渡金屬的配位化學與有機金屬化學的理論與這兩類化合物的應用。以普化，無機一和物化知識為基礎，學生可 學習過渡金屬元素的多元性，比較過渡金屬元素與主族元素的異與同，增加學生化學領域的視野。

briefs.name: 書報討論二(有機無機組)
briefs.tags: 文獻，報告，表達，思考，討論，投影片
briefs.desc: 利用所學的基本知識了解最新的化學研究，並訓練表達與思考問題的能力。

briefs.name: 書報討論二(物化分析組)
briefs.tags: analytical chemistry, physical chemistry, scientific literature, presentation, discussion
briefs.desc: 英語授課(EMI計畫) The aim of this seminar course is to practice reading scientific literature with understanding, and to present the scientific knowledge to audience.

briefs.name: 專題演講二
briefs.tags: English lecture, chemistry reaction, metal catalyzed reaction, organic synthesis, nature product
briefs.desc: 專題演講課程為化學系邀請國內外知名學者到系上演講，每堂演講請務必簽到並繳交報告。實際上課時間地點視不同講者而定， 依本系公告欄與系網頁公告為準。成績考核方式依簽到及報告繳交次數計算期末成績考核。

briefs.name: 專題研究二
briefs.tags: 專題研究
briefs.desc: 專題研究課程為由教授與學生擬定研究題目，於教授研究室學習各種研究技巧，解決研究上遭遇之問題。以進行論文研究，培 養解決化學問題的能力。

briefs.name: 教學實習二
briefs.tags: 教學實習
briefs.desc: 教導並訓練學生如何準備實驗課與授課

briefs.name: 同步輻射應用
briefs.desc: 教學目標： 同步輻射光源是廿一世紀尖端科學研究的實驗利器之一，在化學、物理、材料、生醫與醫學檢測、綠色能源、古生物、地質 與環保、微機械等基礎及應用科學研究，世界各國也因而紛紛完成或興建不同電子能量的同步加速器產生更寬廣、強度更強 及同調性更佳的同步輻射光源，目前已有利用同步輻射光源建構而成的X光自由電子雷射（X-ray Free Electron Laser, XFEL）進行更尖端的科學研究。在亞太洲地區台灣、日本（有12座同步輻射設施，其中以大型同步輻射設施Spring 8及自由 電子雷射設施、韓國（浦項加速器實驗室及自由電子雷射設施PAL-XFEL）、中國大陸（北京、上海及合肥）、泰國、新加 坡、澳洲、約旦及印度均有大型同步輻射加速器光源的研究設施進行尖端的研究。 本課程的主要目標在於帶領年輕學子認識在全球科技的競爭中，同步輻射光源的尖端科學研究及應用扮演著非常重要的角 色，藉由本課程的教學希望年輕學子能認識同步輻射光源為科學研究的重要工具之一，希望未來能利用同步輻射光源做出影 響深遠的重大科學發現。

briefs.name: 生物物理化學
briefs.tags: protein folding, protein structure, protein dynamics, biophysical methods, ESR
briefs.desc: This course provides an in-depth exploration of the principles and applications of electron spin resonance (ESR) spectroscopy in biological and biophysical research. This course is designed for students pursuing or currently engaged in research within the fields of biophysics, structural biology, or physical chemistry. Completion of Physical Chemistry I-II or equivalent coursework is required.

briefs.name: 蛋白質結構與化學
briefs.tags: 胺基酸, 胜肽合成, 化學耦合, 蛋白質結構和摺疊, 膜蛋白, Amino acid, peptide synthesis, chemical ligation, protein structure and folding, membrane proteins
briefs.desc: 討論蛋白質結構與摺疊基本概念, 並介紹蛋白質相關的化學, 包括胺基酸化學, 胜肽合成和修飾, 膜蛋白性質與功能 The following topics will be discussed in the lectures: Protein Structure and Folding, Amino Acid and Peptide Chemistry, the Properties and Functions of Membrane Proteins

briefs.name: 電化學方法：導論及應用
briefs.tags: Butler-Volmer Equation (巴特勒-福爾默方程), Tafel Plots (塔菲爾圖), Cyclic Voltammetry, Bulk Electrolysis (整批電解法), Hydrodynamic Voltammetry (流體動力學伏安法)
briefs.desc: This course is intended to provide an introductory but thorough background in electrochemistry. Fundamentals, methods, and applications of electrochemistry to independent research will be covered. The course is intended to be an introductory graduate-level course on electrochemistry and electrochemical methods. This course will blend the theory of electrochemistry with electrochemical characterization methods and applications of electrochemistry in research. 1. The basic theory of potentiometric and dynamic voltammetric measurement (30%). 2. The electrical double-layer structure and the theoretical description of the kinetics of chemical and electrochemical processes occurring at the electrode surface (30%). 3. Applications of electrochemical methods in independent research (40%).

briefs.name: 金屬醫藥化學與生醫材料
briefs.tags: 金屬(metal)、生物(biology)、醫藥(medicine)、材料(material)、酵素(enzyme)
briefs.desc: 本門課程旨在(1)回顧四大生物分子及基礎無機化學、(2)金屬酵素功能以及作用機制介紹、(3)臨床使用金屬生物醫藥介紹、 (4)金屬生物醫藥及生醫材料的設計與開發。於學期末則安排由學 生挑選相關主題，進行口頭報告。 This class aims to (1) review four kinds of biomolecules and basic inorganic chemistry, (2) function and reaction mechanism of metalloenzymes, (3) introduction of FDA-approved metallopharmaceutics, (4) design and development of metal- based biomedicine and biomaterials. In the end of the semester, students have to choose a topic and give an oral presentation relevant to the metal pharmaceutical chemistry & biomaterial.

briefs.name: 生物無機化學
briefs.tags: bioinorganic; enzyme; mechanism; model compounds; physical methods
briefs.desc: The aim of this course is to train MS and PhD program students in organizing and presenting scientific materials and results. In addition, it may help students to promote their research.

briefs.name: 生物有機反應機構
briefs.tags: 生物有機反應機構 英文: Bioorganic Reaction Mechanism
briefs.desc: 生物有機反應機構 Bioorganic Reaction Mechanism

briefs.name: 高等生物化學
briefs.tags: Advanced Biochemistry, Biological Molecules, Molecular Interactions, Kinetics and Catalysis, Assembly and Activity
briefs.desc: 以化學系主修的學生為出發點，從分子的角度來探討生物化學，了解化學在生命科學裡扮演的角色，進而思索化學在生命科學研 究中所具有的優勢與適於發揮的層面。

briefs.name: 生醫分析
briefs.tags: Chromatography, Electrophoresis, Mass Spectrometry, Spectroscopic Methods, Immunoassays
briefs.desc: Bioanalytical chemistry is a sub-discipline of analytical chemistry that involves the separation, detection, identification and quantification of biological samples in different settings. It often involves the study of molecules such as proteins, peptides, DNA and drugs.

briefs.name: 電化學實驗
briefs.tags: Cyclic Voltammetry (循環伏安法), Differential Pulse Voltammetry (微分脈衝伏安法), Open Circuit Potential (開路電位), Organic Electrocatalysis (有機電催化), Electrochemical Simulation (電化學模擬)
briefs.desc: In CHEM504600, students learn the fundamental theoretical concepts underlying electrochemistry. This lecture course will cover the fundamentals, methods, and applications of electrochemistry in the context of independent research. In this wet lab course, CHEM531500, students will apply their theoretical knowledge in substantial laboratory modules in electrochemistry. CHEM531500 will focus on typical three-electrode electrochemical experiments and laboratory techniques that form the basis for applying electrochemistry in students' own research projects and building basic electrochemistry knowledge and intuition with respect to thermodynamics, kinetics, and mass transport. Electrochemistry laboratories will track theoretical concepts developed in the lecture course for students simultaneously enrolled in both courses.

briefs.name: 固態化學
briefs.tags: crystal structures (晶體結構); crystal synthesis methods (晶體合成方法); facet-dependent properties (晶面效應); materials characterization techniques (材料鑑定方法); phase diagrams (晶相); properties of materials (材料性質)
briefs.desc: This course presents major topics covered by solid state chemistry including crystal structures, structural analysis of crystals, synthesis of nanocrystals and bulk solid materials, property characterization, properties of materials, phase diagrams, and crystal defects. The course also introduces latest development and understanding of semiconductor crystal facets on their electrical, photocatalytic, optical, magnetic, piezoelectric, and organic catalytic properties, as well as the structural origin for the emergence of these behaviors.

briefs.name: 科學計算

briefs.desc: This course aims to present an introduction to numerical methods for solving problems in science. The topics include the numerical solution of nonlinear equations, interpolation, numerical differentiation and integration, systems of linear equations, the method of least squares, and numerical solutions to differential equations.

briefs.name: Ｘ光繞射及晶體結構分析

briefs.desc: 本課程的目標是讓學生掌握無機結構化學的基本概念，並透過學習晶體結構的理論與實踐，進一步理解化學結構與物理性質之間 的關聯。內容涵蓋晶體學基礎、化學結構描述、對稱性、分子與固體的鍵結理論，以及晶體結構數據的分析方法。

briefs.name: 雷射化學及光譜
briefs.tags: laser, spectroscopy, ultrafast laser, optics, photochemistry
briefs.desc: This course is designed for chemistry department graduate students who need practical knowledge in laser technology for their graduate research. The course will cover 1. Laser Fundamentals 2. Types of Lasers 3. High resolution tunable lasers + instrumentation for frequency-resolved laser spectroscopy 4. Nonlinear Optics 5. Introduction to ultrafast lasers + instrumentation for time-resolved laser spectroscopy 6. Laser spectroscopy

briefs.desc: 本課程“觸媒化學”將教授異相催化領域的相關基本知識，內容包括： 1) Introduction to heterogeneous catalysis 2) Adsorption 3) Catalyst characterization 4) Catalyst preparation 5) Catalytic reactors and the measurement of catalytic kinetics 6) Kinetics 7) metal surfaces 8) metal catalysis

briefs.desc: 本課程以反應機制與結構–反應性關聯為主軸，並結合分子軌域理論來理解有機分子在反應中的行為。內容包括能量與反應座 標、動力學與熱力學控制、取代基與溶劑效應、酸鹼性與反應性，以及線性自由能關係、同位素效應與立體電子效應等工具。分 析鍵結、反應性、芳香性與立體選擇性，協助學生用定量、軌域與機構三種視角整合分析有機反應，為進階有機合成與相關研究 奠定基礎。

briefs.desc: 本課程開設目的是確保大學部學生具備「學院知識表述能力」。教師透過選文的精讀指導，帶引學生體察語言形式與表達內容的 關係；透過寫作指導，從「問題意識的形成」到「資料的蒐集運用」到「知識論述」再到「完成報告」。本課程教導學生如何遵 循學院寫作模式，如何尊重他人智慧財產權，確保學生充分知悉相關的學院規範。

briefs.name: 大學中文
briefs.tags: 大學中文 College Chinese
briefs.desc: 本課程開設目的是確保大學部學生具備「學院知識表述能力」。教師透過選文的精讀指導，帶引學生體察語言形式與表達 內容 的關係；透過寫作指導，從「問題意識的形成」到「資料的蒐集運用」到「知識論述」再到「完成報告」。本課程教 導學生如 何遵循學院寫作模式，如何尊重他人智慧財產權，確保學生充分知悉相關的學院規範。

briefs.name: 詩選
briefs.tags: 古典詩平仄格律,章法,習作討論,漢魏六朝詩,唐宋詩
briefs.desc: 本課程透過有系統的古典詩教學，讓中文系本科生擁有古典詩的創作技巧及鑒賞能力。課程中對古典詩之體式，包括平仄、格律、用韻、章法， 均作詳細說明，對絕句、律詩的創作法則亦分別作深入講解，並將詩篇賞鑒融入其中；上課中所教授之相關創作方法、理論，在名家詩作中可立 即印證。學生在體會名作佳篇之情意內容、獲取美感經驗的同時，對歷代重要詩學觀念、古典詩的形式內涵、詩中語言、聲律、情景……等元素的 掌握和運用，皆能有所會心。 修習本課程學生需進行古典詩（主要是近體七絕和七律）的習作，除透過教師個別指導外，學期中會有若干課堂討論，同學在自己的創作經驗 和評賞過程中，可以充分掌握進入古典詩苑圃的金鑰。

briefs.name: 基礎寫作
briefs.tags: 寫作, 描寫, 敘述, 說明, 議論
briefs.desc: 語言文字是人際溝通的基礎、信念傳播與情感表達的媒介，其性質、結構、方法與效能，亦是文學相關科系訓練的核心之一。 「基礎寫作」課程用意並非訓練文學創作能力，而是希望能聚焦在切題、造句、謀篇，訓練學生整合表達知識與意見的基礎文字 能力。

briefs.name: 基礎寫作
briefs.tags: 寫作，閱讀，表達，對話，議論
briefs.desc: 語言文字是人際溝通、信念傳播與情感表達的媒介，其性質、結構、方法與效能，亦是文學相關科系訓練的核心之一。即 使AI工具應用越來越普遍，若自身欠缺良好的閱讀與寫作基礎，也往往難以分辨AI產出文字的品質，遑論能事半功倍地運用。 「基礎寫作」課程用意並非訓練文學創作能力，而是希望能聚焦在切題、造句、謀篇，熟練描寫、敘述、說明四種寫作方法，增 進學生整合表達知識與意見的文字能力，才能進一步談到善用AI而不被AI所役。

briefs.name: 基礎寫作
briefs.tags: 基礎寫作, 現代中文, 描寫, 敘述, 說明, 議論
briefs.desc: 語言文字是人際溝通的基礎、信念傳播與情感表達的媒介，其性質、結構、方法與效能，亦是文學相關科系訓練的核心之一。 「基礎寫作」課程用意並非訓練文學創作能力，而是希望能聚焦在切題、造句、謀篇，訓練學生整合表達知識與意見的基礎文字 能力。

briefs.name: 語言學導論
briefs.tags: 語言本質,語音,音系,構詞,句法,語義
briefs.desc: 本課程從語言本質、語音、音系、構詞、句法和語義等方面解說語言現象，俾使同學對日常賴以思考、表情達意的語言有更系統且深入的認識，同 時具備語言分析的基礎知識與能力。這些知識將可應用於外語學習，以及語言教學。

briefs.name: 漢魏六朝文
briefs.nameEn: The Selected Reading of articles in Six Dynasties
briefs.tags: 六朝,Six Dynasties,文選,Wen Xuan,賦,rhapsody 駢文 parallel prose ,典故,allusion
briefs.desc: 本課程以漢魏六朝文章選讀為主，以求增進對漢魏六朝文的認識與體會，培養古典作品之閱讀能力與素養。

briefs.name: 華語教學通論
briefs.nameEn: Survey of Teaching Chinese as a Second Language
briefs.tags: 華語師資培育 (Mandarin teachers education)，華語文教學現況 (current situation of Teaching Chinese as a Foreign/Second Language)，華語語言學 (Chinese linguistics)，華語文教材 (Mandarin teaching materials)，教學實務(teaching pratice)
briefs.desc: 本課程以培育華語教學師資為主要目標，旨在引導學生掌握國際與臺灣華語文教學的發展現況，使其理解華語語音、詞彙、語法 與漢字教學的基本理論。課程內容亦涵蓋語言發展與習得、華語文測驗與評量、華語文教材編寫的基礎概念，以及華語教師應具 備的專業能力、學識與涵養，並進一步初步培養學生進行一對一教學及編寫教材的實務能力。

briefs.name: 詞選
briefs.tags: 唐宋詞,詞體,詞人,詞史,詞論
briefs.desc: 詞為音樂文學，其體要眇宜修，其內容包羅萬千，寄情寓意，意內言外。本課程為一學期課程，分述唐宋詞之發展，並閱讀 相關詞人作品，期能學習詞體特質，感受詞情。除閱讀詞作，本課程亦指導填詞習作，透過親身創作，體驗詞心之幽微。

briefs.name: 經學名著選讀
briefs.nameEn: Selected Readings in the Five Classics
briefs.tags: 詩經、尚書、禮記、周易、左傳
briefs.desc: 本課程以經學名著選篇閱讀為主，除於期初針對經學史、經學性質做一簡明之介紹外，將按照五經特性，於各經中挑選數篇進行 主題析講。五經與其搭配主題如下：1.《詩經》──生活與家，2.《尚書》──極致與矛盾，3.《禮》──人文，4.《易》──命，5. 《春秋》──事變。

briefs.name: 聲韻學
briefs.tags: 上古音,中古音,近古音,近代音,現代音,語音學
briefs.desc: 「聲韻學」是研究漢語音韻的結構及其演化過程的科學，目的在於了解漢語語音逐步演化的軌跡，並掌握其演變規律。語音 學的工具及方法是學習聲韻學的重要門徑，因此，本課程將先概述語音學的相關知識。然後將由學生最熟悉的現代漢語（國 語）入手，作為了解漢語語音演變的起點，學生將學習以國際音標標注國語音讀，以便與之後古代漢語的擬音溝通比對，理 解其演變狀況。接著依次講授中古漢語（魏晉隋唐）、近古漢語（兩宋）、近代漢語（元明清）、上古漢語（周秦兩漢）的語 音。探究中古漢語的基礎材料之一為《切韻》系的韻書，其系統兼賅古今南北，故可以此為基點，上推古音，下接今音。經 由各時期音韻系統的分析，希望達到的教學目標主要有三方面： 一是使學生了解漢語語音在各時期的不同面貌及其發展規律。 二是使學生認識漢語聲韻學的研究材料、研究方法、基礎知識及術語，並奠定聲韻學研討的根柢。 三是使學生能運用聲韻學的知識到相關的學科及日常生活上，如：解讀古書及出土文獻、欣賞與校勘歷代韻文、深入理解漢 字、從事詩文創作、明瞭現代方言的關係和來源、了解日常字音的問題等。

briefs.name: 杜詩
briefs.tags: 杜甫, 詩, 中國, 古典, 文學史, Du Fu, Poetry, Chinese, Classical, Literary History
briefs.desc: 本課程以研討方式，深入探究中國詩歌傳統中的重要詩人杜甫及其作品，從詩人與時代社會以至詩學傳統的互動出發，結 合文本的細讀，分析杜甫在中國詩史上的地位，以至對後世的影響。

briefs.name: 西遊記
briefs.tags: 西遊記 Journey to the West, 三教 Three teachings, 內丹 Internal alchemy, 禪 Chan, 淨土 Pure Land, 晚明心學 Late Ming Mind Learning, 宗教旅行 Pilgrimage;
briefs.desc: 晚明四大奇書文體形成之後，成為後人撰寫章回小說的典範，影響甚鉅。本課程擇取四大奇書之一的《西遊記》為講授文本，透 過完整閱讀《西遊記》，引導學生理解《西遊記》中豐富的文學義涵與宗教隱喻，並對中國章回小說的發展有更進一步的認識。

briefs.name: 左傳
briefs.tags: 左傳, 春秋, 先秦思想, 史傳文學, Zuo Zhuan /The Commentary of Zuo, Chun Qiu /Spring and Autumn Annals, Thoughts of ancient China, Chinese historical literature
briefs.desc: 本課程為中文系專業選修，將學習《春秋》經傳體系與《左傳》的基本知識與書寫特色，並練習閱讀古代漢語文獻。同時，透 過自行閱讀與報告，練習比較不同角度敘事，培養深入掌握、反思大量資訊的能力。

briefs.name: 進階寫作：劇本創作
briefs.desc: 本課程為培養劇本編寫能力的實作課程，將介紹劇本寫作的基本技巧、規則與方法，同時閱讀討論近當代各國的劇本創作， 以了解劇本創作的潮流發展與風格特色，同時以於學期中完成一部劇本為目標，藉由創作實踐培養劇本寫作必須的觀察、想 像與組織能力。 同時，注重寫作習慣的養成。如何將寫作的熱情和概念想法，轉化成具體的實踐方法，因台灣向來的教育使然，容易把創作 視為靈感所至偶一為之的興趣，難以形成專業，這對創作發展極為不利。在學習歷程中，企圖透過循序漸進的課程安排，體 會創作即生活、作品即態度，能主動且有系統地觀察、蒐集、累積寫作材料，並從而擬定、形成個人的寫作計畫，發展能夠 持之以恆的寫作方式。 最後，以讀劇演出的方式，對本學期中所完成的劇作進行初步的演出執行，讓創作者了解自己的劇本被搬演的可能性，觀察 作品的語言文字在劇場空間的視聽效果，並促進同世代間的寫作交流。

briefs.name: 華語教材教法
briefs.nameEn: Methods and Materials in Chinese Language Teaching
briefs.tags: 華語文教學法(Teaching Methodology)、教學目標(Instructional objectives)、教材情境(Situational Context of Teaching Materials)、教材內容(Content of Teaching Materials)、教學設計(Instructional Design)、練習活動(Practice Activities )、測驗與評量 (Testing and Assessment )
briefs.desc: 本課程基於華語文教師在教學現場應用出版教材所遭遇之限制，精選華語文教材相關研究期刊論文為教材內容，透過導讀論 文了解教材設計理論與編寫之邏輯思維，進而學習分析與評鑑當前華語文出版教材之架構與內容。 此外，課程中將從教學目 標、教材情境、教材內容、教學設計、練習活動、測驗評量與版面編排七大面向著手，學習檢核現行出版之華語文教材，並 透過小組討論與協作方式，共同決策教材修編方向與內容。 總體而言，本課程以華語文教材編寫能力為最終目標。在理論基礎上，除了認識華語文教學法之外，更加著重教材設計相關 理論基礎知識。在教材編寫實務上，藉由現行華語文教材改編的方式，讓小組成員相互合作，集體討論內容素材與活動設 計，修編與完善未來將會在課堂中實際使用之華語文教材。

briefs.name: 中國文學史二
briefs.tags: 中國文學史，詩，古文，詞，小說，
briefs.desc: 本課程講述唐代以後文學史。以文學現象及內在思維的演變及發展為主，兼及部分代表性作品閱讀、分析。除採用臺靜農《中國 文學史》為指定教材用書之外，並將隨時補充近人重要研究著作，以使學生對中國文學之全貌以及精神，有一初步之把握。 另於第一週加入「課程概說：中古與近世：唐宋明清文學的新發展及其意義」，最後一週則略論「近代中國文學的萌芽(兼論台 灣中文系的特殊性)」，使學生對7世紀迄今中國古典文學的發展，以及台灣中文系的地位，可以有更清楚的認知。

briefs.name: 史記
briefs.tags: 史記(Shi Ji), 典型人物(typical character), 漢武帝(Emperor Wu of Han), 紀傳體(history presented in a series of biographies), 司馬遷(Sima Qian)
briefs.desc: 《史記》長久以來一直被視爲第一流的文學作品與歷史作品，而它的文學性與表達社會歷史洞見的歷史性，主要是 透過人物傳記表現出來的。因此司馬遷如何透過人物刻劃，呈現文學性，表達獨特的歷史觀察，就特別值得留意。 司馬遷在人物傳記中創造了「典型人物」，這些典型人物不但是歷史上一個個活生生的真實人物，也是可以見出歷史的 普遍性，是一般與特殊統一的人物典型。讀者若能掌握這些典型人物，不但可以發掘歷史的真實，而且可以預測未來「可能 發生的事」，掌握人類歷史發展中具普遍性的一面，鑒往知來。 本課程除了對《史記》有一整體導論外，透過《史記》的人物分析，可以看到背後呈現的深刻的人性與歷史觀照，看到 各類型的生命在歷史場景中呈現的各種風姿。更重要的是，這些人物也是能反映歷史的普遍性的人物典型。透過史公的妙 筆，這些人物傳記確實顯示了「 更高的真實」──一種未來仍可能發生的真實。讀歷史能到達這個程度，所謂「以史為鑑」或 「讀史使人聰明」，才算有了具體的落實。

briefs.name: 莊子
briefs.tags: 莊子,逍遙遊 ,齊物論,養生主,秋水。Chuang Tzu,Enjoyment in Untroubled Ease,The Adjustment of Controversies,Nourishing the Lord of Life,The Floods of Autumn
briefs.desc: 《莊子》是影響傳統中國士人人生態度最重要的經典，本課程將深入探討《莊子》的價值追求與特殊論述，理解其思想形成的根 源及影響。

briefs.name: 李商隱詩
briefs.tags: 李商隱, 義山,玉谿生
briefs.desc: 本課程旨在講授李商隱重要詩作，並介紹詩人生平、相關歷史背景，期使學生對於李商隱、李商隱詩有一具體而完整之認識。課程中將依詩人各階 段詩作與「未編年詩」，循序講授，以全面了解李商隱的生命歷程；此外，亦將詳細析論李商隱詩之字句、對仗、用典、音律、結構等技巧，並適 時與前、後時代詩人的詩作相比較，以深入體會李商隱詩獨特的藝術魅力。

briefs.name: 中國文學批評
briefs.tags: 文學批評, 傳統文學, 文學理論, 中國文學, 文論
briefs.desc: 本科旨在讓學生認識中國文學批評的發展概況；研習重要的文學理論文本從而提升學生的對傳統文學的分析、鑒賞及批評 能力。

briefs.name: 現代文學理論
briefs.tags: 現代文學，文學理論，文學，文化研究，理論。Modern Chinese Literature, Literary Theory, Literature, Cultural Studies, Theory
briefs.desc: 本課程將以主題的方式，簡介二十世紀各種「理論」影響後，對於現今文學與文化研究仍然切題的若干「理論」視野。透過深入淺出的講解，配合現代文學文本解讀之練習，開拓對於「文學」及「理論」的認識。

briefs.name: 現代散文
briefs.tags: 散文,文學史, 現代性, 文化政治, 選集
briefs.desc: 本課程授課範圍為五四以降的中文現代散文，包含文學史與文類發展的講述，重要散文作家的散篇選讀，並聚焦討論具有經典地 位的特定散文集，和當代議題性散文選集所涉及的文化政治與選文策略。課程內容的設計並非包山包海地展現現代散文發展全 貌，而是嘗試在有限的課程時間中，勾勒文類發展概要，通過預讀筆記和師生共讀，理解傑出散文家的風格與關懷。

briefs.name: 西方當代戲劇選讀
briefs.tags: 現代戲劇,當代戲劇,西方戲劇,歐洲戲劇,劇場製作
briefs.desc: 本課程以二十世紀末至二十一世紀的歐洲劇場為主軸，透過文本細讀與舞台語彙分析，帶領學生掌握當代戲劇如何在語言、敘 事與形式上回應戰爭與創傷、記憶與家庭、媒體社會與人際疏離等核心議題。課程選讀多位重要劇作家：Jean-Luc Lagarce 以迴旋、延宕與自我修正的語言，呈現親密關係中的失語與權力；Joel Pommerat善於在改寫童話與重構現實之間，運用敘 事層次與舞台機制，打造兼具寓言性與當代感的劇場；Jon Fosse以極簡對話、重複與沉默製造時間的壓力，讓存在的焦慮在 微小波動中顯影；Wajdi Mouawad以史詩式敘事與強烈倫理召喚，書寫流亡、戰爭與家族秘密的傳承；Florian Zeller擅長 以精準的戲劇結構與視角錯置，拆解家庭、記憶與認知的裂縫；Sarah Kane以極端、殘酷而詩性的語言，直面暴力、愛與絕 望的極限經驗，讓舞台成為揭露人性深層創傷與渴望的試煉場。課堂將結合讀劇、編寫練習、演出版本比較與短講討論，從角 色建構、敘事技法、節奏與聲音、空間與身體等層面，訓練學生把「讀劇本」轉化為「讀劇場」，並建立可用於觀劇、評論與 研究的分析工具，進而一覽當代西方戲劇多聲道、跨美學的整體風貌。

briefs.name: 跨文化戲劇
briefs.tags: 跨文化,戲劇,表演研究,比較文學,當代劇場,導演
briefs.desc: 本課程以「跨文化戲劇」為核心，探討戲劇如何在不同語言、文化與歷史脈絡之間移動、翻譯、改寫與再生。課程將結合中文 系的文本細讀能力與表演研究的觀演素養，從古典到當代、從東亞到歐洲與全球劇場，分析跨文化交流中的美學轉換、權力關 係與文化想像：例如經典文本在異地被如何「再敘事」、傳統表演（戲曲／民俗儀式）在現代劇場中的轉化、以及翻譯、導 演、演員身體、舞台符號如何共同構成「跨文化」的劇場語言。教學方法包括：關鍵概念導讀（改編、互文、文化挪用與倫 理、東方主義／自我東方化、後殖民視角、全球化與在地化）、案例討論（跨國合製、節慶展演、移民／離散劇場、跨媒介劇 場）、以及小型實作（短段落改編、雙語朗讀與節奏設計、舞台調度的文化符碼實驗）。 期末作業以「分析＋創作」並重。學生可選擇完成一篇跨文化劇場個案研究報告，或以小組形式提出一個跨文化改編／演出企 劃（含文本來源、轉譯策略、角色與美學設定、觀眾溝通與倫理說明）。本課程期望學生能以更精準的概念工具理解跨文化戲 劇的生成機制，並培養將文學閱讀轉化為劇場觀念與創意實踐的能力。

briefs.name: 中國思想史二
briefs.tags: 中國思想，佛學，宋明理學，朱子學，陽明學，考據學
briefs.desc: 本課程以講授中國思想史，自隋唐迄宋元明清之主要思想體系（佛學、朱子學、陽明學、考據學）為主。可瞭解中國思潮的發展 以及其基本議題，包括各思想流派的分合以及核心觀念。

briefs.name: 易經
briefs.tags: 易經,周易,五經,經學,先秦
briefs.desc: 易經為中國哲學之活水源頭，亦為群經之首。歷代重要思潮如兩漢經學、魏晉玄學、宋明理學等等均無不與易學息息相關，其於 吾國思想文化影響，可謂重大深遠。希望藉本課之教學，導引正確之學習方向，以窺易學之堂奧，進而瞭解中國文化，增進個人 智慧。

briefs.name: 第二語言習得
briefs.tags: 第二語言習得、語言學習、語際語言、學習策略、溝通能力
briefs.desc: 本課程內容以介紹第二語言習得相關理論，並以華語文作為二語習得語言的現象加以說明。第二語言習得將探討影響語言習得的因素、有效 的模式與方法，以及相關理論, 包括偏誤分析、中介語研究、認知發展、語言習得過程研究與第二語言能力研究。透過對各項理論的理解， 與研究的探討，了解學習者的需求，並進一步將其有效地運用於語言教學上

briefs.name: 華語文海外研修
briefs.tags: 華語文海外研修,華語文教學
briefs.desc: 本系大學部華語文教學組的同學應修習本課程，申請赴國外大學、海外僑校等相關華語教學及實習機構，進行華語文海外研修。 希望透過交流合作，讓同學們學習海外華語文教學之方法與技巧，並增進華語文教學的實務經驗。

briefs.name: 漢語語法分析
briefs.tags: 層次,變換,語義特徵,配價,語義指向,複句,虛詞
briefs.desc: 本課程提供漢語語法分析知識，以提升同學進行語法分析的能力，進而將所學應用於中文寫作與華語文教學。課程以句子和虛詞為主要的分析對 象。句子分為單句與複句：單句方面側重討論謂語的類型以及漢語語法研究者經常採用的五種分析方法；複句方面側重區別三種事理邏輯類型及其 下位的小類。虛詞方面側重語法功能的辨認及功能成分之間的比較分析。

briefs.name: 旅行與文學
briefs.tags: 旅行 文學 世界 異國 背包客
briefs.desc: 本課程名為「旅行與文學」，有別於「旅行文學」，主要強調作品閱讀外，亦注重旅行技術面。作品閱讀包括各種穿越邊 境、沙漠、城鎮、河川的旅遊書寫與文學書寫中的行旅；技術面包括各種關於旅行的配備裝置、路線規劃、住宿選擇、省 錢旅行法、旅遊資源利用等。希望透過一學期的材料閱讀與技術指導，鼓舞修課同學繪製出屬於自己的地圖，背起背包， 展開青春的冒險與壯遊。

briefs.name: 漢語歷史語法專題討論
briefs.tags: 句式, 語氣, 語法演變, 雙音化/複合化, 詞彙化, 語法化, 動補式, 處置式, 被動式, 轉折句
briefs.desc: 本課程有多重目的。一是提供漢語歷史語法知識，以助培養歷史語感。二是提供語法分析訓練，幫助辨識古典文獻語言的句子以 及篇章結構。三是以專題討論的方式呈現漢語歷史語法研究成果，以為探索古漢語語法的起點。

briefs.name: 出土文獻專題
briefs.tags: 出土文獻Unearthed literature, 古文字 Ancient scripts, 甲骨文 Oracle bone script s, 金文 Chinese bronze inscriptions, 簡帛 Bamboo and silk script s
briefs.desc: 隨著中國考古學的發展，內容豐富、數量龐大的出土文獻不斷重現於世，成為一門新興學科，影響層面既深且廣，涉及古文字 學、語言學、文獻學、考古學、經學、歷史學、思想史、文學史、藝術史等許多不同領域。 進行出土文獻的研究，不僅需要古文字學基礎，更須具備古代漢語等相關學科的知識，並全面深刻地了解現行研究成果。 由於簡牘帛書為先秦典籍與文書的實際載體，因此在各出土文獻中，簡帛所能牽涉的研究範疇尤其寬廣。本課程將以新出簡帛 材料為主體，兼及甲骨文、金文及其他出土文獻。透過選讀、研討出土文獻原始材料和相關論文，以及期末報告的訓練，希望 能培養研究生紮實的獨立研究能力及跨領域的學科視野，並掌握正確的古文字學方法，具備閱讀、鑑別相關研究論著的能力， 打下研究出土文獻的基礎。

briefs.name: 議論文寫作實務專題
briefs.nameEn: Seminar on Practical Writing of Argumentative Essays
briefs.tags: 語言形式與內容的對應, 長句子的組成方式, 事理合成模式, 發言立場與態度, 問題意識, 學術論文架構, 文獻註記
briefs.desc: 本課程目的在提供議論文寫作的知識，引導撰寫短篇評論和學術論文。課程重點包括（1）語言形式與表達內容的對應關係， （2）長句子的組成方式及其內部的事理合成模式，（3）發言的立場與態度，（4）論述的要件，（5）學術研究的問題意識，（6） 學術論文架構，（7）引用、改寫與文獻註記，（8）論述條理、語調與說服力。

briefs.name: 對外華語教學實作
briefs.nameEn: Practical Teaching of Mandarin as a Foreign Language
briefs.tags: 對外華語教學；教學實作；對外華語教學試教；對外華語教學不同課型；對外華語教學反思
briefs.desc: 這門課強調從教學實務一步一步嘗試華語作為外語的教學如何準備，使學生從接到教學任務後的第一步開始逐步了解每個教學環 節中的重點和細節。我們每週就至少一個議題以師生/生生協作的方式來探討。課程的進行預計是經由學生先自行備課，並在網 上平台分享預習作業和所遇到的困惑，然後進入課堂討論、由教師講解、學生試教、師生講評等。課後作業是修改預習作業或寫 課後反思。課後除了修改備課單內容，也需在平台上分享教學後心得反思。這是一門實踐性極強的課，需要學生投入並樂於與老 師及同學分享心得、教學示範和教學成果。

briefs.name: 漢學英文二
briefs.tags: Sinology, Western, English language scholarship
briefs.desc: The primary objective of this course is to introduce you to important English language source materials that should prove useful in your future research. The source materials covered in the course include bibliographies, online resources, journals, and specialized academic dictionaries. Each week, one to two students will introduce the content of the assigned source materials and teach everyone in the class how to use them.

briefs.name: 敘述理論專題
briefs.nameEn: Topics in the Theory of Narrative
briefs.tags: 敘述學，敘述理論，歷史理論，身份與文化認同，修辭學
briefs.desc: 敘述乃是指稱一種講述故事（story-telling）的能力與活動。如果依據這個簡單的定義來看，那麼，有關敘述的討論與研 究，其實可以涵蓋文化現象光譜中的諸多面向。本課程試圖從西方敘述文類與敘述傳統的歷史發展此一脈絡出發，檢視二十世 紀以來在敘述理論與敘述學方面的相關論題與論述。

briefs.name: 古典小說專題
briefs.tags: 古典小說Classical Fiction, 唐人小說Tangren Xiaoshuo, 唐傳奇Tang Chuanqi, 話本Huaben, 擬話本Simulant Huaben
briefs.desc: 本課程研討中國古典短篇小說所涉及的有關文體的敘事形式、主題內容，以及從小說史角度觀照的意義和價值等重要課題，選讀 文本包含唐代小說、話本小說「三言」、「二拍」，透過閱讀原典文獻與前行研究，掘發古典小說的豐富內涵，擴展小說研究的 學術視野與進路。 本研究所課程探討的小說文本，不侷限於文學性的解讀，亦將視角延伸至歷史學、社會學、宗教學等不同學科，期能帶領學生在 閱讀古典文獻時，開拓跨領域的研究向度，厚植人文關懷。

briefs.name: 中晚唐詩研究
briefs.nameEn: Seminar on Mid- and Late Tang Poetry
briefs.tags: 中唐詩 Mid-Tang poetry, 晚唐詩Late Tang poetry, 唐詩 Tang poetry, 細讀 close reading
briefs.desc: 本課程以中、晚唐為範圍，以文學史為理解框架，取重要的典範性詩人作品作為研讀、討論對象。本課程主要目標在透過對重要 作品的共同研讀與討論，提升對唐詩的解讀能力以及對詩人、對唐代文學史的認識，從而發展各自的研究課題。

briefs.name: 中國古典散文與文論
briefs.nameEn: Classical Chinese Prose and Literary Criticism
briefs.tags: 散文、 古文 、文學、敘事、議論、抒情、文白之爭
briefs.desc: 本課程將統整20世紀以來中國古典散文研究的主要重點，從文學/非文學、古/今、文/白等幾個視點，探討中國古典散文的書寫理 論以及創作表現。在課程設計上，將返璞歸真，著重文論以及作家作品的原典閱讀，並輔以重要學術論文，奠定學生有關散文研究 的厚實基礎，期待來日有能力在此一專業基礎上，思考並回應當代文學與文化問題。

briefs.name: 宋明理學專題
briefs.tags: 宋明理學，朱子學，陽明學，陽明後學，中國思想
briefs.desc: 以深入閱讀原典的方式理解宋明理學之概念與發展。

briefs.name: 文心雕龍研究
briefs.nameEn: The Literary Mind and the Carving of Dragons（Wen xin diao lung）
briefs.tags: 文心雕龍、文論
briefs.desc: 《文心雕龍》在當時並沒有什麼地位，明代中葉以後，才漸為學人注意。此後地位一路扶搖直上，不僅國內中文系早已 視 為科班出身必讀之作，國外漢學界也極表推崇，施友忠先生的英譯本三十年前已問世。該書之所以被看重，主要是因為 論 題涉及面較為完整，表述體制相當規格化，與傳統文論頗有差異，在西潮孕育的尺度下，似乎是中國較拿得出手的一本 文 論專著（鍾嶸《詩品》雖也是專著，但討論範圍限於詩）。 因為它是本文論，書中當然會提到許多在它之前的作家及作品， 加以受到當時的表述習尚影響，全書都採取駢儷句式， 並 經常會溶用古書中的詞句，對於不熟悉齊、梁以前作品及六朝表 述習慣的人而言，閱讀時，似乎有不少語言障礙，其 實， 多讀幾篇之後，會發現字面理解並不困難。真正難懂的在那些語 詞真正指涉的意思。 不管它的見解是否高明，要想對中古文學有基礎認識，《文選》與《文心雕龍》是必讀的兩本書，因為 它們都具有總匯 的 特質。可是本系一直未正式開設，實在愧對同學，因此，重理舊業，彌補這缺憾。

briefs.name: 《詩經》詩學
briefs.nameEn: Poetics of the Book of Songs
briefs.tags: 《詩經》、詩學、經學、志、興、詩用、斷章取義、詩歌本源
briefs.desc: 今人因西學與時代風潮，多不以中國正統經學所述道理為正確，連帶《詩》亦僅視為文學，與「經」無關。然而，中國從來以《詩》為「經」， 非只文學經典，這和《詩》作為詩其型態極特殊有關，由是故能開啟並揭示人類存在中人性之道。本課程旨在考察《詩》如此向度，由《詩》作 品之形制構造言起，說明《詩經》「以詩為經」之基礎所在，反省《詩》為「經」時之影響與意義。

briefs.name: 晚清小說專題
briefs.tags: 晚清 小說 中國 世界 研究
briefs.desc: 「晚清小說」研究乃是一進行式的研究，諸多材料尚待挖掘與論述。本課程將從基本知識與資料的掌控到研究議題的確立，帶 領同學系統性探索晚清小說，發掘箇中各種閱讀與研究潛能。

briefs.name: 性／別研究
briefs.tags: 性／別Gender/sexuality，中國古典文學lassical Chinese Literature，性／別理論Gender/Sexuality Theory
briefs.desc: 本學期的課程將主要通過文學作品的研讀來探討性／別研究相關議題。我們將「文學」視為通過一些藝術形式而想像、再現、質詢、詮釋現實、試圖回應或脫離現實，或對現實提出複雜「理論」的文化成品。在這樣的認識下，本課程將選讀若干文學作品，探討其中呈現關於「性／別」（性，性別，以及其他社會差異）的各種複雜現實與理論面向，藉著閱讀與討論的過程，深化對「性／別」的認識，同時又開拓文本閱讀與性／別研究的方法與視野。

briefs.name: 香港文學的「流動」與「根著」
briefs.nameEn: Mobility and Rootedness in Hong Kong Literature
briefs.tags: 香港文學, 流動, 根著, 文學史, 都市文學 Hong Kong Literature, Mobility, Rootedness, Literary History, Urban Literature
briefs.desc: 以「流動」與「根著」為切入焦點，講授不同時期的香港文學，課程分為兩個單元：「第一單元：流動與多文文化」、「第二單 元：流動的視角、根著的省思」，配合相關歷史文獻、研究文獻與作品分析，研習議題包括流徙與家國想像、台、港文學的連 繫、流動與多文文化、根著的省思等等，作品細讀包括趙滋蕃、劉以鬯、司馬長風、西西、也斯、馬國明、陳冠中等作家的主 要作品，結合課堂閱讀報告及討論，引導學生從多角度深入研讀。

The content including travel information, travel plans, geographical environment and location, eating habits/food culture, tastes and methods of different foods, plans and expectations for the future, auspicious words, introduction to festival activities and seasonal foods, etc.

briefs.tags: 中文,華語,當代中文第四冊,中高級華語一,Mandarin High-Intermediate I
briefs.desc: 1. 本課程以長篇對話及篇章兩種形式,擴展能談論的話題。 This course expands the topics that can be discussed through two forms: long conversations and written discourse. 2. 內容主題涵蓋網路、藝術活動、科技、風水、經濟情況、地震 等。 The content topics cover the internet, art activities, technology, feng shui, economic situations, earthquakes, and more. 3. 學生能討論現實與虛擬的不同、介紹自己喜歡的藝術活動、討論 科技正面與負面的影響、討論風水與迷信的關係與不同、表達出 所觀察到的社會轉變、談論災害發生的原因及地區等。 Students can discuss the differences between reality and virtuality, introduce their favorite art activities, discuss the positive and negative impacts of technology, talk about the relationship between feng shui and superstitions, express observed societal changes, and discuss the reasons for and regions affected by disasters.

briefs.tags: 中高級華語課程，當代中文課程，High Intermediate level Mandarin Course
briefs.desc: 教學內容 Content 1.本課程以長篇對話及篇章兩種形式，擴展能談論的話題。 This course expands the topics that can be discussed through two forms: long conversations and written discourse. 2.內容主題涵蓋大學生活、社會現象、歷史、就業、社會結構的改變、政治等。 The content topics cover university life, social phenomena, history, employment, changes in social structure, and politics. 3.學生能談論大學與未來的生活規劃、傳統觀念與現代觀念的不同、歷史事件的影響與改變、個人學經歷；了解台灣社會族群和語言文化 的 多元化；對政治提出自己的看法，表達個人意見並說服他人等。 Students can discuss university and future life planning, the differences between traditional and modern concepts, the influence and changes of historical events, personal learning experiences; gain an understanding ofthe diversity of Taiwan's social groups and language cultures; express their own opinions on politics, convey personal viewpoints, and persuade others, among other skills.

briefs.name: 新聞華語一
briefs.tags: 真實語篇 authentic language materials, 社會 society, 經濟 economics, 經濟 economics, 環境 environment
briefs.desc: 1. 本課程為針對母語非華語的國際學生所設計，選材自真實語篇。涵蓋國際社會多面向的新聞主題及議題。 This course is designed for international students whose native language is not Chinese, with materials selected from authentic texts. It covers a wide range of news topics and issues in the international community. 2. 適合CEFR B1以上等級，或學完《當代中文課程第三冊》的學習者。 It is suitable for learners at CEFR B1 level or above, or those who have completed the Book 3 of the "A Course in Contemporary Chinese".

briefs.name: 高級華語一
briefs.tags: 師生、生生討論、任務活動、角色扮演、學生報告 Lectures, class activities, group discussion, task-based learning
briefs.desc: 1. 本課程主要為閱讀篇章，從而擴展談論的話題。 This course primarily focuses on reading passages to expand the range of topics for discussion. 2. 內容主題涵蓋公共議題、國際問題、多元成家等層面。 The content covers various aspects such as public issues, international matters, and diverse family structures. 學生能談論死刑存廢、國家財政與稅務關係、難民問題、核能存廢及同性婚姻等議題。 Students can discuss topics such as the abolition of the death penalty, the relationship between national finances and taxation, refugee issues, the pros and cons of nuclear energy, and same-sex marriage.

briefs.name: 高級華語二
briefs.tags: 說明文、論述的能力、辨析主題宗旨、表達觀點的技巧、華語文能力
briefs.desc: 本課程的教學目標為：一、透過說明文的構思模式訓練學生論述的能力。二、引導學生學習辨析主題宗旨與表達觀點的技巧。 三、引導學生學習特定主題的知識，有效應用教材中的語法點與詞彙，強化華語文能力。

briefs.name: 高級華語三
briefs.tags: 社會、科技、經濟、政治、文化、環境 Society, Technology, Economy, Politics, Culture, Environment
briefs.desc: 本課程為針對母語非華語的國際學生所設計，選材自真實語篇。涵蓋社會、科技、經濟、政治、文化、環境等多元主題，拓 展學生對不同語體、領域的語言認知與運用。上完課後，華語程度約可達到 CEFR C1 (ACTFL Superior) 的程度。本課程 適合學習時數超過750小時，具備4500個詞彙量的學習者。 This course is designed for international students whose native language is not Chinese. It uses authentic language materials covering diverse topics such as society, technology, economics, politics, culture, and the environment. It aims to expand students' language awareness and usage across different registers and domains. After completing the course, students' Chinese proficiency level is expected to reach approximately CEFR C1 (ACTFL Superior). This course is suitable for learners who have studied for over 750 hours and have a vocabulary of 4500 words.

briefs.name: 商用華語一
briefs.tags: 商用華語, Business Chinese, Business Mandarin, Resume, Receipt
briefs.desc: 本課程教授外籍學生學習職場或商業往來等特定情境下使用的中文。目的是讓學生藉由語言學習，不只建立特定情境下以中文應對的工作能力， 也了解台灣，甚至華人圈職場與商場的文化。

briefs.name: 商用華語二
briefs.tags: 商用華語, 商務華語, 專業華語, business Chinese, Chinese for specific purposes
briefs.desc: 本課程目標為幫助國際學生學習職場或商業情境的華語（中文），後七課的主題從參加商展開始，包含工作上的洽談、宴請以及 行銷業務、國際貿易等。此外，為配合職場及商業情境需要，課程除了口語的練習之外，亦涵蓋書面語的應用文書練習，如邀請 函撰寫、客戶服務信件回覆等。進度預定為每兩週一課。

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: 書報討論, 演講, seminar
briefs.desc: 本課程邀請通訊相關領域學者與業界菁英，針對最新通訊技術及產業發展，提供一個半小時左右之演講。修課研究生 可藉由專家學者演講內容，了解通訊工程技術演進與產業未來發展，並進而激發研究創意及學習專業倫理。

briefs.name: 錯誤更正碼
briefs.tags: Error-correcting codes (錯誤更正碼), block codes (區段瑪), convolutional codes (迴旋碼), cyclic codes (循環碼), BCH codes (BCH碼), Reed-Solomon codes (里德-所羅門碼), low-density parity-check codes (低密度偶校碼)
briefs.desc: This course covers the most important error-correcting codes for combating errors that occur in the transmission or storage of data.

briefs.name: 展頻通訊
briefs.tags: 展頻通訊 (Spread Spectrum Communications); 直序展頻 (Direct-Sequence Spread Spectrum); 跳頻展頻 (Frequency-Hop Spread Spectrum); 似隨機序列 (Pseudo-Random Sequence); 碼追蹤 (Code Tracking); 碼同步 (Code Synchronizer); 分碼多重接取 (Code Division Multiple Access);
briefs.desc: This course introduces the fundamental knowledge of spread spectrum communication systems. Two major spread spectrum techniques, including direct-sequence spread spectrum (DSSS) and frequency-hop spread spectrum (FHSS), will be comprehensively studied.

briefs.name: 多天線通訊
briefs.tags: 多重輸入輸出, 空間多工, 傳輸多樣性, 干擾消除, MIMO, spatial multiplexing, transmission diversity, interference cancellation
briefs.desc: Multi-antenna theories have been developed for decades that guide the practical implementation of multi- antenna technique to various wireless systems. This course aims to introduce the fundaments of multi- antenna theory and some of their applications in practical systems. Students can gain insights from theoretical analysis using tools such as information theorical, linear algebra, and mathematical statistics, and how apply multi-antenna theories to solve practical problems.

briefs.name: 檢測與估計理論
briefs.tags: Detection, Estimation, Signal Processing, Communications.
briefs.desc: In this course, we will introduce the basics of detection and estimation theory, which are fundamental to many problems in communications, signal processing, and systems theory. In the detection part, we will cover topics such as Neyman Pearson and Bayesian Detection, Detection of Deterministic and Random Signals, Composite Hypothesis Testing etc. In the estimation part, we will discuss topics such as Minimum Variance Unbiased Estimators, the Cramer-Rao Lower Bound, Maximum-Likelihood Estimators, Least Squares Estimator, Bayesian Estimators.

briefs.name: 數位訊號處理積體電路設計
briefs.nameEn: Digital Signal Processing Integrated Circuits Design
briefs.tags: Digital Signal Processing, VLSI Circuit Design, DSP Architecture
briefs.desc: This course introduces both the theory and practice for designing a digital signal processing IP for various systems. The first part is to introduce the theoretic tools to design the digital signal processing architecture. Besides, the noise and power issues for communication are also introduced when the architecture is implemented in fixed-point signal format for VLSI. In the second part, the circuit-based energy delay models are also introduced to design the hardware architecture according to different constraints including timing, cost, power, etc. The third part will provide some DSP architectures, including arithmetic operator architecture, FIR/IIR filter, multi-rate signal processing system, FFT/IFFT processor.

briefs.name: 凸優化理論及應用
briefs.tags: 凸集 Convex Set, 凸函數 Convex Function, 凸最佳化問題 Convex Optimization Problem, 對偶性 Duality, 內點法 Interior-Point Method
briefs.desc: Convex Optimization (CVXopt) has been extensively applied to various science and engineering problems over the last decades, meanwhile well supported by the Powerful CVXopt theory and convex solvers (e.g., CVX or SeDuMi) available for obtaining an optimal solution, along with insightful performance and convergence analyses. Its applications are comprehensive, from (a) Wireless Communications and Signal Processing (WCSP) to (b) Artificial Intelligence (AI) (Machine Learning and Deep Learning). In view of ``CVXopt-aided AI or AI-aided CVXopt or other smart fusion” that has been a research trend, this course covers CVXopt Theory and its cutting-edge applications to come up with a practical solution as well as findings on qualitative performance insights (e.g., beamforming, and resource management for 5G-beyond and 6G systems, federated learning, and hyperspectral image (HSI) denoising, HSI super resolution (HIS-SR) by CVXopt and/or CVXopt-aided AI, etc.)

briefs.name: 無線網路
briefs.tags: Ad-Hoc Networks，Cellular Networks，Channel Coding，Error Control，Mobile Computing，Sensor Networks，Wireless Networks
briefs.desc: 本課程將介紹無線網路的基本原理及應用，其內容包含無線電信號的特性、編碼及解碼，無線通道的錯誤更正碼設計，蜂巢狀基 地台簡介，行動通訊網路技術，多人無線接取技術，通道分配及網路協定。此外也會介紹隨意行動網路及先進無線技術。

briefs.name: 光纖通訊系統
briefs.tags: Communication systems, optical fiber, optical devices, modulation formats, networks
briefs.desc: This is a basic introductory course of current optical fiber communication system. In this course, you will learn the basic concept of optical fiber, some selected fiber devices, and optical communication systems, including Wavelength-Division-Multiplexing (WDM) system, analog CATV system, and optical networks. This course will focus more on the physical layer design of optical fiber communication systems. Some basic and frequently used optical network protocols will also be introduced. This course is suitable for seniors and graduate students who are interested in both communications and electro-optics and would like to pursue further studies on the physical layer of optical communication systems and devices.

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文研究, Thesis
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文研究, Thesis
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行深入研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之創新性成果。

briefs.name: 自然觀察智能
briefs.tags: Ecosystem, nature, naturalistic intelligence, sustainability, respect
briefs.desc: This course explores naturalistic intelligence, focusing on the human ability to recognize, categorize, and draw meaning from the natural world. Students will examine how this form of intelligence contributes to scientific inquiry, ecological awareness, sustainability, and creative problem-solving. Through interdisciplinary perspectives—including biology, psychology, anthropology, and environmental studies—participants will investigate how humans interact with nature across cultures and contexts. Course topics include nature observation and classification, traditional ecological knowledge, the role of naturalistic intelligence in education and leadership, and its practical applications in agriculture, conservation, urban planning, and wellness. Students will engage in experiential learning through fieldwork, reflective writing, and collaborative projects designed to deepen their understanding of natural systems and their relevance to human life.

briefs.name: 廢棄物新生：循環材料與電池的綠色革命
briefs.nameEn: Rebirth of Waste: Circular Materials and the Green Revolution in Energy Storage
briefs.tags: 廢棄物, 循環材料, 電池, 綠色革命, 儲能, Wastes, Circular Materials, Battery, Green Revolution, Energy Storage
briefs.desc: 您知道未來手機電池裡的材料可能來自報廢輪胎或者是每天喝完咖啡的咖啡渣嗎？當全球面臨能源危機與資源枯竭，我們該如 何從廢棄物中找到新的價值？本課程帶領學生從生活中常見的廢棄物出發，認識材料的永續循環概念，並深入探討這些材料如 何轉化為電池、超級電容等儲能元件的關鍵元素。課程中將結合案例討論與跨領域創新思維，讓您以非理工背景也能輕鬆進入 綠色科技的世界。 課程目標： 1. 理解材料循環與資源再利用的基本概念。 2. 認識碳材料及其在儲能元件中的應用。 3. 建立永續設計與科技倫理的跨領域視野。 4. 培養團隊合作、問題解決與簡報表達能力。

briefs.name: 復育福爾摩沙：邁向台灣永續未來的生態轉化
briefs.nameEn: Let Formosa Be Formosa: Ecological Restoration and Sustainable Futures for Taiwan
briefs.tags: Formosa, ecological integrity, environment, food security, biodiversity, ecosystem reintegration
briefs.desc: Once celebrated as “Formosa” (“the beautiful island”), Taiwan has long been recognized for its rich biodiversity and striking landscapes.
