Yet modern pressures—from urbanization and industrialization to climate change and global geopolitics—have threatened its ecological integrity. This seminar examines Taiwan’s ecological past, present challenges, and possible sustainable futures. Students will explore Taiwan’s environment through ecological science, indigenous knowledge, history, policy, and global comparisons. The course emphasizes how ecological restoration and sustainability can coexist with human well-being, and how Taiwan’s story contributes to international conversations about ecological futures.

briefs.name: 企業財務之氣候揭露
briefs.tags: Climate, Nature, Financial Disclosures, risk, framework 氣候、自然、財務揭露、風險、框架
briefs.desc: This course focuses on how corporations apply the TCFD (Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures) and TNFD (Taskforce on Nature-related Financial Disclosures) frameworks to disclose climate- and nature-related financial information. Two major components are covered: (1) Identifying, quantifying, and disclosing climate-related risks (physical, transition, and liability risks); and (2) Assessing corporate dependencies and impacts on nature and biodiversity based on the TNFD LEAP framework (Locate–Evaluate–Assess–Prepare). Students will learn how to integrate climate and environmental data with financial metrics to produce decision-useful disclosures. Through a combination of theory, international case studies, and practical exercises, the course enables students to draft TCFD/TNFD-aligned disclosure reports and evaluate how such transparency affects financial markets, regulation, and sustainable corporate strategies. 1. Under

briefs.name: 碳盤查、淨零排放與商業模式創新
briefs.nameEn: Carbon Inventory, Net-Zero Emissions, and Business Model Innovation
briefs.tags: 碳盤查 (Carbon Inventory), 淨零排放 (Net-Zero Emissions), 溫室氣體管理(Greenhouse Gas Management), 低碳轉型(Low-Carbon Transition), 商業模式創新 (Business Model Innovation)
briefs.desc: 一、課程說明 本課程「碳盤查與淨零排放策略」旨在培養學生具備全面且實務導向的溫室氣體盤查能力，並深入理解淨零排放的國際趨勢 與企業永續發展需求。課程涵蓋碳盤查國際標準（如GHG Protocol、ISO 14064）、排放因子與計算方法、數據取得及管理 技術，以及企業與供應鏈的排放熱點辨識。 此外，課程每週均有指定閱讀文獻，強調跨領域整合，指導學生熟悉碳管理工具、數據系統應用及永續報告撰寫，並介紹淨 零轉型中商業模式創新的理論與實務案例。學生將學會如何制定減碳策略，運用內部碳定價與政策解析，強化其在產業減碳 與低碳經濟的競爭力。 通過期中及期末報告，學生能實際演練碳盤查專案執行流程，從數據收集、分析，到建議提出與溝通，增進專業判斷力和團 隊合作能力。完課後，學生不僅能勝任碳盤查專業工作，亦具備推動組織淨零碳排與創新永續商業模式的實務能力，為臺灣 及國際低碳轉型培育關鍵人才。 二、學習目標 理解碳盤查的基本原理與國際標準（GHG Protocol、ISO 14064-1），掌握組織與產品碳排放計算方法。 熟悉全球氣候政策（如巴黎協定、IPCC）、台灣本地法規及企業永續管理趨勢，培養跨域碳管理知識。 熟練收集盤查資料、設定組織與產

briefs.name: 循環經濟
briefs.tags: 循環經濟(Circular Economy)、物質流分析(MFA,Material Flow Analysis)、生命週期評估(LCA,Life Cycle Assessment)、碳足跡(Carbon Footprint)、系統思考(Systems Thinking)
briefs.desc: 本課程以「循環經濟」為核心，帶領學生運用系統思考整合資源流盤點(MFA)、生命週期(LCA)、碳足跡概念(CFP）、循環策略 (R-strategies)，提出可被檢核且具可行性的循環方案。課程前半段建立循環經濟框架、利害關係人與價值鏈分析、資料品質 與指標設計、資源流平衡與熱點診斷等方法；後半段以工作坊方式完成專題提案，包含情境設計、效益量化（資源/廢棄物/碳減 量）、經濟可行性與敏感度分析，以及推動路線圖（政策、採購、契約或合作機制）與風險對策。期末以口頭答辯與書面報告呈 現成果，培養學生跨域整合、量化分析與永續方案落地能力。

briefs.name: 計算機程式設計一
briefs.tags: Python programming, problem solving, basic data structures, preliminary algorithms
briefs.desc: This course is aimed to help students learn how to program in Python. There will be several labs, one midterm exam, and one final project, with the following percentages: Midterm exam 40% 有兩次考試機會，只取較高分的那次 (電腦教室考試） Quizzes and labs 30% (多次電腦教室小考 和 線上實作） Written exam 5% (筆試, 跟期中考一起） Final project (25%) 期末專題

briefs.name: 計算機程式設計二
briefs.tags: C/C++ Programming, Data Structures & Algorithms, Input/Output & Control Statements, Functions & Recursion, object-Oriented Programming & Applications (AI/Game)
briefs.desc: This course introduces core programming concepts in C and C++, covering data representation, pointers, file I/O, basic data structures, object-oriented programming, templates, and standard library containers. Students also explore introductory AI and gaming applications.

briefs.name: 計算機程式設計二
briefs.tags: C/C++ Programming, Data Structures & Algorithms, Input/Output & Control Statements, Functions & Recursion, object-Oriented Programming & Applications (AI/Game)
briefs.desc: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to programming through both C and C++. Part 1 focuses on foundational C concepts, including basic syntax, arrays and pointers, file input/output, string utilities, bitwise operations, structures, linked lists, trees, and algorithms for efficient computing, enabling students to understand low-level data representation and memory manipulation. Part 2 transitions to C++ and object-oriented programming, covering classes and objects, operator overloading, inheritance, polymorphism, templates, and standard library containers, while also introducing applications in AI and computer gaming. Together, these two parts equip students with solid procedural and object-oriented programming skills, efficient data-handling techniques, and the ability to design more complex software systems. Course Goals: (1) Build proficiency in C/C++ programming (2) Understand efficient data structures and algor

briefs.name: 英語聽講
briefs.tags: This course is designed to develop students’ English proficiency in listening and speaking.
briefs.desc: This course is designed to develop students’ English proficiency in listening and speaking. Students who are planning to study at an English-speaking country are encouraged to register the course. The TOEFL iBT and the IELTS will be introduced in class. However, this course is not an exam preparation course rather it is a course to develop your ability to use and understand English at the university level. Especially, how well you combine your listening, reading, speaking and writing skills to perform academic tasks will be evaluated.

briefs.name: 軟體設計與實驗
briefs.tags: software,design,programming,apps,android,ios,web,ai,軟體開發,軟體設計,程式設計,行動應用,人工智慧,網際網路
briefs.desc: 本課程的目標是讓學生深入了解軟體設計與開發流程，並提供開發整合 AI 技術的網頁/移動應用的實作經驗。今年課程內容將探索基本的 軟體設計概念、開發工具及前沿技術，為學生進入充滿活力的軟體開發領域做好準備。課程分為三個部分： 第一部分：Flutter 和 Dart 的跨平台開發入門 第二部分：AI 基礎與服務探索 第三部分：軟體設計流程與以使用者為中心的開發 * This course is taught in Mandarin.

briefs.name: 軟體設計與實驗
briefs.tags: HTML5, CSS, Firebase, React, Cocos Creator, Game programming, Web programming
briefs.desc: 本課程目的在於培養資訊領域學生具備實作大型程式與團隊合作開發的能力。課程中將介紹一款2D遊戲開發引擎 (Cocos Creator)，修課學生必須組隊，與組員一同發想應用(遊戲)，並在Cocos Creator上實做一款完整的應用(遊 戲)，最後在期末展中上台發表其成品。修課過程中，我們將陸續介紹開發H5應用軟體所需的程式語言，包含 javascript, Typescript, CSS, HTML 5，輔以作業與上機考試的方式，讓學生能理解並活用所學的知識。

briefs.name: 資安攻防演練
briefs.tags: 駭客、道德、資安、攻防、演練、滲透測試、網路安全、資料庫安全、網站安全、OWASP、物聯網、IoT
briefs.desc: 本課程旨在培養學生網路安全的實務技能與應變能力，從基礎工具學習到攻防實作訓練。課程涵蓋職業道德、程式語言、資 料 庫、網路與通訊、攻擊方式、防守預防處理方法以及國際常見的資安問題如OWASP Top Ten 等。透過實作課程，學生將學會 如 何辨識常見的網路攻擊並執行滲透測試 (Pentesting)。物聯網 (IoT) 和電磁波方式通訊如紅外線、藍芽、2.4G通訊、低 地軌 衛星通訊、5G、6G通訊等新興應用場景，使學生能夠將所學知識靈活應用於現實情境。本課程上課方式包含 情資局勢分享與 攻 防的道德宣導、知識技術傳授、私人虛擬環境實作演練，透過課堂講解與實作並行，為學生提供強化資安技術的綜合性學習 體 驗，適合有興趣進一步探索網路安全領域的學生。

briefs.name: 機率
briefs.tags: Probability, Discrete Random Variable, Continuous Random Variable, Expectation, Stochastic Process
briefs.desc: This course will introduce the probability theory and give some examples to show how we can deal with uncertainty in engineering problems through probabilistic methods.

briefs.name: 機率
briefs.tags: axiom of probabiltiy, conditional probability, independence, random variable, distribution function, moments
briefs.desc: This course introduces the students to the theory of probability. The course covers the following subjects in probability: probability space, independence, conditional probability, random variables, mathematical expectations, probability density functions and limit theorems

briefs.name: 正規語言
briefs.tags: Automata Theory 自動機理論, Formal Languages 正規語言,Turing Machines 圖靈機, Computational Complexity 計算複雜度, Grammar and Parsing 文法與解析
briefs.desc: This course focuses on understanding the theoretical underpinnings of computer science through the study of formal languages, automata, and computational models. It covers the relationships between languages and computational power, providing tools to model and analyze computational problems. Students learn how different classes of formal languages (e.g., regular languages, context-free languages) are represented and how automata and grammars can process them. Key topics include: Finite automata, pushdown automata, and Turing machines. Regular languages, context-free languages, and undecidability. Applications of these concepts in computational problem-solving, compiler design, natural language processing, and AI.

briefs.name: 編譯器設計
briefs.tags: Compiler, C, LEX, YACC, RISC-V, Parser, Optimizations
briefs.desc: This course will introduce basic compiler technologies and design a small subset of C front-end compiler in the class. We will mainly focus on generating RISC V assembly codes for a subset of C programs. In Taiwan, Andes is a Taiwan-based embedded processor core now used worldwide for RISC-V. In addition, we have many companies developing RISC-V cores and applications. We will need the compiler to generate codes to be able to run on RISC-V environments.

briefs.name: 作業系統
briefs.tags: 作業系統, 多工程式, 同步, 資源管理, 排程, operating systems, multiprogramming, synchronization, resource management, scheduling
briefs.desc: This course covers fundamental concepts in operating systems for computers, including multiprogramming, interrupt, processes, kernel, parallelism, critical sections, deadlocks, communication, multiprocessing, multilevel memory management, binding, name management, file systems, protection, resource allocation, scheduling. Experience with concurrent programming, synchronization mechanisms, and interprocess communication.

briefs.name: 基礎高效能計算叢集電腦實務
briefs.nameEn: Fundamental High Performance Computing Cluster Practice
briefs.tags: 叢集電腦架設管理
briefs.desc: 本課程教授高效能計算與叢集電腦系統管理的基礎知識與操作技術，目的是讓學生懂得利用叢集電腦處理實現高效能計算。建議 修課對象為大一級大二生，並且未來有意願參加學生叢集競賽、或對於系統建置、管理、實作有興趣的學生。

briefs.name: 競技程式設計二
briefs.tags: C++ 程式設計, Algorithm 演算法,Data Structure 資料結構,ICPC 國際大學生程式設計競賽,Team Work 團體合作
briefs.desc: 這是參與國際性程式設計競賽的進階課程。它將涵蓋複雜的問題解決技能，如動態規劃的各種優化、樹狀資料結構、計算幾何、 網路流等。將教授資料結構、圖論等主題。 本課程旨在鼓勵學生參加國際性程式設計競賽，並為參賽者提供進階培訓。

briefs.name: 多媒體技術概論
briefs.tags: 多媒體, 影像, 視訊, 音訊, 圖學, mutimedia, image, video, graphics, audio
briefs.desc: This course aims to give technical background knowledge in multimedia technology. We will focus on the representation, processing, and analysis of various types of multimedia data, including image, graphics, audio and video. This course will require students to implement some important algorithms to process the major types of multimedia data.

briefs.name: 系統整合實作一
briefs.tags: 實作
briefs.desc: 專題生本學期需跟著指導教授做研究，指導教授將依學生的表現來評分。

briefs.name: 系統整合實作二
briefs.tags: 實作
briefs.desc: 專題生本學期需跟著指導教授做研究，指導教授將依學生的表現來評分。

briefs.name: 獨立研究一
briefs.tags: 特殊選才、獨立研究、優等計畫
briefs.desc: 本課程由學生基於自己特殊專長自行向任課教師提出優等研究計畫書，由學生主導執行

briefs.name: 計算機結構
briefs.tags: computer architecture (計算機結構), performance evaluation (效能評估), instruction set architecture (指令集架構), memory hierarchy (記憶體階層), pipelining (管線化)
briefs.desc: In this course, we will discuss how a computer system works. Topics will include performance evaluation of a computer system, instruction set design, basic building blocks of a computer (I/O, memory, datapath, control), pipelined datapath, and memory hierarchy.

briefs.name: 計算機結構
briefs.tags: Computer architecture, performance evaluation, instruction set architecture, memory hierarchy, pipelining, computer arithmetic, processor
briefs.desc: In this course, we will discuss how a computer system works. Topics will include the performance evaluation of a computer system, instruction set design, the basic building blocks of a computer (I/O, memory, datapath, control), pipelined datapath, and memory hierarchy.

briefs.name: 嵌入式系統概論
briefs.tags: 嵌入式系統，微處理機，介面，嵌入式作業系統，藍牙應用 embedded System, Microprocessor, Interface, embedded Operating System, Blue Tooth Application
briefs.desc: This course will introduce the architecture and design process of embedded systems. We will introduce the operation mechanism of microprocessor software such as registers, I/O ports, addressing modes, timers, and interrupts. Upon mastering microprocessor principles, the course will proceed to introduce common microprocessor interfaces including UART, I2C, and ADC/DAC. Furthermore, students will be guided to apply embedded operating systems for projects. The objective of this course is to cultivate students' capabilities in embedded system design, enabling them to independently develop systems tailored to specific requirements.

briefs.name: 計算方法設計
briefs.tags: 演算法;貪心策略;分割擊破策略;刪除搜尋策略;動態規劃策略
briefs.desc: 讓同學了解演算法設計，懂得如何去分析一個演算法的好壞，並且能知道演算法有哪些設計策略，進一步加強同學撰寫程式的能力，可以根據不同的情況運用不同的策略設計出自己所需的演算法。

briefs.name: 軟體工程
briefs.tags: Software Engineering, Software Quality, Software Testing, Software Development Process Model, Software Reliability
briefs.desc: The course is an introduction to software engineering. State-of-practice and state-of-the-art principles, methods, and tools for planning, design, coding, validation and maintenance of software systems will be studied and discussed. Among the topics covered are: software requirement engineering, specification techniques, structured design, structured programming, top-down design and development, code inspection techniques, the software life cycle methodology, software management, software validation and verification techniques, software metrics, cost models, and software reliability measurement. The course discusses both the empirical aspects of software engineering and the underlying theory. Practical software engineering is given special attention.

briefs.name: 影像處理簡介
briefs.tags: image filtering; quality enhancement; image restoration; image segmentation; color space
briefs.desc: This course will introduce fundamental techniques for digital image representation, processing, and analysis. Students will learn the knowledge of image processing algorithms and practical implementation of various digital image applications. This course will cover the following topics: 1. Digital Image Fundamentals 2. Image Filtering & Enhancement 3. Image Restoration 4. Color Image Processing 5. Morphological Processing 6. Image Segmentation 7. Feature extraction

briefs.name: 人工智慧概論
briefs.tags: artificial intelligence, intelligent agents, genetic algorithm, knowledge based systems, machine learning, neural networks.
briefs.desc: This course introduces students to the fundamentals, problem-solving methods, knowledge and reasoning, and learning paradigms of artificial intelligence. Topics covered include intelligent agents, uninformed and informed search, genetic algorithm, games, knowledge based systems, propositional logic, machine learning, and neural networks.

briefs.name: 資料庫系統概論
briefs.tags: databases, database systems, sql, java, programming,資料庫系統,資料庫設計,資料處理,後端,程式設計
briefs.desc: 本課程概述了當前的資料庫管理系統以及實作方式。主要課程內容包括： 1. 讓學生熟悉如何使用資料庫系統解決實際問題、資料庫設計； 2. 探討資料庫的內部運作機制以及實現技術（例如 儲存子系統、詢問回答系統等）。 3. 實際資料庫系統 (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, NoSQL DBs etc.) 之個案探討 學生需已經具備良好的 Java/物件導向程式設計（OOP）及資料結構的基礎知識。剛修完作業系統、演算法，對大型程式系統有興趣之學生 優先。

briefs.name: 超大型積體電路系統設計
briefs.tags: 超大型積體電路系統設計, VLSI System Designs, IC Designs, Hardware Accelerators, Domain Specific Accelerators
briefs.desc: This course aims to help you understand modern VLSI system design and its associated technologies. It covers advanced design concepts for VLSI systems and the synthesis-based ASIC design flow. We will also discuss architecture exploration and performance evaluation at the system level, addressing the key considerations of system integration, such as computation, data transfer, memory hierarchy, etc. Emerging high-level design techniques will also be introduced to help you prepare for future design styles. Finally, case studies will be covered to help you understand the challenges behind advanced and future VLSI architecture.

briefs.name: 多媒體網路與系統
briefs.tags: 多媒體網路, 3D高斯潑濺, 點雲技術, 數位雙生, 聯邦學習, 體積視訊, 延展實境, 雲端遊戲, 使用者體驗品質, AI生成內容, Multimedia Networking, 3D Gaussian Splatting, Point Cloud Technology, Digital Twins, Federated Learning, Volumetric Video, Extended Reality, Cloud Gaming, Quality of Experience, AI-Generated Content
briefs.desc: This course consists of two parts. In the first half, we will review the central concepts of multimedia systems and next-generation networking. This foundation ensures all students are prepared for the second half, where we will explore cutting-edge multimedia networking systems. Topics include volumetric video streaming (e.g., Point Cloud and 3D Gaussian Splatting), immersive digital twins and XR, AI-generated content (AIGC) for 3D scenes, and privacy-preserving distributed learning (Federated Learning). The goal is for each student to complete a research project and produce a publishable report by the end of the semester.

briefs.name: 圖形理論
briefs.tags: discrete mathematics, algorithm, graph, theory, matching, planar graph, coloring
briefs.desc: Graph theory is a delightful playground for the exploration of proof techniques in discrete mathematics, and its results have applications in many areas of the computing, social, and natural sciences. Some algorithms and applications are included, but the focus is on understanding the structure of graphs and the techniques used to analyze problems in graph theory. Students that would like to take this course are assumed to be interested in and have knowledge of discrete maths and algorithm.

briefs.name: 高等計算生物學
briefs.tags: 計算生物;演算法;序列;比對;分析
briefs.desc: 進階地討論一些計算生物問題的演算法設計與分析。

briefs.name: 線上演算法
briefs.tags: 即時演算法Online Algorithms, 競爭比率分析Competitive Analysis,最壞情況分析Worst-case Analysis, 不確定性Uncertainty in Computation, 對抗模型Adversarial Models, 確定性演算法Deterministic Algorithms, 隨機演算法Randomized Algorithms
briefs.desc: This course provides an introduction to online algorithms, which is designed for making decisions in dynamic environments without complete prior information. As uncertainty and real-time demands grow quickly in our fast-changing world, the curriculum explores a variety of online problems and the algorithmic strategies to find approximately optimal solutions. Emphasis is placed on developing students’ ability to design and implement these algorithms, formally analyze their performance using competitive analysis, and apply these techniques to solve practical, real-world challenges.

briefs.name: 高等賽局理論與應用
briefs.nameEn: Advanced game Theory and its applications
briefs.tags: 聯盟博弈論 , Coalitional Game Theory, 核心 Core,核仁 Nucleolus ,沙普利值 Shapley Values
briefs.desc: 博弈論在經濟學、軍事學、國際政治學、生物學和社會科學中得到了成功的應用。 最近，它還被應用於通訊、多媒體、計算機 視覺、AI等領域。 在本課程中，我們將討論合作博弈論和各種應用。

briefs.name: 高等程式語言
briefs.tags: Java, OpenCL, DNN, Compiler, Simulator
briefs.desc: This course will introduce advanced programming language concepts (especially with languages for GPUs) and compiler optimizations. This course will be covering more seminar style classes with more research discussions and include presentations and reports for students to realize advanced programming languages technologies. This course is not a basic course in the graduate school. For the basic graduate compiler course, one can find “Advanced Compiler” course.

briefs.name: 雲端原生軟體開發與最佳實踐
briefs.nameEn: Cloud Native Development and Best Practice
briefs.tags: 設計思考 Design Thinking, 容器與服務編排Container / Kubernetes 雲原生 Cloud Native, 微服務 Microservice, 持續整合與交付 Continuous Integration/Continuous Deliver,
briefs.desc: 在數位轉型的浪潮中，雲端原生（Cloud Native）已成為企業加速創新、提升彈性和競爭力的關鍵策略。本課程將帶領學員深入 理解雲 端原生的核心概念、技術線以及如何在現代軟體開發中應用其最佳實踐。主要內容會包含雲端原生架構的核心原則，例如微服務 （Microservices）、容器化（Containerization）和持續整合/持續交付（CI/CD）。Docker 和 Kubernetes 等業界標準工 具， 實現應用程式的建構、部署與管理。希望可以完成設計和實作具有高彈性、高可用性、可擴展性的現代化雲端原生應用。

briefs.name: 即時系統設計
briefs.tags: 即時系統排程，資源管理，排程問題，固定優先，動態優先
briefs.desc: 本課程的名稱是即時系統設計，討論的主題是即時系統設計以及相關的排程問題，是一門探討即時系統及其排程演算法的研究與 設計的課程。 主要以即時系統的相關知識的授課及論文研讀及研究為主，希望培養學生進行即時系統相關的獨力研究的能力，以及完成相關研 究。 研究的能力。

briefs.name: 電腦儲存系統設計與實作
briefs.tags: file-system, operating system, storage system, distributed system, research-oriented
briefs.desc: This course teaches the design and implementation of advanced storage systems. For detailed policies, please follow: https://lego.sys-nthu.tw/policies

briefs.name: 數位孿生技術與應用
briefs.tags: 數位孿生 、實到虛 、虛到實 、三維高斯重建 、機器人學 Digital Twin, Real-to-Sim, Sim-to-Real, 3D Gaussian Splatting, Robotics
briefs.desc: Introduction to Digital Twin Technology explores the integration of multi-view reconstruction models with physics-based and AI-driven simulations to build digital twin systems. Students will learn the full pipeline from Real-to-Sim (R2S) reconstruction and procedural generation to Sim-to-Real (S2R) deployment using data augmentation and world foundation models. The course covers task, environment, and physical simulations, alongside advanced visualization in NVIDIA Omniverse and Kit-CAE. Through hands-on projects using NVIDIA Isaac Sim, students will develop closed-loop digital twins that unify perception, simulation, and control for applications in robotics, manufacturing, and smart environments.

briefs.name: 偏鄉智慧醫療專題實作
briefs.nameEn: Practice Project of Medical Intelligent Services In Remote Areas
briefs.teacher: 唐傳義,林文綺,林沿妊,葉肩宇
briefs.tags: 醫療數據 (health data),醫學影像 (medical image),電子病歷 (electronic health records, HER),國際醫療資料交換標準(FHIR)
briefs.desc: 本課程是一實作課程,同學能設計出偏鄉可使用的系統雛 型。 本課程會訓練同學在場域作田野調查與系統分析,透過服務設計中的顧客歷程(Customer Journey)設計後,再進行服務藍圖(Service Blueprint)後台系統規劃。

briefs.name: 人工智慧與藝術導論
briefs.nameEn: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence and Arts
briefs.tags: Artificial intelligence, Art, Visual art, Creativity, Cognition, Perception, Psychology, Philosophy of art, Aesthetics, Computer-generated art, Computational creativity, Artistic creativity, Machine learning, DNN, CNN, GAN.
briefs.desc: 本課程介紹人工智慧與藝術方面跨領域的現狀和研究。主要的目的是能夠深入了解人工智慧技術與藝術的特性，以及相互之間的關 係，並探討適用於人工智慧藝術創作的方法。本課程開放給工程和人文藝術背景的同學，並鼓勵跨領域的學生進行藝工合作的課程計 畫。 This course introduces the current state of research and development in the interdisciplinary field of artificial intelligence and art. The main objective is to provide a deep understanding of the characteristics of artificial intelligence technology and art, the relationship between them, and to explore methods applicable to artificial intelligence-based artistic creation. This course is open to students with engineering and humanities backgrounds and encourages interdisciplinary students to participate in collaborative art-engineering projects.

briefs.name: 機器導航與探索
briefs.tags: 同步定位建圖(SLAM)、機器學習(Machine Learning)、導航(Navigation)、機器探索(Robotic Exploration)、強化學習(Reinforcement Learning)
briefs.desc: 本課程模組分為三個主要的部分，分別為即時追蹤與地圖建置(SLAM)、基於機器學習之場景理解(Scene Understanding)與探 索導航的動作控制(Action Control)。即時追蹤與地圖建置部分包含機率模型與相機模型等理論基礎，也包含基於深度學習之 RGB-based的3DSLAM方法。場景理解的部分包含機器學習的基本概念，再帶到深度學習的技術與目前的物件偵測與語意切割技 術。動作控制的部分則包含路徑規劃與導航演算法，並帶入強化學習的概念來引導行進的路徑。

briefs.name: 資料科學
briefs.tags: Data science, Data mining, Machine learning, Social network analysis, Data analysis
briefs.desc: The objective of this course is to offer an introduction to data science, emphasizing on both theory and hands-on capabilities. In this course, we first cover the topic of data acquisition and cleaning to understand how datasets are collected. Then, we introduce data analysis algorithms and theories to extract knowledge from the large volume of data and gain useful insights. We will also cover and discuss some important and active research topics in recent top conferences and journals.

briefs.name: 研究方法二
briefs.tags: 研究方法
briefs.desc: 1.研究方法一、二限光電所教授同意指導之光電所碩士班研究生及大學部四年級學生選修但不列入大學部畢業學分。 2.此課程由指導教授與研究生自訂時間與方式進行。 3.研究生於學期中需與指導教授共同擬定研究題目、規劃進度、並在指導教授指導下進行研究，學習及了解科學研究之方法。研究 生於期末需依指導教授指定之格式繳交書面或進行口頭之研究報告，並依其表現與報告進行評分。

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: 書報討論, 資訊工程, 人工智慧, 演算法, 網路, 人機界面, 資訊安全
briefs.desc: 每週邀請學界業界專業學者演講，介紹資訊工程學系內各領域的最新進展與研究成果。

briefs.name: 科技英文
briefs.tags: writing, style, qualifier, structure, grammar
briefs.desc: This course covers the grammar, vocabulary, style, logic, and tools needed for writing and reading materials on science and technology. The grammar review part covers sentence construction and common mistakes. The vocabulary part compares similar but often misused words in technical English. A large portion of the course will cover style with editing exercises on making the writing concise, precise, professional, coherent, easy to read, and persuasive. The logic part deals with the organization of ideas and reasoning, with a review of common logical fallacies. The course will be using collaborative writing tools for collaborative authoring of such materials.

briefs.name: 學術英文寫作
briefs.tags: 學術英文寫作, 生成式AI, 論文結構, 提示工程, 資訊設計 Academic English Writing, Generative AI, Thesis Structure, Prompt Engineering, Information Design
briefs.desc: 本課程結合寫作理論、範本應用與生成式 AI，系統性教授學術與科學寫作，涵蓋從標題、摘要、簡介、相關研究、方法、結 果、討論到結論的完整架構。課程以經典寫作理論為基礎，如 John Swales 的 CARS 模型，解析論文「簡介」的撰寫策 略， 並參考 Writing up Research 指導「相關研究」的組織方式。此外，透過分析 Learning to Find Answers to Questions on the Web 這篇經典論文，說明方法章節的撰寫技巧，強調問題陳述、步驟描述與虛擬碼應用，以取代過時的 流 程圖呈現方式。對於數據與圖表的使用，則參考《Presenting Numbers, Tables, and Figures》，介紹 Edward Tufte 的資訊設計理論，幫助學生提升研究成果的視覺化表達能力。 課程採翻轉教學模式，結合實體與線上學習，在課堂上以作業解答、問題討論與論文修改示範為主，強調即時實作與累積評 分 制度，以提升學習成效。此外，課程導入生成式 AI，協助範本分析、草稿修改與文獻檢索，並提供寫作輔導時段（Writing Clinic），讓學生獲得個別指導。透過傳統與 AI 工具的結合，本課程幫助學生掌握學術英文寫作，提升論文品質與寫作效 率。

briefs.name: 高等邏輯合成
briefs.tags: logic synthesis, EDA, 2-level logic optimization, multi-level logic optimization, technology mapping, synthesis for FSM
briefs.desc: Logic synthesis is a very important step in design flow of digital systems. This course will cover various aspects of logic optimization including 1.Representations for Boolean Functions 2. Two-Level Logic Minimization 3. Multi-Level Logic Minimization 4. Timing Optimization 5. Technology Mapping 6. Synthesis for Finite State Machines 7. Low Power Design 8. Automatic Test Pattern Generation 9. Synthesis for hardware security

briefs.name: 平行計算方法設計
briefs.tags: parallel, algorithms
briefs.desc: PART I 1. Introduction .Classification of parallel computers .Performance of parallel algorithms 2. Shared-memory computers, basic techniques, and Brent Theorem PART II 3. Tree Machine 4. Linear-processor array 5. Mesh-connected computers 6. Hypercubes 7. Perfect shuffles 8. Mesh-connected computers with multiple broadcasting 9. Processor arrays with reconfigurable bus systems PART III 10. Systolic architectures 11. Fault-tolerance, randomized algorithms, P-completeness

briefs.name: 幾何建模
briefs.tags: 幾何建模、曲線與曲面、網格重建、網格處理、模型分析 Geometric Modeling, Surfaces and Curves, Mesh Reconstruction, Mesh Processing, Shape Analysis
briefs.desc: This course introduces the fundamental concepts and techniques of geometric modeling in computer graphics, such as curves and surfaces. The course focus on the surface representation and covers essential processes like mesh subdivision, simplification, parameterization, optimization, and deformation.

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文研究, Thesis
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 網路系統之理論與實作專題
briefs.nameEn: Special Topics in Theory and Implementation of Network Systems
briefs.tags: network systems, wireless local-area networks, mobile networks, software-defined networking, network function virtualization, resource allocation
briefs.desc: This course aims to discuss research issues of network systems from both the theoretical perspective and the implementation perspective.

briefs.name: 嵌入式系統設計專題
briefs.nameEn: Special Topic on Embedded System Design
briefs.tags: 作業系統,嵌入式系統,系統設計,系統程式,系統實作
briefs.desc: 這門課程的名稱為嵌入式系統設計專題，主要探討的內容是嵌入式系統的內涵以及嵌入式系統的設計方法。課程主要以論文研讀為 主，再搭配討論及報告撰寫。

briefs.name: 軟體工程專題
briefs.tags: 軟體可靠度, 軟體工程, 軟體測試, 軟體度量, 軟體可靠度建模
briefs.desc: 本課程首先介紹軟體可靠度工程技術，我們會詳細說明軟體可靠度量化理論、模型建構技術與設計方法、軟體評估理論、軟體可 靠度 管理(例如要如何描述軟體可靠度、如何測試、如何評估、如何預測、如何設計、如何提升)及軟體度量等。除此之外，本課程亦 將 會介紹如何來進行軟體測試。我們將詳細說明軟體測試相關的基本概念、理論基礎、施行技術、管理流程和方法等。 本課程結合了軟體可靠度與軟體測試，學生將可掌握軟體測試的基本理論與施行方法，並學習到如何將軟體測試結果及軟體故障 數 據，運用軟體可靠度工程技術來予以解析及詮釋，使之用來預測與評估所開發出來的軟體產品的功能正確性及系統穩定性，進而 了解 軟體品質、改進軟體測試的方法與程序、以及加強軟體開發過程中相關資源的分配。

briefs.name: 資料庫系統專題一
briefs.nameEn: Special Topics in Data Base Management System(I)
briefs.tags: 研究方法, 簡報技巧, 論文寫作, academic writing, research presentation
briefs.desc: This course is designed for graduate students who are interested in knowing state-of-the arts and applications of the information technology. The objective of this course is: 1) guide students to recognize the current state of the art of information technology and emerging killing applications; 2) identify their research topics; and 3) write a research proposal in the related fields. Students will learn how to find an interesting IT application problem by surveying a specific application domain, understand the current information techniques available to solve the problem, assess the applicability and weakness of the current IT technology to the problem, narrow down specific aims as research goal for writing a research problem.

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文研究, Thesis
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行深入研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之創新性成果。

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: 電晶體技術, 半導體製程技術, 半導體製造, 半導體設備, 專家、就業
briefs.desc: 本課程主要是邀請半導體公司主管或專家探討新的半導體技術未來發展，並了解其應用趨勢，讓學生更清楚未來就業方向。內容 更包括一些技術原理和流程，使學生在學習專業知識之外，更能理解半導體生態和未來職場上的運作機制。

briefs.name: 領導統御
briefs.tags: leadership, EQ, communication, work ethics
briefs.desc: This course is to enhance your soft skills. We will explain how to become an effective and accountable leader in the workplace. Furthermore it is important to foster your presentation and communication skills. We design several projects, including some event in flight, to let you plan your thoughts and present to all of us.

briefs.name: 業界實習
briefs.tags: 業界實習
briefs.desc: 學生經指導教授安排至合適的半導體相關產業或研究單位進行實習，拓展學習視野並習得學以致用之實務經驗。

briefs.name: 人工類神經突觸及記憶體運算元件
briefs.nameEn: Artificial Neuromorphic Synapse and Memory Computing Device
briefs.tags: Semiconductor, Hole, PN-Junction, MOS-capacitor, MOSFET
briefs.desc: Neuromorphic computing aims to realize artificial intelligence (AI) by mimicking the mechanisms of neurons and synapses that make up the human brain. Inspired by the cognitive functions of the human brain that current computers cannot provide, neuromorphic devices have been widely investigated. This course will introduce several conventional memories to students, including NOR and NAND FLASH, resistive-random-access-memory (RRAM), phase-change-memory (PCM), and Ferro-electric-random-access- memory (FeRAM). We will discuss operation principles, process flows, cell structures, array architectures, and challenges of scaling and reliability issues and the applications to the Neuromorphic computing using the nonvolatile memories

briefs.name: 半導體元件
briefs.tags: Basic of Quantum thery, Solid state physics, Band theory
briefs.desc: 開課目的(Course purpose)： To give the basic understanding of Semiconductor devices. 課程說明(Course description)： At first give a lecture of basic of solid-state physics and introduction of quantum. Then, give a lecture of semiconductor physics of covalent-bond and its statistics. Third, give a lecture of PN-junction, Bipolar and MOS-FET.

briefs.name: 超高能隙半導體概論
briefs.nameEn: Introduction to Ultra Wide Bandgap Semiconductors
briefs.tags: 超寬能隙半導體, 碳化矽, 鑽石, 氧化鎵, 氮化鋁, 氮化硼, 高功率, 高電壓, 高溫, 耐輻射 Ultra Wide Bandgap Semiconductor, SiC, diamond, gallium oxide, aluminum nitride, boron nitride, high power, high voltage, high temperature, radiation hard.
briefs.desc: This course teaches graduate students to learn Ultra-Wide Bandgap Semiconductors (UWBGS) with bandgap energy higher than that of SiC. UWBGS includes diamond, gallium oxide, aluminum nitride, and boron nitride, of which material properties, synthesis technology, and applications to very high-voltage, high-power, and radiation hard sensors and electronic devices will be discussed.

briefs.name: 半導體技術之高介電材料介紹
briefs.nameEn: High-k dielectric materials for CMOS technology
briefs.tags: High-K, ALD, Interface, HfO2, Defects
briefs.desc: 一、開課目的(Course purpose)： Prepare the students for a comprehensive exploration of the ever-evolving field of state-of-the-art high-k dielectric-based technologies. This course has been meticulously designed to equip postgraduate students with the essential knowledge and skills necessary to understand and engage with advanced dielectric materials. Participants will delve into crucial electrical and structural characterization methods and deeply engage with the development of cutting-edge memory and logic devices based on high-k hafnium oxide materials. 二、課程說明(Course description)： In 1965, Gordon Moore authored a paper called "Cramming More Components onto Integrated Circuits," where he introduced the idea that the transistor density on chips would exponentially increase, known as Moore's Law. The industry has effectively maintained this exponential growth for the past four decades. It has been crucial to scale up t

briefs.name: 設計自動化一
briefs.tags: algorithms, placement, routing, logic optimization, technology mapping
briefs.desc: This course will describe several important algorithms in placement and routing, clock tree synthesis and routing, logic optimization and technology mapping. It is more for EDA tools for digital SoC chips. We want to motivate more people interested in this important areas.

briefs.name: 全流程智慧系統設計基礎一
briefs.nameEn: Essentials of Intelligent System Design Flow Ⅰ
briefs.tags: 3D-IC (三維積體電路), System-In-Package (系統封裝), System Design Automation (系統設計自動化), Design (設計), Simulation (模擬), Verification (驗證), Test (測試)
briefs.desc: This course will focus on “More than Moore” 3D-IC and System-In-Package design, simulation, and sign-off methodology. The goal of this course is to help students understand how to implement a complex electronics system based on intelligent SDA (System Design Automation) technology. Besides, through this course, students can get the essential components of the challenges of latest system level design from all aspects of advanced packaging design and thermal aware electrical analysis. Meanwhile, this course has practical exercises based on Allegro Package Designer Plus EDA tool. In the practical exercises, students must complete Lab exercises and deliver a final project.

briefs.name: 製程整合
briefs.tags: Process integration, Logic Technology, CMOS, Process Flow, System Integration and 3D Chiplet.
briefs.desc: This course provides the basic introduction of process integration in semiconductor IC manufacturing, and the topics include Logic technology scaling, enablement of new technology nodes, process variation/design co-optimization, process flow in FEOL/MEoL/BEoL, chiplet and 2.5D/3D integration of Wafer-on-Wafer and Chip-on-Wafer technologies, architecture in AI computing, and the implementation of stacking technology into advanced Logic/Memory.

briefs.name: 光學鄰近修正
briefs.tags: 微影技術,光學鄰近效應修正,光罩,半導體,曝光機,光阻
briefs.desc: 本課程將教授光學鄰近效應修正之簡介、架構、理論及實際應用。光學鄰近效應修正(Optical Proximity Correction, OPC)，為先進半導體製程之不可或缺技術，尤其半導體技術進入奈米級節點後，沒有經過OPC修正之光罩根本無法使用。OPC技 技術牽扯到複雜的光學、物理、化學、電漿物理、及材料力學，本課程將以深入淺出之方式，帶領學生理解，甚至進入專業領 域。課程將以課堂教授之方式進行。

briefs.name: 微影、蝕刻、鍍膜、清洗、製程設備與控制
briefs.nameEn: Litho Process & Control, Scanner, Track, Metrology, Deposition, Etching, Cleaning
briefs.tags: Oxidation, Deposition, Etching, Cleaning, Coating, Developing, Physics, Chemistry
briefs.desc: Tokyo Electron Technology Introduction. We would like to give an introduction to semiconductor fabrication technologies and what role Tokyo Electron takes in this Industry. In particular, we will explain some basics of Tokyo Electron’s equipment processing technology including oxidation (reviewing various thermal processes), deposition (Chemical Vapor Deposition, Atomic layer Deposition and Physical Vapor Deposition), dry removal (Plasma etching and Gas Etching), wet cleaning and removal (batch and single wafer, and advanced drying technologies), coater-developer and advanced packaging related technologies. Additionally, we will discuss TEL’s approach to leveraging strengths, aggressive R&D investment, TEL’s focus on the environment and people.

briefs.name: 奈米世代封裝技術
briefs.tags: 先進封裝技術,先進系統整合, PPAC (功耗,效能,面積,成本),Mobile Computing (行動運算), AI/HPC (人工智慧/高效能運算), Chiplets Integration (小晶片整合), Si Interposer (矽中介層),TSV (矽晶圓穿孔), 3DIC Stack (3維晶片堆疊), InFO (整合扇出型封裝), CoWoS (晶片/晶圓堆疊暨基板整合), Silicon Photonics (矽光子), CPO (光學共封裝).
briefs.desc: This graduate course provides a comprehensive overview on semiconductor advanced IC packages and packaging technologies across the applications of mobile computing, networking, and HPC/AI for engineering graduate students. Students will learn both theory and best practices of advanced packaging technology. After the class learning, students are expected to be familiar with the fundamental aspects of advanced IC packaging technologies and packages in architecture, interconnect technology, materials system, thermal/mechanical/electrical/optical characteristics, and reliability, to further prepare themselves for the future career and research work in semiconductor IC packaging area.

briefs.name: 化學機械研磨製程
briefs.tags: 平坦化 (Planarization), 研磨墊(Polishing Pad), 研磨液(Slurry), 研磨碟(Disk), 凹陷(Dishing), 侵蝕(Erosion), 研磨速率(Polishing Rate), 均勻度(Uniformity), 選擇比(Selectivity)
briefs.desc: CMP is one of the curcial process technology in the relentless progress of the CMOS devices towards smaller and faster fabrication. However, there are still many challenges in both the novel process and yield/cost of the CMP process with the associated defect and contamination issues. In this course, three objects are expected to: 1) To equip with sufficient CMP fundamental knowledge 2) To construct a comprehensive thinking model in CMP process 3) To build up the ability in analyzing issues & proposing solutions in CMP process

briefs.name: 半導體薄膜沉積技術
briefs.tags: Semiconductor Processing, Thin Film Deposition, CVD / ALD/PVD, Materials Analysis, Advanced Semiconductor Thin Film Materials
briefs.desc: The three main core technologies in semiconductor manufacturing are Photolithography, Etching Technology, and Thin Film Processing Technology. Thin Film Processing is the most diverse among these, including methods such as Evaporation, Sputtering, Molecular Beam Epitaxy (MBE), Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD), and Atomic layer Deposition (ALD), and others. Therefore, this course will focus on the fundamental preparation principles of these techniques and their applications in semiconductor devices. The curriculum will also cover the rationale for selecting a specific thin-film technique for a particular fabrication step. Finally, we will introduce preparation methods for novel semiconductor materials developed in recent years, along with the key analysis techniques for semiconductor thin film materials.

briefs.name: 電漿蝕刻原理及製程技術
briefs.nameEn: Plasma Etching Principal and Process Technology
briefs.tags: 電漿蝕刻; Plasma Etch; 半導體製程原理; Semiconductor process principle; 真空技術; Vacuum Technology
briefs.desc: Introductory course on plasma etch principle, focusing on the low-temperature plasma physics used for plasma etch process and generic plasma etch chamber functionality. Also plasma etch process development and applications, focusing on the real application examples for plasma process parameter selection and the problem solving principal practice in a production environment. This course will be taught in English.

briefs.name: 先進半導體製程技術
briefs.tags: 積體電路、半導體製程、微影技術、蝕刻技術、薄膜製程技術
briefs.desc: 隨著科技的進步，半導體技術已經成為現代電子產業的核心，本課程的開設旨在幫助碩博士生深入理解和掌握半導體製程技術，特 別是積體電路（IC）的生產過程中的各種關鍵技術。課程將涵蓋微影技術、蝕刻技術、薄膜製程技術、離子佈值技術、化學機械研 磨技術、金屬化製程及製程整合技術等。先教授標準教科書的內容，讓學生全面了解如何在半導體製程中基礎核心概念。再增加近 十年國際半導體領域最重的國際會議IEDM and VLSI symposium資料，讓學生能學習到最先進的製程發展，以大幅縮短產學落 差。

briefs.name: 半導體製造之製程監控和品質改善技術
briefs.nameEn: Process monitoring and quality improvement technology in semiconductor manufacturing
briefs.tags: 統計製程控制, SPC, 監控, 製程改善, 缺陷, 品質監測
briefs.desc: 本課程極適合未來想從事於品管工程師、製程整合、和各模組工程師，因為課程內容主要著重於半導體廠內線上監控數據的處理 和製程改善方向; 至於在製程改善方向都是以製程能力為主，內容的重點，會講述再半導體廠內，品質如何監測，從氧化、沉 積、金屬化、微影、蝕刻、離子植入、化學機械平坦化等各模組的品質測量項目，這個章節討論比較多的是缺陷形式和其原因， 也會討論其改善的方法，其方向是重在學生邏輯的思考，所以課堂討論和考試也重在邏輯方式的思考回答。

briefs.name: 扇出型晶圓級封裝
briefs.tags: Fan-Out Wafer-Level Packaging (FOWLP), InFO (Integrated Fan-Out), 3DIC, CoWoS, Fan-out Panel Level Packaging (FOPLP), Chip First, Chip Last
briefs.desc: TSMC employed their InFO (integrated fan-out) technology in the application processor for most advanced mobile phone, in 2016, generating great excitement about FOWLP technology throughout the semiconductor packaging community. Essential details of FOWLP – such as the temporary bonding and de- bonding of the carrier on a reconstituted wafer/panel, epoxy molding compound (EMC) dispensing, compression molding, Cu revealing, RDL fabrication, solder ball mounting, etc.– will be addressed.

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文,Thesis
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 專題討論
briefs.tags: Academic, Oral, Slide design, Prsentation Techniques, Public Speaking
briefs.desc: In the pursuit of academic research, excellence involves more than just conducting high-quality studies or writing outstanding papers; the ability to articulate ideas clearly and fluently during presentations is equally vital. An effective presentation not only conveys core findings and concepts in a concise and powerful manner but also helps researchers organize their thoughts and refine the logic behind their topic. This course covers essential public speaking techniques and slide design methods. Finally, through practical exercises and constructive feedback, we aim to elevate every student’s presentation capabilities.

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文, Thesis
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: E-News新聞編採多元媒材培力課程
briefs.nameEn: Journalism Multi-Media Program on E-News Practices
briefs.tags: 自媒體, 創作, PODCAST, INSTAGRAM, YOUTUBE, tiktok, 粉絲團, 小編, 短影音, 訪談, 寫作, 出版, 公關, 行銷, 業配, 獲利
briefs.desc: 為提供跨領域學習，增進科管院學生遊刃於科技財經與大眾傳媒之能力，將透過本X-Class課程培養新聞編輯採訪技能，以科 管院所發行之E-news線上刊物為實作媒體，提升學生媒體素養及培養新聞報導之文字採訪撰寫編輯、編排能力。本課程由科 管院兼任講師周岐原先生教授，安排將在本學期進行實體與線上課程；本課程為一學分選修之X-Class，因此全程將錄製影音 檔案供衝堂學生課後自主學習。衝堂學生課堂中若需與教師討論，則另行安排時段線上進行。 為便利學生選課，本課程將於上下學期重複開課，同樣以E-News為實作刊物，教學內容將有所不同。歡迎有志學習大眾傳播 新聞編採之同學上、下學期均來選修，單獨選修亦可。課程評量方式除課堂互動表現之外，將主要以學生被分派而完成之E- News電子報文章來評定成績。為鼓勵佳作，科管院辦公室將提供獎勵金予表現優異的作品。

briefs.name: 企業導師與職涯發展(二)
briefs.tags: 職涯發展,企業導師,就業,競爭力,校友, career development, mentor, jobs, competency, alumni
briefs.desc: 以科技管理學院「企業導師領航計畫」為主軸，藉由本課程推動「企業導師領航計畫」，讓本院學生提早認知職涯發展，此課程 中由本院及本校傑出企業家校友擔任導師，提供經驗交流及傳承，引領本院大二以上學生了解產業趨勢及就業市場，培養未來競 爭力。具體而言，本課程的導師來自高科技、金融、證券、投資、生物科技、製造、文創、法律各領域，藉由導師們豐富實務經 歷、產業專業、職場生存法則，讓參與課程的同學不斷檢視自己的職涯規劃並調整學習方向。

briefs.name: 創業說書人：從夢想到市場的真實旅程
briefs.nameEn: Founders Unfolded: The Journey Behind the Startup
briefs.teacher: 彭心儀,吳世英,王俊程,劉玉雯
briefs.tags: AI新創, 新創企業, 商業模式, 社會創新, 產業趨勢, 永續發展, AI startup, new venture, business model, social innovation, industry trend, sustainable development
briefs.desc: 本課程旨在啟發學生以創業與創新的思維面對未來產業挑戰。課程邀請多位不同領域的創業者分享其創業歷程與實務經驗，涵蓋 AI新創、數位科技、文化創意、社會企業、綠色能源、地方創生等議題。透過講者對創業夢想、商業模式、資金籌措、永續價值 與社會影響力的真實案例剖析，學生將能理解創業的挑戰與機會，並進而構思屬於自己的創業提案。

briefs.name: 金融機構專題
briefs.tags: Financial Institutions 金融機構,Financial Regulation 金融監理, Capital Adequacy 資本適足率, Securitization 證券化, Credit Risk 信用風險, AI and FinTech 人工智慧與金融科技, Risk Management 風險管理, Mergers and Acquisitions 併購
briefs.desc: This graduate-level course explores key research themes in financial institutions, markets, and risk management, with a focus on regulation, capital adequacy, securitization, risk management practices, and institutional strategy. Building on these themes, the course is designed to guide students in developing an independent research project that may serve as the foundation for future thesis work. The course is organized into four major parts:1. Financial institutions and regulation. 2. Capital adequacy and securitization. 3. Risk management. 4. Institutional responses and strategic developments. Lectures are structured over a 16-week schedule and integrate exercises, case discussions, and research applications to strengthen learning outcomes.

briefs.name: 醫學科學實驗
briefs.teacher: 王群超,劉懿璇,邱于芯,段立珩,彭偉豪
briefs.tags: Real-time quantitative PCR、細菌生化特性鑑定、Bioinstrumentation、抗原抗體反應(肝炎抗體檢測)、Biosignal processing
briefs.desc: 培養學生在醫學科學的實作經驗 讓同學們能夠了解醫學科學在研究與應用的實際例子

briefs.name: 分子生物學
briefs.tags: 基礎化學與生物原理, 基因體, 分子生物學的中心法則, 基因表現調節, 亞細胞生命形態, 調節核酸序列藍圖
briefs.desc: 了解生物分子層面的機制，是理解細胞與生物體如何運作的基石。近幾十年 來，基因學與生物技術出現突破性的進展，我們對於細胞在分 子層面如何運 作有更深入的認識，新興科技也讓我們得以直接操控生物分子本身。為了廣 泛介紹這些進展，本課程劃分為六大部分，包 含: 1. 基礎化學與生物原理, 2. 基因體, 3. 分子生物學的中心法則, 4. 基因表現調節, 5. 亞細胞生命形態, 6. 調節核酸序列藍圖。

briefs.name: 轉譯醫學
briefs.tags: 生物醫學, 生物技術, 臨床, 新藥開發, biomedicine, biotechnology, clinical, drug development
briefs.desc: Translational medicine depicts a "bench-to-bedside" process, transforming discoveries from basic research into clinical application. In this course, we will introduce general concepts about translation medicine, provide an overview of current development of translational research in biomedicine, including history, success and failure, as well as ethical debates. We will also discuss guidelines for designing and conducting a translational study, and the regulatory issues abound. In addition to lectures given by instructors, Biomedical R&D and physician scientist will be invited to offer their viewpoints and experiences in industry, lab and clinics. To the end of this course, students will understand the basic terminology in translational medicine and will gain a general concept about drug development and (pre-) clinical trials.

briefs.name: 醫用寄生蟲概論
briefs.tags: 寄生蟲學、吸蟲、絛蟲、線蟲、原蟲 parasitology, trematoda, cestoda, nematode, protozoa
briefs.desc: 本課程以蟲種分類為教學主線，傳授全世界對人體危害較為重要之寄生蟲與傳播媒介，本課程分為三大類，分別為蠕蟲、原蟲及 節肢動物，蠕蟲又分為吸蟲、絛蟲、線蟲，原蟲又分為瘧原蟲、阿米巴及鞭毛蟲，其次而是著重以感染位置分類並介紹之基礎寄 生蟲學。教學的方向內容包括寄生蟲學的基本原理、生活史、人體疾病與治療，本課程教學的目的為讓第一次接觸寄生蟲學的學 生能快速進入學習，且透過影片增進學生對寄生蟲學之興趣。

briefs.name: 組織學
briefs.tags: 人體組織學; 基本組織; 器官的組織與細胞; Human histology; basic tissues; tissues and cells of organs
briefs.desc: 研讀光學顯微鏡下人體的組織架構與電子顯微鏡下細胞超微細構造,了解器官內不同組織如何構成器官,以及不同細胞與非細胞成 分如何構成組織及其功能,並且了解正常組織的結構為病理診斷打下基礎.課程目的: 1.認識顯微鏡下細胞內胞器的結構與功能. 2.認識顯微鏡下四種基本組織的結構與染色特徵. 3.認識不同器官中組織及各種細胞的結構與功能. 4.學生於心中建立身體器官與組織架構的三度空間觀念(心象).

briefs.name: 專題研究
briefs.tags: 專題研究
briefs.desc: 每位學生在指導教授指定之題目與指導之下，進行實驗、研究，依據實驗結果完成報告。

briefs.name: 人體解剖學虛擬實作
briefs.teacher: 李佳霖,莊永仁,張壯榮,段立珩
briefs.tags: 解剖學, 生理學, 器官, 虛擬實境, VR
briefs.desc: 以解剖學虛擬實境教材進行教學，其具備下列以下功能：可以觀察人體的局部（例如頭、胸、腹部等，亦即局部解剖學）；也可 單獨觀察某個系統（例如呼吸、循環、消化、神經等系統，亦即系統解剖學）；可以搜尋與定位特定的器官構造；有不同角度的 切面，且可放大切面觀察細節；可以將數個切面組合以觀察各器官構造之走向、相對位置與關係；互動式解剖（可將器官構造移 開、放回、旋轉等）；可將器官構造著色與標記；可以與同部位的X光、MRI或CT影像一起觀察比對；內含器官構造之說明、影片 與動畫。

briefs.name: 生物醫學工程
briefs.tags: Biomedical Engineering; Biomaterials; Tissue Engineering; Biomedical Optics; Molecular Separation
briefs.desc: Biomedical Engineering is connected with many fields of life/medical sciences and engineering. Due to the diversity of the field, beginners typically will need a large amount of work to collect the necessary knowledge in order to understand of the fundamentals. Biomedical Engineering is an integrated course of lectures and you will be exposed to a wide variety of biomedical engineering concept, instrumentation, and techniques.

briefs.name: 醫學統計與流行病學
briefs.tags: statistics; hypothesis testing; medicine; epidemiology; study design
briefs.desc: 本課程前半學期介紹統計學之基本概念與應用，每堂課最後一節會以R統計軟體進行實作。 後半學期介紹流行病學之基本概念，內容可分成三部分：第一部分是基本流行病學測量；第二部分是流行病學研究設計，介紹常 見的研究設計；第三部分則是流行病學的實例與研究。

briefs.name: 醫學微生物與免疫學
briefs.tags: Microbiology, Bacteriology, Virology, Immunology, Antibiotics, Vaccine, Infectious disease
briefs.desc: This is a general lecture of Medical Microbiology and Immunology. The lecture is split into three major parts, including bacteriology, virology, and immunology. Students enrolled in this lecture will be introduced with the interaction between the microbial world and the host immunity.

briefs.name: 醫學倫理學
briefs.tags: 醫學倫理（medical ethics），病人自主（Autonomy）、行善（Beneficence）、不傷害（Non-maleficence）、公平正義（Justice）
briefs.desc: 1.本課程希望能幫助學生探索醫學倫理 學中的基本而重要的問題; 2.透過對醫學倫理學的認識，來凝視生 命的意義，確定生命的普遍價值; 3.幫助學生熟悉如何運用醫學倫理學之方 法與思維，來解決生醫學、科技研究與 應用時所產生之倫理、法律、社會問題， 並在遇到道德困難 的情境時，作出正確 的抉擇。 4.培養學生對於生命關懷的熱情與悲憫， 並嘗試以實際行動來表達、實踐對所處 社會的誠摯關懷。

briefs.name: 基因體資料科學
briefs.tags: 基因體資料科學genomic data science, 多體學資料 omics data, 探索式資料分析 exploratory data analysis, 全基因體關聯性分析 genome-wide association study, 多基因風險分數 polygenic risk score, 孟德爾隨機化分析 mendelian randomization
briefs.desc: 隨著基因體學引發的精準醫療革命，能夠更好地分析基因體的數據和資訊變得非常重要，將有助於瞭解人類健康與疾病進展。基 因體資料科學是將統計學和資料科學技術應用於基因體學的一門誇領域學科，旨在培養學生對基因體資料的理解、分析和應用能 力。透過豐富的理論知識和實務技能培養，學生將能夠應對當今生命科學和醫學研究中的日益複雜的基因體資料。

briefs.name: 高齡科技融合音樂照護方案之創新應用
briefs.nameEn: Innovative Application of Gerontechnology with Music Care Program
briefs.tags: 高齡科技Gerontechnology,音樂照護Music Healthcare, 設計思考Design Thinking,大學社會責任 USR
briefs.desc: 本課程以高齡福祉事業的「信念、利潤、倫理」三角架構為核心，結合長照 3.0、Blue Zone 與高齡科技，帶領學生理解健康 長壽社區的發展趨勢。課程導入設計思考、DBL、利害關係人訪談與人物誌建構，並透過USR場域觀察、科技倫理與共生設計深 化實作能力。藉由參訪長照機構與北部高齡場域，學生將探討失智友善社會、創新服務、AI 音樂陪伴等議題，最終以分組提案 與專題報告展現創新高齡福祉解方。

briefs.name: 高齡照護與高齡科技應用
briefs.nameEn: Elderly Care and the Application of Gerontechnology
briefs.tags: R03;高齡照護 (Elderly Care)、高齡科技 (Gerontechnology)、精準健康 (Precision Health)、長期照護 (Long-term Care)、智慧醫療 (Smart Healthcare)、物聯網應用 (IoT Application)、老年醫學 (Geriatrics)、生成式AI (Generative AI)、輔助科技 (Assistive Technology)
briefs.desc: R03;本課程因應超高齡社會挑戰，旨在培育具備「老年醫學核心知識」與「高齡科技應用視野」之跨域人才。課程由醫師、護理師等臨 床專 家，結合福祉科技產業高階主管聯合授課。內容涵蓋老年醫學評估、長期照護實務，以及 AIoT、智慧輔具、穿戴式裝置等前瞻科技在照 護現場的實際應用。透過理論與產業實務的對話，引導學生針對高齡照護痛點，探索具可行性的創新科技解決方案。

briefs.name: 基因大數據分析
briefs.tags: 精準醫療、高通量定序、大數據分析、基因表現定序、外顯子定序。Precision Medicine、Next generation sequencing、Big data analysis、RNA-seq、Exome-seq。
briefs.desc: 精準醫療是一現代醫學的終極目標, 其中基因資訊的解讀扮演了重要的關鍵角色, 因著高通量定序技術的發展，定序資料的分析 與解讀也越發重要。本課程將先介紹高通量定序的發展，然後將針對目前在研究與臨床應用最多的技術RNA-seq與Exome-seq來 深入探討，課程會說明這兩個技術的實驗細節與臨床應用，並利用Galaxy platform來進行序列分析的教學，同時學生也會實際 在電腦上操作，透過學會galaxy platform的分析流程，來進行序列資料解讀與探討其生物意義，培養學生可以獨立進行高通量 定序資料分析的能力。

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: Seminar, Molecular Biology, Virology, Cell Biology, Structural Biology, General Life Science
briefs.desc: This is the seminar course aiming at training students for scientific talk and discussion.

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: 書報討論Seminar，科學論文Scientific publication，文獻探討Literature search，口頭報告Oral presentation
briefs.desc: 本課程將讓學生了解基本的科學論文架構、文獻蒐集以及閱讀科學論文的技巧，包含教師授課以及學生的口頭報告，讓學生 練習整理以及利用口頭報告呈現科學論文和雙向的互動討論，藉此增加學生對科學的思考能力及口頭報告的能力。 This course will provide students with an understanding of basic scientific paper structure, literature databases, and reading skills for scientific papers. Includes teacher lectures and student oral reports for students to practice. The organization uses oral reports to reflect interactive discussions of scientific papers and subjects, promote students' scientific thinking abilities, and improve oral reporting skills.

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: 感染、癌症、免疫、藥物開發、醫學轉譯
briefs.desc: 本課程將著重於分子生物學/醫學相關課題，透過期刊論文的討論，學習生醫領域相關研究的實驗模式、方法以及當今研究的 最新發現，培養學生閱讀、查詢、整合及表達科學文獻的能力。

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: Neuropsychiatric disorders, 神經精神疾病, Neurobiology, 神經生物學, animal models, 動物模式,seminar, 書報討論,
briefs.desc: This seminar focuses on recent advances in the neurobiology of neuropsychiatric disorders. Each student will present one original research article and lead a brief discussion. The course emphasizes critical reading, scientific communication, and understanding current trends in neuroscience research.

briefs.name: 工程科技英文閱讀與溝通
briefs.nameEn: English Reading and Communication for Engineering Students
briefs.tags: English for academic purposes (學術英文), English for specific purposes (專業英文), poster presentation (海報發表), English for meetings (會議英文), graph literacy (圖表素養), speaking skills 口說技巧
briefs.desc: In addition to knowledge and technical acumen, effective communication is crucial in the engineering fields. To improve their communicative abilities, students practice essential language skills to enhance their academic performance in their fields. The course consists of three dimensions: English for meetings, classroom discussions, and presentations. Through role-play speaking activities, group discussions, poster presentations, students develop as much confidence as fluency and competence in using English in academic contexts.

briefs.name: 專業實踐倫理
briefs.tags: 倫理, 道德, 價值觀, 專業, 工程, Ethics, Morality, Values, Profession, Engineering
briefs.desc: 首先，定義倫理作為本課程之討論基礎。討論專業倫理標準，思考建立個人價值觀。討論分析反思工程及專業倫理案例，建立個 人專業倫理準繩。 First, define ethics as the foundation for discussions in this course. Discuss professional ethics standards and reflect on the development of personal values. Analyze and reflect on engineering and professional ethics cases to establish personal professional ethics standards.

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: seminar, interdisciplinary, engineering, lecturebased, EMI
briefs.desc: This is an interdisciplinary course with a series of lectures by guest speakers (professors, scholars, and experts) from research fields related to engineering. This course is designed to provide students with ideas and thoughts on diverse cutting edge research. This course aims to help students develop their own strategic thinking, explore and expand their research interests.

briefs.name: 創新創業與營運管理實務
briefs.tags: 創新,創業,產業,管理,公司治理
briefs.desc: 本課程的目的就是希望能夠幫助有志走新創事業的理工科學生裝備基礎的會計、財 務、公司治理的知識。希望從會計和財務的 點，以學生的新創事業為假想，提供可能的方法，希望能夠回答，在有了特定技術後，甚麼時間點該創業? 除了技術外，該著力 於何處? 何時才是市場成熟的時機? 什麼樣的階段適合留在學校繼續培育，達到什麼樣的規模後，適合進入產業?

briefs.name: 人工智慧運算架構與系統一
briefs.tags: computer architecture, high performance computing, AI accelerator, CPU design, Artificial Intelligence
briefs.desc: High-Performance Computing (HPC) 產業因為半導體產業的相關先進技術進步，所設計的晶片越來越複雜，對於一個想跨入這個產 業的學習 者，會面臨很多的困難，台灣由於半導體產業蓬勃發展，在晶片設計的後段設計生產製造方面，多年來培育了非常多不同領域的人才，但是 在前 段晶片設計與軟硬體系統整合發展上，一直比較受限，台灣產業的屬性與學校教育的環境在HPC這個領域並未開展開來，而HPC 晶片的開發 因為 複雜度相對於Edge Computing 晶片的複雜度高，需要很多新的設計概念與方法，以及具備更多垂直整合系統設計的要求，為了因應在人 才培育 上，HPC 的發展需要新的課程與方法，ACAL 準備了一系列的課程，希望能協助想進入HPC 前段設計的學習者，了解這個領域的基本技能 需求， 並建立一個共學的環境，讓對這個領域有熱情的同好，能有一個共同學習與做研究的平台。 這門課每個階段的教學會有一個主題，可能是該主題的入門概論，可能是理論基礎課程，也可能是從實作面出發的主題討論課程，在期末專 題提 案之前，每一個探討的主題，都是為了協助同學了解人工智慧晶片設計的流程與基礎。

briefs.name: 經濟學原理二
briefs.tags: 經濟學, 個體經濟, 國際貿易, 比較利益, 市場均衡
briefs.desc: 本門課程簡介經濟學的基本原理。經濟學不是一門教人自私的社會科學，而是研究個人、廠商和組織如何做選擇的社會科學。 本課程主要介紹理性消費者和廠商決策的最適化，以及市場如何運作和達成均衡的原理。本課程也將介紹在不同市場結構下，廠商的訂價和合作競爭等決策行為。最後，本課程將分析政府在經濟社會運作中可以和應該扮演的角色（或者不扮演）。鑑於近年來各國對公平、正義的呼聲日益高漲，本課程也將針對部分大眾對於經濟學的迷思進行答辯和剖析。

briefs.name: 經濟學原理二
briefs.tags: 總體經濟學, Macroeconomics, GDP, Employment, Inflation, Fiscal Policies, Monetary Policies
briefs.desc: This course offers an introduction to the theories and applications of macroeconomics. We will discuss the basic macroeconomic concepts and models concerning the behavior of the major aggregate variables, such as GDP, employment, and prices. We will also apply the theories to explain macroeconomic phenomena in the economy and to illuminate issues in macroeconomics policies. You are expected to come into this class with basic knowledge in the principles of microeconomics. This course is offered in English. Upon successful completion of this course, students will be able to (1) define and discuss key terminology of the macro economy, (2) describe and discuss standard theories of long-run and short-run macroeconomics, (3) discuss the impacts of fiscal and monetary policies using verbal, graphical and simple mathematical techniques, including elementary algebra.

briefs.name: 經濟學原理二
briefs.tags: Economics, macroeconomics
briefs.desc: 本課程教授經濟學原理中總體經濟學部分

briefs.name: 經濟學原理二
briefs.tags: monetary policy, fiscal policy, GDP, inflation, unemployment.
briefs.desc: 此科目欲培養之核心能力為:具備基本經濟學知識，瞭解經濟學範疇，與運用經濟思維解釋經濟議題。授課以教師講解為主, 歡迎 同學隨時發問並提出意見。

briefs.name: 經濟學原理二
briefs.tags: 差別取價，總體經濟學，國民生產毛額，經濟增長，通貨膨脹，貨幣政策，財政政策；price discrimination, macroeconomics, GDP, Economic Growth, Inflation, Monetary Policy, Fiscal Policy
briefs.desc: This course offers an introduction to macroeconomics theories and applications. We will discuss topics such as, GDP, unemployment, and inflation. We will also introduce various uses of macroeconomic policy by government to achieve some specific goal such as promoting long-run economic growth, stabilizing inflation, and smoothing out the business cycle.

briefs.name: 經濟學原理二
briefs.tags: 國民所得, 物價水準, 經濟成長, 貨幣政策, 國際金融, national income, price level, economic growth, monetary policy, international finance
briefs.desc: 本課程目的在以經濟學的基本分析工具探討總體經濟學的核心議題。內容以包括總體 經濟學的基本概念，如國民所得、物價水準、經濟成長、貨幣政策、及國際金 融等。

briefs.name: 經濟學原理二
briefs.tags: Macroeconomics, Gross Domestic Product (GDP), Inflation, Monetary Policy, Aggregate Demand
briefs.desc: This course focuses on Macroeconomics, the study of the economy as a whole. Building upon the principles of rational choice, students will examine key indicators of economic health, including Gross Domestic Product (GDP), the cost of living, and unemployment. The curriculum covers the structure of the financial system, the role of money and inflation, and the dynamics of an open economy. Students will also analyze Aggregate Demand and Supply to understand short-term economic fluctuations and evaluate how monetary and fiscal policies influence these variables. The goal is to equip students with the analytical skills necessary to interpret complex business situations and make informed economic decisions.

briefs.name: 經濟學
briefs.tags: 經濟學，Economics，廠商行為，經濟成長，貨幣政策
briefs.desc: 經濟學是研究理性個人如何做選擇的社會科學。本課程主要介紹消費者與廠商如何做決策。在消費者理論方面，本課程將探討影 響消費者購買行為之因素與其決策準則。在生產者理論方面，本課程將介紹在不同市場結構下，廠商的生產與定價決策行為。此 外，本課程也將分析政府在經濟社會所扮演之角色。最後，本課程介紹衡量一國產出水準與財富指標，分析影響一國失業率、物 價水準(通貨膨脹)的可能因子，以及政府如何利用政策工具(如:貨幣政策)改善國內失業率與產出水準。

briefs.name: 會計學二
briefs.tags: Accounting,會計,property,liabilities of the firm, analyses of the company-organization
briefs.desc: Accounting (II), continues the Accounting (I). This course focus on these topics: property, liabilities of the firm, analyses of the company-organization, and accounting information. The purpose of the financial accounting is primarily to provide the data concerning enterprise’s financial standing to the exterior personage rather than business enterprise administrator. This course seeks to develop your ability to prepare and to use financial accounting information.

briefs.name: 會計學二
briefs.tags: IFRS, Financial statements analysis, GAAP, Investment, Internal Control, Management, 財務報表分析, 投資, 內部控制, 企業管理
briefs.desc: This course aims to make students familiar with financial reporting procedures and assist them in reading financial statements.

briefs.name: 企業概論
briefs.tags: 營運企畫;產業分析;市場研究;募資;創業
briefs.desc: 本課程將由企業營運的基本概念介紹為開端（包括企業組織類型﹑企業外在環境與企業在社會之角色扮演等），再以企業內部機 能 （包括人力資源﹑行銷﹑生產﹑研究發展﹑財務）為主軸，詳述現階段與未來企業實際運作的法則，以協助同學奠定未來進階管 理 課程的基礎，以及將來進入企業後實務的操作。

briefs.name: 個體經濟學二
briefs.tags: Competitive Market, monopoly, oligopoly, public goods, externalities
briefs.desc: This course is an advanced undergraduate course that teaches the fundamentals of microeconomics. Microeconomics I is prerequisite. This course begins with a review of competitive firms and market. Next, we discuss different models of market structure, including monopoly and monopsony, oligopoly and monopolistic competition. Last, we study several important topics in microeconomics, such as uncertainty, asymmetric information, public goods and externalities.

briefs.name: 個體經濟學二
briefs.tags: 一般均衡 ，獨佔，寡占，賽局理論，訊息不對稱，外部性，道德危機；general equilibrium, monopoly, oligopoly, game theory, asymmetric information, externality, moral hazard
briefs.desc: This course is offered in English and is the second part of an one-year microeconomics course of Microeconomics which is a requirement for Economics program. Knowledge of calculus will be expected as it is used frequently for solving problems. The course starts with a general equilibrium setting and discuss the economic welfare of such setting. We then investigate several market structures other than perfect competition, in which firms have the market power. A detailed analysis on firms behavior and the corresponding welfare analysis will be discussed. Lastly, we will talk about economics with uncertainty and various sources of market failure such as externality, asymmetric information, and moral hazard.

briefs.name: 個體經濟學二
briefs.tags: 一般均衡, 賣方獨佔與買方獨佔, 賽局理論, 佔市場, 不確定性, 訊息不對稱, general equilibrium, monopoly and monopsony, game theory, oligopoly, uncertainty, asymmetric information
briefs.desc: This course is the second part of Microeconomics and is a follow-up of Prof. Wu’s Microeconomics I. This course intends to apply more advanced tools, including algebra and calculus, to analyze various microeconomic issues. In this semester, we will mainly study the properties of various markets, and consumers’ and producers’ decisions in these markets.

briefs.name: 個體經濟學二
briefs.tags: firms; production; profit maximization; game theory; monopoly; oligopoly
briefs.desc: Economics is the study of human behavior. To understand how people can cooperate in social orders, and why they often cannot, we need to have a framework for understanding human action and its consequences. Economics provides one such framework. Microeconomics has been applied to issues ranging from those expected in economics, such as what determines the price of consumer goods, to such things as how people vote, how much education they acquire, and how many children they have. This course offers an introduction to the theory and methods of microeconomics. In the first semester, we will cover topics include the simple demand and supply framework, consumer choice and demand under constrained maximization; price and output determination of the firm, and the perfect competition model.

briefs.name: 貨幣銀行學二
briefs.tags: 中央銀行, 貨幣政策, 貨幣政策傳導機制, 金融監督與管理 Central Bank, Monetary Policy, Monetary Policy Transmission Mechanism, Regulation and Supervision of the Financial System
briefs.desc: 這門課主要介紹在現代自由市場經濟及金融體系下，中央銀行扮演的角色與任務、貨幣政策的目標、工具與操作方式、以及 貨幣政策的傳導機制等觀念。此外，本課程亦將介紹現代金融監督與管理以及貨幣經濟理論。 本課程主要探討的議題如下： (1) 中央銀行扮演的角色與任務 (2) 貨幣政策的目標、工具與操作方式 (3) 貨幣政策的傳導機制 (4) 金融監督與管理 (5) 現代貨幣經濟理論

briefs.name: 貨幣銀行學二
briefs.tags: financial system, monetary policy, interest rate, inflation, central banking
briefs.desc: 本課程分析貨幣、銀行體系、與金融市場對現代經濟活動的影響以及其交互作用。本學期將強調中央銀行的功能與影響。 課程內容以指定用書為主並輔以其他補充教材。

briefs.name: 統計學二
briefs.tags: statistics, data analysis, regression, 統計學, 資料分析, 迴歸分析
briefs.desc: This course is the second part of a two-semester sequence. The goal of Statistics II is to learn to answer empirical questions using regression and other statistical methods. We will focus on studying regression and its applications through data analysis, visualization, and simulation. The design of the course is less mathematical than the instructor's Statistics I and focuses more on hands-on applications.

briefs.name: 統計學二
briefs.tags: 大樣本假設檢定 Large-Sample Tests of Hypotheses, 小樣本推論 Inference from Small Samples, 變異數分析 The Analysis of Variance, 簡單線性迴歸與相關 Simple Linear Regression and Correlation, 多元線性迴歸分析 Multiple Linear Regression Analysis
briefs.desc: 本課程承接上學期之統計學基礎訓練，進一步教授統計學的核心推論方法與實務應用能力，適合商學院學生修習。課程內容涵蓋 區間估計、假設檢定、兩母體比較、變異數分析（ANOVA）、迴歸分析等主題，協助學生建構更完整的統計推論架構。課程重視 統計理論與應用的結合，透過真實資料與生活議題的案例，引導學生進行資料分析與解讀，強化其資料素養與問題解決能力，並 能運用統計方法萃取關鍵資訊，做出有根據的推論與決策。

briefs.name: 文化與經濟
briefs.tags: 文化, 經濟, 藝術, 傳播, 文創產業
briefs.desc: 這門課的主題是合併探討文化與經濟活動之間的關係，一方面試圖將文化因素導入經濟分析，另一方面利用經濟分析解釋 文化活動與文化現象，開拓經濟學的領域。將文化因素導入經濟分析的方面，本課將提出理解文化因素的分析角度，並且 探討如何結合經濟理性與意識形態，解釋文化對於經濟活動的影響。在解釋文化活動與現象的經濟分析中，本課的內容包 括兩部份︰一部份是以經濟學分析文化活動，所謂的文化活動包括贈禮、宗教、藝術等等；另一部份則是分析文化表現中 呈現的經濟意義，所謂的文化表現將包括文學、電影等媒體。

briefs.name: 成本與管理會計二
briefs.tags: Managerial Accounting, Planning, Performance Evaluation, Pricing, Cost Accounting
briefs.desc: The goal of cost and managerial accounting is to acquaint students of management with the fundamental tools of management accounting, but also to promote their understanding of the dramatic ways in which the field is changing. The emphasis throughout the course is on using accounting information in managing an organization. In this course, the traditional tools of managerial accounting, like product costing, budgeting, and performance evaluation, will be augmented and updated with contemporary approaches such as activity-based costing, customer profitability analysis, value-chain analysis, target costing, balanced scorecard, and strategic cost management.

briefs.name: 財務報導與實務
briefs.tags: Financial Reporting,Financial Accounting, business Analysis, Enterprise Valuation, Earning Forecast
briefs.desc: This course is designed to provide a strong conceptual, analytical and procedural foundation for the study of financial reporting and practice. The historical development of accounting thought and the role of financial accounting in today’s economy are investigated. Socioeconomic, political, legal, and ethical influences on financial reporting are considered. Discussions include procedures to record, summarize, and report results of business events; content and presentation of financial statements and specific reporting issues related to cash and receivable. An overview of financial statement analysis is also presented. International issues are addressed as appropriate.

briefs.name: 經濟系職涯規劃
briefs.tags: 經濟系，職涯規劃，校友演講 Economics Graduates, Career Development
briefs.desc: 本課程為經濟系同學介紹未來職涯發展，由邀請畢業之校友以演講來分享求職或升學經驗，並對於其從事的行業或產業進行深度的介紹，以增進 並且協助修課同學對于畢業後的職涯規劃

briefs.name: 計量經濟學二
briefs.tags: Statistics, econometrics, policy evaluation 統計、計量、政策評估
briefs.desc: This course is the second part of the introductory econometrics sequence. The first part introduces the fundamentals of regression, where ordinary least squares (OLS) serves as an effective estimation method under certain "classical" assumptions. Building on this foundation, we will explore five key topics: a statistics review, experiments (specifically, randomized controlled trials), panel data, instrumental variables, and difference-in-differences (DID) & regression discontinuity design (RDD). By the end of the course, you should have a solid understanding of various empirical research designs that enable credible analysis and feel comfortable working with real-world data. The primary focus of this course is estimation theory, with extensions to hypothesis testing. While the emphasis remains on theoretical concepts, students will have multiple opportunities to gain hands-on experience with real datasets through homework assignments. I strongly e

briefs.name: 數據分析與機器學習
briefs.tags: 數據分析, 機器學習, 貝氏統計, AI數理基礎, Python程式設計
briefs.desc: This course surveys basic concepts and technical tools required for proceeding the Bayesian data analysis. The goal of this course targets to equip students with the understandings of how to interpret and what are the limits of common data analytical results. In addition to introducing theoretically analytical models, proper programming skills are covered in this course. Note: This course requires learning Python programming skills for verifying theoretical methods and practicing analytical applications.

briefs.name: 總體經濟學二
briefs.tags: IS-LM model, Business Cycle, Unemployment, Inflation, Exchange Rate System
briefs.desc: The course will cover economic growth, consumption, investment, unemployment, business cycles, inflation, monetary and fiscal policy, financial markets and international macroeconomics.

briefs.name: 總體經濟學二
briefs.tags: Macroeconomics, Monetary Policy, New Keynesian, Price adjustment, Dynamic implications
briefs.desc: This course is the continuation of Macroeconomics I. Following the foundation of the Real Business Cycle model, I plan to teach the modern New Keynesian model in which consumers or firms cannot adjust their prices freely. In order to teach the New Keynesian model, I will start with the traditional money demand and supply model, such as IS-LM model. The course design allows students to build a solid foundation in analytical skills that can potentially assist them in analyzing the current macroeconomics events in a more profound point of view.

briefs.name: 總體經濟學二
briefs.tags: Macroeconomics,Empirical, 總體, 經濟, 實證
briefs.desc: In this course, we will continue exploring the theories and the empirical findings about macroeconomics. These topics include money, inflation, IS-LM analysis, and asset pricing. We will learn more the general frameworks for Macroeconomic analysis. This is the second part of the Macroeconomic sequence.

briefs.name: 財政學二
briefs.tags: 租稅轉嫁、無謂損失、租稅競爭、避稅、地方分權, tax shifting, deadweight loss, tax competition, tax avoidance, fiscal federalism
briefs.desc: The principal objective of this course is to provide a working knowledge of modern theoretical techniques for investigating how taxes affect economic behaviors and how tax policies can be evaluated. The course will also provide empirical findings relevant for evaluating the theoretical arguments. In addition, the course will introduce the revenue systems and ongoing tax issues in Taiwan.

briefs.name: 政治經濟學
briefs.tags: voting, rent seeking, institution, political incentive, bureaucracy
briefs.desc: This course is an introductory class on political economy. Political economy broadly refers to applying the methodology of economics to analyze political behavior and institutions. The first half of the class introduces the analytical tools, with a focus on voting theory. Some of the questions we will discuss in class include: why do people vote? what determines voters’ voting behavior? what are the incentives of politicians? The second half of the class covers essential topics discussed by political economists, such as rent seeking, bureaucracy, and institutions.

briefs.name: 審計學二
briefs.tags: 審計, 查核, 內部控制, 舞弊, audit
briefs.desc: 說明審計理論及查核實務，主要以講義授課彙整重點，輔以補充審計公報內容補充。

briefs.name: 數理經濟學二
briefs.tags: 跨期選擇, 動態經濟模型, 總體經濟學, 最適控制, 動態規劃, intertemporal choices, dynamic economic models, macroeconomics, optimal control, dynamic programming
briefs.desc: 本門課的目標是介紹研究經濟動態的常用分析工具，包括微分方程式、差分方程式、動 態規劃、最適控制等。動態經濟模型的應用範圍很廣泛，尤其在現代的總體經濟學。我們 希望用這些數學工具來幫助同學學習總體經濟學，特別著重在消費者的跨期選擇及相關的 動態經濟模型。

briefs.name: 國際經濟學二
briefs.tags: 國際金融，匯率，利率平價，國際總體經濟學，international finance, international macroeconomics, exchange rate regimes
briefs.desc: The goal of this course is to understand the financial aspects of international economy, and how these are affected by the macroeconomic policies.

briefs.name: 產業組織
briefs.tags: Market Structure 市場結構, Perfect Competition 完全競爭, Monopoly 獨佔, Oligopoly 寡占, Monopolistic Competition 獨佔性競爭, Social Welfare 社會福利, Deadweight Loss 無謂損失, Game Theory 賽局理論，Nash Equilibrium 納許均衡，Price Discrimination 差別取價，Price Rigidity 價格僵固,
briefs.desc: 本課程屬於個體經濟學的範疇，將探討產業組織理論的基本理論及政府對產業干預的影響，內容包括討論在各種不同市場結構 (Market Structure)下：完全競爭、獨佔、寡佔、獨佔性競爭等產業結構下，廠商的行為 (Conducts) 以及在各個產業結構下市場的成效 (Performance) 或整個社福利的水準。接著根據成效分析的結果提供政府制定產業規範 (regulation) 政策或市場干預的參考。為了方便分析寡佔廠商的策略,我們 也將介紹非合作賽局理論。 Keywords: Market Structure 市場結構，Perfect Compeitition 完全競爭，Mononpoly 獨佔，Oligopoly 寡占，Monopolistic Competition 獨佔 性競爭，Game Theory 賽局理論，Nash Equilibrium 納許均衡，Price Discrimination 差別取價，Price Rigidity 價格僵固

briefs.name: 人口經濟學理論與實務
briefs.tags: population; fertility; households; labor supply; immigration
briefs.desc: This course focuses on research on population economics. Students will be introduced to a wide range of theoretical and empirical research topics related to population economics and learn to develop the ability to conduct research in this field. Population economics or demographic economics is a field in economics that applies economic analysis to demography, the study of human populations and society. Topics in population include changes in family arrangements, immigration (and the assimilation of immigrants), fertility choice, evolution of gender norms and its impact on individual outcomes, household bargaining, aging, labor supply, education, as well as how laws and policies affect population.

briefs.name: 計量經濟學的因果推論
briefs.tags: OLS, IV, DiD, RDD, IPW, SC
briefs.desc: Economics (or management in general) always concerns the cause-effects such as the price causes the quantity demanded/supplied, or a training program causes the productivity of the unemployed. In a nutshell, a casual equation specifies how a treatment affects an outcome. In this course, we start with some critiques on the conventional econometric tools such as ordinary least squares (OLS) or instrumental variable (IV) estimation which fails to mimic a randomized experiment nor a natural experiment. To mimic the former, we go through the literature on “selecting the observables” such as sub-classification and matching. To mimic the latter, we go through the literature on “selecting the un-observables” such as difference-in-differences (DID), synthetic controls and regression discontinuity (RD). Casual inference with machine learning methods will also be discussed.

briefs.name: 國際金融
briefs.tags: 國際金融，匯率，利率平價，國際總體經濟學，international finance, international macroeconomics, exchange rate regimes
briefs.desc: The objective of this course is to familiarize advanced graduate students with major research questions in international macroeconomics. The course will focus on determination of the account and exchange rate, business cycle comovement, and monetary policy.

briefs.name: 西洋經濟史專題
briefs.tags: Business organisation, Institutional changes, Industrial revolution
briefs.desc: This course is to discuss some important issues in the economic history, including money, banking, agriculture, institutional changes, and industrial revolution. This is seminar, and students are thus encouraged to read related materials before the class and expected to participate in discussion.

briefs.name: 書報討論二
briefs.tags: 國際金融; 國際貿易; 總體與貨幣; 公共經濟學; 產業經濟學; 勞動經濟學
briefs.desc: 本課程為專題演講, 每週會邀請不同校外講者至本系演講, 講授內容為經濟相關論文和課題。藉由專題演講的機會, 希望能讓同學接觸更多元的經濟領域, 並且能和不同專業領域的學者交流學習。

briefs.name: 總體經濟理論與實務
briefs.tags: Macroeconomics, Growth, 總體, 經濟, 成長
briefs.desc: In this course, we will cover several Macroeconomics related topics. We will discuss some macroeconomic facts and issues, and then discuss the techniques for exploring the mysteries of economic development. This is a course designed for graduate students.

briefs.name: 國際貿易
briefs.tags: 國際貿易, 引力模型, 異質性廠商, 外人直接投資, 全球價值鏈, International Trade, Gravity Model, Heterogeneous Firms, Foreign Direct Investment, Global Value Chains
briefs.desc: This course covers topics in international trade and foreign direct investment. The discussion begins with trade costs and the role of geography and information in international trade. We then move to the new trade theory and the role of firm heterogeneity in international trade. We will also study foreign direct investment and the behavior of multinational firms. Finally, we will look into offshoring and global supply chains.

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文研究, Thesis
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 計量經濟專題
briefs.tags: Causal inference; finite-sample properties; large-sample properties; machine learning; Monte-Carlo experiments
briefs.desc: This is a reasonably updated course of Graduate Econometrics. More precisely, (i) Large-sample properties are the emphases; (ii) Monte-Carlo experiment will be introduced, as it is a way to assess the finite-sample properties; (iii) Relationships between the large-sample properties and the prevalent empirical tools such as those in Causal Inference or Machine Learning will also be discussed.

briefs.name: 個體經濟專題
briefs.tags: 個體經濟學, 人力資本, 勞動經濟學, Microeconomics, human capital, Labor Economics
briefs.desc: This microeconomics topics course presents examples of bridging microeconomic models with data, focusing on models of human capital. The course is broadly divided into 3 parts: 1. Introduction to models of human capital and their identification. 2. Life-cycle models and dynamic programming. 3. Matching markets in education. Parts of these topics might be covered in courses on microeconomic theory, econometrics, computational economics, labor economics, or industrial organization. This course is an attempt to synthesize topics spread across multiple field courses, with the goal of introducing students to tools for taking microeconomic models to data.

briefs.name: 校務研究理論與實務
briefs.tags: Statistics, econometrics, institutional research 統計、計量、校務研究
briefs.desc: This is a topic course on institutional research (IR). We will discuss central issues regarding this field. First, we introduce the core concept of IR from the history of institutional research in the US, Europe, Australia, Korea, Japan, and other countries. Then the recent development of IR in Taiwan will be briefed. Understanding analytical tools associated conducting IR is the next main topic. In particular, we formally explore suitable empirical strategies (i.e., a variety of econometric/big data techniques) along with the search for identification, which will be very much emphasized throughout this course. The ultimate goal of this course is to motivate PhD or master students conducting a quality institutional research. This evidence-based process is crucial for policy makers in higher education institutions. Thereby, students will be required to initiate a new project related to IR, survey the literature, collect data, summarize basic statistic

briefs.name: 總體經濟專題
briefs.tags: Macroeconomics, Heterogeneous Agent, Growth, Search, Dynamic
briefs.desc: This course will go over critical theoretical models in Macroeconomics, including labor search, asset pricing, growth, and heterogeneous agents.

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文研究, Thesis
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行深入研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之創新性成果。

briefs.name: 書報討論二
briefs.tags: 國際金融; 國際貿易; 總體與貨幣; 公共經濟學; 產業經濟學; 勞動經濟學
briefs.desc: 本課程為專題演講, 每週會邀請不同校外講者至本系演講, 講授內容為經濟相關論文和課題。藉由專題演講的機會, 希望能讓同學接觸更多元的經濟領域, 並且能和不同專業領域的學者交流學習。

briefs.name: 偏微分方程與複變函數
briefs.nameEn: Partial Differential Equations and Complex Variables
briefs.tags: 傅立葉分析 (Fourier Analysis), 偏微分方程 (Partial Differential Equations), 複變分析 (Complex Analysis)
briefs.desc: The content of this course is the basic engineering mathematics required by undergraduate students such as differential equations and functions of complex variables: including ordinary differential equations, Laplace transformations, Fourier series solutions and special functions, partial differential equations, functions of complex variables, etc. Note: This course does not involve the use of AI.

briefs.name: 線性代數
briefs.tags: 子空間Subspace, 行列式 Determinant, 特徵值 Eigenvalue, 特徵向量 Eigenvector, 奇異值分解 Singular Value Decomposition
briefs.desc: Linear Algebra is a branch of mathematics that deals with vector spaces and linear transformations. This theory is the foundation of many areas in pure and applied mathematics, including functional analysis, differential geometry, multidimensional calculus, graph theory, etc. The concepts, tools, and, especially, the language of linear algebra are essential and widely used in engineering, physics, economics, social sciences, and natural sciences. For instance, optimization and artificial intelligence (AI) in general, and convex optimization (CVXopt), heavily rely on linear algebra, which provides a great language to intelligently translate a non-CVXopt problem under consideration into a solvable CVXopt problem, thereby leading to optimal solutions together with insightful analysis. The main goal of this course is to build a foundation in linear algebra that is essential to the innovative capability to solve challenging problems in extensive real-world applications.

briefs.name: 離散數學
briefs.tags: linear algebra, vector spaces, linear transformations,
briefs.desc: This is an introductory course to discrete mathematics and is the key to the success of many subjects (including many others outside the EE field) that you will encounter in the future.

briefs.name: 近代物理
briefs.tags: 狹義相對論(Special Relativity )、波粒兩相性(wave-particle duality)、測不準原理（uncertainty principle）、量子物理 (Quantum Physics)
briefs.desc: Explore two cornerstones of modern physics — Einstein's Special Relativity and Quantum Physics.
