Delve into the precision of high- speed phenomena and the microscopic world, covering wave-particle duality, the uncertainty principle, and practical applications in semiconductors, electronics, and beyond. Gain insights into the fundamental principles shaping our understanding of the physical universe.

briefs.name: 電磁學
briefs.tags: 靜電,靜磁,電磁波,傳輸線,平面波,Electrostatics; Magnetostatics,Electromagnetic Waves,Transmission Lines,Plane Waves
briefs.desc: This course aims to use rigorous mathematical formulations to explain experimental phenomena related to electrostatics, steady-state currents, magnetostatics, and electromagnetic interactions. based on these mathematical relationships, Maxwell’s equations are derived, and the discussion is further extended to electromagnetic waves. This course is essential for subsequent studies in electromagnetic waves, optoelectronic engineering, optoelectronics, and solid-state electronic devices.

briefs.name: 電磁學
briefs.tags: 靜電,靜磁,馬克斯威爾方程式,平面波,傳輸線,electrostatics,magnetostatics,Maxwell Equation,Transmission Line,Plane Wave
briefs.desc: Introduction to the basic physics of electromagnetism, including fundamental electrostatics, magnetostatics, electromagnetic interactions, plane electromagnetic waves, and basic transmission line theory.

briefs.name: 電路學
briefs.tags: Electric circuits (電路), circuit analysis (電路分析), circuit theorem (電路理論), first-order circuit (一階電路), second-order circuit (二階電路), sinusoidal steady-state analysis (交流穩態分析)
briefs.desc: This course introduces the basic analytical techniques of electric circuits. Starting from the fundamental circuit laws, this course will show how these laws can be applied in analyzing circuits. The principles of linear circuit systems will also be introduced, and how these principles can be utilized in circuit analysis. The students will not only learn the analytical techniques of electric circuits, but also develop a better understanding of the nature of electric circuits.

briefs.name: 邏輯設計實驗
briefs.tags: Logic Design, FPGA implementation
briefs.desc: 本課程能讓學員深入了解邏輯電路之設計流程，親身體會數位電路之設計經驗。本實驗需先修過邏輯設計(EECS1010)課程始能加選，本實 驗幫助同學快速領悟邏輯設計理論，並能實際應用所學於硬體實驗電路，如此，能讓同學對數位邏輯設計有更深一層的體驗與認知。

briefs.name: 邏輯設計實驗
briefs.tags: Logic Design, FPGA, Programmable Logic, Verilog HDL
briefs.desc: 本課程將教授數位電路設計的實作技術，將邏輯設計之理論實現在實體的可程式邏輯晶片中。將教授硬體描述語言 Verilog HDL、硬體模擬器、FPGA電路板使用、邏輯分析儀使用等硬體設計技術。此外並搭配多個實驗主題的實作，學生 可學習到邏輯晶片之設計流程，相關主題包括組合電路設計、序列電路設計、計數器設計、有限狀態機設計、投票機設 計、多功能時鐘設計。本課程將以上課與上機實際操作互相搭配，學生預計能學習到數位邏輯電路設計之基本技術。

briefs.name: 電子學一
briefs.tags: 電子元件,電路分析,Electronic Components,Circuit Analysis
briefs.desc: This course introduces the fundamental principles of electronic elements and circuits. Using simplified models, we will discuss the characteristics of major electronic devices and circuits, estimate and project basic circuit behavior, and help students understand typical circuit blocks and design methods. In this course, we primarily rely on simplified models to explain circuit behavior and characteristics. These trainings allow the students to develop an overall understanding of the circuit functions and performance tradeoffs. The introduction of various equivalent model concepts discussed in class will help students to read into complex circuits and grasp its main features and key parameters, which is essential to the next-level circuit design courses.

briefs.name: 電子學一
briefs.tags: Microelectronics, Transistors, Amplifiers, Integrated circuits, Models
briefs.desc: This course is an introductory course of microelectronics. We will focus on the fundamental knowledge of microelectronic circuits and emphasize the design-oriented approach. This course introduces the most important concepts for design of analog circuits including physics and models of semiconductor transistors, as well as various amplifier configurations at transistor levels. The frequency response, differential pairs, multistage amplifiers, and operational amplifiers are also included. By developing solid understanding of basic knowledge, learning microelectronics could be enjoyable.

briefs.name: 電子學二
briefs.tags: Analog Integrated Circuit, Integrated Circuit, Linear Circuit, Operational Amplifier Circuit.
briefs.desc: This is a course titled " EE2260 Electronics II" that follows "EE2255 Electronics I". The course will begin with a review of semiconductor devices, then focus on analyzing analog circuits, specifically the operational amplifier, a core component in negative feedback systems.

briefs.name: 計算機程式設計
briefs.tags: Computer programming, declarations, statements, efficiency, legibility, structure programming, object oriented programming; 電腦程式，宣告，執行動作，效率，可讀 性，結構型程式，物件導向程式
briefs.desc: The main objective of this introductory course is to help students develop programming skills to solve problems. As computers are becoming more powerful and ubiquitous, proper use of computers can increase productivity significantly. Thus, the ability to write efficient programs to solve problems improves one’s core competence and can be an important differentiator for one’s career. Among today’s popular programming languages, C is found to have the biggest impacts. Many modern computer languages borrowed heavily from C. Thus, proficiency in C language would pave ways to good programming in other languages. In this course, we will devote most of the time in C programming. object-oriented programming and classes, however, will also be briefly introduced.

briefs.name: 計算機程式設計
briefs.tags: C/C++ Programming, object-Oriented Programming, Classes and objects, Operator Overloading, Inheritance and Polymorphism, Templates, Stream I/O C/C++程式設計, 物件導向程式設計, 類別與物件, 運算子多載, 繼承與多型, 樣板, 串流輸入輸出
briefs.desc: This course introduces students to C/C++ programming. Students will learn the fundamental concepts of object-oriented programming, the components and structure of C/C++ programs, how to define variables and classes, and how to use object-oriented features such as operator overloading, inheritance, and polymorphism, as well as stream-based input/output and templates.

briefs.name: 嵌入式系統與實驗
briefs.tags: micro-controller, embedded system, sensors, actuators, wired network, wireless network, IoT, GPIO, ADC, DAC, LCD, servo, PING, camera, UART, Zigbee, WiFi. 微控制器，嵌入式系統，感測器，制動器，有線網路，無線網路，通用輸入輸出，物聯網，類比數位轉換器，數位類比轉換器，液晶螢幕，伺服馬達，超音波感測，相機，通用非同步收發傳輸器，低速短距離無線網路協定，無線區域網路。
briefs.desc: In this course we learn the basics of micro-controller programming and applications. The course is developed with interfacing and programming with several sensors and actuators (including GPIO, ADC, DAC, LCD, 3D accelerometers, servo, laser PING, etc.) and wire/wireless communication (UART, BLE, WiFi). A robot car will be built to demonstrate a complete embedded system. Students will learn through a series of hands-on labs.

briefs.name: 資料結構
briefs.tags: C++, Array, Stack, Queue, linked list, Tree, Graph, Sorting, Hashing
briefs.desc: 課程目標：本課程涵蓋基本資料結構的形態與應用，如 linked List，Stack, Queue, 樹狀結構，圖形 結構, Hashing等等。學生可學習到資料結構的設計與應用。

briefs.name: 生成式人工智慧實務應用
briefs.nameEn: Generative AI in the Real World
briefs.tags: Multimodal Generative AI 多模態生成式人工智慧, MLLM/MSLM 多模態大型語言模型/多模態小型語言模型, AI Image Generation AI 影像生成, TrustWorthy AI 可信任人工智慧, Creative AI Applications 創意人工智慧應用
briefs.desc: This course equips students with a working understanding of multimodal generative AI, including MLLMs and generative image, and the skills to design, deploy, and critique real-world applications responsibly. It also aims to inspire curiosity, encouraging students to explore creative, meaningful, and unconventional applications of AI in diverse domains, so they leave not just with technical skills, but with the imagination to apply them to problems and opportunities they truly care about.

briefs.name: 機率
briefs.tags: 機率公設, 條件機率, 隨機變數, 分佈, 期望值, 變異數 Axioms of Probability, Conditional Probability, Random Variables, Distributions, Expectations, Variances
briefs.desc: This course introduces the theory of probability to students in engineering. Through clear and intuitive explanations, it emphasizes not only the mathematical foundations of probability theory but also its broad applications in real-life and engineering contexts. Topics include random events, conditional probability, random variables, expected values, and common probability distributions, equipping students with the skills to solve practical problems.

briefs.name: 機率
briefs.desc: 機率

briefs.name: 統計
briefs.tags: probability, statistics, hypothesis tests, random variables, confidence interval.
briefs.desc: This course introduces the students to the theory of statistics. The course covers the following subjects: probability space, independence, conditional probability, random variables, mathematical expectations, probability density functions, multivariate, accumulated distribution functions. We will also lecture confidence intervals, statistical hypotheses testing, CRB, special distributions, sufficient statistics and Maximum likelihood approach. This course aims to build a solid foundation for engineering students to apply statistical tools and theory for engineering applications.

briefs.name: 光電工程
briefs.tags: wave, geometric optics, polarization, diffraction, interference, Fourier optics, laser
briefs.desc: This course starts with a review of electromagnetic waves, followed by geometric optics for optical systems and resonators. We will then study the polarization state of light and its use in various devices. The wave nature of light generates many fascinating phenomena, including interference and diffraction etc. Once the concept and theory of interference and diffraction are introduced, we will learn useful devices, such as diffraction gratings, etalons, and laser cavities. Finally, we study Fourier optics and coherence of light, which are important for image manipulation and optical signal processing.

briefs.name: 電磁波
briefs.tags: Maxwell's equation, plane electromagnetic waves, transmission lines, waveguides, antenna
briefs.desc: This class covers the following topics: Maxwell’s equations, plane electromagnetic waves, wave-guiding structures: transmission lines and waveguides, antenna and applications

briefs.name: 積體電路設計導論
briefs.tags: CMOS, VLSI, digital, integrated circuit, technology, logic, flip-flops
briefs.desc: This course provides the fundamental knowledge of designing VLSI. It begins with a review of transistor theory and CMOS process technology. It then discusses the design considerations of a variety of CMOS digital circuits such as inverters, logic gates, flip-flops, and arithmetic circuits using different design styles (static and dynamic logic). Furthermore, system-level design and low-power techniques will also be discussed in details.

briefs.name: 控制系統
briefs.tags: 迴授控制系統,機電整合,系統動態,機器人,精密控制,feedback control system, mechatronics, system dynamics, robot, precision control
briefs.desc: Feedback control is widely used in areas such as electronics and mechatronic systems, especially in those requiring fast response and high precision (e.g. robot, unmanned vehicles, etc). Through the introduction of system modeling, stability, and performance analysis, students should develop an understanding of frequency-domain and root-locus methods for control system design.

briefs.name: 通訊系統一
briefs.tags: Communication systems (通訊系統), Fourier analysis (傅立葉分析), amplitude modulation (調幅), frequency modulation (調頻), noise (雜訊).
briefs.desc: This is the first course in communications, which provides an introduction to basic communication concepts, analog communication systems, and digital baseband transmission.

briefs.name: 通訊系統一
briefs.tags: Communication systems (通訊系統), Fourier analysis (傅立葉分析), amplitude modulation (調幅), frequency modulation (調頻), noise (雜訊).
briefs.desc: This is the first course in communications, which provides an introduction to basic communication concepts, analog communication systems, and digital baseband transmission.

briefs.name: 數位訊號處理概論
briefs.tags: omega, n, 2pi, e, i
briefs.desc: 本課程之宗旨乃為離散時間訊號處理提供足夠嚴謹的數學基礎, 並透過電腦作業設計，培養學生的直覺。 This course aims to provide sufficiently rigorous mathematical foundation for discrete-time signal processing. Computer-based homework will be designed to cultivate insight in this field.

briefs.name: 機器學習導論
briefs.tags: machine learning; statistical learning theory; artificial intelligence; neural network
briefs.desc: The goal of machine learning is to program computers to use example data or past experience to solve a given problem. This course will cover topics, parametric methods, multivariate method, perceptron, deep learning and reinforcement learning.

briefs.name: 電能處理
briefs.tags: 電能處理, 接枝法, 壓條法, 脈寬調變轉換器, 硬切換, 軟切換, Power processing, graft technique, layer technique, pulse-width modulated converter, hard switching, and soft switching.
briefs.desc: 本課從自然規律、生命機理談起，接著引出電能處理的法則和電力轉換器的拓樸結構，讓學生對電能處理有全面性的基 本概念，也可以連結至自然界、生物器官及其他領域暨有的運作和控制機制。然後，回頭來談電能處理器所需用到的器 件和驅動電路，並且運用自然法則來衍生出各式各樣的電能處理器結構。 藉由這樣的啟發訓練，將要求學生從自然界 或其它領域找到可以比擬用在電能處理上的機制，那麼學生可以體會到「駕馭自然圭臬 無窮妙用」、「究竟天下道理 萬源歸宗」。 上過本課程後預計可以開闊學生的視野和激發學生的想像力。 教學進度 1.本課程相關生理和物理現象介紹(2週) 2.電能處理發展歷史介紹(1週) 3.功率元件探討 -被動元件(2週) -開關元件(3週) 4.期中考 5.轉換器結構與衍生原理探討 -轉換器種類(1週) -硬切式轉換器(2週) -軟切式軟換器(2週) 6.轉換器分析與設計(3週)

briefs.name: 電動機械實驗
briefs.tags: 電力電子轉速控制Power electronic speed control, 直流馬達DC motor, 同步馬達Synchronous motor, 感應馬達Induction motor, 變壓器transformer,
briefs.desc: 電動機械實驗旨在從事：電力系統基本特性實驗、電力品質基本特性實驗、工業控制配電實驗、變壓器實驗、各式旋轉電機特性 實驗、電力電子基本電路特性實驗、馬達固態驅動控制實驗、及SoC (System on Chip) 馬達驅動控制實驗等。

briefs.name: 實作專題一
briefs.desc: This course will train the students to have hands-on experience on a specific project under the guidance of a professor. The fields of research project range from microelectronics, nanotechnology, VLSI design, to biomedical engineering.

briefs.name: 實作專題二
briefs.desc: This course will train the students to have hands-on experience on a specific project under the guidance of a professor. The fields of reseach project range from microelectronics, nanotechnology, VLSI design, to biomedical engineering.

briefs.name: 光波導概論
briefs.tags: 光波導, 全反射, 光柵, 光耦合器, 光纖, optical waveguide, total internal reflection, optical grating, directional coupler, optical fiber.
briefs.desc: We will talk about the basic knowledge of optical waveguides, focusing on theories and practical applications. Wave propagation theory of planar dielectric waveguides is first introduced, followed by the description of gratings and directional couplers in either waveguide or optical fiber type.

briefs.name: 進階類比電路分析與設計
briefs.nameEn: Advanced Analog Integrated Circuits Analysis and Design
briefs.tags: Analog, mixed-signal, integrated circuit, switch, oscillator, phase-locked loop
briefs.desc: This introductory course will cover the analysis and design of analog/mixed-signal integrated circuits for digital systems and for digital communications.

briefs.name: 醫療電子之臨床導入
briefs.nameEn: Clinical Application of Medical Electronic Device
briefs.tags: 醫療電子器材法規、醫療電子器材認證、醫療電子器材管理、醫療電子器材臨床實務
briefs.desc: 本課程目的在培養學生對醫療電子器材的法規、認證、管理、以及臨床實務面上有所認識；藉由這些知識的基礎，引導學生發想 未來醫療電子的創意。

briefs.name: 固態電子實驗--半導體製程與實驗
briefs.tags: 半導體製造Semiconductor manufacturing, 場效電晶體 Field-effect transistors, 微影 Optical lithography, 鍍膜 Deposition, 濕式蝕刻 Wet Etching
briefs.desc: The silicon integrated circuit is surely one of the wonders of our age. The ability to fabricate tens of millions of individual components on a chip with an area of a few centimeter square has enabled the information age. This course attempts to describe not only the manufacturing practice associated with the technologies used in silicon chip fabrication, but also the underlying scientific basis for those technologies. This course will show the students how silicon field-effect transistors are made using the knowledge learned in the ULSI technologies. However, due to the limited implementation hours, students can only fabricate p-type or n-type MOSFET with characteristics measured and simulated.

briefs.name: 固態電子實驗--半導體製程與實驗
briefs.tags: 半導體製造Semiconductor manufacturing, 場效電晶體 Field-effect transistors, 微影 Optical lithography, 鍍膜 Deposition, 濕式蝕刻 Wet Etching
briefs.desc: The silicon integrated circuit is surely one of the wonders of our age. The ability to fabricate tens of millions of individual components on a chip with an area of a few centimeter square has enabled the information age. This course attempts to describe not only the manufacturing practice associated with the technologies used in silicon chip fabrication, but also the underlying scientific basis for those technologies. This course will show the students how silicon field-effect transistors are made using the knowledge learned in the ULSI technologies. However, due to the limited implementation hours, students can only fabricate p-type or n-type MOSFET with characteristics measured and simulated.

briefs.name: 通訊系統二
briefs.tags: 通訊系統 (Communication Systems); 數位調變 (Digital Modulation); 數據檢測 (Data Detection); 消息理論 (Information Theory); 錯誤控制碼 (Error-Control Coding);
briefs.desc: This course is a sequel to EE 3640 Communication Systems I. The goal of this course is to provide a comprehensive introduction to the basic principles, fundamental limits and technologies of digital communications, including signal-space representations, digital modulation techniques, data detection schemes, information theory, multichannel transmission, error-control coding, spread-spectrum modulation, and other related topics. Students can learn much about the basic concepts of communication systems, digital modulation, data transmission and reception, and some important theorems of digital communications.

briefs.name: 電力電子
briefs.tags: 電力電子 Power Electronics, DC-DC 轉換器 DC-DC Converters, 功率半導體 Power Semiconductor Devices, GaN / SiC, Wide-Bandgap Devices, 電源管理 IC Power Management IC, 高頻電力轉換 High-Frequency Power Conversion
briefs.desc: 本課程介紹電力電子之基礎與進階概念，內容涵蓋電力轉換原理、常見轉換器拓樸、控制方法與功率半導體元件。課程進一步延伸 至現代電力應用，包括高頻電力轉換、電源管理 IC 概念，以及氮化鎵（GaN）與碳化矽（SiC）等寬能隙功率元件。課程將結合 理論推導、設計實務與產業應用案例，協助學生建立電力電子系統分析與設計的完整基礎，並銜接後續於電力、系統與積體電路相 關領域之進階學習。 This course introduces fundamental and advanced concepts of power electronics, including power conversion principles, converter topologies, control techniques, and power semiconductor devices. The course further extends to modern applications such as high-frequency power conversion, power management IC concepts, and wide-bandgap devices including GaN and SiC. Practical design considerations and industrial case studies are emphasized to help students build a solid foundation for advanced studies in power, system, and IC-related fields.

briefs.name: 專題研究
briefs.desc: 由教授與學生擬定研究題目，以進行專題研究，培養解決問題的能力。

briefs.name: 內嵌式記憶體電路設計
briefs.tags: memory circuits, computing-in-memory for AI
briefs.desc: This course introduces general knowledge of various on-chip memories to students who are interesting in circuit design, system-level designs, design for manufacturing (DFM) or process integrations. Current embedded memories (ROM, SRAM, CAM, ROM, OTP/MTP, and FLASH) and next-generation memories will be introduced. This course will study the devices and circuit of memory bitcell, memory structures, sense amplifiers, high-voltage circuits, and other digital and analog peripheral circuits. This course also will cover the basic concept of computing-in-memory for AI chips. The system-level applications, techniques of low-power and low-voltage designs, and design-for-manufacturing (DFM) issues for embedded memories and CIM are also included. Students who are interesting in transistor-level circuit designs, SoC designs, semiconductor devices, or process integrations are welcome to take this course.

briefs.name: 超大型積體電路設計
briefs.tags: VLSI, CMOS logic, Semiconductor, IC, Circuit design
briefs.desc: This course provides the fundamental knowledge of designing Very Large-Scale Integrated circuits (VLSI). It begins with a review of the IC fabrication process and the CMOS transistor theory. Then, the layout rules and design techniques for a variety of CMOS logic circuits such as inverters, logic gates, flip-flops, and arithmetic circuits using different design styles (e.g., static logic, steering logic, and dynamic logic) are discussed. For system-level design, low- power techniques, semiconductor memories, and IO plan will be discussed in detail.

briefs.name: 高等數位晶片設計流程
briefs.tags: FinFET, low power design, digital design flow, hierarchical flow, flip chip
briefs.desc: 學習數位電路晶片之進階設計流程，與現今趨勢接軌，培養後摩爾定律時代所需之晶片設計知識。使用TSMC 16nm教學用製程 (N16 ADFP)演練數位電路晶片之進階設計流程，包含FinFET library, hierarchical flow, flip chip, power gating 等。

briefs.name: 晶片安全設計
briefs.tags: 硬體安全, 晶片安全, 數位設計, FPGA, 積體電路設計 Hardware security, Chip security, Digital design, IC design
briefs.desc: 本課程由業界15年經驗，現為力旺電子子公司熵碼科技之研發處處長──吳孟益博士並帶領研發同仁所開設，目的在帶給學生硬體 安全(晶片安全)的入門實戰能力。內容包含晶片安全設計的基礎理論，以及數位設計、FPGA開發驗證的實作與報告，讓學生於 在學期間，便能了解業界對安全的需求及考量，和整個產業生態與實際運作，為進入IC設計產業提早做好準備。

briefs.name: 有線通訊積體電路設計
briefs.tags: integrated circuits, wireline communication, wireless communication, amplifier, equalizer
briefs.desc: This is an introductory course of integrated circuits for wireline/optical communications. It covers basic modulation/demodulation schemes, system design considerations, and key function blocks. All material is based on modern VLSI implementation viewpoints.

briefs.name: 數位訊號處理
briefs.tags: z-trasnform (z 轉換), Sampling (取樣), Discrete Fourier Transform (離散傅立葉轉換), Fast Fourier Transform (快速傅立葉轉換), FIR Filter (有限響應濾波器), IIR Filter (無限響應濾波器)
briefs.desc: This course introduces the foundations of digital signal processing, including signal representations, sampling, z-transform. digital filter architectures and FIR/IIR filter designs, and Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) and the computation of DFT. Students takng this course should have knowledge about differential equations, complex analysis, and linear algebra.

briefs.name: 智慧電網
briefs.tags: Power Systems, Power Converters, Smart Grid, Wind Power Generations, Phasor Measurement Units.
briefs.desc: Electric power systems are experiencing significant changes at the worldwide scale in order to become cleaner, smarter, and more reliable. This course will examine a wide range of topics related to these changes, which are primarily caused by the introduction of new information technologies, renewable energy penetration, digitalized equipment, new operational strategies, and so forth. The emphasis will be put on the modeling and control of smart grid systems. The major topics include (1) Phasor measurement systems, (2) Power converters for microgrid, and (3) Wind power generations.

briefs.name: 高等電機理論
briefs.tags: 機電能量轉換Theory of Electromechanical Energy Conversion, 參考框理論Reference-frame Theory, 同步機Synchronous Machines, 橋式轉換器Fully Controlled 3-Phase Bridge Converters
briefs.desc: 介紹電動機之電磁能與機械能量轉換過程、各式電動機之結構與分析、驅動器電路、框轉換理論。(本課程採英文授課) Introduction of electromechanical energy conversion, analysis and operational principle and electric machines, motor drives, reference-frame theory.(This course is offered in Engliash )

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: Seminar, DSP, AI, Circuit Design, EDA
briefs.desc: Seminar talks will be arranged and offered to EE students to cover related areas in industry and academia.

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: 專題演講,邀請演講,Keynote speech, invited talk
briefs.desc: 書報討論課程每週邀請演講者進行專題演講，演講主題以電力組相關領域為主，由電力組老師邀請演講者，演講時間約1~1.5小 時，同學在演講結束後可與演講者互動。

briefs.name: 英文學術演講與簡報
briefs.tags: academic presentations, poster presentations, oral presentations, communication skills, audience analysis
briefs.desc: This course is designed to equip graduate students with the skills to express themselves effectively, present their research confidently, and connect with varied audiences. It features rich academic content, and a step-by-step approach to build students’ confidence as speakers. It provides specific guidelines and useful language for students to follow in order to prepare, practice, and deliver presentations. Students will do a variety of individual, pair, and small group work as well as whole class activities which are supplemented by homework assignments. They will learn how to tell the story of their research, and develop both live and virtual talks. In addition, they will practice how to incorporate and document material from sources into their presentations. Supplementary course materials can be found on our eeclass.

briefs.name: 超大型積體電路測試
briefs.tags: VLSI, Design for Testability, Testing, Test Pattern Generation, Built-In Self-Test, Fault Diagnosis, Board-Level Testing
briefs.desc: This course is devoted to the fundamental knowledge of testing Very Large-Scale Integrated circuits (VLSI). The emphasis is on the investigation of various technically feasible test solutions combining both Design-for- Testability hardware and Computer-Aided Design algorithms for test-pattern generation to ensure the overall testability and quality of manufactured ICs. It begins with the topics of fault modeling and fault simulation, followed by the algorithms of Automatic Test Pattern Generation (ATPG). Then, widely adopted Design-for-Testability (DFT) techniques in IC design industry, such as Scan Test, Built-In Self-Test (BIST), and test compression will be introduced. Upon the completion of this course, the students will know how to apply all kinds of test solutions to make an IC easily testable and reliable in a cost-effective way.

briefs.name: Ｈ無窮強健設計及在控制、訊號及生物之應用
briefs.nameEn: H infinity Robust Design and Its Applications to Control, Signal Processing, and Systems Biology
briefs.tags: H∞強健控制,系統生物學,合成生物學,訊號處理,自動控制
briefs.desc: 在工程領域，許多設計都是根據系統的簡化數學模型。然而在真實系統有可能相當複雜多變，有許多參數擾動及環 境雜訊的干擾。因此如何設計一個強健控制器或濾波器來抵抗參數擾動及外來干擾並達成設計目標，在控制系統及 訊號處理領域是很重要的研究課題。如果設計一個系統缺乏強健性，在隨時一些擾動或外界干擾就失去功能，這將 是個非常不實用的系統。雖然H∞強健控制就設計似乎相當理論，卻是個非常有實用價值的設計原理，可用在自動控 制，訊號處理，通訊系統及合成生物學上。陳教授在這些領域有深入研究，並各發表幾十篇相關論文，相當有經驗 並在世界領先，因此本課程可提供學生做跨領域的訓練及整合之用。

briefs.name: 排隊理論
briefs.tags: Markov chains, Markov processes, probability, queueing theory, stochastic processes
briefs.desc: This course is an introduction to the elementary queueing theory and its applications. 1. Introduction 2. Review of Probability and Stochastic Processes 3. Simple Markovian Queueing Models 4. Advanced Markovian Queueing Models 5. Networks, Series, and Cyclic queues 6. General Arrival or Service Patterns

briefs.name: 記憶體系統
briefs.tags: 快取, 主記憶體, 儲存快取, 儲存, 設計與最佳化, Cache, main memory, storage cache, storage, design and optimization
briefs.desc: The memory hierarchy plays an increasingly important role in determining the cost, performance, power consumption, and reliability of SoC, mobiles, PCs, and datacenters. Students interested in these industries or research areas may want to have architectural-level knowledge in the memory hierarchy. This course introduces architectural-level techniques of designing, managing, and optimizing a memory hierarchy at all levels, including on-chip caches, main memory, storage caches, and storage.

briefs.name: 電子系統層級設計與合成
briefs.nameEn: Electronic System Level Design and Synthesis
briefs.tags: Electronic System Level ESL design, SystemC, TLM, High level Synthesis HLS, Multi-core platform
briefs.desc: In this course, we study and implement a system with multiple cores and accelerators with ESL environments (SystemC/TLM). Students will also learn to use High-Level Synthesis (HLS) to design and synthesize RTL circuits from SystemC. The HLS-based design can be integrated with a RISC-V virtual platform (riscv-vp) for hardware and software co-design and analysis. Several examples will be used to demonstrate the ESL methodology including image processing, deep-learning neural networks to investigate efficiency of different system architectures.

briefs.name: 機器學習
briefs.tags: 分類 Classification，回歸 Regression，類神經網路 Neural Networks，支持向量機 Support Vector Machine，降維 Dimensionality Reduction
briefs.desc: 機器學習領域有各種不同演算法，讓電腦可以從資料中學習，完成目標任務。隨著各領域數位化資料的累積，機器學習已經應用在五花八門 的各種領域。例如早期應用在資料探開，搜索，推薦上。到後來可以應用在各種非結構資料上，如語音、影像、文字等。如今機器學習更是 應用在各種科學領域，例如天文學、生物學、化學等。 機器學習結合了統計、數學與資訊科學等學門。廣義來說，機器學習研究如何讓電腦具有學習的能力，從以往的經驗及 數據中學習到知 識，以增進電腦本身的效能，因此機器學習也可解釋為利用資料來建立一些模擬真實世界的模型 （Models），利用這些模式來描述資料中 的特徵（Patterns）以及關係（Relations）。這些模式有兩種用處，第 一，瞭解資料的特徵與關係可以提供決策所需要的資訊。第 二，資料的特徵可以幫助進行預測。

briefs.name: 計算攝影學
briefs.tags: 計算攝影學, 相機成像, 影像最佳化, 卷積神經網路, 擴散網路
briefs.desc: 介紹如何透過計算來增強拍照的影像品質，並實際藉由程式實現來驗證可行性。除了讓學生了解最先進的影像處理演算法 外，亦透過Python學習如何使用最新的影像處理函式庫，如影像最佳化的ProxImaL，以及卷積神經網路框架PyTorch。

briefs.name: 語音訊號處理
briefs.tags: speech processing 語音處理, automatic speech recognition 語音辨識, signal and system 訊號與系統, machine learning 機器學習, hidden markov model 隱藏馬爾可夫模型
briefs.desc: This course introduces signal processing techniques for processing speech signals. Course content will be split into three major parts: speech signal processing techniques and analysis methods, automatic speech recognition systems, and current research trends in speech and language processing.

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文研究, Thesis
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行深入研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之創新性成果。

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文研究, Thesis
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 邏輯設計
briefs.tags: logic design, digital circuit, logic optimization, sequential circuit analysis and design, boolean algebra
briefs.desc: This course teaches the fundamentals of logic design, including boolean algebra, combinational circuit design and optimization, and sequential circuit design and analysis.

briefs.name: 邏輯設計
briefs.tags: logic gates, flip-flops, combinational logic, Boolean algebra, sequential logic, finite state machines
briefs.desc: This course is about the principles of digital logic and its implementation in electronic circuits and systems. We will start from the basic logic design concepts and proceed to apply them in building interesting and practical digital systems. Systematic hierarchical design using elementary building blocks will be emphasized. Boolean algebra, arithmetic circuit design, and finite state machine design will be covered. Basic description of digital logic at Register Transfer Level (RTL) will be introduced for digital system development through the Verilog hardware description language.

briefs.name: 邏輯設計
briefs.tags: logic design, digital circuit, logic optimization, sequential circuit, boolean algebra
briefs.desc: This course introduces the basic theories and the implementations of logic circuits and digital systems. We will start with the topics of number systems and Boolean algebra, which are fundamental to all digital systems, followed by the optimization, storage elements such as flip flops, and sequential circuits. With both combinational logic and sequential circuits, we will discuss the design of registers, counters, memory as well as programmable devices.

briefs.name: Python語言程式入門
briefs.tags: introduction to programming, Python language, computer science, structured language, modules
briefs.desc: This course introduces fundamental programming concepts in the Python language and related environment. Fundamental concepts include overview of computer systems, python environment setup, Python language overview, command line interface, numbers, string formatting, sequences, dictionaries and sets, control flow, exception, file, function, recursion, object orientation, inheritance, polymorphism, and modules.

briefs.name: 訊號與系統
briefs.tags: Signals and System, Linear Time Invariant System, Convolution, Fourier Series, Fourier Transform, Laplace Transform, z-Transform
briefs.desc: "Signals and Systems" is a foundation course to the study of many fields that constitute the discipline of electrical engineering (EE), such as signal processing, communications, circuit design, and control. In this course, you will learn a new EE language, which allows you to analyze, design, and implement continuous-time/discrete-time linear time-invariant systems via their input and output signals in the time domain, frequency domain, and transform domain.

briefs.name: 訊號與系統

briefs.desc: "Signals and Systems" is a fundamental course to the study of many fields that constitute the discipline of electrical engineering, such as signal processing, communications, and control. In this course, we will describe various analysis methods along with some practical examples for continuous- time/discrete-time deterministic signals and linear time-invariant systems, including the convolution, Fourier series, Fourier transform, Laplace transform, z-transform operations, and so on.

The content emphasizes on ordinary differential equations, Fourier analysis, and Laplace transform. This course is the mathematic foundation for electromagnetics, modern physics, solid-state physics, signal and system, electrical circuits, and so on. Basic mathematic skills, especially calculus, are required.

The content emphasizes on ordinary differential equations, eigenfunction expansion, Fourier transform and Laplace transform, laying the mathematics foundation for advanced subjects such as Electric Circuits, Electromagnetics, Modern Physics, Quantum Physics, Solid-state Physics and Optics. Basic mathematical skills, especially calculus, are required.

Data structures can be considered as essential building blockings in modern computer science. The concepts covered in this course include: - Introduction to Algorithm - Arrays - Stacks - Queues - linked lists - Trees - Graphs - Sorting - Hashing - And other advanced topics

briefs.name: 計算機網路概論

briefs.desc: This course introduces the fundamental design principles of computer networks and the Internet. We will explore the layered architecture of the network protocol stack, including the Application, Transport, Network, and Data link layers. Beyond theoretical concepts, the course emphasizes practical skills, training students to design and implement networked applications through hands-on programming assignments.

briefs.desc: 課程說明： 實作專題為本班必修課程， 所有學生必須修滿2學期。 課程由選修學生跟隨實作專題指導老師， 透過「從做中學」（learning by doing）的方式， 學習到學術研究的精神、方法、與實作過程。 教學方式： 選修學生必須定期，如每週，與實作專題的指導老師進行討論， 規劃完成進度並精進實作專題的方向與內容。 成績考核： 學期成績由實作專題指導老師依學生過去一學期的總體表現進行評量。

briefs.name: 實作專題二
briefs.desc: 課程說明： 實作專題為本班必修課程， 所有學生必須修滿2學期。 課程由選修學生跟隨實作的老師， 透過「從做中學」（learning by doing）的方式， 學習到學術研究的精神、方法、與實作過程。 教學方式： 選修學生每週必須定期和跟隨實作的老師進行討論， 忠實執行老師所交代的事項。 成績考核： 學期成績由實作專題指導老師依學生過去一學期的總體表現進行評量。

briefs.name: 演算法
briefs.tags: Algorithms, Design, Performance Analysis, Complexity, Correctness
briefs.desc: In this course, we will look at a lot of fundamental problems that are solved daily around us, and we will study their solutions (that is, the methods or the algorithms), and show how to analyze the performance of the solutions. We will also introduce general techniques to help us design a good algorithm when we face a new problem.

briefs.name: 計算機結構

briefs.desc: To understand how computer systems work. Emphasis will be placed on 1. What characterizes the performance of a computer 2. Instruction set design and its interaction with a compiler 3. Basic building blocks: I/O, Memory, Datapath, Control 4. Pipelined datapath 5. Memory hierarchy

briefs.name: 財務管理
briefs.tags: 財務分析、公司理財、企業價值、財務風險、財務議題
briefs.desc: 本課程目的在於培養財務分析的能力與技巧，並進而做投資與融資之決策。 課程內容首重於： (1)財務報表分析 (2)公司價值及資本預算 (3)風險及報酬分析 (4)資本結構及股利政策 (5)其他相關議題：合併與收購；融資策略

briefs.name: 策略
briefs.tags: 能力,定位,簡則,整合,開放,賦名
briefs.desc: 本課程教授「策略」(或稱「策略管理」)。策略被認為是所有管理學科之王(the king of management disciplines),其所 講究的是經營者或是管理者為達到公司目標所採用的行動方向與具體作為。策略當中尤以「創新」與「變革」為兩個熱門議題, 因此,本課程將特別著重在科技創新與變革策略的介紹與討論,並分成六大主題進行說明:能力、定位、簡則、整合、開放以及賦 名。

briefs.name: 財務金融策略管理
briefs.tags: Financial Services Industry, Capital Markets, Foreign Exchange Markets,Risk Management, Financial Innovations
briefs.desc: Strategic Management of Financial Institutions – A Corporate Strategic Management Perspective (金融 機構策略管理) is a lecture course with active class participation, in form of discussion, group study and presentation, by students. Whilst non-deposit-taking financial institutions will be touched on a selective basis, the course stresses the conceptual foundation of Banking together with the idiosyncrasies of those credit markets dominated by deposit-taking financial institutions. Recent developments with potentially far-reaching implications for the future design of banking and financial markets are addressed. The course focuses on the environmental dynamics against which bank management decisions and strategies must be taken on or formulated, rather than operational practices per se. Distinguished experts will be invited to give speeches on selected topics and share their field experiences. Students without finance background will also benefit from the class.

briefs.name: 企業論壇
briefs.tags: 科技管理、科技治理、產業發展、企業經營、孫運璿科技講座
briefs.desc: 本課程之主旨在透過專題演講的方式，讓學生對於全球趨勢、政經環境、社會文化、法規政策、產業發展與企業經營管理等不同 面向有更為深入的認識與瞭解。專題演講擬邀請的對象包括各領域的專家學者、孫運璿科技講座主講者與不同產業之企業家和專 業經理人等。學期成績將由課堂參與、期末心得口頭報告以及書面報告等成績計算。

briefs.name: 組織權力與領導
briefs.tags: 組織權力與領導 (AI世代應有的提升)
briefs.desc: 本課程旨在培養和提升EMBA/MBA學生的領導力，重點在於實用性，探討如何在瞬息萬變的數位化AI商業環境中，將領導力、 權力與政治技巧有效應用於各類組織中 （特別是受傳統文化影響而又急需創新和創業的企業）促進企業成長，個人事業成功 和生活美滿。 在任何組織中，不論其規模或性質，都存在領導力實踐與權力運用的交互作用。隨著外界環境變化，這種互動/博弈過程也在 變化，其結果直接影響組織績效與個人職涯發展。而當前快速變動的數位化商業環境中，人工智慧（AI）提升了資訊透明 度、資料可得性與決策速度。本課程不以AI為主軸，而是適度結合 AI 所帶來的「眼光延伸」與「策略敏捷化」，協助學生理 解在領導力實踐，權力運用在公司政治要素中，哪些能力將因數位工具被放大，哪些則更加依賴領導者的人格、價值與判 斷。 AI 時代的領導者最重要的能力仍然是願景、策略判斷、贏得人心、文化建設與執行力。科技提高效率，但無法取代領導 者的洞察力、勇氣、道德框架與激勵人心的力量。因此，本課程將在原有領導力實踐，權力運用在公司政治的基礎上，加入 「AI 帶來的環境變化」作為參考視角，使學生更能以現代化的方式理解傳統領導力的深度意義。 本課程強調

briefs.name: 策略性人力資源管理

briefs.desc: This course provides EMBA participants with a strategic and practice-oriented understanding of Human Resource Management (HRM) in contemporary organizations. Moving beyond traditional personnel administration, the course emphasizes HRM as a critical driver of organizational performance, leadership effectiveness, and sustainable competitive advantage. Key topics include talent acquisition and retention, performance management, employee motivation and engagement, leadership development, reward systems, and managing workforce diversity in global and cross-cultural contexts. Through case discussions, managerial scenarios, and reflective exercises, participants will examine how HRM practices can be aligned with organizational strategy and adapted to dynamic business environments. The course encourages executives to critically reflect on their own managerial experiences and to develop evidence- based HRM approaches that support organizational change, innovation, and

briefs.name: 人文思維與社會實踐
briefs.tags: 歷史，政治，國家，組織，社會，history, politics, state, organization, society
briefs.desc: 這門課的目的不在於教你如何經營管理，也無法教你賺錢致富的訣竅，事實上，以上兩件事我也教不來。這門課試著跟各位 分享的事情是，如何當一個有想法的主管，以及如何成為一個更好的人。 這個世界上每天的資訊量多到數不完，可是，人與人之間卻越來越難溝通。我們知道得越多，卻越活在自己的世界裡。這個 世界為什麼會變成今天這個樣子？人類的行為有沒有什麼模式與規則？未來又會變成什麼樣子？你想不想參透外在世界的變 化？你想不想洞察人心的奧秘？你想不想了解自己與旁人的憤怒、無奈、焦慮、與快樂？以上這些問題雖然都沒有標準答 案，不過，這個世界上有一群人叫社會學家，他們對於這些問題都有一些切入的角度。我相信這些角度將會讓你變成一個更 有深度的經理人，讓你在長官、同儕、下屬間獲得更多的肯定。

briefs.name: 企業研究方法與倫理

briefs.desc: This class examines the management of marketing in international business. Topics include the cultural environment in international markets, international marketing research, various degrees of foreign involvement (exports, licensing, foreign subsidiaries), 4 Ps (product, promotion, place, and price) in international marketing, and negotiations in international marketing.

briefs.name: 公司法與公司治理
briefs.tags: Corporate Law, Corporate Governance, Business Sustainability, ESG
briefs.desc: As an introductory course of corporate governance, we will explore contemporary issues pertinent to corporate law and finance. In addition, this course will improve students’ knowledge on traditional corporate governance issues (e.g., corporate fraud; agency conflicts) and discuss the cutting-edge issue of sustainable corporate governance.

briefs.name: 知識與組織行為管理
briefs.nameEn: Management of Knowledge and Organizational Behavior
briefs.tags: Management, Knowledge, Organizational Behavior
briefs.desc: This course consists of two subjects: knowledge management and organizational behavior. Two instructors will convey their domain expertise on these two subjects via case teaching, discussion, and lecture. Knowledge management covers topics in knowledge creation, organizational learning, KM systems, and AI in knowledge management. Organizational Behavior covers topics in rewards, motivation, communication and negotiation, teams, leadership, employee selection and migration.

briefs.name: 大數據分析
briefs.tags: Big Data, fact-based, decision-making, Business Analytics
briefs.desc: Organizations are increasingly relying on fact-based decision-making and Business Analytics to achieve and sustain a competitive advantage. This course traces the evolution of analytics, and provides insight into how companies can transform themselves into analytical competitors. It also emphasizes the critical role that technology, humans, and business processes play in conferring a distinctive organizational capability that enables firms to harness the enormous potential of data.

briefs.name: 跨國企業管理
briefs.tags: Multinational Enterprises, Strategies
briefs.desc: The focus of this course is on the challenges associated with the formulation and implementation of strategies in business enterprises whose operations stretch across national boundaries. This course aims to provide students with the knowledge, skills, and sensitivities needed to manage more effectively in an international environment.

briefs.name: 策略管理
briefs.tags: Strategic Management, business/organizational policy
briefs.desc: The primary thrust of this course is general management. It will be different from most of the courses you have had in functional areas (e.g., accounting, marketing) because you will be required to use a wide range of business knowledge and exhibit diverse skills. Therefore, it will be demanding and challenging because you must perform in topic areas where you have both strengths and weaknesses.

briefs.name: 深度學習概論

briefs.desc: 簡介深度學習的技術，包括各種具代表性的深度學習神經網路模型，如何進行模型的訓練，以及其相關的實際應用。另外，此課 程將著重在實作深度學習的模型以及如何達到模型的訓練以解決實際的問題。

briefs.name: 智慧製造與營運管理

briefs.desc: 本課程主要分成兩大部分: 第一部分(Part I)為針對品質管理相關議題之基本觀念及方法進行簡介，並從技術面、管理面及制度面的概念與作法做深入 的探討，期能使學生對抽象的觀念有具體的了解，理論與應用並重，以奠定日後從事品質管理、分析及改善的能力。 Part I provides an introduction to the fundamental concepts and methods related to quality management, and offers an in-depth exploration from technical, managerial, and institutional perspectives. briefs.name: 書報討論

briefs.name: 智慧製造與永續標竿學習

briefs.desc: 因應人工智慧及工業4.0的發展趨勢，以及台灣產業升級與數位轉型的挑戰，規劃至雲林、高雄等地區，安排智慧製造企業、AI 研究中心、學術機構等智慧製造相關的產官學研單位進行參訪與實證課程，以及國際產學專家 演講，並參觀各國的智慧製造工 廠及最新產業趨勢。

briefs.name: 人本AI設計
briefs.tags: 人本人工智慧(Human-Centered AI), 跨智慧協作(Inter-Intelligence Collaboration), AI代理(AI Agents), 設計流程與方法(Design Processes & Methods), 個人、團隊與集體智慧(Individual–Team–Collective Intelligence), 人與人工智慧互動(Human-AI Interaction)
briefs.desc: 人工智慧（AI）已深度嵌入日常生活與各領域的工作流程，而新一代 AI——包含協作型 AI agents、生成式模型與多模態互動——正快 速改變人類如何思考、合作與決策。在此脈絡下，本課程聚焦於「人本 × 跨智慧協作（Human-Centered & Inter-Intelligence Design）」的實踐，探討如何設計能與人類形成互補、協同與增能（augmentation）的 AI 系統。課程將從理論概念與國際案例出 發，帶領學生理解人類在 AI 系統中的角色、限制與優勢，並學習如何建構能支援個人、團隊到集體層級的 AI 協作流程。 在方法上，我們將整合人本設計流程、數位設計卡、多回合決策支持、以及 AI 介入下的雙鑽石設計模型。學生將從問題理解、需求洞 察、AI 介入點規劃，到原型建置與迭代測試，逐步學習如何與 AI 共同創造（co-creation），並處理生成式 AI 帶來的挑戰，例如 透明度、信任、偏誤、責任分工與人機協作動力。透過專案式學習，學生將實際設計一個 AI 支援的服務或系統原型，並探索如何透過 良好的互動設計，使 AI 能更有效支援個人能力、促進團隊協作、或增強集體智慧，從而為產業與社會創造更深的價值。

briefs.name: 數位科技與法律
briefs.tags: 數位經濟、科技政策與法律、數位科技治理、物聯網、大數據、人工智慧、 5G產業、創新與管制、法令遵循、企業風險
briefs.desc: 「大數據與隱私專題」藉由Amazon及Tesla等實例，帶領思考數位經濟時代最核心的隱私保護問題。大數據產 業如何兼顧消費者隱私？歐盟GDPR對產業的衝擊為何？ 「創新與平台經濟專題」透過Airbnb、Uber、Netflix、YouTube 等具體個案，以共享經濟、新興數位產業之智慧財產權、 平 台業者責任及商業競爭為主軸，理解數位平台生態並檢視相關法律問題。 「人工智慧應用專題」由5G產業發展趨勢出發，進而探索自駕車責任分配、演算法與商業模式、AI時代的風險、機會與挑 戰。 「綜合討論」由同學報告，強調跨領域對話，針對特定議題分享經驗，提出具體立場或建議。

briefs.name: 數據經營管理
briefs.tags: 財務報表(Financial Statements)、產業分析(Industry Analysis)、財務健檢(Financial Health Check)
briefs.desc: 在數據驅動的時代，管理者必須具備閱讀與解讀財務資訊的能力。本課程將以企業外部公開資訊為主軸，介紹財務報表的基本架 構、各報表間的整合與意涵，並透過實際案例探討企業的財務策略與營運表現。課程內容涵蓋財務四大報表概述、產業分析方 法、企業比較分析、以及外部財務資訊在偵測企業舞弊上的應用。課程強調實務導向與批判思考，使學生在未來職場能以數據支 撐決策。

briefs.name: 社會創新與影響力策略
briefs.tags: 社會創新SOCIAL INNOVATION,影響力策略IMPACT STRATEGY
briefs.desc: 本課程以企業與組織的視角出發，系統性地探討社會創新的理念、架構與實踐途徑。課程聚焦於企業與社會企業如何將社會與環 境目標融入核心策略，藉由創新思維與商業模式轉型，實現永續價值與正向影響。學員將學習與運用多項關鍵分析與設計工具， 包括變革理論、社會商業模式畫布及影響力衡量工具，並透過真實或模擬案例進行討論與應用。課程以互動式講授、小組合作與 反思討論為主要教學方式，旨在培養學員以策略性思維設計出兼顧創新、影響力與永續發展的組織實踐方案，從而推動企業在追 求經濟效益的同時，創造更具社會價值的影響力。

briefs.name: 創新與創業
briefs.tags: 創新5.0, 創新規劃, 創新組織, 新產品開發, 商機的認知與評估, 創業團隊與管理, 商業模式 (Innovation 5.0, Innovation planning, Innovative organization, Opportunity recognition and evaluation, Entrepreneurial teams and management, Business model)
briefs.desc: 1.介紹創新與創業管理的基礎知識與技能，使學生能瞭解創新與創業精神與經濟發展、企業管理之間的關係及 實務創業家所關心主要問題。 2.開拓學生的視野，瞭解專業經理人除了要為股東善盡企業社會責任外，發揮創新與創業精神才是創造企業成長及獲得 超額利潤的來源。有助於培養EMBA學生以創新思維，處理既有企業的新事業發展管理的能力。 3.使學生瞭解新創事業的特性與其所面臨的相關管理問題，如創業商機辨識與評估, 創業團隊領導, 商業模式創新與新創企 業的成長管理。

briefs.name: 管理經濟學
briefs.tags: 管理經濟學,經濟學,管理
briefs.desc: 管理經濟學課程是EMBA 教育中一門重要的必修業務理論基礎課，它是一門把經濟學原理和分析方法應用於企業經營管理決 策的學科。 其教學目的，一是為企業的管理決策實踐經濟理論和經濟分析的思維框架；二是使學生瞭解企業在市場經濟體制中的地位， 使企業的決策能夠更好地適應於市場體系，以提高學生在市場經濟條件下管理決策的能力和水準。

briefs.name: 服務科學
briefs.tags: 服務主導邏輯, 服務系統, 價值共創, 服務設計, 城鄉創生, Service-Dominant Logic, service system, value co-creation, service design, urban-rural revitalization
briefs.desc: 眾所週知，世界已經邁向了服務經濟的時代。「服務」存在人類社會遠在所謂的「服務業」的產業 分類。但究竟「服務」是什麼？而當IBM於2004年倡導所謂的「服務科學」，或者後來加上工程與 管理，統稱「服務科學工程與管理」(Service Science, Management, and Engineering, SSME)。近年來，在原有的SSME外加上Design，成為現在一般談及服務科學時，以SSMED來描述 它。究竟其內涵與實質內容為何？究竟服務科學的範圍與議題為何？服務科學與現有的學術與實務 領域有何關聯？如何將服務科學的理論應用於實務上？實務上的議題與需求如何來成為服務科學的 研究內容與貢獻？本課程的課程內容規劃即在滿足大家對服務科學的好奇心。同時也希望學生能勇 敢地探索此一新的領域，成為服務科學發展學術與實務社群的生力軍。 本課程的目標簡述如下： 1. 學生能完整定義服務科學的內涵與範疇。 2. 學生能應用服務體驗設計，進行服務設計。 3. 學生能分析與規劃服務價值網絡以提供服務價值。 4. 學生能針對不同的產業提出創新的服務模式。 5. 學生能指出重要的服務科學相關的重要議題，進行研究。 本課程的內容與教學具有以下的特色： 1. 理論與實務並重； 2. 講授與個案教學

briefs.name: 定價博弈與談判路線圖
briefs.tags: 國際關係,國際政治,經濟
briefs.desc: 本門課將國際政治經濟學的學習嵌構在對國際關係現象的觀察和解釋中，首先介紹國家之間交往的特點，以及國家間持續合 作的不 確定性、導致戰爭與和平的因素。接著，我們會從國家間的政治關係轉向討論國家間的經濟往來，以及國際政治與經濟的互 動，並 介紹一些國際政治經濟學關注的主要問題，包括經濟相互依賴、全球化和發展等問題。最後，我們再從政治和經濟的維度理 解中美 關係的發展歷史。

briefs.name: 固態物理一
briefs.tags: solid state physics; crystal structure; phonons; electrons; band structure
briefs.desc: Description: Introduction to crystal structures and electronic properties of crystals, suitable for beginning graduate students of engineering. Preliminary requirement: modern physics. Textbook: C. Kittel, "Introduction to solid state physics", 8th ed. Reference: Ashcroft and Mermim, "Solid state physics". Syllabus: 1. crystal structures 2. reciprocal lattices 3. crystal vibrations from atomic viewpoint 4. elastics 5. free electron model 6. energy band structures 7. semiconductor crystals Evaluation: 1. homework 2. midterm test 3. final test Teaching method: mainly by in-person lectures.

briefs.name: 量子力學
briefs.tags: Quantum mechanics, Quantum transport, quantum physics.
briefs.desc: The first half of the QM lecture will use Modern Quantum Mechanics (J. J. Sakurai). The second half of the lecture focus on the QM in solid sate (Semiconductor and/or Superconductor), the text book is Quantum Physics of Semiconductor and Devices (D. Jena). Additionally, we will use software packages, such as Quantum Toolbox in Python (QuTiP) and KWANT (TBM) to help understand the physical phenomenon.

briefs.name: 積體光學
briefs.tags: Silicon Photonics, Modulators, Couplers, Lasers, Waveguidess
briefs.desc: This course provides a fundamental and practical introduction to the design, analysis, and fabrication of guided-wave optical devices and photonic integrated circuits. The primary goal is to establish a strong theoretical foundation in electromagnetic wave propagation and light-matter interaction within confined structures. Key topics include planar dielectric waveguides, coupled-mode theory, grating structures, optical filters, and active devices. We will explore various material platforms, emphasizing silicon photonics and analyze essential components such as modulators, detectors, and on- chip lasers. Special attention will be given to advanced applications in high-speed optical communication, sensing, and future photonic computing architectures.

briefs.name: 微波電路分析及設計
briefs.nameEn: Analysis and Design of Microwave Circuits
briefs.tags: Microwave, RF, Circuit Design, Communications, IC, Solid-State Devices
briefs.desc: This course introduces concepts and principles of circuit analysis and design at microwave frequencies by examining both active and passive devices. Microwave device modeling and non-ideal effects in circuit operation such as noise and nonlinear distortion are also emphasized. The design techniques required to develop most of the major building blocks in modern microwave systems are also included.

briefs.name: 微電子工程
briefs.tags: Solid-state devices (固態元件), Silicon processing technology (矽製程技術), VLSI (超大型積體電路), Etching (蝕刻), Thin film deposition (薄膜沉積), Lithography (微影)
briefs.desc: This course aims to introduce the advancement and detailed investigations of the fundamental principles used in the design and fabrication processes of silicon-based electronics for solid- state devices, integrated circuits, and beyond. The audience will gain a solid understanding of vital techniques such as lithography, film deposition, wet etching, anisotropic dry etching, crystal growth, ion implantation, and chemical vapor deposition of metals and insulators. In addition, this course offers valuable insights into modern electronics and provides comprehensive training in FinFET design and CMOS logic layout leveraging TCAD/EDA tools, equipping you with the knowledge to take this semiconductor journey moving forward.

briefs.name: 積體電路元件
briefs.tags: Semiconductor, Device Physics, VLSI, Integrated Circuit, Transistor, Diode, BJT, MOSFET
briefs.desc: This graduate course is designed to provide an in-depth exploration of Semiconductor Devices for Integrated Circuits, bridging the gap between fundamental physics, microelectronics, and professional VLSI device knowledge. By a combination of engaging lectures and hands-on assignments, students will learn on a comprehensive journey covering important aspects of semiconductor technology essential for contemporary integrated circuits. The curriculum begins with a foundational concepts such as semiconductor band diagram and structure, carrier conduction in semiconductors, junctions, MOS capacitor, planar and 3D MOSFETs, memory devices, and bipolar junction transistors, and power devices. Students will obtain a deep understanding of the intricacies of these devices and their roles in modern electronics. A central focus of the course is on the exploration of device scaling limits, operational concepts, and anticipation of future trends. The dynamic field of semiconductor

briefs.name: 發光二極體
briefs.tags: Light-Emitting Diodes, Double Heterostructure, Visible LED, White LED, MicroLED
briefs.desc: The light emitters made of III–V alloys are the most important and widely used photonic devices because Si and Ge do not emit light due to their indirect band structures. The semiconductor laser is similar to the solid-state ruby laser and Ar+ gas laser in that the emitted radiation is highly monochromatic and produces a highly directional beam of light. A related important photonic device is the light-emitting diode (LED), which has a device structure very similar to the semiconductor injection laser but without a resonant optical cavity. Today, visible LEDs play a leading role in displays and solid-state lighting applications. In this course, the device physics, structures, and characteristics of many types of heterostructure LEDs are discussed. The current status and challenges of visible LEDs are reviewed.

briefs.name: 高速元件
briefs.tags: Schottky, MESFET, HEMT, BJT, HBT
briefs.desc: 本課程將學習metal-Semiconductor Junction, metal-Semiconductor Field-Effect Transistors, Heterojunction Bipolar Transistors等III-V元件之DC和AC特性，了解它的高頻特性及其應用!!

briefs.name: 人工神經網路特論
briefs.nameEn: Special Topics on Artificial Neural Network
briefs.tags: neural network; artificial intelligence; dynamic system; liquid state machine; Hopfield model; statistical mechanics
briefs.desc: 本課程旨在給學生對於人工神經網路的理論基礎和應用已經在軟硬體上的實現有概略的介紹，它將討論典型的主題，包括從統計學習理論 (statistical learning theory)的觀點，嚴謹的討論學習的統計基礎，例如神經網絡的訓練(training)和測試(testing)、VC 維度(VC dimension)和模 型複雜性 (model complexity)、正則化(regularization)作為過度擬合(overfitting)的補救措施。此外，我們還想介紹許多特定的神經網絡模型，包 括基於動態系統 以及其他植根於統計物理學或生物學的模型。例如 Hopfield 模型、玻爾茲曼機(Boltzmann machine)、脈衝神經網絡(spiking neural network)， 液態神經網路等等

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: 半導體、奈米電子、生醫電子、光電元件、量子電子元件。
briefs.desc: 本門課將每週邀請學者及業界專家對於微電子及跨領域之相關最新研究給予專題演講，使學生充分掌握科技趨勢，並了解科技 對人類、社會的影響，學習到豐富的科學與工程知識，以及實際運用的能力，培養發掘問題、分析問題及處理問題的能力，並 能設計實驗、執行實驗、有分析數據及歸納結果的能力。

briefs.name: 半導體光偵測器與電路
briefs.tags: 光電效應，光響應度，訊雜比，光二極體，光電晶體，前級電路
briefs.desc: 本課程將涵蓋半導體光偵測器用到的基本物理(包括Optoelectronic Processes以及Electrical Processes)、各種光偵 測器的基本結構與運作原理、不同應用要求下的光偵測器結構設計和電路設計, 並著重光偵測器系統整合考量. 由於 將同時討論到元件與電路, 對於已經修過基本半導體物理、固態電子元件、以及類比積體電路設計等課程的學生而言 較能輕鬆學習.

briefs.name: 半導體功率元件
briefs.tags: 半導體, 元件, 功率, 高電壓, 理論, Semiconductor, Device, Power, High Voltage, Theory
briefs.desc: This course aims to provide students with a comprehensive view of modern semiconductor devices for power electronic applications. After completing this course, the students will be able to understand the operating physics and electrical characteristics of power devices, as well as their design considerations.

briefs.name: 邏輯非揮發性記憶體
briefs.tags: embedded Memory, Non-Volatile Memory, Logic compatible, OTP cell, FLASH, EEPROM
briefs.desc: This course will examine in detail the modern Logic non-volatile memory including device structure, process, reliability, design, characterization, qualification, application and IP.

briefs.name: 氮化鎵功率與射頻元件技術
briefs.nameEn: Gallium Nitride based Power and RF Technology
briefs.tags: Gallium Nitride, Power Device, RF Device, High electron mobility transistor, Stability and Reliability, Packaging and System
briefs.desc: This course aims to offer a comprehensive understanding of compound semiconductor power and RF device technologies. It covers essential theories and techniques crucial to these fields, including device physics, epitaxy, stability, reliability, circuit topologies, modeling, packaging, and system considerations. Project for TCAD device simulation will be conducted. 注意事項: 此為專門針對氮化鎵基功率元件技術的進階課程，有些基本概念已假設學生已經學會，建議有參與相關研究題目 和具備功率元件基本知識的學生選修。

briefs.tags: Fluid mechanics, thermodynamics, heat transfer, combustion, computational tools, experimental methods
briefs.desc: Session 1: Introduction to thermodynamics and heat transfer (by Prof. 陳紹文) Week 1: Introduction to energy systems Week 2: Fundamental thermodynamics (i):systems,states,properties,cycles,etc Week 3: Fundamental thermodynamics (ii):1st law Fundamental thermodynamics (iii):2nd law Week 4: Fundamental heat transfer (i):1D HT Week 5: Fundamental heat transfer (ii):Thermal Resistance and Applications Week 6: Exam 1 Session 2: Introduction to fluidics (by Prof. 王翔郁) Week 7: Intro to Fluid dynamics Week 8: Energy and momentum balance Week 9: Internal Flow Week 10: External Flow Week 11: Exam 2 Session 3: Introduction to real-life engineering thermofluidic (by Prof. 林洸銓) Week 12: Job careers, classification of fluid flows, flow patterns and Bernoulli equation Week 13: Refrigerators, heat pumps, steam power plants Week 14: Combustion and thermochemistry Week 15: Internal combustion engines, jet engines Week 16: Exam 3

briefs.name: 能源與環境概論
briefs.tags: 綠色能源, 節能技術, 環境汙染
briefs.desc: 本課程為能源使用與環境關聯課程的基礎課程，主要課程則認為提供學員對能源使用的認知與社會責任的理解，在課程中並安排團 隊合作的環境觀察與分析內容，藉由此提升學員對生活環境中的觀察力與理解能源使用對環境的汙染

briefs.name: 工程數學二
briefs.tags: linear algebra, vector calculus, Fourier series, 線性代數, 向量分析, 傅立葉級數
briefs.desc: 本課程主要教授向量分析、線性代數、傅立葉轉換相關數學、原理與計算。

briefs.name: 電子學二
briefs.tags: 積體電路放大器，差動放大器，多級放大器，頻率響應，回授。Integrated-circuit amplifier, Differential amplifier, multistage amplifier, Frequency Response, Feedback
briefs.desc: This course of Microelectronics (II) deals with the analysis of analog circuits. The objective of this course is to help students developing a solid foundation of analyzing analog circuits. While the application of integrated circuits is covered, emphasis is placed on transistor circuit analysis. The students are asked to do homework on circuit analysis. The lecture covers the following topics: 1. Basic Amplifiers 2. Integrated-circuit amplifiers 3. Differential and multistage amplifiers 4. Frequency Response 5. Feedback

briefs.name: 電子學實驗二
briefs.tags: BJT circuits, operational amplifiers, timer 555, comparator, trigger circuits
briefs.desc: In this course you will learn about the basic principles of circuit design and operation in a practical, real-world laboratory setting. You will work both with discrete components such as resistors, capacitors, diodes, and transistors as well as with integrated components such as operational amplifiers and timer 555. In addition, you will become familiar with the operation of basic electronic test equipment (digital multi-meters, oscilloscopes, function generators, curve tracers, etc.). In addition, you will further understand the characteristics of transistors through the semiconductor analyzer which is very important for device development. There are 12 experiments this semester.

briefs.name: 電磁學一
briefs.tags: electrostatics, potentials, electric fields in matter, magnetostatics, magnetic fields in matter, electrodynamics
briefs.desc: 本課程教授基本電磁學知識及理論。 應用於電機、電子、通信、材料、物理等等。 授課內容包括：在自由空間及物質中的靜電場、電流、在自由空間及物質中的靜磁場、慢時變電磁場、電感及磁能等等。

briefs.name: 材料科學導論一
briefs.tags: 基礎結晶學,晶體缺陷,材料相變化之熱力學, 動力學,工程材料性質簡介,
briefs.desc: 基礎結晶學、晶體缺陷、材料相變化之熱力學與動力學、工程材料性質簡介、本課程著重於基礎材料科學觀念之建立 與工程材 料原理之定性描述

briefs.name: 材料熱力學
briefs.tags: 熱力學定律(Thermodynamics laws),氣體熱力學行為(Behavior of gas),固溶體熱力學(Thermodynamics of Solution),相圖(Phase diagrams),氣相間與固-氣相間化學反應(Gas-gas and gas-solid chemical reactions)
briefs.desc: This course includes three major parts: basic thermodynamics, solution thermodynamics, binary phase diagrams, and chemical reactions. The first part includes the three laws of thermodynamics, auxiliary functions, and free energy calculation. The second part starts from gas behavior, one-component system, solution behavior, and finally binary phase diagram. The third part teaches gas-gas reactions and gas-solid reactions. Students will learn the physical meaning of the three laws of thermodynamics, the calculation of thermodynamic functions and the applications of thermodynamics in materials science. This course aims to provide a basis for a variety of subsequent courses in Materials Science.

briefs.name: 工程化學概論
briefs.tags: 量子化學、熱力學、動力學、電化學、綠能、半導體應用
briefs.desc: 本課程跳脫傳統化學的通才式教學，不再要求工程背景學生死背元素週期表，而是轉向理解原子與分子結構如何決定化學行為，並進一步定義材料 的物理極限。課程以 2nm 暨埃米世代的關鍵技術——「化學機械平坦化（CMP）漿料化學」為主軸，重新拆解並整合熱力學、動力學、電化學與 量子力學等基礎學理。我們的目標是引導學生從原子軌域的核心視角出發，深度剖析先進製程中複雜的化學作用與反應機制，建立直擊技術本質的 洞察力。 This course departs from the traditional, generalized approach to chemistry. Instead of rote memorization of the periodic table, engineering students will focus on how atomic and molecular structures dictate chemical behaviors, which in turn define the physical limits of materials. Centering on Slurry Chemistry in Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP)—a pivotal technology for the 2nm and Angstrom eras—we deconstruct and reintegrate the core principles of thermodynamics, kinetics, electrochemistry, and quantum mechanics. The objective is to guide students from the foundatio

briefs.name: 近代物理一
briefs.tags: Modern Physics, Quantum Mechanics, Relativity
briefs.desc: 自半導體元件發明，近代物理及量子力學之應用充斥在我們的生活。近幾年來，由於奈米科技快速發展，物質奈米微小 化，更顯出近代物理常識之重要。藉由此門課,慢慢了解古典物理至近代物理之發展史，先用歷史之觀點來看待近代物 理，進而了解量子物理如何成功闡述古典物理無法解釋之現象。儘可能用輕鬆方式深入淺出地介紹相關內容，如： 相對論、普 朗克 常數、光電效應、電磁輻射之粒子性、物質的粒子性、物質之波性、海森堡測不準原理、薛丁格方程式、原子結構等.

briefs.name: 機率與統計
briefs.tags: Probability: 機率, Random Variables: 隨機變數, Statistics: 統計學, Hypothesis Testing: 假設檢定, Linear Regression: 線性回歸
briefs.desc: This is an introductory course in applied statistics and probability aimed at undergraduate students in engineering. The course seeks to provide students with methodologies for dealing with the variability in observed data and applying statistical methods to engineering and physical problems. Topics covered include basic concepts of probability, discrete and continuous random variables, probability distributions, sampling distributions, point estimation of parameters, interval estimation, hypothesis testing, linear regression, and logistic regression.

briefs.name: 控制系統
briefs.tags: 回授控制(Feedback Control), 動態反應(Dynamic Response), 控制器設計(Design of Controller), 時域分析(Time-Domain Analysis), 頻域分析(Frequency-Domain Analysis)
briefs.desc: 宗旨： 分析動態系統在暫態及穩態的反應，學習設計回授控制器以改進系統的反應。 內容： Ch. 1. An Overview and Brief History of Feedback Control Ch. 3. Dynamic Response Ch. 4. A First Analysis of Feedback Ch. 5. The Root-Locus Design Method Ch. 6. The Frequency-Response Design Method

briefs.name: 量測系統實驗
briefs.tags: 儀器(instrumentation), 量測(measurement), 實驗(experiment), 感測器(sensor), 分析(analysis)
briefs.desc: 在一學期內完成十二項與量測技術相關的實驗，並針對量測與實驗相關應用進行專題報告。 01.應變量測 02.溫度量測與控制 03.壓力量測 04.流速量測 05.水位量測 06.轉速與位置量測 07.位移量測 08.運動量測 09.LabVIEW虛擬儀控應用 10.微型感測器 11.光譜分析與高速攝影 12.MATLAB科學計算語言

briefs.name: 熱傳學
briefs.tags: Heat Transfer, 1D/2D Conduction, Convection, External Flow, Internal Flow, Free Convection
briefs.desc: NTHU ESS 340000, Spring 2026 Heat Transfer 熱傳學 Instructor: 陳紹文教授 (辦公室: 李存敏館607室, 分機: 34169, E-mail: chensw@mx.nthu.edu.tw ) Lecture time: W3, W4, F3, F4, Classroom: ESS 501 (實體上課) Grade: Homework: 25%; Participation/Quiz: 5%; Exams: Midterm: 35%, Final: 35%. Textbook: F.P. Incropera, D.P. DeWitt, T.L. Bergman, A.S. Lavine, "Principles of Heat and Mass Transfer", 7th Edition, International Student Version, John Wiley and Sons Inc., 2013. Tentative outline: 1. Chapter 1 Introduction (2 hours) 2. Chapter 2 Introduction to Conduction (4 hours) 3. Chapter 3 1-D, Steady-State Conduction (6 hours) 4. Chapter 4 2-D, Steady-State Conduction (4 hours) 5. Chapter 5 Transient Conduction (4 hours) 6. Chapter 6 Introduction to Convection (6 hours) 7. Chapter 7 External Flow (6 hours) 8. Chapter 8 Internal Flow (6 hours) 9. Chapter 9 Free Convection (4 hours) 10. * Chapter 11 Heat Exchangers (4 hours) 11. * Chapter 10 Boiling and Condensati

briefs.name: 物理冶金二
briefs.tags: 退火, 成核與成長, 固化, 鋼鐵與非鐵合金, 破裂與潛變, 疲勞, Annealing, Nucleation and Growth, Solidification, Ferrous and Nonferrous Alloys, Fraction and Creep, Fatigue
briefs.desc: This is the second course of a two-semester sequence treating metallurgical phenomena and their utilization in engineering materials and processes. The contents in the second semester are mainly the metallurgical phenomena including annealing, nucleation and growth, solidification, ferrous and nonferrous alloys, fracture and creep (brief introduction), fatigue and corrosion fatigue.

briefs.name: 核能安全
briefs.tags: 核反應器熱水力研究,放射性物質外釋,大氣擴散機制,風險度評估法,SMR
briefs.desc: 本課程的主旨在講解核反應器安全相關的熱水力問題，以及放射性物質外釋後在環境中大氣擴散機制作用下放射性強度分佈及 對人體造成劑量大小的估算方法。同時簡介風險度評估的方法，及核能電廠失水事故的分類及解析等內容。

briefs.name: 書報討論二
briefs.tags: 文獻搜尋, 系統匯整, 互動討論, 科學溝通, 專業報告; Literature Search, Systematic Compilation, Interactive Discussion, Scientific Communication, Professional Presentation
briefs.desc: Weekly group meetings for interactive presentations by enrolled students on their selected research articles published in Nature or Science during 2020-2026

briefs.name: 半導體製程
briefs.tags: 半導體 Semiconductor, 熱製程 Thermal Process, 微影 Lithography, 薄膜沉積 Thin Film Deposition, 蝕刻 Etching, 製程整合 Process Integration.
briefs.desc: 此課程為半導體製程技術與原理的探討與介紹，可學習到半導體製程技術的演進、各製程步驟與製程設備的主要技術原理及重要 的基礎觀念，內容包含半導體製造簡介、磊晶製程、熱製程、微影製程、蝕刻製程、薄膜沉積製程以及製程整合..等，為從事 積體電路製造、積體電路元件與積體電路設計的核心基礎課程，有助學員日後投入半導體、光電、微機電與感測器等相關產業。

briefs.name: 機器學習導論
briefs.tags: 機率, 分類, 回歸分析, 監督式, 非監督式, probability, classification, regression analysis, supervised, unsupervised
briefs.desc: This course introduces basic concepts in machine learning and their associated mathematical tools. It is aimed at advanced undergraduates, and assumes no previous knowledge of machine learning concepts.

briefs.name: 固態物理導論一
briefs.nameEn: Introduction to Solid State Physics I
briefs.tags: Crystal Structure (晶體結構), Reciprocal Lattice Structure (倒晶格結構), Energy Band Theory (能帶理論), Mechanical Properties (力學特性), Electrical Properties (電學特性), Optical Properties (光學特性), Magnetic Properties (磁學特性), Thermal Properties (熱學特性), Phonon Physics (聲子物理), Semiconductor Physics (半導體物理)
briefs.desc: This course provides an in-depth examination of solid-state physics, focusing on crystal structures, lattice dynamics, and the properties of materials. Students will explore theoretical concepts and practical applications related to various physical properties of materials.

briefs.name: 材料機械性質
briefs.tags: 變形(Deformation), 破裂與破裂力學(Fracture and fracture mechanics), 強化機制(Strengthening mechanisms), 差排理論(Dislocation theory), 應力狀態之張量分析(Tensor analysis of stress state)
briefs.desc: Mechanical Properties of Materials includes three major parts: Deformation and Fracture of Materials, and Strengthening Mechanisms in Materials (mostly on metals). The class will begin with tensile response of materials and then dislocation theory and deformation mechanisms including slip and twinning. The second part is strengthening mechanisms in metals, and the final part will be fracture behavior and elements of fracture mechanics. The prerequisite of this course is ESS2500 Introduction to Materials Science I and ESS3510 Physical metallurgy (I).

briefs.name: 燃料電池原理與應用
briefs.nameEn: Principles and Applications of Fuel Cells
briefs.tags: 電化學, 燃料電池, 極化, 電極, 電解質, Electrochemistry, Fuel Cell, Polarization, Electrode, Electrolyte
briefs.desc: 本課程涵蓋燃料電池領域之歷史發展、電極電位理論、電池原理、燃料電池種類、各類型燃料電池之工作原理與應用範 圍、燃 料電池之發展瓶頸與現況、以及燃料電池應用等主題，自淺而深提供學生有關燃料電池原理與技術的基礎知識、進階理論 與應 用領域，使學生具備基本但完整的燃料電池知識，並能於未來的進修或工作中加以應用。

briefs.name: 奈微米系統工程原理
briefs.nameEn: Principles of Nano and Micro Systems Engineering
briefs.tags: 微機電系統, 奈米科技, 奈微熱流系統, 奈米材料科技, 奈維米生醫系統, 奈米製程及檢測
briefs.desc: 本課程旨於介紹奈微米系統科技之基本原理、微尺度及奈米尺度之物理現象、相關奈微系統製造方式，三個重要的微系統應用領 域:光學微機電系統、生醫微機電/奈微熱流系統、和射頻微機電系統，以及奈米科技於先進光電、生醫、能源系統上之跨領域應 用與未來趨勢。

briefs.name: 工程系統專題研究一
briefs.nameEn: Independent Study in Engineering & System Science I
briefs.tags: 專題研究
briefs.desc: 由學生與指導教授共同擬定研究課題，進行專題研究，讓學生獲得解決實際工程問題之訓練。

briefs.name: 工程系統專題研究二
briefs.nameEn: Independent Study in Engineering & System Science II
briefs.tags: 專題研究
briefs.desc: 由學生與指導教授共同擬定研究課題，進行專題研究，讓學生獲得解決實際工程問題之訓練。

briefs.name: 專題演講
briefs.tags: 學術演講,經驗分享,Seminar Talks, Experience Sharing
briefs.desc: 本課程將邀請電子、材料、機械、物理、能源工程、生物醫學、核子工程等相關領域的專家學者，於每周進行專題演講，並與參 與課程之碩博士研究生座談。 This course will invite experts from different fields, including but not limited to electrical engineering, materials science, mechanical engineering, physics, energy engineering, biomedical, nuclear engineering, to give seminar talks and experience sharing with enrolled graduate students on a weekly basis.

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: 文獻搜尋，溝通技巧，專題報告，公開討論，專業互動；Literature Search, Communication Skill, Topical Presentation, Open Discussion, Professional Interaction
briefs.desc: This course is designed to provide students with opportunity to practice their professional presentation skill, particularly in the scientific and technical areas. The students are expected to give a presentation on the topic related to their research.

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: Microfluidics Systems, BioMEMS, Bio sensors, Cell Chips, Hydrogen Energy, Fuel cells
briefs.desc: 由奈微米系統工程組參與學生輪流選擇2-3篇與奈微米系統工程相關之國際期刊或會議論文做口頭報告。原則上一學期輪到一 次。

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: literature review, reports, communication, problem solving
briefs.desc: The seminar is to have weekly discussion about thesis topics and progress including literature review, methodology and problems encountered and possible solutions.

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: 文獻回顧, 英文科技論文簡報, Literature Review, English Presentation Skills
briefs.desc: 本課程為研究所必修課程，藉由學生報告文獻與修課同學共同討論研究議題以培養其具備科技論文之閱讀與簡報能力。 This course is mandatory for graduate students and aims to develop their ability to read and present scientific papers by having reports on literature and engaging in discussions with classmates on research topics.

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: 系統分析, 元件製程, 電路設計, system analysis, device fabrication, circuit design
briefs.desc: 書報討論課程。與本組研究相關的各類文獻閱讀、整理與討論。研究進度報告。

briefs.name: 微波工程
briefs.tags: microwave, electromagnetic wave, transmission lines
briefs.desc: This course introduces the students with the fundamentals of RF/microwave engineering and circuit theory. The students need to have background of undergraduate electromagnetics. Some basic circuit background also helps.

briefs.name: 先進半導體特論
briefs.tags: 半導體, Semiconductor, Circuit Design, Device Physics, metrology
briefs.desc: The course is separated into two parts: (1) Teach, through a series of lectures by invited speakers from industry, and (2) In-touch observation and possible operations by the side of semiconductor equipments, which are located in TSMC’s Taichung Training Center. The purpose is to provide a comprehensive overview how a semiconductor manufacturing company functions, from providing process technology and design infrastructure to manufacturing, metrology, testing, packaging, quality, reliability, failure analysis, intellectual property.

briefs.name: 高等物理冶金
briefs.tags: 材料熱力學,材料動力學,晶體介面與微結構,相變化,成核與成長, thermodynamics, kinetics, crystal interface and microstructure, phase transformation, nucleation and growth
briefs.desc: based on thermodynamics of materials, reaction rate theory and diffusion theory, this course includes the following topics: crystal interface and microstructure, nucleation and growth theories, diffusional transformations in solids, diffusionless transformation. The goal of this course is to teach students the core knowledge of materials science, especially the application of thermodynamics and kinetics in the most important phase transformations in material systems. The prerequisite courses are: thermodynamics of materials (ESS2510 or equivalent), physical metallurgy I and II (ESS3510 and ESS3520).

briefs.name: 材料分析與檢測
briefs.tags: 先進製程環境質傳機制 (AMC Mass Transfer in Advanced Nodes),原子級失效分析與摻雜鑑定 (Atomic-Scale FA & Active Dopant Profiling),寬能隙界面工程與缺陷控制 (WBG Interface & Defect Engineering), 同步輻射原位動力學 (Synchrotron-based In-situ Kinetics)、綠能、半導體製程研究應用
briefs.desc: 本課程聚焦 2nm 與埃米世代之半導體製程需求，整合國內頂尖學研機構與產業專家實務經驗。透過「問題導向學習 (PBL)」模式，致力將材料分 析與檢測理論，轉化為解決先進製程、材料特性分析及失效模式的關鍵實力。 課程亮點： 同步輻射原位分析：先進光源光束線應用與 In-situ 即時監測實務。 第三代半導體技術：SiC (碳化矽) 基板檢測與先進鍍膜核心解析。 原子級失效分析：運用 APT、DHEM 與逆向工程探討微觀晶體議題。 系統整合與環境控制： 先進製程 AMC (氣體分子污染物) 控制與 IP 產業策略。 目標：引領學員掌握產業技術趨勢，促進學研與產業之深度對話。 Core Focus: Material Analysis for 2nm & Angstrom-Era Semiconductors This PBL (Problem-based Learning) focused course bridges academia and industry, transforming characterization theory into actionable expertise for advanced nodes, material properties, and failure analysis. Key Highlights: Synchrotron Analysis: Advanced beamline applications and In-situ monitoring techniques. 3rd Gen Semiconductors: Deep dives into SiC substrate inspection and coa

briefs.name: 輻射度量實驗
briefs.tags: 核輻射度量, Nuclear Radiation Measurement, 加馬射線, Gamma ray, 偵檢器, dectector, 中子, neutron, 多頻道分析儀, MCA
briefs.desc: 本實驗課的目的為配合輻射度量原理授課內容，訓練學生熟悉各種輻射偵檢系統，進行量測 學習。輻射量測實驗包括：輻 射量測基本電子設備、計數統計, 誤差傳遞, 示波器, 放大器, 鑑別器, 以及多 頻道脈高分析儀等.偵檢器包括蓋格-米 勒（GM）計數器特性與計數統計、NaI(Tl)碘化鈉閃爍偵檢系統與加馬 能譜、二極半導體偵檢器, 氣體中子比例偵檢器與 阿伐及貝他粒子能譜、純鍺偵檢器（HPGe）與高解析加馬能 譜, X-光螢光分析及X光影相技術等基本偵檢器的操作與量測 技巧。此外並增加反應器實驗以瞭解活化分析技 巧，讓學生實際至清華水池式反應器參觀。 This course is to gain the experience of the radiation measurement, including, detection electronics system, gamma ray, neutron, and X-ray measurement using all kinds of detector and to do the neutron activation analysis with a visiting of THOR. 課程大綱 (Syllabus)

briefs.name: 先進太陽能電池
briefs.tags: 太陽能產業、先進太陽能電池技術
briefs.desc: 提供太陽能產業與研究前瞻與現況發展，並以新式太陽能電池技術為藍本激發同學在綠色能源政策與社會需求貢獻所學。

briefs.name: 奈微米生醫及流體系統
briefs.tags: Nano drug delivery, BioMEMS, MicroFluidics, Biosensors, Single molecule detection, Tissue engineering
briefs.desc: 本課程以一學期時間教授奈微米尺度之生物醫學及流體系統相關之工作原理、基本架構、以及其廣泛之應用。課程首先以四週時間簡介奈微米技 術及基礎生化及分生技術，之後在期中考前介紹基本之生醫檢測技術及奈微流體操控生醫分子技術。期中考之後則以不同專題探討奈微米生醫特 殊之技術及其應用，與生醫分子動態模擬與實驗方法。期末以學生分組針對不同專題進行報告方式進行。 This course provides an in-detail instruction on the fundamental principles, basic frame works, and the variety of applications to biomedical and fluidic systems in micro or nano scale. Before midterm examination, fundamental micro/nano fabrication methods, basic analytical Biochemistry principles, and general micro/nano fluidic physics and devices will be introduced. After the midterm 5 specific applications for micro/nano biomedical/fluidic systems will be elaborated. Students will then be arranged into several groups for preparing final projects and reports.

briefs.name: 西洋文學概論二
briefs.tags: Greek Mythology, Homer, Odyssey, Greek Tragedy
briefs.desc: This course introduces the first-year student of literature to some of the major concepts, themes, as well as some of the most famous narratives, characters, and literary forms of the western literary tradition. The aim of such a course is to provide students the basic tools, concepts, and reading knowledge for more advanced study of western literature in upper-level courses beyond their first year at the university. While such a course does not offer a comprehensive coverage of all the major texts of western literature, it conceptualizes the western literary tradition as a series of debates and issues for discussion. We will analyze the literary texts in their historical, cultural, and political contexts, and we will examine the significance of these texts for the western literary tradition.

briefs.name: 應用語言學
briefs.tags: sociolinguisics, psycholinguistics, neurolinguistics, language acquisition, language pedagogy, computational linguistics
briefs.desc: This is a survey course that provides an overview of the main subfields in applied linguistics. Through lectures and class discussions, students will become familiar with key issues and debates in sociolinguistics, psycholinguistics, neurolinguistics, language acquisition, language pedagogy, and computational linguistics. For some of the topics, other teachers from our department who are specialists in these areas will lead the class (see calendar below). In addition to weekly reading materials, multimedia materials will be incorporated into the lectures to help students understand the topics discussed in class.

briefs.name: 進階英文：閱讀與討論
briefs.tags: English Reading, Speaking, listening skills, impromptu speaking skills
briefs.desc: The aim of this course is to enhance students' critical English reading abilities and develop more formal discussion skills focusing on critical reading of and reference to source materials. In this class, students will read a variety of texts with enhanced fluency following coherent and effective use of reading strategies. Students will also build-up impromptu speaking skills to actively engage in leading a discussion with a critical perspective (e.g., distinguishing between fact and opinion, evaluating sources, and identifying points of view). Discussion skills will be practiced in a variety of formats including whole-class analysis of topical issues, problem-solving group work, or short individual oral presentations.

briefs.name: 進階英文：閱讀與討論
briefs.tags: This course aims to help students to become efficient and competent readers.
briefs.desc: This course aims to help students to become efficient and competent readers. Students will learn how to understand and analyze texts through asking questions, making predictions, drawing inferences, and identifying the main idea. Further, students are expected to read extensively outside of class time.

briefs.name: 進階英文：閱讀與討論
briefs.tags: discussion, critical thinking, work analysis, skill implementation, life reflection
briefs.desc: The course is designed to provide a toolkit to develop fundamental skills and mindsets for 21st century success. The purpose of the compiled contents is to equip young adults to transit from the academic setting into the 21st century work field hoping to aim for a smoother transition in the near future. The course seeks to inspire, develop, guide and provide support for life-related issues. Students are required to read articles from major news agencies and professional development websites then come to class for topical discussion and skill-building tasks.

briefs.name: 進階英文：閱讀與討論
briefs.tags: academic speaking and listening key skills, practical training and practices on academic/formal presentations, lectures and talks
briefs.desc: The course is designed to cultivate students’ English proficiency in academic speaking and listening by providing practical training and practices on academic/formal presentations, lectures and talks. To achieve the goal, students will be instructed on key listening and speaking skills by the textbook in line with vocabulary and reading skills as needed and assigned topic-oriented tasks to step by step develop academic English proficiency in both targeted learning areas.

briefs.name: 進階英文：聽講
briefs.tags: This course is designed to develop students’ English listening and speaking competencies.
briefs.desc: This course is designed to develop students’ English listening and speaking competencies. Students will further develop listening skills (e.g. identifying main ideas and details, making inferences, and analyzing what you have heard) through listening to authentic materials related to culture, news, and current events. Students will also develop discussion skills through a variety of interactive activities. By the end of the course, students will learn to: 1. comprehend listening materials which cover more specialized or sophisticated topics, 2. identify and analyze points of view, arguments, or implicit information in the listening material, 3. lead and participate in effective group discussions and deliver oral presentations

briefs.desc: This course is to help students develop oral language proficiency for academic purpose. Materials from authentic sources are chosen to enhance students' listening comprehension as well as critical commentaries and oral expression.

briefs.desc: This course aims to advance students’ listening and speaking skills Students will further develop listening skills (e.g., identifying main ideas, details, making inferences, and note-taking) through less simplified and authentic listening materials. Students wi through a variety of listening genres and systematic guidelines that help students through strategies and critical-thinking skills that help students for academic achievement.ll also develop discussion skills through a variety of interactive activities. By the end of the course, students will learn to: 1. comprehend listening materials which cover more specialized or sophisticated topics, 2. identify and analyze points of view, arguments, or implicit information in the listening material , 3. lead and participate in effective group discussions and deliver oral presentations.
