briefs.tags: 偏微分，多重積分，向量分析，二次微分方程，Partial Derivatives, Multiple Integral, Vector Calculus, 2nd order differential equations
briefs.desc: 學習無限數列，級數，3維空間幾何，偏微分，多重積分，向量分析。 主要運用微積分方法分析研究高維度空間問題，並為學習進階數學做好準備。

briefs.name: 微積分Ａ二
briefs.tags: 泰勒級數 Taylor Series, 參數方程式 Parametric Equations, 偏導數 Partial Derivatives, 拉格朗日乘數法 Lagrange Multipliers, 重積分 Multiple Integrals
briefs.desc: 本課程微積分二主要是介紹微積分的理論、計算與應用，學習重點在於基本數學觀念與邏輯的理解，內容涵蓋： 1) 數列、級數和泰勒級數的性質及其應用。 2) 參數方程和極座標。 3) 向量、空間幾何和向量內積與外積。 4) 多變數函數之偏導數、極值問題和拉格朗日乘數法。 5) 重積分。

briefs.name: 微積分Ａ二
briefs.tags: 數列，級數，向量函數，多變數函數，多變數積分，sequences, series, vector calculus, functions of several variables, double and triple integrals
briefs.desc: 訓練學生數學相關基礎的聽說讀寫能力，為之後進階的專業學科作準備。

briefs.name: 微積分Ａ二
briefs.tags: Derivative, Integral, Differential Equation, Parametric Equation, Polar Coordinate, Infinite Series, Vector Function.
briefs.desc: 本課程所欲培養之核心能力包括(1)具備發現問題、分析問題並解決問題的能力(2)培養運用數學作為發展其他學科的能力(3)培 養數學邏輯思考的能力(4)學習進階數學的能力

briefs.name: 微積分Ａ二
briefs.tags: parametric equations, sequences, multivariable calculus, vector calculus
briefs.desc: This course introduces key topics in advanced calculus, including parametric equations, sequences, multivariable calculus, and vector calculus.

briefs.desc: 1. Calculus in Polar coordinate 2. Sequences, Series 3. Vector and Space 4. Vector functions 5. Partial deriavatives 6. Multiple integrals 7. Vector Calculus

briefs.tags: several variable calculus, vector analysis, sequences, series
briefs.desc: This is a basic calculus course. Students are expected to learn basic ideas in Cauculus, including convergence, calculus in several variables and some numerical methods.

briefs.name: 微積分Ｂ二
briefs.tags: Sequences and series; Differentiation and Integration for several variables
briefs.desc: 1. Sequences and series. 2. Differentiation and Integration for several variables.

briefs.name: 微積分Ｂ二
briefs.tags: Sequences and Series, Partial Derivatives, Multiple Integrals, Vector Fields
briefs.desc: # Infinite Sequences and Series # Partial Derivatives # Multiple Integrals # Integration in Vector Fields

briefs.name: 微積分Ｂ二
briefs.tags: 數列(Sequences), 級數(Series), 向量函數(Vector Functions), 偏導數(Partial Derivatives), 多重積分(Multiple Integrals)
briefs.desc: 本課程為上學期課程之延伸。課程內容將介紹數列、無窮級數、多變數函數，並將單變數函數的微分、積分之概念與其應用推廣至多維度空間。

briefs.name: 微積分Ｂ二
briefs.tags: Series, Parametric equations, The geometry of space, Partial derivatives, Multiple integrals, Vector Calculus
briefs.desc: 「微積分學」是為了研究事物變動的現象的一門數學，它提供了利用數量分析去研討事物變動的基礎理論和有效工具。 因為自然現象、工 業科技 或社會事務所牽涉的問題很多都是變量問題，所以都需要利用微積分加以數理分析。 我們利用函數關係來表達這些變量之間的關聯，因此探討函數關係就成了微積分學的主要課題。「變率」與「和」是函數研究中最重要基本 的兩 個要素，它們相應地產生了「微分」與「積分」這兩種基本運算，微積分這個名詞因而產生。

briefs.name: 微積分Ｂ二
briefs.tags: The techniques of integration, Sequences , Infinite series ,Functions of several variables ,Differentiations of several variables ,Double and triple integrals
briefs.desc: 本課程主要是培養理工商同學最基礎的數學，不管是理論或計算應用都有最紮實的訓練。

briefs.name: 微積分Ｂ二
briefs.tags: ntegration, Calculus of several variables, differential equations, Taylor polynomial and infinite series, probability and calculus, and Trigonometric functions
briefs.desc: 1.課程說明(Course Description) 本課程之目的在介紹微積分基本知識與其應用，訓練學生思維能力。

briefs.name: 微積分Ｂ二
briefs.tags: integration, sequences, series, partial derivatives, double integrals
briefs.desc: In this course, we will investigate differential calculus further by studying integration techniques, sequences, series as well as partial derivatives and multiple integrals. This course is a continuation of the Calculus course taught by the instructor previous semester.

briefs.name: 微積分專業學術英文
briefs.nameEn: English for Specific Academic Purposes (ESAP): Calculus
briefs.tags: 專業學術英文（English for Specific Academic Purposes）、微積分（Calculus）、點燃快講（Ignite Talks）
briefs.desc: This course aims at English for Specific Academic Purposes (ESAP) and thereby is conducted in English. Mandarin is (partially) used only in the occasion of checking understanding and during the Q&A session. The course materials are illustrated mainly by examples from high school mathematics and calculus. The purpose is to help students to get used to taking courses in the framework of English as a Medium of Instruction (EMI). This course is part of the Ministry of Education’s “Teaching Practice Research Subsidies Program”, so questionnaires and consultations will be used to evaluate the teaching effectiveness.

briefs.name: 線性代數二
briefs.tags: diagonalization, inner product space, Jordan canonical form
briefs.desc: 這是數學系大一的必修課程。預備知識為線性代數一。 本門課是非常重要的基礎課程。未來不管是要繼續數學研究，或者轉向其他自然科學，工程或者經濟財金方面，本門課仍然是 必備的知識。因此我們將會以較嚴格的方式考核學生的學習成效。 跟高中數學課程比起來，本課程較為抽象，需要學生花費較多的心力。 我們將同時要求學生的基本計算，抽象概念理解以及邏輯推理的能力。

briefs.name: 基礎數論
briefs.tags: 長除法Division Algorithm, 同餘Congruence, 二次互逆律Quadratic Reciprocity Law, 密碼學Cryptograph, 連分數Continued Fraction
briefs.desc: 本課程主要為介紹「數」的世界。在學習數學的過程中，我們接觸過了各種不同類型的數：整數，有理數，無理數，虛數，代 數數，超越數...等。這些數所含的意義以及數彼此之間的關係，一直令從古至今的人們趨之若鶩地想要去瞭解和研究。這堂課 會從整數開始，透過嚴謹的邏輯推導，帶大家一起探討數字間的規則。課程最後也會簡單介紹如何透過「數」所含的複雜度， 來建立現在的加密解密系統和數位簽章。

briefs.name: 程式設計二
briefs.tags: 蟒蛇 Python, 演算法 algorithm, 數值蟒蛇 Numpy, 機器學習 Machine Learning, 畫圖 matplotlib
briefs.desc: 透過 Python 語言，學習進階演算法以及機器學習的基本概念。本課程將接續「11410MATH171001 程式設計一」上課 同學必須先有 Python 語言及重要函式庫的相關基礎，包含但不限於條件判斷、迴圈、自訂函式、模組、字串處理、 comprehension、numpy、matplotlib 等；欠缺相關基礎者，應自行於開學前補上進度。

briefs.name: 高等微積分二
briefs.tags: 微分， 積分，可積性，傅立葉級數，傅立葉變換。 Derivatives, Integration, Integrablility, Fourier Series, Fourier Transforms
briefs.desc: 本課程為數學分析的基礎課程，大二上學期高等微積分課程的延伸。在這個課程中，將著重於多變數向量值函數的微分，多變數函數積分與可積性等的定義及理論證明。也會介紹隱函數定理，反函數定理的證明與應用。最後會介紹傅立葉級數與其應用。ˇㄢ

briefs.name: 高等微積分二
briefs.tags: Limt, function, uniform Convergence, continuous mapping, Differentiable mapping. 極限,函數,均勻收斂,連續映射,微分映射
briefs.desc: 高等微積分的內容主要是古典的基礎分析 本課程主要從微積分的基礎理論開始,把微積分的理論嚴謹化.然後加入一些分析的基礎訓練! 主要講解的課程內容如下 1.抽象賦距空間(metric space)的點拓(point-set topology) 2.均勻收斂(uniform convergence)的相關極限交換理論,Azela-Ascoli定哩,Stone-weierstrass定理 3.Continuous Mapping 4.Differentiable Mapping 5.The inverse and Implicit Function Theorems and Related Topics 6.Fubini's Theorem and the Change of variables Formula 7.Fourier Analysis 目標導向 1.期許學生能獲得基礎的分析知識 2.培養學生分析邏輯的基礎能力 3.藉此培育優秀的科學人才 為國家社會盡些貢獻

briefs.name: 代數二
briefs.tags: Ring theory, Sylow theorems and Galois theory
briefs.desc: We will cover ring theory, Sylow's theorem and Galois theory.

briefs.name: 統計學
briefs.tags: Point Estimation (點估計), Hypothesis Testing (假設檢定), Interval Estimation (區間估計), Decision Theorem (決策理論), Bayesian Inference (貝氏定理)
briefs.desc: This course is an introduction to the theory and application of statistical methods. We will particularly focus on probability models and modern statistical concepts, and methods developed in a mathematical framework. Topics to be covered include random variables and their various properties, statistical inference, point and interval estimation, hypothesis testing, statistical modeling for experimental and observational data, survey sampling, Bayesian analysis, decision theory, aspects of experimental design, and a variety of real applications such as two-sample comparison and analysis of variance.

briefs.name: 離散數學
briefs.tags: 計數方法(Counting Methods), 遞迴關係(Recurrence Relations), 生成函數(Generating Functions), 鴿籠原理(The Pigeonhole Principle), 圖論(Graph Theory)
briefs.desc: 此課程目標為讓學生深入理解離散結構中的計數方法、遞迴關係與結構性證明。並建立學生對組合分析與圖論的數學基礎與常見定理之理解。課堂會訓練學生以嚴謹方式撰寫組合與圖論相關證明，為後續進階課程（組合學、圖論、演算法等）奠定理論基礎。

briefs.name: 向量分析
briefs.tags: Integrals on curve and surface, Green's theorem, Stokes' theorem, Divergence theorem, Laplace operator
briefs.desc: We will talk about line and surface integrals, divergence and curl of vector fields in R^3, special vector fields in R^3, Laplace operator, Green Theorem, Stokes Theorem, and Divergence Theorem.

briefs.name: 複變數函數論一
briefs.tags: complex function, complex differentiation, residue, Cauchy integral formula, Riemann mapping theorem
briefs.desc: 本門課介紹單複變函數的基本性質, 包括其微分, 積分及極限等的方面的結果. 因複解析函數與光滑函數的性質差異很 大, 這裡有許多結果是一般實函數所沒有的. 其獨特性讓一些問題以複函數的方式來看特別容易解決.

briefs.name: 高等線性代數
briefs.tags: multilinear maps, tensor products, symmetric bilinear forms, symplectic forms
briefs.desc: This course is suitable for undergraduate mathematics majors in their third or fourth year. Required background knowledge include linear algebra, abstract algebra and advanced calculus.

briefs.name: 幾何二
briefs.tags: Gauss-Bonnet, Index theorem, global geometry, homology group of surfaces, classification of compact surfaces
briefs.desc: The material that will be covered in the Spring semester includes (but not restricted to) the following: 1. Review: Parallel transport, geodesics, curvatures 2. Gauss-Bonnet Theorem and application of Gauss-Bonnet Theorem 3. Global differential geometry 4. Classification of compact surfaces 5. Homology group of surfaces

briefs.name: 碎形幾何學
briefs.tags: 碎形幾何學, fractal geometry, 碎形, fractal, 維度, dimension, 代, iteration, 收縮映射定理, contraction mapping principle
briefs.desc: 碎形是利用一些函數或法則不斷進行重複疊代產生的複雜的圖形。碎形幾何學是研究碎形圖的幾何的一個數學分支。 本課程希 望通過介紹美麗的碎形圖而引起學生的對高階數學的好奇心，從而更有動力學習數學。本課程將引導學生從基礎的碎形理論開 始，逐步深入了解碎形的結構、生成方法和其數學特性，探索規則和幾何形狀之間的關係來啟發學生的想像力和創造力。課程目 標包含理解碎形幾何的基本概念和數學原理、探索碎形的生成方法及學習高階的數學、激發學生創造力，通過碎形設計和製作展 示學習成果。

briefs.name: 偏微分方程導論
briefs.tags: 波方程（wave equations）、熱方程（heat equations）、Laplace方程（Laplace equations）、分離變數（separation of variables）、Fourier級數（Fourier series）
briefs.desc: We will develop fundamental tools for studying basic partial differential equations (PDEs) such as the wave, heat, and Laplace equations. Topics include the characteristic method, separation of variables and Fourier series method, fundamental solutions, and variational method. Throughout the course, we will emphasize the derivation and interpretation of PDEs, along with selected applications and connections to modern perspective in PDE theory. This course follows the framework of English as a Medium of Instruction (EMI) and is conducted in English.

briefs.name: 泛函分析二
briefs.tags: Fredholm operators, index of operators, elliptic operators, spectral theory, von Neumann algebra
briefs.desc: The course begins with the theory of Fredholm operators (a special type of bounded operators) and their indices. Subsequent topics will depend on the interest of the registered students and the instructor.

briefs.name: 實變數函數論二
briefs.tags: L^p spaces(L^p 空間), Hilbert spaces(希爾伯特空間), Banach spaces(巴納赫空間), Fourier transform(傅立葉轉換), Complex measures(複測度).
briefs.desc: L^p spaces, Hilbert spaces, Banach spaces, Fourier transform, Abstract measure, and complex measures.

briefs.name: 拋物型偏微分方程
briefs.tags: Parabolic PDE, Heat Equation, Convolution Solution, Heat Kernel
briefs.desc: I will cover some basic PDE theory for 2nd order parabolic PDE: including the representation formula of solution, maximum principle, existence and uniqueness of solution, regularity of solution, apriori estimate, integral estimate, .. and many more other interesting topics.

briefs.name: 常微分方程二
briefs.tags: Ordinary differential equation, existence, uniqueness, linearization, asymptotical behavior
briefs.desc: This course provides an introduction to the theory of ordinary differential equations (ODE). The theory of ODE has a number of applications in science and engineering. Topics to be covered in the second semester include: 1. Method of Lyapunov functions (parts mot covered in last semester) 2. Two-dimensional dynamical systems 3. Second order linear equations 4. Perturbation methods

briefs.name: 近世代數二
briefs.tags: Galois Theory, Commutative algebra, Non-commutative algebra, Finite group representation, Homological algebra
briefs.desc: 本課程延續上學期近世代數一的研究所程度內容，主要目的為介紹代數相關領域的知識和方法，令學生熟悉代數語言的使用。

briefs.name: 代數數論二
briefs.tags: Brauer groups, central simple algebras, local class field theory, global class field theory, L-functions
briefs.desc: In this semester, we will introduce Class Field Theory and present its proof.

briefs.name: 量化金融
briefs.tags: Probabilistic Modeling, Decision Making, Data Science, Quantitative Finance, Machine Learning
briefs.desc: This is the first course in the Quantitative Data Science sequence, focused on building the rigorous mathematical, probabilistic, and statistical frameworks necessary for advanced Quantitative Finance. We will cover the core concepts of probabilistic modeling, information geometry, and mean-covariance analysis. The emphasis is on the theoretical foundation, equipping students to understand and apply these advanced models to real-world financial data in subsequent courses.

briefs.name: 微分幾何二
briefs.tags: Differential manifolds, Riemannian metrics, connections. curvatures, Jacobi fields
briefs.desc: 本課程介紹黎面幾何的基本知識與性質，曲率與拓樸間的連結。本門課將以建立數學建模與問題導向的教學方式進行。

briefs.name: 科學計算
briefs.tags: finite difference method, Poisson equation, heat equation, wave equation, ordinary differential equations, Discrete Fourier analysis
briefs.desc: We will introduce basic numerical methods for fundamental Partial Differential Equations, such as the Poisson equation, heat equation and the wave equation with application to some advanced topics such as the transport-diffusion equation and reaction-diffusion systems. We will also introduce the idea of sampling and discrete Fourier analysis with applications to Partial Differential Equations.

briefs.name: JAX數值計算
briefs.tags: JAX, High-Performance Computing, Automatic Differentiation, Numerical Algorithms, Machine Learning
briefs.desc: This course provides a deep dive into JAX—a cutting-edge, high-performance numerical computing library in Python. We will cover JAX's core concepts, including its functional approach, just-in-time (JIT) compilation, and automatic differentiation, and explore its potential for implementing scalable algorithms for large-scale data, in fields such as probabilistic/scientific ML and AI. This course emphasizes practical application for advanced computation.

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文研究
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 紐結理論
briefs.tags: knots, knot group and invariants, other topics
briefs.desc: The course starts with traditional topics such as knot groups, classical knot invariants and polynomials, relation to number theory and, if time permits, their appearance in fluid dynamics. The remainder of the course is devoted to knowledge developed and became dominant in knot theory and beyond since 1980, for example, the Jones polynomial, von Neumann algebras, Chern-Simons gauge theory, Reshetikhin-Turaev-Witten invariants, representations of Hecke algebras, Yang-Baxter equation, the volume conjecture, and Khovanov homology. The exact topics to be covered will depend on the students registered in the course.

briefs.name: 幾何分析導論
briefs.tags: Green's function, spectrum theory, Riemannian manfiolds
briefs.desc: 課程說明(Course Description)： 帶領學生研讀幾何分析的重要問題與其應用。 訓練學生思維能力.

briefs.name: 辛幾何導論
briefs.tags: symplectic form, Lie group action, Hamiltonian action, moment maps
briefs.desc: This is an introductory course on symplectic geometry. The material that will be covered in this course includes (but is not restricted to) the following: Symplectic vector spaces, isotropy, coisotropy, Lagrangian, symplectic manifolds, Hamiltonian action, moment maps, Poisson structure, symplectic reduction.

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文研究
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 學術演講
briefs.tags: 學術演講（academic lecture）
briefs.desc: We will invite experts in mathematics and related industries that apply mathematical concepts to share their expertise and experience through academic lectures. Detailed schedules and related information will be announced on the department website.

briefs.name: 算子論二
briefs.tags: Hilbert spaces, Banach spaces, bounded operators, selfadjoint operators, spectral theorem of bounded and unbounded operators
briefs.desc: This is a continuation od "Operator theory one ". . We willwill concentrate on the spectral theorem on selfadjoint bounded and unbounded operators. Lots of examples will be discused to present the applications to differential equations, harmonic analysis, complex function theory and mathematical physics.

briefs.name: 論文
briefs.tags: 論文
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 行銷管理
briefs.tags: 行銷管理；市場；消費者；品牌；行銷組合
briefs.desc: This course focuses on the application of marketing concepts and theories to high technology-based and traditional products/services.

briefs.name: AI領導力與企業轉型策略
briefs.nameEn: AI Leadership and Organizational Transformation Strategies
briefs.tags: 領導力, 組織轉型, 價值創新, 人工智慧, 生成式人工智慧, 企業AI戰略, AI風險與治理框架 Leadership, organizational transformation, value innovation, artificial intelligence, generative AI, enterprise AI strategy, AI risks and governance
briefs.desc: 在 AI 技術快速重塑產業結構與商業模式的環境下，企業領導者不僅需要理解 AI 的技術可能性，更需具備將 AI 轉化為組織 能力與競爭優勢的策略視野。本課程從 AI 觀念、技術邏輯、組織導入路徑、跨部門人機協作、工作流程自動化與治理政策等 層面，協助學生形成「能帶領組織採用 AI 的新領導力架構」。 本課程講師，除清華大學史欽泰榮譽講座教授及中華民國企業經理協進會羅達賢理事長及工研院余孝先AI策略長三位指導教授 外，也邀請數位發展部侯怡秀次長、台灣人工智慧學校蔡明順校務長等具有實務經驗之專家參與授課。

briefs.name: 商務溝通
briefs.tags: 商務溝通,Business Communications
briefs.desc: This course will cover the theory of communication and its applications in the business environment. The process, channels and key success factors of effective business communication will be discussed in detail. Sources of miscommunication will also be discussed. Examples will be used to illustrate different communication situations such as public speech, presentation, sales call and negotiation. The students will be asked to do role playing in various business communication situations.

briefs.name: 企業個案分析
briefs.tags: Case Analysis, Digital Transformation, Disruptive Innovation, Blue Ocean, Service Innovation 個案分析，數位轉型，破壞式創新，藍海策略，服務創新
briefs.desc: 本課程為 MBA 學生在課程學習二年以來，整體能力的展現。藉由哈佛個案討論的教學方式，讓學生能在課堂中活用以前學 過的理論與概念，並在每一次的個案討論中，在教師的帶領下，熟悉策略運用、科技衝擊、與組織協同合作等議題，以期 能訓練學生對管理理論的嫻熟度。 課程進行將分為二個階段，第一個階段以哈佛商學院為主所出版的個案為討論內容，學生將在課堂上針對教師的帶領與提 問，在班級互動的學習型態下理解各種假想情境，並練習在有限的資訊提供下做出決策。第二個階段則以訓練學生能製作 並報告一個與各自的企業相關的個案為主。學生將被分組並共同確立各自熟悉並有管理意涵的主題，並以哈佛個案的方 式，完成一篇個案，並在課堂上與同學討論。

briefs.name: 科技與社會
briefs.tags: 科技, Science & Technology, 社會, Society, AI, Artificial Intelligence, 人工生殖, Assisted Reproductive Technology, 社會學想像, Sociological Imagination
briefs.desc: 「科技與社會」(Science, Technology & Society, 簡稱STS)是一個包羅萬象的學門，主要在研究科技與社會之間的關係。本 課程將聚焦目前影響人類社會最重要的兩個科技：AI、生殖科技，前者主要影響人類的認知及行為，後者則是影響人類身體以及對 待生命的態度。本課程希望能夠提供一個環境，讓學員發揮社會學的想像力，考察科技在社會中所扮演的角色。每週的教材，都是 針對科技對台灣新世代與未來社會發展所面臨的挑戰，期待學員可以從人文與社會科學的角度，進行深度的討論。

briefs.name: 研究方法
briefs.teacher: 洪世章,余士迪,歐怡君,錢克瑄,王貞雅,邱議德
briefs.tags: 詳情請參閱課程大綱PDF
briefs.desc: 本課程旨在協助在職 MBA 學生掌握進行管理研究與實務問題分析所需的基礎方法與思維。課程內容涵蓋研究設計、資料蒐集、 質性與量化分析、文獻回顧撰寫、問題意識形成、個案研究方法，以及如何將研究方法應用於企業實務與專題報告。透過案例討 論、實作練習與分組作業，學生將學習如何從職場情境中提出可研究的問題、選擇合適的方法、進行資料分析，並以清晰且具說 服力的方式呈現洞見。本課程特別強調「能用、能學、能寫」，協助學生同時提升學術邏輯、專業表達與決策分析能力，為完成 專題研究或高階管理決策奠定扎實基礎。

briefs.name: 行知南向
briefs.tags: 觀光醫療, medical tourism, 泰國醫療系統, medical system in Thailand, 泰國觀光業 tourism in Thailand, 新創加速器, startup accelerator
briefs.desc: 為響應政府「新南向策推動計畫」，深耕台灣與國家之間的經貿合作、人才交 為響應政府「新南向策推動計畫」，深耕台灣 與 國 家之間的經貿合作、人才交 流、資源共享與區域鏈結等四大面向，秉持「長期深耕多元開展雙互惠」的核心理念，與東南亞 等國 家創造互利共贏的新合作模式建立「經濟同體意識」，從「降低成本轉向商機共創。課程主要針對目前在南國家的經濟及 技術 識」，從「降低成本轉向商機共創。課程主要針對目前在南國家的經濟及技術 識」，從「降低成本轉向商機共創。課程主 要 針對 目前在南國家的經濟及技術 方面崛起快速的市場來進行了解，希望透過實地訪問、學術交流與企業參南向國家不同的 政治、 濟境 文化與管理實務，作為學生企業新布局參考以達到跨國企業管理的知行合一。

briefs.name: 財務管理
briefs.tags: 公司理財、財務管理、財報分析、公司價值、公司治理
briefs.desc: 本課程目的在於培養財務分析的能力與技巧，並進而做投資與融資之決策。課程內容首重於： (1)財務報表分析 (2)公司價值及資本預算 (3)風險及報酬分析 (4)資本結構及股利政策 (5)其他相關議題：合併與收購；融資策略

briefs.name: 經濟學
briefs.tags: 需求與供給Demand and Supply，彈性Elasticity，市場結構
briefs.desc: 本課程之主旨在介紹經濟學家如何運用經濟學之分析工具來瞭解各種經濟現象。課程內容分為兩大部分，第一部分為個體經濟 學，主在探討個人在各種組織與市場結構之選擇行為，並解釋分析經由人們各式各樣的選擇行為所形成的各種社會現象。課程內 容包括: 經濟學的核心問題、基本概念與經濟模型、市場如何運作、家戶 選擇行為之探討、廠商選擇行為與市場結構等。第二 部分為總體經濟學，主要內容研究的是個別國家或經濟體，甚至全球的經濟現象。此部分課程從介紹總體經 濟基本觀念開始， 解釋景氣波動，進而探討總體經濟政策。目標是讓學生不僅瞭解經濟學家如何研究總體經濟現象，並有助於對國家以及世界經濟 的理解。, Market Structures，外部性, Externalities，國內生產總值Gross Domestic Product (GDP)，失業與通膨Unemployment and Inflation，財政政策Fiscal Policy，貨幣政策Monetary Policy

briefs.name: 服務科學
briefs.tags: 服務主導邏輯, 服務系統, 價值共創, 服務設計, 城鄉創生, Service-Dominant Logic, service system, value co-creation, service design, urban-rural revitalization
briefs.desc: 眾所週知，世界已經邁向了服務經濟的時代。「服務」存在人類社會遠在所謂的「服務業」的產業 分類。但究竟「服務」是什麼？而當IBM於2004年倡導所謂的「服務科學」，或者後來加上工程與 管理，統稱「服務科學工程與管理」(Service Science, Management, and Engineering, SSME)。近年來，在原有的SSME外加上Design，成為現在一般談及服務科學時，以SSMED來描述 它。究竟其內涵與實質內容為何？究竟服務科學的範圍與議題為何？服務科學與現有的學術與實務 領域有何關聯？如何將服務科學的理論應用於實務上？實務上的議題與需求如何來成為服務科學的 研究內容與貢獻？本課程的課程內容規劃即在滿足大家對服務科學的好奇心。同時也希望學生能勇 敢地探索此一新的領域，成為服務科學發展學術與實務社群的生力軍。 本課程的目標簡述如下： 1. 學生能完整定義服務科學的內涵與範疇。 2. 學生能應用服務體驗設計，進行服務設計。 3. 學生能分析與規劃服務價值網絡以提供服務價值。 4. 學生能針對不同的產業提出創新的服務模式。 5. 學生能指出重要的服務科學相關的重要議題，進行研究。 本課程的內容與教學具有以下的特色： 1. 理論與實務並重； 2. 講授與個案教學

briefs.name: 古代經典選文雙向討論
briefs.nameEn: Interactive Discussion on Selected Classical Chinese Texts
briefs.tags: 華語文;文言文;文化引導;文言詞組;文言語法;中國文化
briefs.desc: 本課程為華語文學程本國生與國際生共同必修課。開課目的是讓不同文化背景的學生從多元視角理解古代經典，掌握文言文之 基本詞組、句式，並透過階段性的主題探索古代中國文化，使雙方在跨文化的對話交流中擴充知識內涵、增進論述深度。

briefs.name: 華語文海外研修
briefs.tags: 華語文海外研修,華語文教學,教學實習
briefs.desc: 本學程高階華語文教學組的同學得修習本課程，申請赴國外大學、海外僑校等相關的華語教學和實習機構，進行華語文海外研 修。透過跨國合作及學術交流的機會，讓同學能更深入地瞭解海外華語文教學的方法與技巧，同時取得該領域的實務經驗，以 進一步強化個人未來職業發展。

briefs.name: 口語練習二
briefs.tags: 經驗描述、影片描述、圖片描述、陳述意見、角色扮演、觀點回應、文章摘要、觀點論
briefs.desc: 本課程旨在針對中高級華語學習者的口語表達進行系統化訓練，涵蓋經驗描述、影片及圖片描述、意見陳述、角色扮演等多種 情境，幫助學習者提升口語表達的內容組織、表達能力及語言運用水平。課程結合實際應用場景，逐步引導學生掌握從簡單敘 述到觀點論述的技能。

briefs.name: 高階閱讀寫作
briefs.tags: 文篇分析、精讀文本、進階寫作、風格分析、構式語法
briefs.desc: 本課程為華語文碩士學位學程本國生與國際生的共同必修課。開課目的是讓學生逐步從文法角度了解寫作文句、段落，乃至於 完成篇章的概念與方法，並在課堂實踐中訓練寫作與分析、評價他人作品的能力。

briefs.name: 古代經典選文閱讀
briefs.nameEn: Close Reading of Selected Classical Chinese Texts
briefs.tags: 華語文;文言文;文化引導;文言詞組;文言語法;中國文化
briefs.desc: 本課程為華語文學程國際漢學組必修課。開課目的是先協助國際學生增進對雙向討論課程選文的基礎認識，以利提高後續討論 的參與度和成果。本課程每週進度與「古代經典選文雙向討論」相同，但更側重培養學生對文字的閱讀與理解能力，因此，第 一至八週將分配閱讀作業，再於隔週課堂逐一討論；第九至十五週則改採課堂測驗，並於測驗後討論的形式。

briefs.name: 口語練習四
briefs.tags: 口語表達,論述方法,說服技巧,故事敘事,修辭運用,溝通策略
briefs.desc: 本課程旨在培養中高級華語學習者在各類溝通情境中，運用多元說話架構，以提升口語表達的條理性與說服力。課程以實際表 達任務為主軸，結合理論與實作，從觀點生成、論述組織、說服技巧、故事敘事到修辭運用，循序引導學生建立高階口語表達 力。 學生將學習如何在正式與非正式場合中，清楚闡述觀點、邏輯說服他人、運用故事建立共鳴，並以得體的修辭維持良好人際互 動。課程最後以「成果發表」形式，展現學生整合性口語表達成果。

briefs.name: 獨立研究
briefs.tags: 獨立研究,研究計畫,專案問題,專案計畫,研究方法
briefs.desc: 本課程鼓勵學生培養獨立研究與學術寫作能力，學生依自身研究興趣，在授課老師指導下擬定並執行研究計畫，將所學理論與 方法應用於人文社會或華語文相關議題之探討。

briefs.name: 華語文教學實務
briefs.nameEn: Teaching Practice for Chinese as a Second Language
briefs.tags: 華語文教學, Teaching Practice, Teaching Chinese as a Second Language
briefs.desc: 本課程旨在針對成人華語教學，使其能夠熟悉和運用華語文教學相關課程中的理論，培養學生在真實情境中運用教學法的能 力。課程內容從課程規劃、教學設計和評量方法、教學技巧的提升、學習資源的運用，以及課堂管理等。學生將有機會實際規 劃和實施華語課程，透過系統性的教學實務培養，包括生詞、語法、課文、鞏固學習內容、延伸應用活動等教學環節，並接觸 多元文化的教學環境。同時，本課程強調反思和對教學實踐的不斷改進，引導學生善用華語教材、培養學生成為具有創意、靈 活和反思能力的華語文教育者。

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: Thesis
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 財經個案研討
briefs.nameEn: Case Studies in Business and Finance
briefs.tags: 市場假說,事件研究法,分析師報告, 淨現值法, 行為財務,計量在財務上的應用
briefs.desc: 針對企業個案進行分析討論，協助同學了解企業個案分析之方法。 學生有機會深入研究實際企業個案，應用經濟學工具進行深 度分析，了解商業決策的複雜性。 透過對實例的討論，學生將學會如何從經濟學角度全面評估企業策略。 這門課程旨在培養 學生在實際商業環境中運用經濟學原理進行深度分析的能力，使他們能夠更全面、更深入地理解並應對現代企業面臨的各種挑 戰。

briefs.name: 投資組合管理
briefs.tags: Portfolio Management, Investments, Risk managements
briefs.desc: 本課程介紹現代投資組合管理的核心理論與實務，包括風險與報酬分析、均值變異數模型、資本資產定價模型、多因子模型等資 產定價理論。內容涵蓋股票、債券、衍生性商品與國際資產配置，並探討市場效率與行為金融。學生將學習投資組合建構、資產 配置策略、風險管理方法，如VaR，以及績效衡量與歸因分析。課程結合理論講授、案例研究與實作工具，使學生具備設計、管理 與評估投資組合的能力。

briefs.name: 財金法律個案
briefs.nameEn: Case Studies: A Law and Finance Perspective
briefs.tags: 實戰模擬,企業倫理,永續,哈佛三環圖,決策
briefs.desc: 透過本課程，學生將挑戰透過財務（經濟）以及法律（企業倫理）的觀點，分析企業的決策問題；並了解到商業決策唯有平衡這 些觀點，企業的經營始能永續。

briefs.name: 公司財務策略與公司治理
briefs.nameEn: Corporate financial strategy and corporate governance
briefs.tags: 公司財務決策,Financial strategy, 公司治理,Corporate governance, 資本結構, Capital structure, 資本預算, capital budgeting, 股利政策, dividend policy
briefs.desc: This course is different from the financial management or corporate finance course. We will go through the topics of standard financial theory, corporate sustainability and externality. These are hot issues in modern corporate finance. The material is consolidated from the related book or paper. I will provide the course lectures for you. So, no need to warry the wide range. In this course, we also link corporate and financial strategies and practice the corporate valuation. Through the semester, students would finish a precise and comprehensive valuation assignment.

briefs.name: 研究方法與學術倫理
briefs.nameEn: Introduction to Research Methods and Academic Ethics
briefs.tags: 論文, thesis, 研究方法, research method, 財務分析, financial analysis.
briefs.desc: 提供論文相關之研究方法 (以量化以及財務分析為主) 以及撰寫案例，幫助學員順利完成論文之撰寫。 透過案例說明，讓學員了解不同的研究方法，並透過校外人士的演講，啟發其研究興趣。

briefs.name: 論文
briefs.tags: 論文
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 全民國防教育軍事訓練--國防政策
briefs.nameEn: All-out Defense Education Military Training-National Defense Policies
briefs.tags: 1.國家發展與國防政策2.國防政策對國家發展的影響(以歷史案例說明)3.國防政策制定的考量因素4.部戰爭、全面戰爭的戰略思維5.世界主要國家國防政策之比較6.國防報告書的意義與目的7.國防政策與建軍發展8.軍事戰略與國防政策9.制空、制海、反登陸何者優先10.有生戰力、全軍破敵的戰略思維11.國防政策對兵役政策的影響12.軍事互信機制的探討
briefs.desc: 使學生瞭解國家發展(政治、經濟、心理)與國防政策關係，藉世界主要國家國防政策之比較，分析國防政策制定的考量因素， 培 養學生對國防政策制定的合理思維，輔以問題討論強化學生邏輯思考能力。 針對我國現行國防政策，認識建軍發展方向，說明軍事戰略與軍事相關基礎知能，了解國防政策如何落實於建軍備戰知相關措 施，進而使學生明白國防政策對兵役政策的影響，支持國家安全防護能力。 淺談未來軍事互信機制的可能性，相應國防政策之發展，強化學生對國防政策認知與實現個人為國保民的責任。

briefs.tags: 全民國防教育、國際情勢、區域安全、兩岸情勢、武裝衝突法
briefs.desc: 藉由全民國防教育軍事訓練之教學傳授國際情勢、國防政策、全民國防、防衛動員及國防科技等五大課程，加強青年學生對國防與軍事 之認識，增進全民國防教育知能，期能建立「責任一體，安危與共，禍福相依」之國家安全共識，並培育術德兼備，文武合一的現代青 年。

briefs.name: 全民國防教育軍事訓練--全民國防
briefs.nameEn: National Defense Education Military Training- Civil Defense
briefs.tags: 全民國防教育、國際情勢、區域安全、兩岸情勢、武裝衝突法
briefs.desc: 簡述國家意識使同學瞭解國家概念，再以全民國防的意義與源起、我國實施全民國防體系架構與理論基礎、概況與願景，探討全民國防 的重要性。先就世界各國全民國防對我國全民國防之啟示及我國實施全民國防的概況與願景，透過分組討論讓同學提出全民國防教育對 個人家庭社會的影響回饋學習成果。再以新安全觀下兩岸全民國防教育的比較及具體作法及活動理解兩岸現況。另就媒體識讀與全民國 防、全民心防維護與途徑及強韌國防-務實推動國防事務重要議題讓同學如何共同成為全民國防教育的實踐者!

briefs.name: 實證研究方法
briefs.tags: Statistics, econometrics, policy evaluation 統計、計量、政策評估
briefs.desc: 本課程為「國立清華大學科技管理學院公共政策與管理碩士在職專班」及「健康政策與經營管 理碩士在職專班」之研究方法必修課程,旨在培養專班學員對公共政策與健康政策研究方法的基本 理解,並學習如何應用統計與計量分析工具,從事公共政策與健康政策相關之實證分析與決策評估。 課程內容涵蓋基本機率概念、敘述統計、統計推論,以及基礎經濟計量方法,並結合公共政策與健 康政策、醫療制度、健康照護管理等實務案例,協助學員理解研究方法在實際政策分析與經營管理決 策中的應用。 除理論與方法之講授外,本課程亦將輔以電腦程式操作與資料分析實作,增進學員對統計與計量 概念的直觀理解,並培養學員蒐集、整理與分析實際政策及健康相關資料的能力,為未來進行公共政 策評估、健康政策分析與實證研究奠定良好基礎。

briefs.name: 國際政治經濟學
briefs.tags: 國際金融秩序,中國政經發展,貨幣政治經濟學,全球化,金融危機
briefs.desc: 本課程講授國際政治經濟學的相關主題，目的在於培養學生對於國際政治與經濟議題的了解與整合，並且應用理論與分析工具對 於當代國際所面臨的政經問題進行有意義的剖析。

briefs.name: 政府與企業
briefs.tags: 政府、企業、全球化、利害關係人、民粹主義、government、business、globalizaation、stakeholder、populism
briefs.desc: 這門課探討政府與企業間的關係。政府一方面透過管制與法律架構規範企業的活動；另一方面，企業則透過過各種管道，試圖影響 政策的制訂。全球化提升企業的跨國影響力，但金融海嘯以及層出不窮的企業醜聞，也導致社會普遍不信任企業；另外，2020開始 的新冠疫情也重新改變了全球經濟的走向；同時，2025美國總統川普重新執政後，對各國普遍課徵的對等關稅，導致全球化的趨勢 受到挑戰。面對此一趨勢，企業相關的法規制訂，勢必變得更具挑戰性。本課程嘗試從不同角度探討政府與企業的關係，包括政府 管制對企業活動的影響，企業對政府的遊說，社會對企業的不信任，以及兼顧社會大眾與企業利益的政府政策等。

briefs.name: 循證政策個案分析
briefs.tags: evidence-based policy
briefs.desc: 本課程講授循證公共政策的相關主題，目的在於培養學生理解循證據的公共政策的內涵與應用。

briefs.name: 境外學習：公共治理與發展
briefs.nameEn: Overseas Study Program : Public Governance and Development
briefs.tags: 境外學習 公共政策 政策管理 國際政策 地緣政治
briefs.desc: 現今國內、外經濟社會變遷迅速，透過此次境外教學，將學習新的理論知識，並以經濟學思考模式來培養敏銳的觀察力，培養 國際觀，讓學生增進思考力及對公共政策有更深刻的見解。

briefs.name: 賽局策略與產業政策分析
briefs.nameEn: Game Strategies, Industrial Organization, and Policy Analysis
briefs.tags: 賽局理論，產業組織，拍賣，配對，信息不對稱，產業政策；Game Theory, Industrial Organization, Auction, Matching, Asymmetric Information, Industrial Policy
briefs.desc: 本課程分為以下兩個部分： 賽局理論與策略： 賽局理論著重多個決策者之間在特定遊戲規則之下的決策連動。上有政策，下有對策。遊戲規則制定者需要了解規則對每一個決策者的誘因 的影響，才不會得到意外的結果。多個遊戲制定者之間，也有可能是另一層的賽局。 產業政策： 進入快速變遷的21世紀，傳統的產業政策工具受到限縮，然近來歐盟為復興產業政策提供新動力，開始重新檢視產業政策。台灣從一個世界 地理上的邊緣國家轉變為重要的電子與資訊科技產品輸出者，在世界經濟發展過程中，台灣的產業發展經驗不容忽視。台灣產業政策扮演的 角色是一個值得探究的課題。本課程講授的主題包含：產業政策基本原理、台灣早期的產業政策(九十年代以前)、台灣近期的產業政策(九 十年代以後) 、以及產業政策復興下各國近期的產業政策等。

briefs.name: 論文
briefs.tags: 論文
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 智慧醫療概論
briefs.tags: 人工智慧(artificial intelligence)，機器學習(machine learning)，智慧醫療(smart healthcare)，醫學資訊(medical informatics)，臨床應用(clinical applications)
briefs.desc: "智慧醫療概論"課程旨在探索人工智慧技術在醫療領域中的應用與創新。在此課程中，學生將深入了解醫療人工智慧的基本概念 及其在不同醫療領域中的實際應用。課程內容涵蓋各種學習演算法，包括監督式、自監督式及深度學習，並討論這些技術如何處 理和分析醫學結構化數據、影像、自然語言和生理訊號。此外，課程將探討生成式人工智慧在健康中的應用，並引導學生反思智 慧醫療的社會、倫理及技術挑戰。透過案例報告與實例分析，學生將獲得實踐經驗，提升其在智慧醫療領域的洞察力與應用能 力。

briefs.name: 機器學習與大數據分析
briefs.nameEn: Machine Learning and Big Data Analysis
briefs.tags: 決策樹 (Decision trees) ,分類規則 (Classification rules, 循例學習 (Instance-based learning) ,叢集 (Clustering) ,健保資料庫 (Nation Health Insurance database)
briefs.desc: 讓學生瞭解各種資料探勘技術，包括決策樹、分類及叢集等。同時也讓學生瞭解台灣健康保險資料庫的結構 ，讓學生套用 WEKA 工具組進行資料探勘。

briefs.name: 統合分析與證據整合：原理與應用
briefs.nameEn: Meta-Analysis and Evidence Synthesis: Theoretical Foundation and Applications
briefs.tags: 統合分析, 實證醫學, 系統性回顧, 網絡統合分析, 證據整合, meta-analysis, Evidence-based medicine, Systematic review, Network meta-analysis, Evidence synthesis
briefs.desc: With rapid growth of literature in clinical or basic science research, it is common that multiple studies provide evidence to the same topic of interest. A coherent conclusion from the evidence is thus needed to guide clinical decisions and future research directions. Therefore, a principled method to search, scrutinize and synthesize current available evidence is crucial. In this course, we will first go through the basic framework of evidence synthesis and the statistical foundation for meta-analysis, which is the most important quantitative tool in evidence synthesis. We will then introduce the critical elements in conventional (pairwise) meta-analyses and their interpretation, before delving into a spectrum of meta-analytic methodologies that cater to alternative data structures that require meta-analysis. This course will also include practical sessions to carry out these methods with statistical packages in R.

briefs.name: 健康互聯網理論與實務
briefs.nameEn: Theory and practice of Internet of Thing in Healthcare
briefs.tags: 樹梅派 (Raspberry) ,網路與互聯網 (Network and IoT) ,無線射頻辨識系統 (Radio Frequency Identification (RFID)), 訊息佇列遙測傳輸 (Message Queuing Telemetry Transport (MQTT)) ,通用非同步收發傳輸器 (Universal Asynchronous Receiver/Transmitter)(UART)
briefs.desc: 健康照護環境中，有相當多的感測設備，因此，健康互聯網日趨重要。本課程主要是針對跨領域的學生開設，從電腦結構及電腦 網路介紹開始，使用單晶片 Arduino 讓學生了解簡單的硬體運作，學生用電路板、電阻、感應器及軟體，完成各式專案，同時 也使用樹梅派讓學生了解系統的運作。

briefs.name: 醫學資訊專題討論
briefs.tags: 醫學資訊學 (Medical Informatics), 醫學資訊擷取 (Medical Information retrieval), 醫學資訊標準 (Standards in Medical Informatics, 醫學影像處理 (Medical Imaging Processing), 自然語言處理 (Natural Language Processing),
briefs.desc: 本課程包括兩部份，前半段將邀請醫學資訊學界和業界，有豐富經驗的講師跟學生介紹醫學資訊領域的研究範圍及實際的應用。 後半段將讓學生研讀醫學資訊領域三年內的期刊，並在課堂上報告，訓練學生如何閱讀、整理論文及報告。

briefs.name: 材料科學與工程二
briefs.tags: 合金；高分子；陶瓷；複合材料；物理性質；Alloys; Polymers; Ceramics; Composites; Physical properties
briefs.desc: The purpose of this course is to provide first-year engineering students fundamental knowledge of materials science and engineering.

briefs.name: 材料科學與工程二
briefs.tags: 材料科學，材料工程，材料製程，材料設計，材料選用，Materials Science，Materials Engineering，Materials Process，Materials Design，Materials Selection
briefs.desc: 延續上學期材料科學與工程之基礎，下學期則為各種材料與性質介紹(英語授課)，先介紹金屬、塑膠、陶瓷、複材四種材 料，再介紹腐蝕性質，以及電、光、磁性質與相關材料，最後介紹生物材料與生醫材料。目標為期望學生能對各種材料特性 及其發展有所認識。 Materials Science and Engineering II” is every week at W3W4F3F4 sessions. The course content consists of introductions of materials according to (1) fundamental classifications (engineering alloys/polymers/ceramics/composites) and (2) functional properties (corrosion/electrical/optical/magnetic/biocompatibility). The aim is to allow students to have the basic understanding of various types of materials and their functions.

briefs.name: 材料科學與工程二
briefs.tags: materials, functionalities, fundamentals, physical properties
briefs.desc: This course aims to provide the students fundamental knowledge of materials science and engineering. The contents covers different types of materials (alloys, polymers, ceramics, and composites) and the functionalities of materials (corrosion, electrical, optical, magnetic, and biocompatibility).

briefs.name: 普通化學二
briefs.tags: Thermodynamics, kinetics, quantum mechanics, periodic trends, chemical equilibrium, solutions
briefs.desc: General Chemistry II is a continuation of your journey into the study of matter, energy, and the fundamental laws that govern the physical world. In this course, we build upon the atomic and molecular foundations established in General Chemistry I and move toward a deeper understanding of energy transformations, molecular behavior, chemical reactivity, and equilibrium systems that shape both natural and engineered processes. This semester, our focus will shift from describing what happens in chemical systems to exploring why and how those changes occur. You will develop a more comprehensive picture of the microscopic and macroscopic principles that drive chemical reactions, from the flow of heat and energy to the structure of atoms and the dynamics of chemical change. We will revisit the atom itself in Chapters 8 and 9. The quantum mechanical model (Chapter 8) introduces the wave–particle nature of electrons and the probabilistic framework that governs at

briefs.name: 工程數學二
briefs.tags: Multi-variable Calculus (多變數微積分), Vector Field Theory (向量場理論), Fourier Analysis (傅立葉分析), Partial Differential Equation (偏微分方程式), Complex Function Theory (複變函數理論)
briefs.desc: Engineering mathematics is the foundation of all engineering disciplines. This course introduces the basic concepts and skills of multi-variable calculus, vector field theory, Fourier analysis, partial differential equations, and complex function theory. By developing these essential mathematical competencies, students will gain a deeper understanding of the theoretical frameworks and scientific principles that support modern engineering.

briefs.name: 材料熱力學二
briefs.tags: 熱力學, 焓, 自由能, 熵, 相圖, Thermodynamics, Enthalpy, Gibbs free energy, Entropy, Phase diagram
briefs.desc: 本課程承接上學期的熱力學三大定律及各種熱力學函數,以及單相氣體的熱力學性質。 以複習古典熱力學為開端，接下來將著重於統計熱力學， 最後再實際比較利用古典與統計熱力學處理固態材料的結果。

briefs.name: 晶體缺陷
briefs.tags: 結構 Structure, 缺陷 Defects, 差排 Dislocation, 晶界 Grain Boundary, 空孔 Vacancy, 固溶體 Solid Solution, 退火 Annealing
briefs.desc: 本課程講述材料結構與缺陷相關知識，涵蓋材料結構 (晶體結構、晶體鍵結與分析方法)、材料缺陷 (空孔、固溶體、差排、 晶 界與塑性變形) 以及缺陷消除 (退火) 等內容。課程目標在建立材料結構與缺陷相關知識，分析並解決材料結構與缺陷相 關問 題，建立材料科學重要基礎知識。

briefs.name: 電子學
briefs.tags: Logic circuits; Diode; Transistor; Amplifier; 邏輯電路; 二極體; 電晶體; 放大器
briefs.desc: 本課程將介紹電子學的基本原理及及其在工業界之應用實例,對未來先進 半導體及光電之元件及製程課程之進一步鑽研及研究, 將非常實用且在基 礎之建立有極大之助益. This course will introduce the basics and applications of electronics. This will help on the research and further study on semiconductor and optoelectronics devices and processing. It will strengthen fundamentals for future versatile applications.

briefs.name: 材料實驗一
briefs.tags: 微結構, 機械性質; Microstructure, mechanical property
briefs.desc: 材料實驗一是在驗證課堂所學的材料科學知識，選擇一些基本單元實際操作，主要有金相製作與觀察、機械性質試驗、、 鋼鐵熱處理、黃銅冷加工及退火材料鑑定。實際操作驗證製程、微結構、性質的關聯。 Laboratories of Materials I is to verify the knowledge of Material Science learned in relevant courses and find out the relationships between the processes, properties, and microstructure of materials through practices. The experiments contain instrument practices of analysis and identification of materials, sample preparation and observation of microstructures, tests on mechanical properties, cold working and annealing of brass, and heat treatment of steel.

briefs.name: 材料實驗一
briefs.tags: 微結構, 機械性質; Microstructure, mechanical property
briefs.desc: 材料實驗一是在驗證課堂所學的材料科學知識，選擇一些基本單元實際操作，主要有金相製作與觀察、機械性質試驗、、 鋼鐵熱處理、黃銅冷加工及退火材料鑑定。實際操作驗證製程、微結構、性質的關聯。 Laboratories of Materials I is to verify the knowledge of Material Science learned in relevant courses and find out the relationships between the processes, properties, and microstructure of materials through practices. The experiments contain instrument practices of analysis and identification of materials, sample preparation and observation of microstructures, tests on mechanical properties, cold working and annealing of brass, and heat treatment of steel.

briefs.name: 材料科技論壇
briefs.nameEn: The Forum of Materials Science and Technology
briefs.tags: 科技新知，專題討論，職涯發展
briefs.desc: 課程將邀請各個領域的專家進行專題演講，希望透過專題演將讓同學了解科技發展與趨勢變化和實驗室安全外，也讓同學提早思 考未來 生涯規畫，認識各項研究主題

briefs.name: 擴散與相變化
briefs.tags: diffusion, phase transformation, Fick's first law, Fick's second law, uphill diffusion
briefs.desc: This course deals with diffusion and phase transformation in materials science. Subjects will be covered in the following. Diffusion includes Steady state, transient state, Fick's first and second laws, variable diffusivities, moving boundary, heterogeneous systems,atomic mechanism, Kirkendal effect and up-hill diffusion. Phase transformation includes nucleation, growth, and spinodal decomposition.

briefs.name: 材料之物理性質
briefs.tags: Energy Bands, Crystals, electrical properties, Optical Constants, Quantum Mechanical, Magnetic phenomena
briefs.desc: The understanding of the behavior of electrons in solids is one of the keys to understanding materials. The electron theory of solids is capable of explaining the optical, magnetic, thermal, as well as the electrical properties of materials. In other words, the electron theory provides important fundamentals for a technology which is often considered to be the basis for modern civilization. A few examples will illustrate this; optical properties of materials are utilized in lasers, optical communication, windows, lenses, optical coatings, solar collectors, and reflectors. Some materials are extremely good electrical conductors, such as silver and copper; others are good insulators, such as porcelain or quartz. Semiconductors are generally poor conductors at room temperature unless some dopants or impurity were doped into the materials. Thus, a considerable effort needs to be undertaken to comprehend its basic concepts.

briefs.name: 材料實驗二
briefs.tags: Surface Morphology; Optical Property; Electrical Property; Magnetic Property; Microscope
briefs.desc: 本課程探討並量測材料的基本物理性質,其中包括講解分析儀器相關原理以及 量測標準樣品並引導學生思考相關領域的議 題。

briefs.name: 材料實驗二
briefs.tags: 陶瓷, 乾壓成型, 注漿成型, 燒結, 實驗
briefs.desc: 本課程介紹一般陶瓷的原料特性、各種不同陶瓷成型法，以及後續陶瓷燒結等製程和原理，讓學生藉由實驗操作了解完整的陶 瓷製程步驟和相關基本知識。此外，結合各項重要物性的量測，讓學生了解各種陶瓷材料的特性與其應用領域。 本課程依據陶瓷物理特性及成型方法不同，規劃三項陶瓷實驗，分別如下： 1.陶瓷實驗一：乾壓成型-鈦酸鋇電容器製備及其介電常數量測 2.陶瓷實驗二：乾壓成型-鐵氧磁體電感製備及其磁導率量測 3.陶瓷實驗三：注漿成型-氧化鋁坩鍋製備

briefs.name: 陶瓷材料
briefs.tags: Ceramics, structures, sinterings, 陶瓷, 結構, 燒結
briefs.desc: 本課程主要介紹陶瓷材料之基本結構和特性，並介紹各種偏離理想構造之缺陷，包括各種離子點缺陷、電子缺陷、以及點 缺陷和晶界間的交互作用；缺陷對材料性質之影響，尤其是物質與電性傳遞性質。完成本課程後，學生應能夠認識陶瓷材 料領域、重要性質和應用，能夠判斷陶瓷的化學鍵結與物理化學性質之間的關聯性，使用化學方程式描述缺陷的反應，並 且了解陶瓷的燒結原理和緻密化機理。

briefs.name: 高分子材料
briefs.tags: 高分子, 材料, 性質, Polymer, Materials, Properties
briefs.desc: 本課程為高分子材料導論性課程，針對高分子材料基礎理論、材料性質與相關應用，做一介紹。 本課程適合對高分子材料有興趣或未來從事高分子材料研究或工作之同學修習。 This course will be based on Chinese.

briefs.name: 電子材料
briefs.tags: 電子元件，p-n二極體，金氧半場效應電晶體，光電元件、光伏元件。(electronic device, p-n diode, MOSFET, optoelectronic device, photovoltaics.)
briefs.desc: This course delves into the mainstream electronic components of the 20th and 21st centuries, emphasizing the physics and manufacturing technologies of semiconductor devices. Topics include semiconductor physics, p-n junctions, MOS capacitors, MOSFETs, optoelectronic and photovoltaic devices, and semiconductor processing techniques. The goal is to equip students with a comprehensive understanding of these electronic components' characteristics and manufacturing methods. Although the field of electronic materials encompasses metals, semiconductors, and ceramics, this semester will focus on semiconductor devices pertinent to electronic technologies. 本課程介紹20乃至21世紀人類文明之主流電子元件其半導體元件物理與製造技術，內容涵蓋p-n結、金 氧半電容、場效應電晶體、光電/光伏元件、以及半導體製程技術。目標為期望學生能對上述電子元件 之特性及製造技術有所認識。電子材料知識囊括金屬、半導體及陶瓷材料，但本學期之課程內容將會專 注於半導體元件，適用於電子科技領域。

briefs.name: 材料科學專題二
briefs.nameEn: Special Topics on Materials Science II
briefs.tags: 專題
briefs.desc: 由教授與學生擬定研究題目，以進行專題研究，培養學生解決問題的能力。

briefs.name: 製造工程學一
briefs.tags: Physical Properties of Materials, metal Alloys, metal-casting Processes, metal-Forming and Shaping Processes, Powder metal Processes and Equipment
briefs.desc: This course is taught in this semester, covering the principles of materials, casting, plastic processing, powder metallurgy, processing of glass, ceramic and plastics, rapid prototyping, cutting and grinding, non-traditional processing, semiconductor processing, joining, surface treatment. The teaching principles of this course are combined with principles and practices and put forward a holistic thinking instead of an introductory or trivial introduction. The knowledge of this course can be used as an important training course for the people in various manufacturing industries in the upstream middle, downstream.

briefs.name: 國防與材料科技
briefs.tags: 國防 National Defense, 材料科技 Materials Science and Technology, 金屬材料 metallic Materials, 陶瓷材料 Ceramic Materials, 高分子與複合材料 Polymer and Composite Materials, 電池與儲能材料 Materials for Batteries and Energy Storage Devices, 高性能材料 High Performance Materials
briefs.desc: 國防科技發展具有雙面意義，一方面以國防需求帶動相關領域的科技發展和技術提升，另一方面以科技能力和水準支援國防需 求；在此雙面向發展中，材料科技領具有舉足輕重的地位與關鍵性的角色。因此，本課程即在探討國防領域中的材料科技需求， 以及材料科技領域對國防科技發展的支援和貢獻，俾使學生領略此二面向的互通性，認識所學材料科技對於國防發展應用面和支 援效力的機會。

briefs.name: 固態物理導論
briefs.tags: 固態物理,電性,磁性,超導性,介電性, solid state physics, electrical properties, magnetism, superconductivity, dielectric properties
briefs.desc: 固態物理為理解材料物理特性的基礎學科，本課程會以材料系學生為主，進行課程的設計，希望能幫助材料系學生與工學院相關科 系學生， 可以跨過數學與物理的障礙，從而獲得固態物理的基礎概念，以銜接後面相關學科。

briefs.name: 材料設計與選擇
briefs.tags: Materials Data, Materials Selection, Materials Design, Aerospace Materials, Superalloys
briefs.desc: Lecture schedule: Monday M2M3M4 sessions; sessions are flexible for lectures and class exercises. The course consists of two parts, the first part is materials selection, and the second part is materials design. The Materials Selection part will introduce product design concept, the materials properties menu, the basics of materials selection, materials selection with multiple constraints and conflicting objectives, process selection, materials and environment. The Materials Design part will mainly focus on superalloys, introduce superalloys for jet engine applications, including blade alloys, disc alloys and coating technology. This course will emphasize on materials selection and design for various engineering applications, including aerospace sector. Core capability to be cultivated by this course, includes the ability to employ the knowledge of mathematics, and materials science & engineering.

briefs.name: 專家系統應用簡介
briefs.tags: 專家系統,AI,第二專長,產品開發,實作
briefs.desc: 專家系統，其主要的目的，乃在於建構一個擁有各自領域專家經驗知識的系統，它是各種人工智慧領域中最實用的一支。 透過對的老師，它變得「簡單」「易學」「好用」。 這一年度，我們將新增、展示幾個最夯的產品，包括： 健康減肥 恐怖情人評估 秒懂財報選股票 理財-購屋篇 專利變現 ……。 上個年度，共有15個系所、73人選修；這15個系所，分別是：中文系、外語系、音樂系、經濟系、醫科系、醫環系、生科 系、生醫院學士班、科管所、工科系、化工系、材料系 、動機系、物理系、理學院學士班。 另外，有社會人士 3人。 大家的成績分布如下： 100分：18人 99~90：27人 89~80分：14人 79~70分：12人 69~60分：2人

briefs.name: 有機化學
briefs.tags: Chemical bonding, molecular structure, acid-base, nucleophiles, electrophiles, reaction mechanisms, spectroscopy analysis
briefs.desc: This one-semester Organic Chemistry course provides a foundational understanding of the structure, reactivity, and transformation of carbon-based molecules, with emphasis on concepts relevant to material science. Students will explore the principles of bonding, molecular structure, acid–base behavior, and the fundamental patterns of nucleophilic and electrophilic interactions. Core reaction classes—including substitution, elimination, and key functional-group transformations—will be examined through the lens of mechanism and curved-arrow notation. The course integrates lectures with active learning, encouraging students to work through mechanisms, present solutions, and participate in guided discussions that strengthen conceptual reasoning. The final portion of the course introduces essential spectroscopic methods such as UV– Vis, FTIR, NMR, and mass spectrometry, equipping students with the tools needed to analyze and identify organic compound

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: 材料科學(materials science), 奈微米技術(micro- and nanotechnology), 生醫工程(biomedical engineering), 高科技產業(hi-tech industry), 社會責任(social responsibility), 職涯挑戰(professional career challenges)
briefs.desc: 課程簡述 (Brief course description) 本課程旨在介紹材料科學的最新發展現狀、材料科技在產業中的應用及其所面臨的挑戰，以及材料科學在提升人類文明未來 應 用中的前景。課程中將邀請材料科學和相關產業的學者專家進行演講，分享前瞻性的專業知識，介紹科技產業與社會的相關 性，進而啟發學生對未來科技探索的興趣，並培養他們面對生涯挑戰的能力。

briefs.name: 固態熱力學
briefs.tags: enthalpy, entropy, Helmholtz free energy, Gibbs free energy, heat capacity, solid solution, phase diagram, surface energy, nanomaterials
briefs.desc: This is an advanced course of thermodynamics for graduate students in the Department of Materials Science and Engineering. Students from other disciplines in science and engineering are also welcome to take. The course will start from review of the three laws of thermodynamics and then move to more insight of entropy and free energies. The calculation and application of Gibbs free energy in chemical reactions and alloy systems will be emphasized, which will then be correlated with the construction of phase diagrams. The thermodynamics involved in surface energy and nanomaterials will be elaborated. Students will be asked to participate in classroom discussion.

briefs.name: 電子顯微鏡學
briefs.tags: 電子顯微鏡學、顯微鏡解析度、電子散射機制，電子顯微鏡成像原理，描穿透式電子顯微鏡，能譜分析儀,structure and resolution, elastic scattering of electrons, diffraction, imaging in TEM, STEM and Spectroscopy
briefs.desc: 目的是讓學生了解電子顯微鏡學、顯微鏡解析度、電子散射機制，電子顯微鏡成像原理，描穿透式電子顯微鏡，能譜分析儀 等，使學生對電子顯微鏡學有基本的認識與了解。上下學期以英文授課。 The class provides the student basic knowledge on transmission electron microscopy including, structure and resolution, elastic scattering of electrons, diffraction, imaging in TEM, STEM and Spectroscopy.The main object of the class is to understand the basic concepts and language of transmission electron microscopy used in materials science engineering. Note that the class will be provided in English.

briefs.name: 材料動力學
briefs.tags: 擴散(diffusion）；化學反應(chemical reaction)；相變化(Phase transformation)；熱力學(theromdynamics)；晶體缺陷 (crystal defect)
briefs.desc: The purpose of this course is to provide students fundamental knowledge of essential kinetics of various material systems. The subjects covered 1) Diffusion; (2) Chemical reactions; (3) Phase transformations.

briefs.name: 自旋電子材料與元件
briefs.tags: 磁紀錄(magnetic recording),磁性感測器(magnetic sensors),磁性記憶體(MRAM),自旋電子學(Spintronics),磁性元件(magneitc devices)
briefs.desc: 介紹目前磁性記憶體MRAM,自旋電子元件(spintronics)與磁記錄的趨勢,與讀寫原理. 主要的內容涵蓋磁性原理，MRAM, spintronics, 磁碟記錄,磁性感測器的要求與運作原理.並針對目前磁性元件如何運 用於工業4.0與記憶體作探討

briefs.name: 電化學原理與應用
briefs.tags: 電化學，battery，energy storage，Materials，Characterization
briefs.desc: To understand the basic principle of Elecctrochemistry and its applications to issues related to materials science, especially in energy storage applications.

briefs.name: 電化學儲能材料
briefs.tags: energy storage, electrochemistry, batteries, supercapacitors
briefs.desc: The objectives of this course are to introduce materials for energy storage applications through supercapacitors and various batteries to students. This course will be helpful to students to understand the concepts of energy storage. The course would also teach students essential techniques and technology of batteries/supercapacitors materials. Learning Outcome: On completion of this course, the students will be able to: ● Understand the basic principles of electrochemical energy storage devices ● Understand the factors affecting electrochemical energy storage devices performance. ● Understand the principles, operation, and prospects of rechargeable battery technology.

briefs.name: 磁性薄膜：製程、分析與模擬

briefs.name: 二維量子材料之量測技術
briefs.tags: 2D Materials, quantum physics, superconductivity, device, measurement (二維材料、量子物理、超導、元件、量測技術)
briefs.desc: 二維材料為實現量子系統的關鍵材料，近年來成為國際高度關注的熱門領域，探索豐富且新穎物理特性、元件設計及創新應用， 需要從材料科學及基礎物理獲得相關知識，期望藉由開設這門針對二維材料的課程，讓學生了解量測技術及超導相關的物理特 性，課程內容會涵蓋基礎的材料科學、數學、物理、量測技術、元件製程及超導系統等，透過跨領域學科的整合，啟發同學對基 礎研究或關鍵技術的興趣及相關知識。 需具備基礎: 普通物理，材料科學導論，微積分

briefs.name: 量子材料導論
briefs.tags: Quantum materials, Superconductivity, Strongly correlated electron systems, Topological materials, Quantum phase transitions
briefs.desc: Quantum materials (QMat) represent a frontier in contemporary solid state research of both fundamental and technological importance. This course aims to bridge the gap between the knowledge acquired from the core curriculum of materials science/physics major in the undergraduate level and the knowledge required for executing cutting-edge quantum materials research in the postgraduate level. The discussion of course material will emphasize on experimental discoveries in major branches of the current QMat research landscape, including unconventional superconductivity, strange metals, spin liquids, topological materials, among others, complemented by the introduction of essential theoretical concepts for their understanding. The evaluation will be done through an oral presentation on a selected QMat research paper and a final report on a research project proposed by the student. After finishing the course, the students should be equipped with the essential kno

briefs.name: 高分子電子學
briefs.tags: 有機光電, 共軛高分子, 高分子, 發光高分子, 高分子太陽能電池, 高分子半導體, 高分子雷射,高分子微電子,導電高分子,軟性電子.
briefs.desc: 介紹高分子應用於新世代電子產品之材料知識基礎,以及在這方面接近state-of-the-art的高分子科學最新進展.課程內容 包括高分子之電子結構,共軛結構高分子,光電性質,電子傳導,聚合和分子設計,高分子物理,表面與介面,高分子電晶體,光電 元件.

briefs.name: 材料界面與生物反應
briefs.tags: Material–Biological Interface,Surface Properties & Characterization, Protein Adsorption,Immune Response & Biocompatibility, Regulation of Cell Behaviors
briefs.desc: This course introduces the cascade of biological responses triggered when materials come into contact with living systems. It examines how the surface physicochemical properties of materials influence protein adsorption, immune reactions, and cellular behaviors, including migration, proliferation, and differentiation—and ultimately how these interactions contribute to tissue repair and regeneration. 從最前端的蛋白質吸附開始，延伸到免疫反應、細胞貼附與遷移、增生、分化，最後連結到組織修復與再生。課程將特別聚焦在「材料表面特性（如化學 組成、粗糙度、親疏水性、電荷）如何主導這些生物反應」，讓同學能夠看懂並設計生醫材料相關研究。課程同時介紹常用的表面與界面分析工具（如椭 偏儀、AFM）以及基礎分子模擬概念，幫助同學理解文獻中的分析方法與數據意義。

briefs.name: 組織工程與再生醫學
briefs.tags: tissue engineering, regenerative medicine, nanomedicine, scaffold, stem cell
briefs.desc: This course provides an in-depth presentation and discussion of how engineering and biological approaches can be combined to enhance human health or to solve problems in human disease, emphasizing integration of biological technologies and methodologies with engineering analysis. Emphasis is placed on tissue engineering triad, including nanostructured biomaterial scaffold synthesis and property, stem cell behavior in tissue growth and organ development, and bioreactor design principles. The purpose of this study is to provide students with advanced scientific and engineering principles of tissue engineering approaches in the design of medical implants, artificial organs, and biomatrices for the field of regenerative medicine.

briefs.name: 3D IC 異質整合及先進封裝
briefs.nameEn: 3D IC Heterogenuous Integration and Advanced Packaging
briefs.tags: 3D IC, heterogenuous Integration, Advanced Packaging, TSV (Through Silicon Via), Thin wafer handling, Microbumping, Chip to chip bonding, wafer to wafer bonding. 3D IC, 異質整合, 先進封裝, 矽穿孔, 超薄晶圓處理, 微凸塊(micro-bumps)製程技術, 覆晶黏著, 直接晶圓接合
briefs.desc: 當電晶體微縮逐漸逼近物理極限，半導體產業開始依靠先進封裝技術來突破效能瓶頸。透過 2.5D、3D 堆疊、異質整合及高 密度互連技術，能有效延續摩爾定律的發展軌跡。 其中，3D 堆疊技術透過 TSV、Micro-bumping、Hybrid Bonding 等方式，將晶片多層垂直整合，提升運算密度、降低面 積並改善功耗，在 AI、HPC、伺服器等領域展現極高效益。 2.5D, 3D 整合方面， CoWoS（Chip-on-Wafer-on-Substrate）已成為 AI GPU 與 HBM 系統的主流封裝架構，透過矽中 介層將高頻寬記憶體與大型邏輯晶片緊密整合，大幅提升資料交換效率。 同時，Intel 的 EMIB（embedded Multi-die Interconnect Bridge） 則以嵌入式橋接技術取代大型矽中介層，提 供高 頻寬、低延遲且具成本優勢的 2.5D 整合方式。 在記憶體領域，SK Hynix 的 HBM（High Bandwidth Memory） 更是先進封裝不可或缺的核心元件，其以 TSV 垂直堆疊 多層 DRAM 晶片，具備超高頻寬、低功耗與小面積等優勢。

briefs.name: 材料損壞分析
briefs.tags: 破裂力學, 材料損壞機制, 斷裂面相學, 疲勞, 腐蝕 fracture mechanics, failure mechanisms, fractography, fatigue, corrosion
briefs.desc: 本課程理論與實例並重，涵蓋破裂力學及材料損壞機制二大領域，以使學者對材料損壞有一完整之觀念與分析能力 This course emphasize both the basics and case studies of the failure of materials. It covers the fracture mechanics and failure mechanisms of materials. Many practical cases of failure will be discussed in the class to give the students a whole picture of the failure of materials.

briefs.name: 奈米科學與材料
briefs.tags: 奈米材料 Nanomaterials, 奈米結構 Nanostructures, 奈米材料合成 Nanomaterials Synthesis, 奈米材料表徵 Nanomaterials Characterization, 量子限域 Quantum Confinement, 界面工程 Interfacial Engineering,能源奈米技術 Energy Nanotechnology, 綠色奈米科技 Green Nanotechnology
briefs.desc: 本課程介紹奈米材料的基本概念、合成方法、結構特性與量測技術，並說明奈米尺度下材料所呈現的特殊物理與化學行為，例如尺寸效 應、量子限域與界面現象。課程將涵蓋各類奈米材料，包括金屬、氧化物、碳基、聚合物與生醫奈米材料，並探討其在能源、生醫、環境 與新興科技中的應用。透過本課程，學生將能理解奈米材料設計與應用的科學基礎，並提升分析與跨領域整合能力，為後續進階研究與工 程應用奠定基礎。 This course provides an introduction to the fundamentals of nanomaterials, including synthesis methods, structural features, and characterization techniques, as well as key nanoscale phenomena such as size effects, quantum confinement, and interfacial behavior. The course covers major classes of nanomaterials—metals, oxides, carbon-based structures, polymers, and bio-nanomaterials—and discusses their applications in energy, biotechnology, environmental technologies, and emerging fields. Students will develop a solid understanding of the scientific principles behind nanomaterial d

briefs.name: 高熵材料特論
briefs.tags: 高熵材料, 科技應用
briefs.desc: 高熵材料領域源於我國，係葉均蔚院士及其團隊於清華大學所開創，近年來十分熱門，相關文獻發表已經超過一萬六千篇， 各式各樣重要應用研究持續其發展。 葉均蔚教授 1995 年發明“高熵合金（High-Entropy Alloys）”，其合金的配方含 5 個以上的主元素，翻轉人類自古以來 以一個或兩個元素為主的合金觀念，並獲得臺灣、中國大陸及日本的發明專利。1995 至 2003 年間累積大量的研究數據及 心得後，在 2004 年始首度披露並發表 5 篇高熵合金論文，之後平均每年發表 10 篇高熵合金論文。此一發明後，自 2004 年發表後隨即引發世人重視及跟進，包括美國、中國、德國、韓國、日本都投入大量人力及物力發展高熵合金，編列許多高 熵合金專案大計畫，並設立高熵合金中心(Center of High Entropy Alloys)。Nature 2016 年 5 月 19 日更對高熵合 金做專題報，此報導肯定了高熵合金新領域，且肯定台灣發源地的事實。2018年清華大學獲得教育部與科技部五年計畫補 助，成立高熵材料研究中心(High entropy Materials Center)，目前仍為全國教育部補助的深耕中心。有鑑於高熵材料 研究在世界各地如火如荼進行，成為材料研究顯學，有必要開設「高熵材料特論」嘉惠學子，讓學生可以瞭&

briefs.name: Python程式在材料科學的應用
briefs.nameEn: Python Programming and its Applications in Materials Science and Engineering
briefs.tags: Python language (Python 語言), Jupyter notebook (J Jupyter Notebook 工作環境), computational thermodynamics (計算熱力學), data science (資料科學), kinetic simulations (動力學模擬)
briefs.desc: This course aims to train students with modern computer programming languages to enhance their understandings to the core principles of materials science and engineering. We target junior/senior/graduate students who have explored to the core courses, such as thermodynamics, phase transformation, engineering math, laboratories of materials, etc. Students will learn basic Python programming skills and use them on the applications of calculating thermodynamical quantities, identifying phase equilibria and phase boundaries, simulating diffusion and phase transformation processes, and of machine learning and analyzing materials science data. The overarching goal is to equip future materials scientists and engineers early on with programming and computational skills, such that they will apply these methods to solve problems in a fundamentally different way from the current customs; specifically, with algorithmic thinkings in investigating/analyzing phenomena/problems. This ability is partic

briefs.name: 電子顯微鏡微分析
briefs.tags: electron microanalysis,EPMA, EDX, EBSD, CL
briefs.desc: The purpose of this course is designed to familiarize the student with the operation of EPMA, SEM-EDX, Soft X-Ray and EBSD. Focuses are directed to study the effects of instrument operational parameters on X-ray microanalysis, in addition to the strategy and skillful technique for SEM and FESEM image. Related techniques, including EDX, WDX, SXES and EBSD, will be addressed. Another aim is to familiarize the student with the principle and application of electron microanalysis via X-ray technique. Special efforts will be focused on the newly developed field emission electron probe micro analyzer, liquid nitrogen-free EDX ,SXES, and novel design for EBSD technique.

briefs.tags: 半導體與微製造,奈微機電系統,微流體與生物感測器,Microfluidics and Biosensors,NEMS & MEMS,Semiconductor, Micro and Nano fabrication
briefs.desc: 藉由奈微所教師之專業與研究室既有之資源，提供學生實際參與執行奈微米科技相關之研究工作，以增進學生對基礎理論之運 用，同時培養學生以解決問題為導向的學習方法，藉以強化學生的分析技巧，組織能力，邏輯思考，深入探索，執行能力，以及 決斷力。為學生提供探索興趣與發現專長的機會。

briefs.name: 半導體生醫感測器 原理與實作
briefs.tags: 半導體，電晶體，感測器，生醫感測器，生物電子
briefs.desc: 本課程講授電晶體感測器之原理，製程，以及量測方式。課程結合原理與實作，以理論與實作並重之方式，增強學習效果，以達到充份之理 解，並且提升運用基礎知識於工程應用之能力。課程針對不同領域之背景所設計，使其皆能消化吸收，以期達到跨領域學習的成效。

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: 專題演講(Seminars), 跨領域研究 — Interdisciplinary Research, 新興科技 — Emerging Technologies, 產學交流 — Industry–Academia Interaction, 專業溝通能力 — Professional Communication, 研究視野 — Research Perspectives
briefs.desc: This course is a seminar series organized by the Institute of NanoEngineering and Microsystems. Experts from various academic fields as well as key professionals from industry will be invited to share their research achievements, technological developments, industry trends, and practical experiences. Through diverse topics and discussions, students will be exposed to the latest advances across disciplines, broaden their academic perspectives, and better understand the connection between research and industry. The course aims to cultivate interdisciplinary thinking and professional communication skills. Students are encouraged to actively participate in discussions and ask questions, helping them gain deeper insights into their own research directions and future career development. 本課程為奈米工程與微系統研究所之專題演講課程，主要邀請來自各學術領域之專家學者及產業界重要人士，分享其研究成 果、技術發展、產業趨勢與實務經驗。透過多元主題的演講與交流，讓學生能接觸不同領域

briefs.name: 微感測器及量測系統之訊號處理
briefs.tags: MEMS, Sensors, Actuators, Transducers, Interfaced Circuits, Piezoresistive, Thermal, Capacitive, Piezoelectric
briefs.desc: This course would cover advanced topics dealing with NEMS/MEMS technologies, transduction mechanisms (such as thermal, piezoresistive, capacitive, piezoelectric transduction), microfabricated sensors, and conditioning circuit design and measurement. In addition, the course also reviews different types of sensors for measurement and circuitry readouts of physical parameters such as acceleration, rotation rate, pressure. Two hands-on lab practicing will be offered to students using the Electronics Lab facility of iNEMS to provide students physical instrumentation on piezoresistive, thermal, capacitive, and piezoelectric transducers taught in the class, therefore benefiting their experimental skills. The design project is an important part of this course. It is carried out by each student or group who develops, simulates, and designs a device and testing configuration of his/her choice, and present the findings in a technical paper.

briefs.name: 應用於微機電之半導體製程與元件量測實作
briefs.nameEn: Semiconductor process and device characterization for MEMS
briefs.teacher: 王玉麟,傅建中,方維倫,馮國華,李昇憲,森川響二朗
briefs.tags: Semiconductors process, photolithography, Dry/wet etching, thin films, MEMS, CMOS, device characterization
briefs.desc: This course is intended to introduce typical semiconductor process and the device fabrication and characterization for MEMS, CMOS, and typical semiconductor devices. It focuses on training students the semiconductor process unit and the equipment operation, as well as introducing the clean room facility and rules. Lab practicing is designed to allow students have hands-on experiences to enhance students’ understanding of the semiconductor device physics.

briefs.name: 微機電構裝技術與可靠度
briefs.tags: 微機電封裝(MEMS packaging)，可靠度(Reliability)，晶片封裝(Chip packaging)，封裝設計(Packaging Design)，多晶片封裝(Multi-chips packaging)。
briefs.desc: 以半導體元件封裝為基礎，進行微機電元件的封裝製程設計教授。從封裝模組的選擇，電性，散熱及機械強度的考量下，設 計出最佳的元件封裝 製作方式。後半部將以元件及模組的可靠度分析與實證教授為主，進行可靠性及品管分析。 The course will focus on the packaging technique from microelectronics to MEMS device. The fundamental packaging procedure will be taught at early semester. Then electric, thermal and mechanical designs will be involved while selecting the proper packaging way to fulfill the purpose. The last several week will teach how to design the reliability for your devices or products.

briefs.name: 微流體系統
briefs.tags: 微流體, 生醫微機電, 微製造, Microfluidics, BIoMEMS, Microfabrication
briefs.desc: Microfluidics deals with the behavior, precise control and manipulation of fluids that are geometrically constrained to a small, typically sub-millimeter scale. There has been a continuously increasing interest in applying microfluidics in a wide spectrum of applications including inject printing, chemistry, material science, biology and medicine. Introduction to Microfluidics Systems is a course designed to give students the fundamentals of fluid mechanics and physics and chemistry principles associated with microfluidics systems with a special emphasis on biological and medical applications.

briefs.name: 微致動器與智能材料
briefs.tags: 智慧材料 Smart materials, 微型致動器 Microactuators, 壓電材料 Piezoelectric materials, 形狀記憶合金 Shape memory alloys, 建模與特性分析 Modeling and characterization
briefs.desc: The main goal of this course is to introduce engineering students to some basic understanding of the characterization and control of micro-sized actuators or actuators working at the micro-scale made of smart materials. Various knowledge and emerging techniques of actuators will be conveyed in this course, such as actuators’ properties, manufacturing, and the theory behind them. Topics will include commonly used smart materials for fabricating microactuators or actuators working on a micro-scale. The smart materials cover piezoelectric material, shape memory alloy, dielectric elastomer and ionic polymer, magnetorheological fluid, and magnetorheological elastomer. Moreover, the concept of modeling and modeling techniques of microactuators will be discussed. Both physical and chemical characterizations of the smart material fabricated devices will be described in detail in actuating aspect.

briefs.name: 當代光電工程
briefs.tags: Display, fiber, lighting, modulation, storage, 顯示元件、光纖、發光元件、調變元件、儲存元件
briefs.desc: The purpose of this lecture is to give novel applications with optoelectronic devices through engineering. Students will gain combinational knowledge of solid-state and polymer electronics device and system as well as their corresponding applications in industry with the latest engineering ideas. In addition to the oral lecture, students are requested to present some latest inventions as a part of the training. When there’s appropriate exhibitions and conferences, a flexibility of enrollment will be provided.

briefs.name: 奈米電子及奈米技術
briefs.tags: Semiconductor, MOSFETs, MESFETs, Ohmic Contacts, Schottky Contacts, PN diodes, BJT/HBT, LED, Solar Cells
briefs.desc: This course is intended to introduce fundamental knowledge of solid-state electronic materials properties, the technology for nano fabrication and semiconductor devices as well. Lab practicing is also designed to allow students have hand-on experiences. Finally, nano-scaled one dimensional, two dimensional materials and devices are introduced. Students will also need to present designated topics and case study by using the knowledge they have leaned in this class.

briefs.tags: 論文研究
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文研究
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 專題演講
briefs.tags: 核子工程、醫學物理、核能材料、輻射應用
briefs.desc: 邀請各領域專家學者進行專題演講

briefs.name: 反應器物理一
briefs.tags: 中文：核分裂連鎖反應、反應截面、中子遷移、中子擴散、反射體、核能電廠。英文：nuclear fission chain reaction, cross section, neutron transport, neutron diffusion, reflector, nuclear power plant
briefs.desc: The maturation of the nuclear power industry, accompanied by a redirection in emphasis from research and development to the nuclear power systems, has induced a corresponding change in the growing demand for well-trained nuclear engineers. Of central importance in such programs are those introductory courses in nuclear reactor analysis that first introduce the nuclear engineering student to the basis scientific principles of nuclear fission chain reactions that lay a foundation for the subsequent applications of these principles to the nuclear design and analysis of reactor cores. These constitute the main goal of this course.

briefs.name: 應用原子核物理
briefs.tags: Nuclear engineering, Nuclear technology, Application, 核子工程, 核子科技, 應用
briefs.desc: Nuclear technology and applications in different fields will be introduced and discussed.

briefs.name: 蒙特卡羅計算
briefs.tags: 蒙特卡羅方法(Monte Carlo method)、隨機抽樣(Random sampling)、變異數降低技術(Variance reduction technique)、輻射遷移(Radiation transport)、模擬(Simulation)
briefs.desc: 蒙特卡羅方法是一種以隨機抽樣(Random Sampling)技術為基礎的通用數值模擬方法，伴隨電腦計算能力的增進，其在各領域 的應用日益多樣。本課程由淺而深逐步探究蒙特卡羅方法的理論與應用，內容主要涵蓋隨機變數、類比蒙特卡羅模擬與各式變異 數降低技巧。

briefs.name: 輻射度量
briefs.tags: Radiation detection
briefs.desc: This course aims at providing students a comprehensive understanding of the fundamentals of radiation detection and measurement. Students are expected to demonstrate a knowledge of atomic and nuclear physics, and the capability of identifying mechanisms behind different types of radiation interaction with matter. Principles of the counting statistics, nuclear instruments, and detectors utilized to measure the charged particles, photons, and neutrons will be introduced subsequently.

briefs.name: 進階放射生物學
briefs.tags: 腫瘤微環境、直線能量轉移、相對生物效應、粒子治療、輻射增敏劑、免疫療法 tumor microenvironment, LET, RBE, particle therapy, radiosensitizer, immunotherapy
briefs.desc: 從腫瘤微環境的觀點，來將基本的放射線化學物理特性推演到其對腫瘤的整體影響, 介紹放射線從對分子的作用衍生至其對細胞、組織、腫 瘤的傷害, 並討論最新推動的放射治療技術，以及如何增加放射線的療效等，課程內容著重於延伸放射生物基礎理論於臨床實務的運用, 最新研究趨勢及新推動之臨床技術等，並培養閱讀相關專業報告及獨立思考的能力

briefs.name: 保健物理
briefs.tags: Health Physic, Radiation Protection
briefs.desc: Health physics is a professional field that cuts across the basic physical, life, and earth sciences as well as such applied areas as toxicology, industrial hygiene, medicine, public health, and engineering. The scientific and engineering aspects of health physics are concerned mainly with (1) the physical measurements of different types of radiation and radioactive materials, (2) the establishment of quantitative relationships between radiation exposure and biological damage, (3) the movement of radioactivity through the environment, and (4) the design of radiologically safe equipment, processes, and environments.

briefs.name: 醫學影像物理學二
briefs.tags: 醫學影像,醫學物理,Medical Imaging, Medicial Physics, MRI, NM, dosimetry
briefs.desc: This course covers what a medical imaging physicist needs to know about image formation, image reconstruction, image processing, magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), nuclear medicine (NM), as well as patient dosimetry and shielding design in diagnostic and interventional radiology. For MRI and NM, systematic knowledge from principles to hardware components, imaging methods, quality management, and clinical applications will be introduced.

briefs.name: 應用光電子學
briefs.tags: Optics, Photonics, Lasers
briefs.desc: Photonics is a subject that integrates optics with modern electronic devices for generating, controlling, and detecting photons. This course will introduce students to the fundamentals of reverent physics and applications, such as liquid-crystal display (LCD), light-emitting diode (LED), optical fiber, photonic crystal, laser-driven X-ray sources, and EUV lithography. In addition to the basics of optics, students are expected to understand the principle of lasers, photon detectors, guided-wave optics, photonic devices, and X-ray Imagining.

briefs.name: 核電廠安全度評估
briefs.tags: 核能電廠安全度評估, 風險告知應用, 量化風險評估, 事件樹與故障樹, 設備失效數據與人為可靠度評估
briefs.desc: 本課程介紹核能電廠安全度評估各項工程領域的評估方法實務

briefs.name: 小型模組化反應器實務
briefs.tags: small modular reactors, SMR, 小型模組化反應爐, Liquid-metal-cooled fast neutron reactor, Molten salt reactor (MSR), 液態金屬冷卻快中子反應器, 熔鹽反應器
briefs.desc: This course will cover various aspects of small modular reactors, including economics, environmental consideration, safety, applications, and design.

briefs.name: 原子科學導論
briefs.teacher: 蔡惠予,陳芳馨,彭旭霞,林曉均,吳幸慈,李志浩
briefs.tags: Atomic Science, Nuclear Physics, Scientific Application, Radiation Application in Medicine, Beam Technology
briefs.desc: 本課程為原子科學院的核心基礎課程，旨在建立原科院大學部同學對於原子科學的基本觀念與學理知識，課程內容涵蓋五大主題：基礎放射物理、核能 應用的核子工程、輻射應用的兩大面向與射束科技，這些主題是原科院畢業生應具備的基礎知識，透過這門課的學習，淺則可對原子科學有全面整合性 的概觀，深則奠定對特定領域發展的基礎且可作為知識廣面的建構。為使這門課有實際應用的實務學習，安排學生實地參訪清華大學水池式反應器。

briefs.name: 重量訓練
briefs.tags: weight training、重量訓練、resistance training、阻力訓練、strength training、肌力訓練。
briefs.desc: 學習運用不同器材以及阻力負荷設定，搭配有效的運動科學訓練，掌握不同訓練目的與訓練自身的方法。

briefs.name: 跆拳道
briefs.tags: 跆拳道,前踢,下壓,旋踢,側踢,後踢,後旋,taekwondo
briefs.desc: 本項目跆拳道課程,乃是初級跆拳道初學者的體驗課程 藉由文字與影音的導引,拓展學員對於跆拳道的第一次接 觸,進而誘發學生的學習興趣 再經由跆拳道運動的基本動作課程學習,加強學生實際的 身體技能操作與運動思維組合 結合踢擊技巧與踢靶的靈活安排,讓學生實際參與跆拳道 的技擊模式 從而使學生體驗到跆拳道運動的樂趣 最後再經由有趣的擊破考評方式,增加學生的參予程度與 成就滿足

briefs.name: 網球初學
briefs.tags: 正拍,反拍,截擊
briefs.desc: 教學目的 (一)認識網球運動並產生興趣，培養網球運動習慣 (二)介紹出正拍、反拍、發球基本動作要領 (三)介紹網球運動基本規則及賽制 (四)透過網球課程，增進學生體適能並養成運動之習慣 主要內容 (ㄧ)網球運動發展史、基本規則及常識介紹 (二)握拍種類介紹 (三)基本球感練習 (四)正拍基本動作教學 (五)反拍基本動作教學 (六)截擊基本動作教學 (七)發球基本動作介紹 (八)基本網球規則及賽制介紹 (九)期中測驗 定點正拍擊球 (十)期末測驗 正、反拍連續擊球，對牆擊球 主要教材及參考用書 (一)International Tennis Federation(2006).Developing Young Tennis Players (二)ITF國際網球規則(2007)國際網球總會 (三)網球相關書籍 四、課外作業 (一)揮拍練習 (二)擊牆練習

briefs.name: 慢壘
briefs.tags: 慢壘、慢速壘球、棒球、softball、球類運動
briefs.desc: 本課程透過理論講授、案例討論與場地實作，協助學生從概念與技能兩個層面建立慢速壘球的基礎能力。 課程內容著重於培養學生對壘球運動的核心知識，包括基本術語、比賽規則、戰術概念與運動禮儀，使學生具備理解比賽與欣賞 賽事的能力，進而提升參與動機與運動素養。 在技術實作方面，課程以初學者能夠掌握的入門技能為核心，涵蓋內外野守備、傳接球動作、打擊技巧以及投球機制等基礎訓 練。透過循序漸進的練習設計與體驗式教學策略，協助學生在安全且支持性的環境中熟悉各項技術，逐步累積參與慢速壘球賽事 所需之實作能力。最終具備基礎的比賽參與能力，能在課程後期的分組競賽中實際運用所學，提升運動體驗品質與團隊合作能 力。

briefs.name: 舞蹈即興創作
briefs.tags: 即興創作 Improvisation, 運動Sport, 體育Physical Education, 舞蹈Dance, 肢體動作Body Movements
briefs.desc: 教師以引導的模式帶領學生參與舞蹈即興創作課程，在不同的舞蹈元素中激盪出令人激賞的舞蹈肢體創作。透過參與該課程強化自身肢體協 調＆律動性及提昇賞析與表演及創造力等等

briefs.name: 羽球初學
briefs.tags: 羽球運動
briefs.desc: 1.學習羽球基本規則 2.學習羽球發球基本動作 3.學習羽球挑球基本動作 4.學習運用規則實際操作比賽

briefs.name: 健走與慢跑
briefs.tags: Brisk Walking、Jogging、Aerobic Exercise、Strength Training、Dynamic Stretching Exercises
briefs.desc: 1.培養學生規律運動習慣，建立正確健走與慢跑姿勢。 2.增進心肺耐力，提升基礎體能。 3.學會運用心率、呼吸與配速進行自我監控。 4.具備健康運動知識，能規劃簡單的個人健走 / 慢跑計畫。

briefs.name: 射擊初學
briefs.tags: 射擊運動, 十公尺空氣手槍, 十公尺空氣步槍, shooting sport, 10 meter air pistol, 10 meter air rifle
briefs.desc: 本課程帶你認識射擊運動，以十公尺空氣手、步槍入門，包括基本觀念與專項技術、比賽規則與流程、心理技能之應用、實彈射 擊。

briefs.name: 重量訓練
briefs.tags: The strength of muscle strength and muscular endurance has a great impact on daily work and activities, because a person has strong muscles and good muscle strength and muscular endurance, it will have better efficiency for the work he is engaged in, and it can also bring people Feeling full of vitality, and more importantly, for those who want to lose weight, weight training can bring unexpected
briefs.desc: 肌力與肌耐力的強弱對日常生活工作與活動有很大的影響，因為一個人有結實的肌肉和良好的 肌力與肌耐力，對於所從事工作會有更好的效率，亦可帶給人充滿活力的感覺，更重要的是對於想 要減肥的人，重量訓練更可帶來意想不到的效果，它可雕塑完美的人體曲線，提升基礎代謝率，在 運動後仍然維持較高的代謝，進而達到減肥的功效，所以重量訓練對促進健康體適能有相當高的重 要性。

briefs.name: 跆拳道進階
briefs.tags: 跆拳道,前踢,下壓,旋踢,側踢,後踢,後旋,taekwondo
briefs.desc: 本項目跆拳道課程,乃是中級跆拳道進階學習者的體驗課 程 藉由文字與影音的導引,拓展學員對於進階跆拳道的第一 次接觸,進而誘發學生的學習興趣 再經由跆拳道運動的基本動作組合課程學習,加強學生實 際的身體技能操作與運動思維組合 結合踢擊技巧與踢靶的靈活安排,讓學生實際參與跆拳道 的技擊模式 從而使學生體驗到跆拳道運動的樂趣與參與 最後再經由有趣的擊破考評方式,增加學生的參予程度與 成就滿足

briefs.name: 桌球初學
briefs.tags: table tennis(桌球),teamwort(團隊合作),beginner(初學),exercise(運動),teaching(教學)
briefs.desc: 大學體育課程的教學目標不只是科目的操作演練，還要有知識、態度、能力的育成，應有「獨立思考、問題解決、領導統 御、尊重他人」等能力的養成，強化學生對身體保健與運動知識的觀念，並將運動技能的行為規範、道德涵養融入生活 中，使其心理、生理及社會行為都能得到充分且均衡發展，以作為日後運動參與及運動欣賞之重要基礎。

briefs.name: 網球初學
briefs.tags: 快樂打網球
briefs.desc: 愛打網球多活十年！社交頻繁的運動更有益於延長壽命,安全從事運動,引發學生運動興趣. 為啥是網球？很可能是因為網球、足球這類運動需要較多的社會交往，而「社會隔絕」本身就是一種減壽的強影響因素,網 球這類綜合運動能夠更加充分地運動全身的肌肉，而且它的運動模式基本上是一種間歇式的劇烈運動，這種運動模式已經 被證明是優於單一節奏、持續性的運動模式了,來自社交的支持對長壽的影響真的非~常大，甚至大過其他所有健康行為比 如不吸煙、身材好、血壓正常。這項研究的結果則告訴我們，良好人際關係對早死的預防效果是鍛煉身體的兩倍……針對性 別、年齡、運動量、吸煙、教育水平、收入、飲酒習慣以及糖尿病與否等影響因素做出調整之後，研究者得到了最終的數 據。網球助你活更長！學習從基礎開始.

briefs.desc: 本課程主要為不諳水性或無法持續完成25公尺者，提供蛙式、基本仰泳（自救與救生）及仰式等動作技術之學習。課程目標除能 輕鬆游完50公尺以上距離外，並能培養游泳健身、水中自救與簡易救援之概念和能力，以期領略游泳運動的樂趣，養成規律游泳 運動的習慣。

briefs.name: 健走與慢跑
briefs.tags: Brisk Walking、Jogging、Aerobic Exercise、Strength Training、Dynamic Stretching Exercises
briefs.desc: 1.培養學生規律運動習慣，建立正確健走與慢跑姿勢。 2.增進心肺耐力，提升基礎體能。 3.學會運用心率、呼吸與配速進行自我監控。 4.具備健康運動知識，能規劃簡單的個人健走 / 慢跑計畫。

briefs.name: 柔道
briefs.tags: 養成規律的運動習慣 Develop a regular exercise habit
briefs.desc: 一、課程簡述：柔道起源於日本，前身是日本柔術。日本柔術演變自古代的相撲，相撲分成二支：一支是以表演、觀賞 為目的的相撲；一支是以實踐為目的，為武士攻防技擊演化而成的柔術。柔道是由日本人嘉納治五郎於1882年改良自日本 古武道柔術而發展出來的一套運動。柔道以「精力善用」「自他共榮」為基本理念，並以鍛練及教育身心為目的，而非單 純以競技勝負為目標，（柔道是最有效使用身心之道，其修行是以攻擊防禦的練習來鍛鍊休養身體精神，並體會該運動的 精髓）。如此來完成大我並對世界有所補益，乃柔道修行的最終目的。柔道的技術可以被分為兩大類即「立技」與「寢 技」。「立技」：分為投技及捨身技，「寢技」：固技、絞技及關節技。 二、目的：1.本課程著重於初學者對柔道的認知及其基本動作之教學。 2.介紹柔道基本知識、養成終身運動習慣、促進同學身體適能及身心健康。

briefs.name: 慢壘
briefs.tags: 慢壘、慢速壘球、棒球、softball、球類運動
briefs.desc: 本課程透過理論講授、案例討論與場地實作，協助學生從概念與技能兩個層面建立慢速壘球的基礎能力。 課程內容著重於培養學生對壘球運動的核心知識，包括基本術語、比賽規則、戰術概念與運動禮儀，使學生具備理解比賽與欣賞 賽事的能力，進而提升參與動機與運動素養。 在技術實作方面，課程以初學者能夠掌握的入門技能為核心，涵蓋內外野守備、傳接球動作、打擊技巧以及投球機制等基礎訓 練。透過循序漸進的練習設計與體驗式教學策略，協助學生在安全且支持性的環境中熟悉各項技術，逐步累積參與慢速壘球賽事 所需之實作能力。最終具備基礎的比賽參與能力，能在課程後期的分組競賽中實際運用所學，提升運動體驗品質與團隊合作能 力。

briefs.name: 重量塑身
briefs.tags: 肌肉耐力skeletal muscular endurance, 肌肉力量skeletal muscular strength, 肌肉爆發力skeletal muscular power, 柔韌度flexibility, 平衡力balance, 有氧運動 aerobic exercise
briefs.desc: 「重量塑身」就廣泛的定義來講包含了應用徒手訓練、器具訓練以及機械式鍛鍊，用以增進肌肉力量、身體體態與 全人健康的綜合式訓練，因此重量塑身的訓練是可以隨時隨地的執行、是可以變換訓練方法；它的優點，在於能夠 給予自己所欲鍛鍊的部位莫大的負荷，以致能有效的鍛鍊身體肌群。就個人的目標設定來說，就可以分為減輕體重 (即瘦身或減輕體脂肪)、增加體重(即增壯、健美或健身)和維持體態等等。

briefs.name: 游泳初學
briefs.tags: 適應水性,換氣,捷式,蛙式,轉身
briefs.desc: 本課程主要為不諳水性或無法持續完成25公尺之學生，提供學習捷泳及蛙泳動作技術之機會。教材內容為自行編撰，採漸進原則 並以適合初學游泳學習之動作與技術，而不同於競技泳姿模式，以增進學生對水之親近及學習成就。每節授課方式均經由動作說 明、示範、反覆練習及個別指導等過程，確保每一單元學習符合授課進度。課程目標除能輕鬆完成50公尺距離之外，並能建立游 泳安全與健身之正確觀念和方法，進而培養規律游泳運動習慣。

briefs.name: 瑜珈進階
briefs.tags: Yoga，Yoga Elementary，瑜伽，瑜珈進階，瑜珈初級，流動瑜珈
briefs.desc: 透過呼吸與肢體動作的相互協調，讓學生們練習在呼吸與身體感知中了解自己，配合身體狀況逐漸增加練習的挑戰，逐步調整 自己的心態、想法，誠實面對自己的身體，進而提升自己的體能與肢體，透過呼吸與身體動作的串連，流暢地完成一組一組的 動作練習，並漸進式的挑戰進階的瑜珈姿勢，以達到安全的練習，並培養學生終身學習的興趣。

briefs.name: 太極拳
briefs.tags: 太極，武術，傳統文化思想，Tai Chi Chuan，martial art，traditional
briefs.desc: 楊家老架式太極拳展現了一條內求的道路，它沉靜、平穩、踏實、卻也靈活變化。原來習練太極拳，除了體 能、身體控 制能力增強、搏擊概念的建立之外，更重要的是心靈的沉澱，從最初的馬步操練，到拳架中的每一式都有其 所該具備的胸 懷。長此修習，氣質便產生變化，遇事不驕不躁，內心能時常保持平靜，情緒穩定、提得起放得下，不執 著，不虛妄。太 極講究陰陽和諧，以太極拳作用在己身便是求全身全心的協調控制，作用在對手便是能招招對應，處處合 拍，作用在生活 中，便是一種人際關係和諧，甚至與大自然天人和諧的觀念。

briefs.name: 定向越野
briefs.tags: 定向運動,Orienteering,順點賽,積分賽
briefs.desc: 本課程旨在暸解定向越野運動的基本理論與規則，並學習定向越野運動的基本及綜合應用技術，透過定向越野運動的實際參與，除強健身體各部 位肌力與適能、培養堅毅忍耐的精神外、學習地圖導航的能力，並能將其用於休閒活動推廣和指導。
