briefs.name: 物理數學
briefs.tags: 群論,張量,古典力學,電磁學,量子力學,統計力學,Group theory,Tensor,Classical mechanics,Electrodynamics,Quantum mechanics,Statistical mechanics
briefs.desc: 本門課為物理系高年級選修課程，可視為應用數學課程的延伸，探討較高階的數學觀念在物理中的應用。

briefs.name: 前沿物理專題演講二
briefs.tags: contemporary physics research, experiences, motivations, scientific curiosity, career, physics education
briefs.desc: Undergraduate Colloquium (II) introduces students to a wide spectrum of contemporary physics research, offering perspectives that extend beyond the traditional undergraduate curriculum. The course features invited physicists who will present highlights from their research and reflect on the experiences, motivations, and scientific curiosity that shape their work. Through these talks, students will encounter new ideas in physics and gain an appreciation for how research questions are formulated and pursued. The colloquium also provides opportunities looking into the excitement and challenge of careers in physics, helping students envision possible pathways for their own future. Complementing the academic speakers, invited guests from industry will discuss how physics informs their professional activities and share their views on the value and versatility of a physics education.

briefs.name: 熱統計物理二
briefs.tags: Phase Transition, Mean-Field Theory, Transport Properties, Non-Equilibrium, Hydrodynamics
briefs.desc: This course is an advanced elective statistical physics course that aims to extend previous discussions for the ideal system to realistic systems with interactions, and to explore thermal phenomena slightly out of equilibrium, transport properties, phase transitions, etc. It is expected to be a challenging course for junior/senior students, so you are welcome to take this course if you are strongly committed.

briefs.name: 光學二
briefs.tags: optics 光學，Diffraction 繞射，Fourier optics 傅立葉光學，Quantum Optics 量子光學，nonlinear optics 非線性光學
briefs.desc: Material covered: Diffraction, Fourier optics, coherence, lasers, quantum optics, nonlinear optics, laser spectroscopy, light-atom interaction, and special topics.

briefs.name: 量子物理二
briefs.tags: 量子力學 (quantum mechanics), 波函數 (wave function), 薛丁格方程式 (Schrodinger equation), 全同粒子 (identical particles), 對稱性 (symmetries)
briefs.desc: This course (conducted in Chinese) is to teach you how to "do" quantum mechanics. The basic theory will be covered mainly in the first semester. A collection of approximation schemes and applications of quantum mechanics (such as quantum cryptography and quantum computing) will be discussed in the second semester.

briefs.name: 基礎天文觀測
briefs.tags: 天文, Astronomy, 天文觀測, Astronomical Observations, 天文物理, Astrophysics
briefs.desc: This is an introduction course to fundamental observational techniques of astronomy.

briefs.name: 表面物理導論
briefs.tags: surface science, electronic, lattice, magnetic, interface
briefs.desc: I would like to give a general introduction of the big picture of surface science. Surface science is a very large field including the electronic, lattice and magnetic behaviors on the surface, at the interface and within the thin films. I will just use an easy, intuitive and plain way to introduce the basic concepts and essential experimental techniques for surface science research. I will use some of my published papers as examples for lecturing. I will also arrange some of the class time for actual practice of basic surface science experiment or lab tour.

briefs.name: 相對論導論二
briefs.tags: physics
briefs.desc: "Introduction to Relativity (I)(II) is a course on General Relativity. In the first semester, the basic idea of General Relativity is discussed. The second semester discusses applications of General Relativity, including, gravitation waves, spherical stars and black hoes, and cosmology.

briefs.name: 基本粒子物理導論二
briefs.tags: QED, Feynman rule, Dirac equation, standard model, electroweak interaction, strong interaction.
briefs.desc: Teach the basic knowledge of elementary particle physics. For example, three fundamental interactions (electroweak and strong forces) and the structure of Standard Model. The students can learn the fundamental computations of particle processes, like Feynman diagrams, decay rates, scattering cross section, preparing for advance research skill. On top of that, help students develop interests in particle physics. Occasionally, I would perform computer programming to demonstrate the numerical calculations during the class.

briefs.name: 光電物理導論
briefs.tags: Wave Nature of Light, Dielectric Waveguides and Optical Fibers, Semiconductor Physics and Light-Emitting Diodes, Stimulated Emission Devices: Optical Amplifiers and Lasers, Photodetectors and Image Sensors, Polarization and Modulation of Light, Quantum Communication
briefs.desc: 光電物理導論 (Introduction to Optoelectronics): This course is intended for advanced undergraduates in their third or final year in university. The students taking this course should have some background knowledge in thermal physics, electromagnetics, and quantum mechanics. Some knowledge in solid state physic (introductory level) will be helpful, but it is not necessary. The contents of course will emphasize both fundamental concepts and applications with modern technological relevance.

briefs.name: 神經物理導論
briefs.tags: NeuroPhys, NeuroAI, neuron, brain, physics-informed machine learning, edgeAI
briefs.desc: What if the brain itself is the ultimate computer? NeuroPhys 2026 takes you on a journey where physics meets neuroscience and AI, uncovering how nature builds intelligence from simple physical laws. We begin by exploring how neurons fire and neuronal network communicate, then move into how these insights reshape machine learning and physics-informed machine learning (PIML) later. Along the way, you’ll meet the neural circuits capable of making decisions, the Hopfield network as a model of associated memory, and the learning rules like Hebb and Oja for brain adaptability. The course will end at the frontier - Edge AI, where brain-inspired computation runs close to the real world.

briefs.name: 專題研究二
briefs.tags: 專題研究
briefs.desc: 由教授與學生擬定研究題目，以進行專題研究，培養學生解決問題的能力。

briefs.name: 專題研究--物理教學二
briefs.nameEn: Special Topics on Teaching Physics II
briefs.tags: special topic on teaching physics
briefs.desc: 為培育學生具備物理教學能力，增進溝通、協調與整合之技巧，提供學生經由擔任課程助教接受授課教師指導，獲得教學實習之 經驗，厚植教學實力，並於該相關專業科目中汲取研究能量，發揮所長。

briefs.name: 專題研究--物理教學四
briefs.nameEn: Special Topics on Teaching Physics IV
briefs.tags: special topic on teaching physics
briefs.desc: 為培育學生具備物理教學能力，增進溝通、協調與整合之技巧，提供學生經由擔任課程助教接受授課教師指導，獲得教學實習之 經驗，厚植教學實力，並於該相關專業科目中汲取研究能量，發揮所長。

briefs.name: 量子科技實驗
briefs.tags: 實驗課程 lab course, 量子科學與技術 quantum science and technology, 量子光學 quantum optics, 色心量子位元 color-center qubit
briefs.desc: This is an introductory lab-based QIST course. There are two main themes: (1) quantum optics, and (2) quantum spin. In quantum optics lab, we explore various topics on quantum foundation through single-photon experiments. In quantum spin lab, we implement laser and microwave sequences to achieve coherent controls of room-temperature nitrogen-vacancy qubits. There are no prerequisites for enrollment, but a general knowledge about quantum mechanics, quantum optics, or quantum information will be helpful. Essential theoretical background of each experiment will be covered in the lectures. *本課程為英語授課 (EMI計劃)

briefs.name: 統計力學一
briefs.tags: Statistics, Thermodynamics, Phases, Ideal gas, Ensembles
briefs.desc: This course will introduce students to one of the pillars of theoretical physics: Statistical Mechanics. Statistical mechanics provides a framework to understand and describe all macroscopic systems, from a cooling cup of coffee, boiling water to electrons in metals, semiconductors, superconductors, magnets, black holes, … just to name a few. Statistical mechanics is a body of knowledge that establishes the relation between microscopic properties and macroscopic properties of the system, which is essential from both fundamental and application points of view. The course will cover the basic theoretical framework and applications(starting from non- interacting systems, classical gas, and quantum gases(fermions and bosons). After the study of non-interacting systems, we will discuss the techniques related to interacting systems.

briefs.name: 電動力學二
briefs.tags: Electrostatics, Boundary-Value Problems, Magnetostatics, Maxwell Equations, Electromagnetism
briefs.desc: We previously studied electromagnetism in two courses: General Physics II (freshman) and Electromagnetism (sophomore). What is new in this course? Electrodynamics will deal with the “same” Maxwell equations but from a more in-depth perspective. We will introduce a powerful tool, the Green function, to solve electrostatic, magnetostatic, and electromagnetic problems. To do that, we unavoidably have to learn the mathematics in spherical and cylindrical coordinates.

briefs.name: 量子力學二
briefs.tags: quantum mechanics, spin, perturbation, scattering, Dirac equation, path integral
briefs.desc: This course is a continuation of Quantum Mechanics I, following Principles of Quantum Mechanics by R. Shankar. Key topics include spin and finite-dimensional quantum systems, the variational method, time- independent perturbation theory, and scattering theory. The course also introduces the Dirac equation, highlighting the relativistic structure of quantum mechanics, and concludes with the path-integral formulation, which provides an alternative and unifying perspective on quantum dynamics.

briefs.name: 超導與頻譜研究特論
briefs.tags: superconductivity, spectroscopy method, BCS theory, unconventional superconductor, microscopic mechanism
briefs.desc: This course is particularly designed for students who want to join the research on superconductivity. It will cover the basic theoretical background and experimental techniques required for entering into the frontier research on superconductivity.

briefs.name: 凝態物理二
briefs.tags: 玻色Bosonization, 樂廷格液體Luttinger liquids,費米Fermi liquids,重整化群renormalization group,拓撲topological
briefs.desc: This course cover the theoretical developments in condensed matter physics including Bosonization, Fermi liquids, renormalization group, topological field theory and its applications, Berry phase in electronic systems.

briefs.name: 專題討論二
briefs.tags: Physics, Colloquium, Frontier Research, Interdisciplinary Physics, Scientific Communication
briefs.desc: The Physics Colloquium is a weekly seminar series designed to expose students and faculty to cutting- edge research across the broad spectrum of physics. Speakers include visiting researchers from other universities, national laboratories, and industry leaders, as well as distinguished local faculty. The goal is to step outside your specific sub-field and appreciate the "big picture" developments in the physical sciences.

briefs.name: 書報討論--粒子二
briefs.tags: Particle Physics, Seminars
briefs.desc: 本課是為了配合新竹地區每週一次的粒子與場演講而開設的課程. 演講通常是邀請國內外專家作為講員.為了配合學生對演講的理解,每次演講的開始 將提供簡單的背景介紹.

briefs.name: 書報討論--原子分子光學二
briefs.tags: 光學,量子資訊,原子,分子,物理, optics, quantum information, atom, molecule, physics
briefs.desc: This course consists of seminars given by researchers specialized in experimental or theoretical Atomic, Molecular, and Optical and Quantum Information physics.

briefs.name: 書報討論--凝態二
briefs.tags: 凝聚態物理，量子物理
briefs.desc: It is a condensed seminar course. There will be around 10 speakers discussing frontier researches about quantum matters.

briefs.name: 物理專題--凝態計算物理
briefs.nameEn: Special Topic : Computational Condensed Matter Physics
briefs.tags: 密度泛函理論, 局部密度泛函近似, 電子結構, 第一原理計算, 強關聯庫倫斥力
briefs.desc: 計算凝態物理/鄭弘泰/介紹使用密度泛函理論計算模擬現代新穎材料電子結構的科學

briefs.name: 物理專題--科學寫作與短講
briefs.nameEn: Special Topic: Scientific Writing and Short Talks
briefs.tags: Scientific writing, presentation, communication
briefs.desc: This course aims to develop students' core skills in scientific writing and oral communication. Participants will work with their own research projects, using their findings as the foundation for learning. Through a series of structured short talks and the development of a comprehensive academic paper, students will refine their ability to effectively present and communicate scientific results to diverse audiences.

briefs.name: 物理專題--量子資訊
briefs.tags: quantum information, including quantum entanglement, quantum computation, quantum error correction, and quantum complexity.
briefs.desc: This course will introduce basic concepts of quantum information, including quantum entanglement, quantum computation, quantum error correction, and quantum complexity.

briefs.name: 物理專題--近代物理發展史
briefs.nameEn: Special Topic: History of Modern Physics
briefs.tags: Development of Quantum Theory
briefs.desc: The lectures will be in Chinese. The development of physics theories is usually based on guessing. This course “tries” to explore the reasoning behind guessing, with the study of original articles. The contents mainly cover some of the development in the late 19th and early 20th centuries.

briefs.name: 物理專題--多體物理計算
briefs.tags: Computational physics計算物理, tensor network張量網, exact diagonalization精確對角化法, python programming, phase transitions相變
briefs.desc: This course introduces computational methods for studying quantum many-body systems, with a focus on hands-on numerical modeling using Python. Emphasis is placed on exact diagonalization techniques and matrix-based approaches applied to lattice models, particularly quantum spin chains. Students learn how to construct many-body Hamiltonians using second quantization, apply linear algebra methods to analyze spectra and eigenstates, and compute physical observables such as correlations and entanglement.

briefs.name: 中微子物理學
briefs.tags: Neutrinos, New physics, Particle Cosmology, Astroparticle Physics, Particle physics experiments
briefs.desc: In this course we will discuss extensions of the Standard Model of Particle Physics focusing on the neutrino sector. In particular, possible origins of neutrino masses are discussed together with their implications for ongoing and future experimental searches. Another highlight is the role of neutrinos in the early universe.

briefs.name: 黑洞與全息論之量子理論二
briefs.nameEn: Introduction to Quantum Theory of Black Holes and Holography (II)
briefs.tags: Black hole entropy, quantum mechanics, entanglement, Hawking radiation, Penrose diagram
briefs.desc: This is the second half of a one-year course designed to introduce students to the (still developing) theory of quantum gravity through an understanding of the quantum theory of black holes. Students who have learned about the quantum theory of black holes, at least in the first half of the course, will be introduced to the concept of holography. Students will learn in this second half how many new insights into black holes and quantum gravity can be gained through holography.

briefs.name: 量子場論二
briefs.tags: Quantum, Field Theory, Gauge Theories, Anomalies, Instantons, Supersymmetry
briefs.desc: This is the second part of a two semester course on quantum field theory. In the second part we want to focus on more advanced concepts like anomalies, instantons and/or supersymmetry. We strongly advise to have attended the first QFT course or another QFT course at a different university before taking this course.

briefs.name: 基本粒子物理二
briefs.tags: Physics beyond the Standard Model, Astroparticle physics
briefs.desc: This is the continuation of the Particle Physics I, with focus on more current research topics.

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文研究
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文研究
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 工場實習一
briefs.tags: 工場實習(Work Shop Practices), 智慧製造(Intelligent Manufacturing), 物聯網(Internet of Things), 車削(Turning), 銑削(Milling)
briefs.desc: 工具機和半導體製造設備

briefs.name: 工場實習
briefs.tags: 鉗工與量測,車床,銑床,數控機器,焊接,3D列印,CAD/CAM,手工具,玻璃加工, 智慧製造
briefs.desc: 本課程教學以實際機具操作為主，並輔以上課知識說明。主要實體操作內容共分十個項目，包括鉗工與量測、車床、銑床、電腦 數控(CNC)車床、電腦數控(CNC)銑床、基礎焊接、CAD/CAM及3D列印、基礎手工具及維修、玻璃加工、智慧製造概念實作。以 期培養學生對於機械製造技術、設備與加工原理、製造流程之基本能力，並初探最新的智慧製造概念與趨勢。

briefs.name: 工場實習
briefs.tags: 鉗工與量測,車床,銑床,數控機器,焊接,3D列印,CAD/CAM,手工具,玻璃加工, 智慧製造
briefs.desc: 本課程教學以實際機具操作為主，並輔以上課知識說明。主要實體操作內容共分十個項目，包括鉗工與量測、車床、銑床、電腦 數控(CNC)車床、電腦數控(CNC)銑床、基礎焊接、CAD/CAM及3D列印、基礎手工具及維修、玻璃加工、智慧製造概念實作。以 期培養學生對於機械製造技術、設備與加工原理、製造流程之基本能力，並初探最新的智慧製造概念與趨勢。

briefs.name: 機械設計製圖
briefs.tags: 機械設計、機構設計、工程設計、創新、製圖、CAD
briefs.desc: 本課程的撰寫重點在於：將工程實務、圖學理論、工具軟體三者結合成為一體，以迎接新世代的電腦輔助設計與繪圖。從設 計實務的觀點，進行圖學理論的介紹，清晰表達圖學的內涵；從軟體應用的觀點，進行設計繪圖的操作，完整發揮軟體的特 色； 並進一步加以整合構成電腦輔助設計圖學，並規劃實際之計畫範例，進行整合的工作，期使本課程能夠成為兼具學術及工程 價 值。課程所採用的軟體為Autodesk Inventor，是為3D參數式設計專家，涵蓋層面計有電腦輔助繪圖(CAD)、電腦輔助設計 製圖 (CADD)、電腦輔助工程(CAE)，從繪圖、設計、運動分析模擬、動態分析模擬、彩現擬真動畫，甚至發展到電腦輔助工業設 計 (CAID)，期待參與的同學能夠非常開心的來學習這門課程。

briefs.name: 機械設計製圖實作
briefs.nameEn: Practical Mechanical Computer Aided Design and Drawing (Practical ME CADD)
briefs.tags: Practical Mechanical Computer Aided Design and Drawing (Practical ME CADD)
briefs.desc: 機械設計製圖實作的規劃，延伸原本已經開課中的機械設計製圖課程，以專案導向的機械設計製圖為起點，系統化的連結到 設備與產品的工程開發基礎訓練，以及團隊設計研發的實務運作。課程內容中導入機械零組件設計製圖的工藝實務，讓學生 進一步把設計、製造、組裝、測試與品質考量綜合學習實踐；同步引進CAD軟體的進階設計模組訓練，讓學生經由實際設計製 圖及應用的過程，充分了解各個不同層面之間的關聯性，藉由這樣的機械設計製圖訓練為同學鋪路及打下基礎，造就學生可 以在後續專業課程的深層學習時更有感覺；同時，建立學員在設備與產品開發工程中，從需求、概念、具體到細部的方法與 流程的基礎能力，讓機械設計製圖的訓練可以滿足開發過程的每個階段不同需求；隨後並導入業界正式出圖的訓練，讓學生 在學期間就可以開始訓練具備職場水準；最終，本課程將透過專題及實作的方式讓學生實際設計、製作、組裝與測試，為學 生打下穩固的初階基礎，為學生後續在系上安排的各門專業科目深入學習與連結上更能得心應手。 本課程的實作部分，將同時兼顧傳統的減法製程(車銑鉋搪磨)，與近幾年進行的加法製程 (3D列印)，帶領學生以實作 的方式來實踐設計，學員的前置學習

briefs.name: 應用力學一
briefs.tags: 剛體、靜力平衡、牛頓定律、集中力、分佈力。Rigid body, static equilibrium, Newton's Law, Concentration force, Distribution force
briefs.desc: 本課程為固體力學之基礎，以質點或剛體之靜力平衡問題探討為主，動力學中的Newton定律亦會涵蓋。

briefs.name: 應用力學一
briefs.tags: Rigid-body mechanics, Equilibrium, Force balancs, Friction, Virtual Work
briefs.desc: Mechanics is the branch of the physical sciences that deals with the state of rest or motion of bodies that are subjected to the forces. There are three subjects in Mechanics: rigid-body mechanics, deformable-body mechanics, and fluid mechanics. This course will cover rigid-body mechanics. It is a basic requirement for the study of the mechanics of deformable bodies and mechanics of fluids. Rigid-body mechanics is essential for the design and analysis of many types of structural members, mechanical components, or electrical devices encountered in engineering.

briefs.name: 工程數學二
briefs.tags: 工程數學engineering mathematics, 微分方程式differential equations, 傅立葉轉換Fourier transforms, 向量微積分vector calculus
briefs.desc: Engineering mathematics is a branch of applied mathematics concerning mathematical methods and techniques that are typically used in engineering and industry. This interdisciplinary subject is motivated by engineers’ needs for practical and theoretical considerations.

briefs.name: 工程數學二
briefs.tags: vector calculus, Fourier analysis, partial differential equations, complex analysis
briefs.desc: Mathematical tools are essential in analysis and prediction for a wide range of engineering problems. Engineering mathematics is a post-calculus course for undergraduate students. It extends the discussion to various types of differential equations and advanced topics. Through class lectures, homework assignments, and exams, you will acquire the knowledge on some but not all the equations with engineering interest and be ready to utilize it in engineering problems such as fluid mechanics, solid mechanics, control theory, etc. Furthermore, you should have a good grasp of the physical meaning behind the math and be able to interpret the solution. This is a two-semester series.

briefs.name: 基礎熱流學二
briefs.tags: 流體力學, 層流, 紊流, 邊界層, 壓力, fluid dynamics, laminar flow, turbulent flow, boundary layer, pressure
briefs.desc: This course is the second part of Thermal and Fluid Science (I & II), which introduces the fundamentals of thermal science. In this semester, the main content introduces the fluid mechanics. Notice that the class instructed by Dr. Yu-Bin Chen will be delivered mainly (> 60%) in English.

briefs.name: 基礎熱流學二
briefs.tags: Dimensionless Analysis, Fluid Statics, Fluid Kinematics, Bernoulli Equation, Finite Control Volume Analysis, Differential Analysis of Fluid flow
briefs.desc: This course is the second part of Thermal and Fluid Science (I & II), which introduces the fundamentals of thermal science. In this semester, the main content is the fluid mechanics.

briefs.name: 應用力學二
briefs.tags: Dynamics;Work; Energy; Impulse; Momentum
briefs.desc: 動力學之基礎為靜力學，為此課程所需之先修課程，由於許多物體在日常生活中都是在運動狀態的，換言之，研究運動的變化與 造成這變化的各種因素為動力學主要討論的範圍，亦即研究的是力對於物體運動的影響為主，其基礎定律是牛頓運動定律。因 此，本課程設計將研習質點與剛體運動學與動力學，首先探討質點的運動，依序討論二維問題、三維的問題，進而探討剛體的運 動；在此部分，仍然由二維問題出發，接著討論較為複雜三維問題。動力學所教授的範圍涵蓋質點運動，質點的動力分析，質點 的能量、動量及其運用，質點系統，剛體運動，剛體平面運動的動力分析，剛體的能量、動量及其應用。希望藉由此課程協助學 生在工程力學領域建立清晰而完整的概念。

briefs.name: 固體力學與奈米材料實驗
briefs.tags: Solid mechanics, nanomaterials, experiment
briefs.desc: 以實驗方法讓同學瞭解機械系統固力與材料相關特性，實驗項目包括:奈米材料拉伸實驗、材料衝擊與硬度實驗、I型樑應 變量測、樑振動模態分析、扭轉振動、動平衡測試、挫曲實驗、穿透式光彈實驗、超音波非破壞性檢測 (實驗項目可能會視需 求與情況微幅調整)

briefs.name: 固體力學與奈米材料實驗
briefs.tags: Solid mechanics, nanomaterials, experiment
briefs.desc: 以實驗方法讓同學瞭解機械系統固力與材料相關特性，實驗項目包括:奈米材料拉伸實驗、材料衝擊與硬度實驗、I型樑應 變量測、樑振動模態分析、扭轉振動、動平衡測試、挫曲實驗、穿透式光彈實驗、超音波非破壞性檢測 (實驗項目可能會視需 求與情況微幅調整)

briefs.name: 固體力學與奈米材料實驗
briefs.tags: Solid mechanics, nanomaterials, experiment
briefs.desc: 以實驗方法讓同學瞭解機械系統固力與材料相關特性，實驗項目包括:奈米材料拉伸實驗、材料衝擊與硬度實驗、I型樑應 變量測、樑振動模態分析、扭轉振動、動平衡測試、挫曲實驗、穿透式光彈實驗、超音波非破壞性檢測 (實驗項目可能會視需 求與情況微幅調整)

briefs.name: 熱傳與質傳學
briefs.tags: heat conduction, heat convection, mass convection, heat radiation, heat and mass analogy
briefs.desc: This course introduces the physical processes, mathematical analyses, and relevant applications of the three branches of heat transfer, namely, heat conduction, heat convection and heat radiation. The convective mass transfer process is also discussed in parallel to heat convection.

briefs.name: 電子學一
briefs.tags: Diodes (二極體), Transistors (電晶體), MOS, BJT
briefs.desc: This course introduces modern electronics, or microelectronics, focusing on integrated-circuit (IC) technology that enables the creation of circuits with millions of components on a silicon chip approximately 100 mm² in size. The curriculum covers the analysis and design of circuits using semiconductor devices such as diodes (二極體) and transistors (電晶體). Building on the operational amplifiers (op-amps) studied in Electric Circuits, this course explores electronic devices that function independently or as part of an IC chip. Fundamental concepts and terminology will be introduced, with some advanced topics reserved for follow-up courses like Electronics II.

briefs.name: 電子學一
briefs.tags: Diodes (二極體), Transistors (電晶體), MOS, BJT, Multi-stage Transistors
briefs.desc: The subject of this course is modern electronics, a field that has been come to be known as microelectronics. Microelectronics refers to integrated-circuit (IC) technology that is capable of producing circuits containing millions of components in a tiny piece of silicon (known as a silicon chip) whose area is on the order of 100 mm2. This course deals with the analysis and design of circuits containing semiconductor devices, such as diodes (二極體) and transistors (電晶體). We already studied operational amplifiers (op-amp) in Electric Circuits, a very useful circuit building block. In this course we will study electronic devices that can be used singly or as a components of an IC Chip. We will learn some basic concepts and terminology. However, we will skip some sections, which will be studied in later courses, such as in Electronics II.

briefs.name: 電子電路實驗一
briefs.tags: 電路學實驗(Circuits experiments), 電子學實驗(electronics experiments), 理論與實際的印證(validation of theory and practice), 量測方法(measurement techniques), 儀器操作(instrumentation operation)
briefs.desc: This course begins with laboratory experiments designed to reinforce fundamental concepts from last semester’s Circuit Theory and this semester’s Electronics I. A limited portion of essential electrician-related skills is also incorporated to ensure safe and effective laboratory operation. As the semester advances, the experimental activities are systematically aligned with the topics covered in Electronic Circuits I, enabling students to translate newly acquired theoretical knowledge into practical application. Each laboratory session will commence with the teaching assistant (TA) providing an overview of the objectives and procedures. Students will then conduct the experiments under supervised conditions. At the conclusion of each session, the TA will review and verify the experimental results. Near the end of the semester, both a written examination and practical assessments will be administered to offer a comprehensive evaluation of students’ master

briefs.name: 電子電路實驗一
briefs.tags: 電路學實驗，電子學實驗，理論與實際的印證，量測方法，儀器操作
briefs.desc: 先以上學期電路學的授課內容執行實驗，讓學生更深入了解電路學所學到的內涵，再配合本學期電子學一的上課進度，執行實 驗。並落實電路學及電子學以實驗印證理論及分析理論與實驗的差距因素。每次實驗時，學習項目由助教解釋後進行，實驗課 結束時，將由助教檢查實驗結果，學期末進行筆試及實地操作，藉以評量本學期的學習成果。

briefs.name: 電動機械
briefs.tags: 電磁能轉換,變壓器,馬達,發電機,驅動器, Electromechanical energy conversion, Transformer, Motor, Generator, Driver
briefs.desc: 本課程將簡要說明電動機械的應用及重要性、結構及製造，介紹基本電磁學及磁路、電磁能轉換原理、電機運轉特性及分析，目 的在使學生了解電動機械的基本結構及原理。 This course will briefly introduce the significant feature, structure and manufacturing of electric machinery. We will focus on the introduction of basic engineering electromagnetics, the magnetic circuits, the principle of the electromechanical energy conversion and the principles of electric machinery.

briefs.name: 控制系統二
briefs.tags: Linear Systems, State Space, Full-State Feedback, Observer, Linearization, Discrete Design
briefs.desc: This course is a continuation of control systems (I). It particularly provides the students with basic knowledge in state-space design, digital control and nonlinear systems. As for the state-space design, it begins with reviewing linear-algebra fundamentals and introducing state-space description of linear systems. Students will then learn how to design the full-state feedback, the estimator and the dynamic compensator of the control system. In digital control, z-transform will be introduced first and controller design using digital equivalents will then be covered. Finally, we will introduce some basic analysis and design tools for nonlinear control systems.

briefs.name: 邏輯設計與應用
briefs.tags: 數位邏輯、電路、布林代數、邏輯閘、正反器, digital logic, circuits, Boolean algebra, logic gates, flip-flops
briefs.desc: Teaching Goals: 本課程旨在介紹數位邏輯電路的基本特性及設計，並提供設計數位系統所使用的基本原理與概念 Learning Goals: 學生可培養基本數位邏輯電路設計的能力，並具備進階課程或實作的基礎

briefs.name: 生醫微型系統晶片
briefs.tags: Microsystem Chips; Lab on Chips; Microfabrication; Bio-MicroElectroMechanical Systems; BioMedical chip technology
briefs.desc: The Goal of the course is to provide Undergraduate students with basic concepts, principles, novel design of Microsystem LabChips for the applications of biomedicine/microfluidics/precise medicine as well as Lab chip microfabrication techniques. This course also aims at encouraging students to read state-of-the-art technology papers and present their thinking professionally to build up global view and capability.

briefs.name: 振動學
briefs.tags: Vibration, damping, harmonically excitation, impulse response, multi degree of freedom system, continuous vibration system
briefs.desc: This course is aimed to deliver the basic concept of dynamic vibration analysis to the undergraduate students, including some advanced topics such as multi-degree-of-freedom systems and vibration of bars and beams. The topic covers the mathematical description on the one- and multi-degree-of- freedom systems, free and forced vibration systems, and continuous vibration system.

briefs.name: 奈米科技與應用
briefs.tags: Nanotechnology, micro fabrication process, nanoelectromechancial systems, sensors, actuators
briefs.desc: This course is intended for the university student who would like to expose herself or himself to the field of microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) and nanoelectromechanical systems (NEMS). This course will focus on the microfabrication technologies, micromechanics, and applications of micro- and nano-devices.

briefs.name: 光機電系統設計
briefs.tags: product system design, innovation, team work, mechatronics, optics
briefs.desc: Opto-Mechatronic Systems Design requires students to form small groups and each group to produce a concept of innovative product and complete feasibility study/demonstration and a pre-business plan in staged exercises. The process of engineering system design is introduced through case studies and design projects. The objective is for students: 1. To learn about the process of designing a system with multi-disciplinary subsystems. 2. To learn about designing creative engineering product/solution. 3. To learn about design as a group activity. The course is offered in English with hands-on prototype building activities.

briefs.name: 專題研究二
briefs.desc: 「專題研究」課程透過實際設計與實驗操作，讓學生對入學以來所習知識與技能得進一步實踐及體驗。透過組成二至四人團隊， 落實培養學生團隊合作之精神。

briefs.name: 專題研究一
briefs.desc: 「專題研究」課程透過實際設計與實驗操作，讓學生對入學以來所習知識與技能得進一步實踐及體驗。透過組成二至四人團隊， 落實培養學生團隊合作之精神。

briefs.name: 機器人製作與競賽實務專題
briefs.nameEn: Design and Manufacture for Robot Competition Project
briefs.tags: 機器人、機構致動系統、定位與導航系統、行銷與公關等之設計與執行流程、機器人競賽; Robotics, Mechanism Driving System, Location and Guiding, Promotion and Public Relation, Competition of Robots
briefs.desc: 配合動各領域所學，讓學生了解機器人設計與製作的工程技術與知識，參加競賽的統籌與配合。藉由清大DIT Robotics團隊 多年來的設計、製作機器人及國內外重要競賽之經驗，讓修課學生學習各系統，包括:底盤系統、手臂機構制動系統、定位與導 航系統、視覺辨識系統、驅動程式、人工智慧、團隊行銷、公關與美宣等之設計與執行流程，以及機器人製作之核心概念;同 時，介紹、執行國內、國際所參與的重要移動機器人比賽的流程與重點注意事項。讓學生進行分組，針對前述不同系統，做更深 入的研究，在學期結束時由全班同學配合完成Eurobot、國內其他重要機器人競賽或分組之機器人設計與製作，並能實際demo或 是參與競賽。

briefs.name: 微機電系統導論
briefs.tags: MEMS, semiconductor, fabrication processes, micro device design, 微機電, 半導體, 製程技術, 微元件設計
briefs.desc: 微機電技術是實現微型傳感器的關鍵技術，目前已廣泛應用於手持式電子、消費性電子、車用電子等產品。微機電技術結 合感測、無線通信、雲端計算等技術，可進一步應用於智慧生活、物聯網(IoT)等頗受矚目的領域。由於微機電技術主要以 半導體製程相關之微加工技術製造微機械元件，簡言之，微機電結合機械設計和半導體製程兩項關鍵技術，且其設計和製 程有密不可分的關係。 因此，本課程將介紹如何利用半導體製程，設計與製造機械元件於晶片，並說明其面對的問題與挑戰。也希望透過此課 程，擴展機械與電機背景同學的視野，培養跨領域的人才。

briefs.name: 智慧製造導論
briefs.tags: Intelligent manufacturing, Cyber-Physical Systems, Digital twin
briefs.desc: This course aims at the Cyber-Physical Systems and applications for intelligent manufacturing system. In this course, we will introduce the automation for the manufacturing systems, sensors and Industrial visualization. The course content includes digital twin concept, Industrial IOT technology and AR technology.

briefs.name: 專利分析與侵權
briefs.tags: 智慧財產權, 專利檢索, 專利分析, 侵權, 舉發
briefs.desc: 目前產業界在開發新興技術與應用之外，面臨到一個新的瓶頸為專利侵權與專利訴訟等問題。有鑑於此，為使學生早日對於專利 的相關知識有所瞭解，並藉由期末報告的舉發或侵權鑑定對專利有更深一層認識。 以建立學生專利基本知識為基礎，透過專利搜尋檢索、閱讀與分析的能力建立，針對特定技術主題進行專利地圖之製作，並透過 舉發或侵權等實例讓學生瞭解產業上實務的攻防。

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: 演講, Seminar, 研究經驗, Research Experience, 業界經驗 Industrial Experience
briefs.desc: 本課程為動力機械工程學系研究所同學的必修課程，每週舉行一次，每次約 2 小時，邀請國內外各相關領域的專家或產業不 同領域的實踐者至本系演講。

briefs.name: 科技論文寫作及研究方法
briefs.nameEn: Writing of Scientific Papers and Research Methods
briefs.tags: Scientific paper, SCI paper, conference paper, thesis writing, academic ethics
briefs.desc: 1. 論文寫作概論 2. 科技論文寫作 - 題目如何選定 - 如何決定作者順序 - 如何撰寫”摘要” - 如何撰寫”前言” - 如何撰寫”材料與方法” - 如何撰寫”結果” - 如何撰寫”討論” - 如何撰寫”結論” - 如何撰寫”致謝辭” - 如何撰寫參考文獻 - 如何製作表格 - 如何製作圖形 -“學術慣例” 3. 科技論文寫作實例探討 - 會議論文 - 期刊論文 - 綜論文章 - 學位論文 - 口頭報告 4. 常見問題探討 5. 學術倫理 6. 研究方法概論

briefs.name: 高等應用數學
briefs.tags: 線性代數 (Linear algebra), 矩陣 (Matrix), 線性方程式 (Linear Equation), 變分法 (Calculus of variation), 漸近分析 (Asymptotic analysis)
briefs.desc: 首先加強大學的線性代數內容，這是工程計算的基礎知識，而後介紹數學變分法與漸進法理論，擴展大學部工程數學的範圍，再 進一步應用於工程領域，可提供工程領域研究生所需的數學知識。

briefs.name: 生物力學
briefs.tags: Size and Scaling, Biological Materials, Biofluids, Biolocomotion, Bio-inspired Design
briefs.desc: This course explores the mechanical principles governing biological systems across the diversity of life. Using Steven Vogel's "Comparative Biomechanics" as our foundation, we will investigate how organisms of different sizes, shapes, and lifestyles interact with physical forces in their environments. The course emphasizes comparative approaches, examining how evolutionary solutions to mechanical problems vary across taxa and scales. Students will develop quantitative reasoning skills and gain appreciation for the engineering principles that constrain and enable biological design.

briefs.name: 進階微流體系統
briefs.tags: 奈微流體生醫系統 、微幫浦、 微混合器 、細胞晶片、 組織晶片
briefs.desc: This course is designed for graduate students who have taken fundamental courses in Microfluidics (such as PME 5170 Thermo-fluidics in Bio-MEMS). It will cover advanced topics in microfluidics, including critical microfluidic devices and integrated microfluidic systems. Their biomedical applications for DNA, RNA, proteins, and cells will be extensively investigated.

briefs.name: 可壓縮流體力學
briefs.tags: Compressible Flow, Modern Compressible Flow
briefs.desc: 教導學生明瞭可壓縮流體之特性及流動所呈現的物理現象；教導學生描述與分析可壓縮流場的方法與技巧，期使學生能將所學的 知識應用於自然現象的解釋以及相關科技的改進與擴展。

briefs.name: 熱對流
briefs.tags: 強制對流熱傳 (Forced Convection Heat Transfer); 自然對流熱傳 (Natural Convection Heat Transfer); 邊界層流熱傳(Boundary lay-er Heat Transfer) ; 管流熱傳 (Duct Heat Transfer); 自由剪切流熱傳 (Free Shear Flow Heat Transfer); 層流熱傳 (Laminar Heat Transfer); 紊流熱傳 (Turbulent Heat Transfer)
briefs.desc: 詳細推導均勻混和物與物種質量保守方程、動量保守及能量保守統治方程式；介紹速度、溫度及濃度邊界層觀念；認 識熱對流的基本原理、數學模式及分析求解方法：包括相似變數解法、積分解法及尺度分析解法。本課程分層流熱傳 與紊流熱傳兩部份。

briefs.name: 電子裝備冷卻系統
briefs.tags: Electronics Cooling, Thermal Management, Heat Sink, Heat Pipe, Evaporation and Condensation, Data Center Cooling
briefs.desc: 本「電子裝備冷卻系統」課程內容涵蓋電子裝備冷卻的熱流學基礎、導熱界面材料、熱擴散、風扇簡介、熱沉、相變化熱 傳與裝置、智慧手機熱管理、資料中心熱管理等，面向頗廣，尚無適當教科書可採用，因此除課堂講授外，另要求同學閱 讀不少文獻並繳交心得報告。

briefs.name: 冷凍空調系統模擬與熱交換
briefs.nameEn: Heat exchangers and System simulation of HVAC
briefs.tags: THIS COURSE IS DESIGNED TO TEACH THE STUDENTS FROM THE BASIC LAWS OF THERMODYNAMICS AND
briefs.desc: This course is designed to teach the students from the basic laws of thermodynamics and principles of refrigeration,airconditioning and heat exchangers and combine these three topics to a text of HVAC system design/analysis. This training is not only learning how to design or select the component but also learning how to do system simulation and analysis. 本課程從冷凍空調原理及熱交換器設計理論開始，並進而結合冷凍空調系統與熱交換器間之關係。課程目標除了培養學生對 實際系統之整合設計能力外，並經由系統模擬之概念及方法拓展對系統之研發能力。

briefs.name: 兩相流
briefs.tags: two phase flow, boiling, condensation, evaporation, melting, solidification
briefs.desc: This course focuses on heat and fluid transport phenomena associated with phase change processes. Topics include thermodynamics of phase change, evaporation, condensation, nucleation and bubble growth, two phase flow, convective boiling and condensation, melting and solidification.

briefs.name: IC封裝模流分析
briefs.tags: IC封裝模流分析, 自由液面流, 毛細流, 氣泡, 計算流體力學, moldflow in IC packaging, free surface flow, capillary-driven flow, air bubble, computational fluid dynamics
briefs.desc: IC封裝(packaging)是晶片製程末端的重要工序之一。由於晶片內部構造尺度極為微小，難以利用傳統的加壓方式推動塑膠液 充填晶片內部空隙。毛細力(capillary force)遂成為此項工藝的主要動力來源。惟毛細現象受制於許多物理因素而不易控 制，諸如表面張力、靜態與動態接觸角、黏滯係數、擬充填之空隙形狀等。本課程將詳細介紹一些已發展成熟的數值分析技術， 以探討毛細現象及IC封裝過程可能出現的包氣及漏液等瑕疵。

briefs.name: 渦輪機
briefs.tags: gas turbine, propulsion, jet engine, turbomachinery, rocket
briefs.desc: 介紹渦輪機之理論、熱力學與流體力學之相關理論、航空器噴射引擎、進氣道、燃燒室與噴嘴。本課程之教學目標在建立渦輪機 之基本解晰能力及解決實際問題之素養，即經由基本原理之了解，建立吸氣式推進系統之分析能力，以創造工程之價值。教學內 容包括渦輪機基本原理，採用理想氣體穩態一維流體理論探討流體之動力與熱力循環分析, 進氣道,壓縮機,燃燒室,渦輪機,噴 嘴之基本原理及噴射推進基本裝置原理等。

briefs.name: 燃料電池及氫能
briefs.tags: fuel cell, hydrogen energy, electrochemistry, clean energy, carbon neutral
briefs.desc: ◆ Learn basic principles of fuel cell operation ◆ Learn battery structure, process, and testing technology ◆ Learn the application of fuel cells and energy management in daily life

briefs.name: 生醫微熱流
briefs.tags: 微流體系統(microfluidics), 微全分析系統(MicroTAS), 生醫晶片(Bio Chip or Lab on a Chip), 微閥及微幫浦(Microvalve and Micropump), and 微製程(Microfabrication).
briefs.desc: Microfluidics is rapidly emerging as an enabling technology, with applications ranging from unmanned aerial vehicles to biomedical applications to drug discovery and delivery. Given the importance of micro/nano mechanical and fluidic phenomena, it is necessary to understand the fluid mechanics, heat and mass transfer, chemistry, biochemistry and engineering principles on which the design of devices is based. These courses are essential in understanding the behavior of fluid flow (droplet) through nano/micro scales for bio-applications.

briefs.name: 移動機器人與自駕車
briefs.tags: 人工智慧 Artificial Intelligence、控制理論 Control Theory、機器學習 Machine Learning、程式設計 Programming 、自主駕駛 Autonomous Driving
briefs.desc: This course gives an overview of mobile robots and self-driving cars controlled by an artificial intelligence system that makes movement decisions autonomously using a variety of sensing data. The AI system is introduced from mathematical (machine learning and classical planning), physical (control, actuation, and dynamics), computational (algorithms and software engineering), and implemental (coding and deployment) aspects. Machine learning includes supervised (deep neural networks for visionary data) and unsupervised (for radar data) learning. AI based control and dynamic theories are the main focus of the course, which are emerging in robotics research. Project assignments aim at deploying students’ algorithms to a Toyota car and a wheeled robot for real-world tests.

briefs.name: 機器人學
briefs.tags: robot mechanisms, dynamics, motion planning, control design, actuator, sensor
briefs.desc: This course provides an overview of robot mechanisms, dynamics, and intelligent controls. Topics include planar and spatial kinematics, multi- rigid-body dynamics, motion planning, control design, actuators, and sensors, and so on. Laboratory assignments provide experience with servo drives, sensors, interface circuitry, microprocessor-based real-time control,and Robot Operating System (ROS) programming. Students will design and fabricate working robotic systems in a group-based term project.

briefs.name: 電腦輔助製造專題
briefs.tags: Special Projects, Computer, Manufacturing
briefs.desc: The objectives of this course are for students to: Gain an introductory understanding of the state-of-the-art developments in selected topics related to modern manufacturing processes and equipment, particularly those that involve extensive use of computer control and software. Learn the fundamental physical and engineering principles underlying these processes and equipment, as well as the key issues associated with them. Acquire basic skills in using a CAD/CAM software tool (Creo/MasterCAM), and apply the tool to design a product component, design a mold for manufacturing the component, and produce the component through both virtual simulation and physical machine tools (subject to resource availability). Develop the ability to search, read, and report on industrial/product information and academic research papers related to these processes and equipment.

briefs.name: 微奈米製造技術
briefs.tags: 微影Lithography, X-ray Lithography, E-beam Lithography, Interference Lithography, RIE, Electroplating, Photoresist and Developlment Process
briefs.desc: 本課程透過微奈米技術的發展史, 一步一步帶領學生認識各種微奈米加工技術, 其中包含 黃光微影技術(Lithography), 電子束微影(E-beam Lithography), 離子束微影(Ion-beam Lithography), 反應式離子蝕刻(Reactive Ion Etching), 電鍍(Electroplating), 成型技術(Molding), 雙光子聚合(Two-Photon Polymerization) 期末並安排半導體相關企業或是國家實驗室參訪, 讓同學能對微奈米加工技術, 有所認識。

briefs.name: 光電子學
briefs.tags: Modulation, optoelectronics, photonics, semiconductor, waveguide, 半導體、光子學、光電子學、波導、調變
briefs.desc: The goal of this course is to provide the background knowledge for understanding the working principles of various optoelectronic devices, as well as their applications. Starting from the fundamentals such as wave properties of light, solid state physics and polarization, followed by optoelectronics devices, including light emitting, detection, modulation and transmission devices, students may expect to gain sufficient concepts of optoelectronics for their own studies.

briefs.name: 應用光學設計
briefs.tags: 光學系統 Optical systems, 光學元件 Optical components, 波動光學 Wave optics, 積體光路 Photonic Integrated Circuits, 光學感測器 Optical sensors
briefs.desc: 光學系統在通訊、感測及新興的高速運算與量子運算領域中具有不可或缺的應用。近年來，積體光路 (Photonic Integrated Circuit, PIC) 更被視為推動微系統性能進步的關鍵技術。本課程旨在使學生深入了解應用光學系統中基礎元 件的原理與設計，並結合系統化耦合的考量，為開發先進集成式光學系統奠定必要的知識與概念基礎。 Optical systems play an indispensable role in fields such as communication, sensing, and emerging technologies like high-speed computing and quantum computing. Moreover, in recent years, Photonic Integrated Circuits (PICs) have been regarded as a key technology for further advancing the performance of microsystems. This course aims to provide students with a thorough understanding of the principles and design of fundamental components in applied optical systems, along with the considerations for system integration, equipping the students with the essential knowledge and concepts required to develop advanced integrated optical systems.

briefs.name: 生醫感測器與生物電子學
briefs.tags: Biosensor, Bioelectronics, Microfluidics, BioMEMS, Nanotechnology
briefs.desc: The course is designed to provide the advanced students with knowledge and methods required for the design, fabrication and characterization of biosensors and bioelectronics for biochemical, biomedical, clinical and environmental applications. The fundamentals of molecular recognition, biomolecular immobilization, transduction mechanism will be covered in the discussion of various biosensors. In addition, the basic electronic biosignal conditioning circuits and processing methods will be introduced. The integration of bioelectronics with biosensors and bioarrays will be discussed to build lab-on-a-chip systems.

briefs.name: 智慧製造應用及實務
briefs.desc: 提供修課學生了解關於AI在智慧製造的應用，主要以智慧工廠所需的AI相關元素進行說明，以機器視覺影像辨識與設備預兆診 斷兩大技術主題為應用主軸，並提供相關應用案例與實作課程。

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文研究
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 非線性控制系統
briefs.tags: Nonlinear Systems, Phase Plane Analysis, Lyapunov Theory, Stability Analysis, Feedback Linearization, Backstepping Control, Sliding Mode Control, 非線性系統, 相平面分析, 李亞普諾夫理論, 穩定性分析, 回授線性化, 逆向步進控制, 順滑模態控制
briefs.desc: The goal of this course is to give the basic concepts and professional techniques in nonlinear control systems, which can be applied to the nonlinear control and other engineering design. This course can help train students’ expertise in the field of power mechanical engineering, ability to perform projects, and ability to solve problems independently. In the future, the students can do academic research and physical projects. 本課程的目的是提供非線性控制系統的基本概念和專業技術，其可被應用於非線性控制和其他工程設計。本課程有助於培養學生 動力機械工程領域的專業知識、專案實施能力和獨立解決問題的能力。未來，學生可以進行學術研究和實際專題。

briefs.name: 結構最佳化設計
briefs.tags: Taguchi Experimental Design, Classical Optimization Tools, Unconstrained Optimization, Constrained Optimization, Genetic Algorithm, Machine Learning
briefs.desc: This is a graduate course on optimal structural design and theory for engineering applications. The course aims at providing the student with a first exposure to a rational integration of traditional design methodologies with concepts and techniques of modern optimization theory and practice for constrained/unconstrained, single-objective/multi-objective optimization problems. In addition, various design sensitivity analysis techniques are also included. Furthermore, existing engineering applications using design optimization techniques are also addressed. In principle, the student learns to create appropriate mathematical optimization models for structural design problems, and to use analytical and computational techniques to solve them.

briefs.name: 電子封裝力學概論
briefs.tags: Electronic packaging, 電子封裝、Thermal and Mechanical Behavior、機械與熱行為、Future Trends、未來趨勢
briefs.desc: Suggested Prerequisite Courses: Finite Element Methods, Mechanics of Materials This course, Introduction to mechanics of electronic packaging, will give an introduction on conventional and advanced electronic packaging technology, structure design, material characteristics, analysis and predict the mechanical behavior of components under thermal loading.

briefs.name: 板殼理論
briefs.tags: Elements of Plate-Bending Theory, Plates of Various Geometries and Forms, Membrane Stresses in Shells, Bending Stresses in Shells, Applications
briefs.desc: In this course, principles of beam, plate, and shell theories and their applications to some structural elements, including domes, pressure vessels, tanks and pipes will be introduced.

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文研究
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 專題演講
briefs.tags: 生物標記, 微流體, 液態切片, 伴隨式診斷, 精準醫療, 次世代定序, 奈米材料, 影像醫學
briefs.desc: 本課程邀請精準醫療、數位健康、生醫工程、癌症生物學與轉譯醫學等領域的專家，分享新興研究成果與實務應用；內容將涵 蓋生醫電子、奈米科技、生醫材料、臨床微流體技術、神經工程、疾病模式及新型治療策略等。透過演講與引導式討論，學生 將學習跨領域技術如何推動早期診斷、藥物開發及精準醫療落地應用。期待學生能積極參與、批判性分析並反思新興科技對生 醫研究與臨床轉譯的影響。

briefs.name: 生物資料庫與生物標記探勘：基礎到臨床應用
briefs.nameEn: Biological Databases and Biomarker Discovery: From Fundamentals to Clinical Applications
briefs.tags: 生物資料庫 (Biobank), 分子流行病學 (Molecular Epidemiology), 基因體 (Genomics), 生物標記 (Biomarker), 基因資料庫 (Genomic Database), 蛋白質資料庫 (Proteomic Database), 高通量數據 (High-Throughput Data)
briefs.desc: 本課程聚焦於生物資料庫與生物標記之應用，從國際與國內的資料庫發展趨勢出發，涵蓋分子流行病學、基因體與蛋白質研究， 以及高通量數據的分析方法。課程內容不僅著重於理論基礎，更強調實務操作，包括基因與蛋白質資料庫的應用、臨床資料庫驗 證生物標記的案例分析，以及進階生物標記探尋的策略。透過專題討論與實戰演練，學生將能培養整合多源資料、發掘潛在生物 標記的能力，並理解其於臨床轉譯與新藥開發中的價值。此課程適合對生物資訊、生物醫學研究及精準醫療應用有興趣的學生， 並期望訓練其跨領域研究思維與獨立解決問題的能力。

briefs.name: 精準醫療檢測概論
briefs.tags: 診斷方法學, 醫療器材, 單細胞分析, 多體學, 液態活檢, Diagnostics, Medical Devices, Single-cell Analysis, Multi-omics, Liquid Biopsy
briefs.desc: 本課程旨在介紹精準醫療（precision medicine）中「檢測技術（diagnostics）」的核心概念與應用。著重在醫療器材工作 原理、診斷方法學、多體學、以及新興技術在生物醫學檢測中的應用，例如智慧ok繃(smart bandage/band-aid)、多模態生 醫感測(multi-modal biosensing)、單細胞分析（single-cell analysis）、液態活檢（liquid biopsy）。課程將採混合 式教學方式：以教師講課、文獻導讀與小組討論、學生報告學術論文等形式交叉進行，藉此拓展學生對該領域之知識、訓練邏 輯思考、提升表達能力、與精進交互討論技巧。理解從研究室檢測技術開發到臨床實際應用的鴻溝與過程，培養跨領域整合能 力，為未來投入精準醫療、醫療器材開發、生醫產業、或臨床轉譯研究奠定基礎。

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: Seminar, Active reading comprehension, Logic thinking skills, Presentational skills, Questionary skills
briefs.desc: 透過報告學術論文訓練同學下列能力 (1) 主動式閱讀論文 (Active reading comprehension), (2) 邏輯思考能力的訓練 (Logic thinking skills), (3) 表達能力(Presentational skills), (4) 交互討論技巧 (Questionary skills) 。

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文研究
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 計算機程式設計
briefs.tags: Python程式語言設計, 物件導向程式設計, 網路爬蟲, 資料處理與分析, 機器學習, 生成式人工智慧, Python, Computer programming, object-oriented programming (OOP), Web crawler, Data processing and analysis, Machine learning, Generative AI.
briefs.desc: 本課程授課對象為已修過計財系<資訊工程導論>，並具備Python基礎程式設計能力的學生。主要是教授如何運用Python計算 機程式語言結合數據收集、處理與分析來撰寫應用程式，並透過程式結合AI解決財務金融相關問題並瞭解相關實務應用。 將使學生能夠熟悉如何以Python程式語言、程式庫及執行應用等技巧，培養程式設計與開發的能力以及人工智慧觀念與應 用，以期未來運用於進階財金相關問題或金融科技創新。課堂上會進行程式撰寫練習與實作，請自備筆記型電腦(Laptop)或 有配置瀏覽器軟體(Browser)的上網設備，如:平板電腦。 註:本課程為延續計財系<資訊工程導論>之進階Python程式設計課程，強烈建議先修過<資訊工程導論>課程並具備Python基 本語法能力後再選修本課程。

briefs.name: 會計學二
briefs.tags: 國際會計準則(IFRSs), 美國財務會計準則(US GAAP), 財務會計(Financial Accounting)
briefs.desc: The purpose of this course is to understand the languages of business. First, students have to know the trend and development of IFRS. Second, students must know how to identify, measure, and recognize the entity’s business activities. Third, students need to understand what financial statements present.

briefs.name: 會計學二
briefs.tags: 會計，Accounting，Financial Accounting，初級，會計二
briefs.desc: 幫助同學瞭解與學習財務會計的基本原理、原則

briefs.name: 會計學二
briefs.tags: 不動產、廠房及設備Property, Plant and Equipmen,無形資產Intangible asset,生物資產Biological asset,非流動負債Non-current liabilities,投資Investment,權益Equity,現金流量表Statement of cash flows
briefs.desc: 本課程之目標在於使同學瞭解會計學之基本原理原則、會計報表之內涵及其分析方法，讓同學經由財務會計專業知識與理論規範 之學習理解，加強培養財務報告解讀及分析能力，以助於日後了解企業的經營成果，幫助釐清財務環境及運用財務報表制定適切 的決策。

briefs.name: 統計學二
briefs.tags: 機率、抽樣分佈、假設檢定、變異數分析、線性迴歸模型, probability, sampling distributions, hypothesis testing, ANOVA, linear regression models
briefs.desc: 本課程旨在建立學生對統計學的基本認識與應用能力，特別強調從實際資料中進行科學化的分析與推論。統計學二之課程內容涵 蓋機率理論、抽樣分配、假設檢定、變異數分析及線性迴歸模型等主題。透過課堂講授與範例演練，學生將能掌握資料整理與分 析的基本方法，並能將統計工具應用於實務問題之解決與決策制定，為後續進階統計或相關領域的學習奠定基礎。 The main goal of this course is to provide students the fundamental probability theory and the necessary tools for the analysis of actual and realistic data. To this aim, the course will cover the following topics: probability, sampling distributions, hypothesis testing, ANOVA and linear regression models.

briefs.name: 公司理財
briefs.tags: investment, real options, optimal capital structure, payout, working capital and risk management
briefs.desc: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the core principles of corporate finance and equips students with a rigorous, analytical framework for thinking about optimal corporate decisions. We will explore the economic determinants that drive key corporate policies, specifically concerning investment (capital budgeting), financing (capital structure), and payout policy. The focus is on developing a decision-making toolkit that bridges financial theory with real-world practice, preparing students to analyze and solve critical financial challenges faced by modern firms.

briefs.name: 公司理財
briefs.tags: 公司理財 corporate finance 資本預算 capital strucutre 股利政策 dividend policy 代理問題 agency problem
briefs.desc: After having the basic knowledge of financial management, in this semester we will learn the core principle of corporate finance. In first topic, we will learn what is the efficient capital markets and behavioral finance. In the second topic, we will learn the theory of capital structure and the capital budgeting for the levered firm. In the third topic, we will learn the corporate payout through the theory of dividend policy. The fourth big topic is the introduction of derivative and how they are used in corporate finance. Finally, we briefly introduce the corporate control in mergers & acquisitions.

briefs.name: 公司理財
briefs.tags: 資本結構, 資本預算, 股利政策, 企業購併, 公司理財
briefs.desc: 本課程探討財務管理後半內容，包含效率市場、資本結構、有舉債情況下的資本預算、股利政策、營運資金管理與短期融資。第二 部份為財務專題，包含企業購併、破產重整。同學將藉由本課程，深入瞭解公司融資與籌資決策與財務操作背後意涵，更甚於財管 課程。

briefs.name: 高等微積分一
briefs.tags: 實數, real number, 極限/limits, 收斂, Convergence, 微分, derivative ,積分, Integration
briefs.desc: 本課程為分析入門，主要內容為實變數函數的微分及積分理論，無窮數列和級數的收斂發散，第一學期學習單變數函數、第二學 期學習多變數函數。 學習抽象的數學定義、熟悉嚴謹的論證、培養邏輯思考及解決問題能力。

briefs.name: 衍生性商品訂價
briefs.tags: 選擇權，選擇權定價，選擇權交易，選擇權避險，交換，
briefs.desc: 本課程涵蓋的內容： 1.選擇權：選擇權的定價、選擇權的交易、股票選擇權、利率選擇權、期貨選擇權、新奇選擇權 2.選擇權避險：選擇權的敏感度指標、組合保險、選擇權的動態避險 3 交換：利率交換、利率交換的中介、信用利差的比較利益、其他類型的利率交換、通貨交換

briefs.name: 衍生性商品訂價
briefs.tags: 布萊克-休斯模型The Black-Scholes model，隨機過程Stochastic processes，風險值 VaR ，數值方法Numerical procedures，避險Hedge
briefs.desc: 本課程將涵蓋連續時間之下的衍生性金融商品訂價理論及多個相關議題

briefs.name: 財務決策分析
briefs.tags: Financial Management、Investment、Capital、Financial Statement、Cash Flow
briefs.desc: 本課程由最基礎的財務報表、比率分析開始，讓學生明瞭最實用的財務知識，進而引領學生瞭解公司的內部治理與投資決策，並結合當下 時事培養學生對金融議題的敏感度。藉由網路大規模的學習，幫助大量學員們瞭解財務報表、風險、權益成本…等金融財務知識，並提升 金融知識的水準，進而瞭解相關時事議題。此外，透過網路的幫忙，幫助學員們學習不間斷，隨時隨地都能提升財務知識的水準。

briefs.name: 不動產市場管理
briefs.tags: 房地產概論, 不動產市場,住宅政策,房市政策,房價
briefs.desc: 「不動產市場管理」課程是兼顧理論與實務的課程，為使初學者認識不動產的學術及實務領域，課程首先介紹介紹不動產之基 本概念，包括不動產界定與範圍、土地與房地產之描述與特性、不動產類型，接續探討不動產投資、生產、交易、使用等過 程，並介紹不動產相關學科及行業等範疇，使同學了解本學門未來發展性。在實務知識方面，針對不動產交易相關法規(如不 動產買賣契約、消費者保護法、公平交易法和公寓大廈管理條例等)，以法條和實際糾紛案例說明，使同學了解實務發生的問 題，並能將課堂所學運用於生活經驗，從建立基礎知識導入自身生活經驗，引發同學學習動機，並從問題導向訓練解決問題的 思考邏輯。 本學期將要求同學參觀個案進行分組報告，不動產的學習必須實際觀察培養個人觀點，透過個案參觀培養學生判斷個案優缺點 能力，而分組報告可藉由同儕學習不同組員觀點，並藉由課堂報告要求培養簡報能力。

briefs.name: 金融大數據
briefs.tags: R programming language, data science, business analytic, computational statistics, visualization
briefs.desc: The goal of this course is to help students to handle financial data using R computer language. More specifically, the course will help students to write R programs to conduct financial analytics, while the purpose of financial analytics is to transform financial data to insights (through visualization in particular) that support, improve, and automate financial decisions. The majority of class time will be used to explain various R language skills so that students can eventually use R to do a real-world financial analysis. In addition to the general knowledge on R programming language, a special type of R commands from the so-called `tidyverse' system will also be taught in depth. An important area of R usage is time series analysis which will be covered extensively in the class, This knowledge will then be applied to financial prices and this hopefully will be useful for students who are interested in quantitative finance.

briefs.name: 不動產財務管理(磨課師)
briefs.tags: mortgage、prepayments、defaults、mortgage-backed security、mortgage derivatives
briefs.desc: This course examines the convergence of real estate and the capital markets. It is an advanced course in real estate finance and covers the structure, analysis, and valuation of a variety of real estate securities including: residential mortgage backed securities (MBS), collateralized mortgage obligations (CMOs), mortgage servicing rights (MSR), reverse mortgage, and mortgage-related derivatives.

briefs.name: 投資實務研討(磨課師)
briefs.tags: 投資學Investments，投資組合Portfolio，股票Stocks，債券Bonds，報酬Return，風險Risk
briefs.desc: 為學生建構正確的投資觀念，有系統的講解金融市場的運作，進而使其有信心地進入投資的世界。教學影片講解清晰，化繁為 簡，並援引生活實例增近學生對於教材的理解及加深對於理論的印象。利用免費平台模擬股市操作，引領學生嘗試接觸投資實 務，將可大大強化其財富智商(MQ)，是每位學生必備的個人理財指引。

briefs.name: 操盤人講堂
briefs.tags: 基金管理 / Fund Management; 基金經理人 / Fund Managers; 投資 / Investment; 清華永續基金 / Tsing Hua Endowment Fund 交易 / Trading
briefs.desc: 本課程將邀請來自金融各領域(包括投信、銀行、保險、信用評等機構等)的專業人士，分享其在金融市場中的第一線實戰經 驗。課程內容不僅著重於如何操作大型資金，還會深入探討專業法人面對市場波動的應對策略。同學將有機會學習專業操盤人建 構投資組合的思路，並了解其如何在不同市況下追求穩定獲利的策略，為未來進入投資領域打下實務基礎。

briefs.name: 國際財務管理
briefs.tags: MNC跨國企業, exchange rate risk management 率風險, international investment國際投資, currency deirvatives匯率衍生性商品, international arbitrage國際套利
briefs.desc: The course focuses on the financial activities from a multinational corporation’s viewpoint. It provides students a systematical approach to learn and think from the perspective of financial manager. There are four major parts covered in this course: I. the international financial environment II. exchange rate behavior III. exchange rate risk management and IV. international investment. The following concepts will be introduced and discussed: international capital and foreign exchange market, the advantage of international diversification and foreign investment assessment.

briefs.name: 創新產業與企業社會責任
briefs.tags: 創新產業
briefs.desc: 透過介紹創新產業及分享企業實務運作，讓學生瞭解各產業之營運模式及上中下游合作模式；除可加強學生之產業知識外、了解 各產業實務與所學之關聯，並可藉此培養蒐集、彙總資料的能力及個人口條、台風的訓練，以增加自己的價值。

briefs.name: 金融與新創科技經營實務與案例研討
briefs.nameEn: FinTech and Innovation Management – A Case Study Approach
briefs.tags: 金融、科技
briefs.desc: 本課程將以互動溝通和多元學習以及案例研討的方式，幫助學生瞭解金融科技與新創公司的各個實務面向：包括科技應用、商業 模式、營運實務、及市場運作等，以期培養學生對金融相關的創新應用生態圈，有清楚並宏觀的了解。

briefs.name: 玉山金融與科技講堂
briefs.nameEn: Yushan Finance and Technology Lecture Hall
briefs.tags: 玉山;金融;數位;科技;銀行;金控;財金;證券;投信;AI
briefs.desc: 本課程將邀請玉山金控各業務與科技主管以其豐富之第一線實務經驗，系統性介紹銀行業之金融科技技術、主要金融產品與服務運作模 式。課程內容涵蓋法人與個人金融服務的業務架構與案例解析，包括但不限於授信、支付與收款解決方案、數位帳務與財富管理服務。 另針對當前業界關注之數位金融科技議題（如資料分析與視覺化、機器學習應用、API生態系等）及永續金融/ESG相關實務（綠色融 資、ESG評估流程、永續報告與風險揭露）進行專題分享與討論。

briefs.name: 書報討論
briefs.tags: Seminar, Financial Topic
briefs.desc: 邀請財金學界專家前來講，讓同學瞭解最新的學術研究發展。

briefs.name: 財務工程專題
briefs.tags: financial derivatives, option pricing, stochastic calculus, relative entropy, AI
briefs.desc: 本課程的內容，一方面簡介新金融商品、交易、與市場的發展，一方面著重衍生品如期貨選擇權相關的數理模型和理論方法，另涵蓋應用主題如 金融科技與 AI 智能投資 ，專題研究，並輔以實務專家演講，促使同學自然而然地聯想到「數量方法」與「財務金融」的高度相關性。

briefs.name: 財務資料分析
briefs.tags: empirical studies; derivative market; options; futures; financial econometrics
briefs.desc: Students who are taking this course should have already taken courses of option and future markets (derivative markets) and financial econometrics. This course is an introduction to empirical researches of derivative markets, with focus on a particular topic. This course will focus on the implied information of option markets and introduce several important findings of this topic.

briefs.name: 財務風險管理
briefs.tags: risk, value-at-risk, volatility, financial risk, financial derivatives
briefs.desc: This course examines modern techniques for managing financial risks, including market risk, credit risk, liquidity risk, and operational risk. The course starts with an analysis of risk management problems and risk profiles; then it provides measurement techniques for different types of financial risks on equities, bonds, financial derivatives. It will cover the measurement of value-at-risk (VaR) for measuring market risk and credit risk, economic capital, risk adjusted return on capital. It will discuss how risk measurement tools used for active management of the risk/return profile of financial institutions. It will cover the new basel III regulatory requirements for banks. It will also cover the issues of Large Language Models in financial risk management.

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文研究
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 金融商品設計與評價
briefs.tags: 財務工程(Financial Engineering)、微積分微分方程(Stochastic Differential Equation)、希臘字母避險(Greeks and Hedging)、蒙地卡羅法(Monte Carlo Methods)、有限差分法(Finite Difference Methods)
briefs.desc: 財務工程主要解決問題為金融商品定價與避險。因此本課程除介紹用於定價衍生性金融商品之相關模型，為學生打下理論基礎外，亦介紹用於定價之數值方法。另一方面，為達學以致用目的，本課程亦結合程式設計，以及虛擬交易平台，利用理論模型進行選擇權定價，以及避險策略實作。 Financial engineering primarily addresses the pricing and hedging of financial products. Therefore, in addition to introducing the models used for pricing derivative financial products and providing students with a solid theoretical foundation, this course also covers numerical methods applied in pricing. Furthermore, to achieve the goal of applying what is learned, the course integrates programming and a virtual trading platform, allowing students to implement option pricing and hedging strategies using theoretical models.

briefs.name: 財務時間序列分析二
briefs.tags: financial time series, econometrics, continuous-time modeling, financial econometric models, estimation and testing
briefs.desc: This course introduces topics from research in financial time series econometrics. For each topic, econometric methods are discussed and illustrated by empirical applications. After completion of the course the student will have obtained a fundamental knowledge of continuous-time modeling as applied in research within asset pricing theory. For each topic treated this will include: The ability to analyze the financial econometric models such that their properties are well-understood from a methodological point of view. This will include theory for estimation and testing, dynamic properties and linkage with applied literature.

briefs.name: 金融科技
briefs.tags: 金融科技 Fintech, P2P借貸 P2P Lending, ETF, 保險科技 insurtech, AIoT, 機器人理財 robo advisor, 加密資產 crypto assets, 人工智慧/機器學習AI/ML
briefs.desc: 本課程目的在瞭解國際金融科技的發展趨勢，並探討台灣目前金融科科技產業發展 情形與因應作為。課程內容除了理論基礎 介紹外，將邀請金 融科技產業企業領袖與 專業菁英演講，與學生交流互動，學生也須進行實作加深學習效果，希望藉此課程 能讓學生掌握當 前國際與台灣金融市 場金融科技最新之實務脈動，分析並預測未來 可能之發展。 在全球金融服務朝向數位化、科技化的趨勢下，為培養未來新鮮人的創新思維能力， 透過合作企業提供的「金融科技競賽」 活動，讓同學能夠 將課程所學結合創意， 提出符合未來趨勢的創新金融科技服務，期待各位能提出創意及執行性兼具的創新提案。

briefs.name: 財務與科技管理學術研究研討
briefs.nameEn: Seminar on Research and Academic Publication in Finance and Technology Management
briefs.tags: career planning, financial research, innovation economics, technology management, 創新經濟, 財務研究, 科技管理, 創業
briefs.desc: Both finance and technology management are important research areas in College of Technology Management, National Tsing Hua University. The interaction between researchers from these two areas is of great potential but appears lacking at this stage. As a researcher who published in finance, economics, and technology management journals (https://oir.site.nthu.edu.tw/p/412-1487-18850.php), I plan to design a course that can bridge research topics in both areas and help faculty members/students know how to do research in both areas.

briefs.name: 不動產專題研究二
briefs.nameEn: Seminar on Real Estate Research II
briefs.tags: 不動產real estate, 住宅市場housing market, 區域房市Regional Housing Markets, 房市價量Housing Price and Volume, 房市政策Housing Policies
briefs.desc: 1. 目標: 本課程探討不動產之相關研究，以當前不動產學術界所關注的焦點議題為其研究討論背景，透過國內外相關的已發 表的學術論文，進一步型碩未來碩博士生的研究方向。 2. 課程說明： 為培養學生了解不動產相關實證研究的發展背景及厚實學生進一步發想議題的基底，本課程透過邀請國內不動產金融的頂尖優 秀學者共同授課。由淺入深，以研究議題為導向的介紹，輔以實證研究方法的教學，帶領學生由基礎的不動產資料整理開始， 進而量化分析不動產市場中的交易者行為、市場限制及特性、政府政策效果等議題。學生透過本課程將學習，如何連結在財金 和計量相關的知識，延伸及應用於不動產的議題研究。 3. 教學對象：碩士及博士研究生。

briefs.name: 金融優化方法
briefs.tags: 最佳化, 計量金融, 財務工程, 隨機優化, 數學規劃, 管理科學, Optimization, Quantitative Finance, Stochastic Optimization, Mathematical Programming, Management Science
briefs.desc: The course serves as a twin course of Robust and Stochastic Portfolio Optimization (QF527200). After a quick review of some key topics from linear algebra, the course will dive into the theory of optimization with a focus on its application in quantitative finance. Specifically, this course covers an extensive introduction to the topics of first-order optimization methods. The coverage of material will be suitable for graduate students with a focus on financial engineering, stochastic optimization, and quantitative trading. Many of the results will be presented in a definition-theorem-proof manner. Prerequisite mathematical maturity is essential for success in this course. The intended topics of the course to cover are listed as follows.

briefs.name: 財務實證研討：永續與治理
briefs.nameEn: Financial Empirical Research Seminar: Sustainability and Governance
briefs.tags: 財務實證研究 Empirical Finance Research, 永續發展（ESG）Sustainability (ESG), 公司治理 Corporate Governance, 高階經理人薪酬 Executive Compensation , 資訊揭露 Disclosure
briefs.desc: 本課程旨在培養學生運用財務實證研究方法，探討與永續發展及公司治理相關的重要議題。透過閱讀與討論最新學術文獻，學生 將學習如何檢驗研究假說、設計實證模型、分析資料，並評估研究結果的政策與實務意涵。課程特別強調將永續發展（如 ESG、 企業社會責任、環境保護與科技創新）與治理機制（如董事會結構、股東權益、高階經理人薪酬、員工薪酬與資訊揭露）融入財 務研究框架，藉此訓練學生批判性思考與獨立研究能力，為後續學術研究或實務應用奠定基礎。

briefs.name: 產業研發與創新
briefs.tags: 創新5.0; 創新規劃與預測; 創新組織; 新產品開發; 商業模式 (innovation 5.0, innovation planning & forecasting, organizing innovation, new product development, business model)
briefs.desc: 本課程介紹醫藥與醫材產業研發,創新與創業的基礎知識與技能，使學生能瞭解研發與創新與經濟發展、企業管理之間的關係 及管理者所關心主要問題。使學生瞭解研發,創新與創業所面臨的相關管理問題，如開放式創新、破壞式創新、研發與創新規 劃、創新策略、新產品開發、專案選擇、創業商機、商業模式分析、與創業管理成長與經營團隊管理等。

briefs.name: 美國藥品開發法規研析
briefs.nameEn: Research and Analysis of Drug Development Regulations in the United States
briefs.tags: 法規科學(Regulatory Sciences), 美國食品藥物管理局(U.S. Food and Drug Administration), 臨床試驗(Clinical Trials), 產品查驗登記(Registration and Market approval), 加速核准機制(Expedited Program)
briefs.desc: This course will introduce the US FDA development and approval process and the recent initiatives and programs fostering the innovation, modernizing the clinical trials and supporting accelerated approvals for drugs, biologics and medical devices. It will take US FDA first approval of novel products as examples to discuss how the US FDA regulating and advancing development of new drugs and medical devices.

briefs.name: 美國及歐盟等生醫專利審查實務
briefs.nameEn: Patent practice of Bio medical in EU &USA
briefs.tags: Claim (專利範圍), Specific(說明書), Writing description (明確性), 新穎性(Novelty),進步性(Non-obviousness)
briefs.desc: 1.課程的前段培養學員的專利檢索能力、專利範圍的撰寫以及歐、美的審查程序。 2.課程後段探討該技術撰寫明確性、新穎性、進步性以及對官方意見的答辯。

briefs.name: 生物製劑與疫苗法規科學
briefs.nameEn: Regulatory Sciences for Biologics and Vaccines
briefs.tags: 生物製劑 疫苗 法規科學 製程 品質 biologics, vaccine, regulatory science, Process; quality
briefs.desc: 生物製劑(biologics)與疫苗屬於十分複雜的生物藥品，因此需要嚴謹規範以確保品質穩定，並於前臨床與臨床試驗至審批上市 需有達到一定標準的安全性與有效性。本課程除介紹生物製劑如蛋白,抗體,細胞與基因治療與疫苗品的特性外，強調在前臨床與 臨床試驗與化學,製造與控制(CMC)製造工藝 品質設計與風險管理的法規科學概念，以增進對關鍵生物製劑與疫苗的製程技術的 了解。

briefs.name: 藥品/醫療器材全生命週期GxP品質管理
briefs.nameEn: GxP quality management of medicinal products & medical device through product lifecycle
briefs.tags: 藥品/醫療器材全生命週期、品質管理、非臨床試驗優良操作規節(GLP)、臨床試驗規範(GCP)、優良製造規範(GMP)、品質管理系統(Quality Management System)、優良運銷規範(GDP)、人體細胞組織物優良操作規範(GTP)
briefs.desc: 為確保藥品與醫療器材之品質、安全與有效,有賴於對藥品與醫療器材全生命週期之品質管理,其中，包括非臨床試驗優良操 作規範(GLP)、臨床試驗規範(GCP)、優良製造規範(GMP)及優良運銷規範(GDP)等;為培育醫藥產業界對於藥品/醫療器材全生 命週期GxP品質管理的人才,開立此課程提供學生瞭解GxP品質管理之基本原則與知識，包括藥品/醫療器材全生命週期GxP品質管 理之全球趨勢、政策、法規制度、實務運作等全方位的概念，強化學生對於GxP品質管理(GLP/GCP/GMP/GDP/GTP)的知識，協助 學生認知到專業人員在藥品/醫療器材品質管理扮演之關鍵角色與機會，引導優秀醫藥產業人才投入相關領域。

briefs.name: 從實驗到市面：藥品與醫材的關鍵旅程
briefs.nameEn: From Lab to Market: The Critical Journey of Drugs and Medical Devices
briefs.tags: 藥品生命週期, 生物藥, 精準醫療, 結構生物學, 醫藥法規, 新藥與學名藥, 送審流程, 政府法規
briefs.desc: 本課程帶領學生探索藥品與醫材從實驗室誕生到上市的關鍵旅程，了解現代醫療產品如何在科學、法規與政策環境中實現創新。內容 涵蓋藥品生命週期的各階段，介紹新藥、學名藥與相似藥的異同，以及生物藥與基因治療等前沿技術。課程也聚焦於精準醫療與數位 療法的法規挑戰，並解析結構生物學在新藥設計中的關鍵角色。透過政府政策資源與真實產業案例的探討，學生將對醫藥研發與法規 審查有整體性理解，培養跨領域的醫藥科技素養與社會責任感。課程適合對健康、科技與政策交會議題感興趣的學生，不限科系背 景。

briefs.name: 醫藥法規科學與技術實務
briefs.nameEn: Regulatory Science and Technical Practice in Med Products
briefs.tags: 藥品CMC, 生物藥製程、藥品法規, 學名藥與相似藥, 數位療法, 醫療器材法規, 國際藥品法規, 法規文件撰寫實務, 法規送審, 查驗應答模擬, 法規產業實戰
briefs.desc: 本課程介紹醫藥產品開發過程中關鍵的法規與實務，包括藥品CMC資料的準備、國際主流法規指引（如ICH Q8–Q11）、學名藥與生物 相似藥之申請策略，以及新興數位醫療療法或產品（AI、SaMD、DTx）所面臨的法規挑戰。課程強調eCTD與DMF等送審文件的撰寫實 務，並透過模擬查驗應答訓練學生之法規應對能力。搭配產業案例與法規資料實作，使學生具備藥品與醫材法規工作的基本素養。課 程適合法規、藥學、醫藥科技及生技管理等相關領域之碩士班或在職專班學生修習。

briefs.name: 區塊鏈在醫療資訊的應用與實作
briefs.tags: 分散式數據庫，去中心化，數字簽名，智能合約，加密貨幣，醫療應用
briefs.desc: 區塊鏈技術是一種去中心化的分散式資料庫技術，它基於密碼學原理和分佈式系統技術，可以實現多個節點共同維護和更新數據庫， 而無需依賴單一中央機構。區塊鏈技術中最重要的概念是「區塊」，每個區塊都包含了數據、時間戳、和前一個區塊的數字簽名，並且 所有區塊按照時間戳順序排列，形成了一個不斷增長的鏈狀數據結構，因此稱為「區塊鏈」。在生物醫療領域，區塊鏈可以應用於許多 面向，例如醫療記錄管理，藥物追溯，醫學研究資料的完整保存，醫療保險，或是生物醫療產品的加密識別及認證。 本課程的教育目標是讓完全不懂區塊鏈的學員，上完課之後理解區塊鏈的智慧合約，區塊鏈帳本，並有能力製作出基本智能合約。最 後輔以實例介紹區塊鏈技術在生物醫療的應用。本堂課程學員不需要具有程式語言背景，課程將在電腦教室教學。

briefs.name: 書報討論二
briefs.tags: 藥師執業Pharmacy Practice ,藥品查驗登記Pharmaceutical Registration ,人體臨床試驗Human Clinical Trial,罕見疾病防治及藥物法Rare Disease and Orphan Drug Act,藥害救濟法Drug Injury and Relief Law
briefs.desc: 藥事行政與法規主要探討藥物的管理及管理藥物的人、事、法規，由經濟與社會科學角度的相關問題，及其適用的法律、藥事 執業及藥學發展的影響。內容包含了：藥物(分藥品及醫材)的查驗登記、行政管理法規體系、藥師業務及執業管理、藥局藥 商藥物業務及管理、藥害救濟與罕見疾病防治範疇，因此本課程涵蓋二大單元。 單元一以實際案例討論新藥的誕生及管理，由實驗室到產品上市，研發及管理相當複雜，帶著同學員淺入深地掌握藥政與新藥 開發法規。 單元二為新藥開發流程與藥毒理法規概論，介紹新藥研發流程、如何進行新藥早期探索、臨床前開發考量的重點、臨床前藥毒 理研究及法規考量等；並介紹新藥開發到上市審查所必須掌握之IND藥品臨床試驗管理與相關法規、NDA新藥查驗登記與相關 法規等；使同學能掌握目前新藥研發及製藥最新版法規。

briefs.name: 現代詩創作專題
briefs.nameEn: Special study on modern poetry writing
briefs.tags: 創作,文學獎,分析,小詩,長詩,圖象詩,散文詩,童詩
briefs.desc: 本課程為現代詩創作專題，課程的重點在於現代詩創作與創作相關理論與作品的閱讀和分析，不涉及史觀或史述，主要就是以創作做為主軸 進行專題的研討，課程中分成學生創作共評、創作理論研討三個區塊，希望能夠讓學生在修課過程對於華文現代詩的書寫，透過實作與分 析，更能有進一步的理解。

briefs.name: 東亞漢籍專題
briefs.nameEn: Topics on East Asia Sinographic Texts
briefs.tags: 東亞儒學、漢籍、四書、大學、朝鮮、日本
briefs.desc: 「漢籍」指的是以漢文（主要是古漢文）撰寫的文獻，而「東亞」則是包括整個亞洲東部，即漢字文化圈內東北亞(如朝鮮 半島、日本、琉球等地)與東南亞的範圍(如越南、馬來半島等地)，故「東亞漢籍」即是指在這個地域範圍內二十世紀以前 用漢文撰寫的各類典籍(廣義上，也包含十七世紀以來歐美的傳教士的漢文著作)。是以論其內容，當可有三： 一者是傳統 中 國疆域以外的文人用漢字書寫的各種著作，如釋經之作、個人詩文集等； 再者是中國典籍的域外刊刻本或抄本，如中國古籍 的和刻本、朝鮮本、漢喃本等； 第三則是在中國境內已散佚，卻有幸留存在域外的中國古籍(包括殘卷)。 本課程之授課主 題，包括相關研究課題─東亞四書學的現況介紹（導論），以及實際的文獻研讀與探討，著重以《論語》為 主軸認識中、日、 韓、越等國學者的相關註釋成果與關懷重點。進而訓練學生培養獨立研究的態度與能力。

briefs.name: 史記會注考證專題
briefs.nameEn: Topics on Shi Ji Hui Zhu Kao Zheng
briefs.tags: 司馬遷,史記,瀧川龜太郎,史記會注考證,正史,東亞正史,朝鮮,日本,越南
briefs.desc: 1.史記為中國歷代正史之源流，同時亦具有史學與文學多重學術上之價值，自三家注之外，歷朝士人對於史記的註釋汗牛充棟，其中集大 成者當為近代日本學者瀧川龜太郎的史記會注考證。史記會注考證不僅引用材料詳實豐富，更廣及日本漢學者的研究成果。研讀此一專 書，不僅可以習得針對史記一書的諸多觀點與看法，亦可掌握日本漢學者對於史記研究的概況。 2.藉由重要議題的設計與探討，並透過原典的研讀，輔以現代學者的相關研究進行授課與討論，期使研習者掌握此一領域的重要關鍵議 題。

briefs.name: 近現代通俗文學專題
briefs.nameEn: Selected Readings of Modern Popular Literature
briefs.tags: 近現代通俗文學、大眾文化、消費文學、流行文化、Selected Readings of Modern Popular Literature
briefs.desc: 通俗文學是大眾文化的一部份，是一種以滿足讀者愉悅性消費為目的的商品性文學。通俗文學的流行不僅只是單純文學層次的 問題，還進一步牽涉到整個社會的流行文化，大眾的內在心理、思想情感，以及消費者的意識形態。隨著舊的社會型態轉變， 適合新型態社會需求的通俗文學就會應運而生。因為時代的變遷，流行方式會與時俱進，而其中所衍生的社會意義亦有所殊 異，因而具有研究價值。 本課程選擇近現代時期較具代表性的通俗文學文本，協助同學更深刻地理解通俗文學，反思其文本內外所輻射的深層意 涵。透過此一探討，希望達到的教學目標如下： 1、思考華文領域的文化現象，期能產生對社會文化的批判性思考。 2、期望從課程中培養學生文本細讀、文學賞析，與觀察文化現象的能力，進而厚植相關的研究能量。

briefs.name: 華文文學專題：新加坡
briefs.tags: 新加坡,東南亞,華人,華文Singapore, Southeast Asia, Chinese (ethnicity),Chinese literature
briefs.desc: 在新加坡和馬來西亞，華文文學曾被共同稱為「馬華文學」。然而，1965年新加坡自馬來西亞獨立後，兩地在政治上的分離，導致其文學發 展也逐漸分道揚鑣。自1970年代以來，新加坡華文文學逐漸形成了自己獨特的風格和主題，從而走上了獨立發展的道路。新加坡的華文作家 們在不同的社會背景和文化環境中，探索和表達自己的身份認同、歷史經驗及現實生活，與馬來西亞的華文文學形成了鮮明的對比。隨著英 語文學的興起和華文書寫的影響力逐漸減退，新加坡華文文學的讀者群體在1990年代後明顯縮小。這一趨勢反映了新加坡在全球化浪潮下， 語言與文化的多元變遷及其對文學的深遠影響。 這段時間的新加坡華文文學呈現出豐富多元的面貌，涵蓋了從傳統詩詞和散文到現代小說和詩歌等各種體裁，反映了新加坡華人社會的多樣 性和深厚的文化底蘊。在本課程中，我們將通過每週的主題深入探討新加坡華文文學的各個方面。課程設計圍繞一系列關鍵詞，如「漢 詩」、「講華語運動」、「新謠」等，並結合經典文學作品，帶領學生全面理解新加坡華文文學的各種課題，初步而全面地認識新加坡華文 文學的作家和作品，理解其在全球華文文學中的獨特位置和價值。

briefs.name: 東亞佛教漢藉文獻專題
briefs.nameEn: Topics in Chinese Buddhist Texts in East Asia Buddhism
briefs.tags: 妙法蓮華經Lotus Sutra, 法華經疏Fahua jing shu, 法華經義記Fahua jing yiji, 法華義疏Fahua yishu, 妙法蓮華經文句Miaofa lianhua jing wenju, 竺道生Zhu Daosheng, 光宅法雲Guangzhai Fayin, 聖德太子Prince Sh!3;toku, 智顗Zhiyi, 注疏commentaries and subcommentaries, 詮釋Buddhist Hermeneutics
briefs.desc: 本課程將集中研讀《妙法蓮華經》及其相關注疏，一方面透過經典與注釋的對讀，掌握經典原意與注疏詮釋的層次異同，藉此理 解《妙法蓮華經》本身重要觀念，及其對中國乃至東亞佛教思想發展的影響；另一方面則並列對觀東亞《妙法蓮華經》的四部重 要注疏，從思想史的發展角度探究注疏間的異同，特別是不同時代下的《妙法蓮華經》定位和概念詮釋，並解釋《妙法蓮華經》 如何在與《般若》、《涅槃》競逐的脈絡下逐步發展至天台獨尊《法華》的地位。

briefs.name: 儀式戲曲專題
briefs.tags: 戲曲, 儀式劇, 祭祀戲劇, 宗教戲曲, 儺戲, 目連戲 Chinese Theater, Ritual Chinese Drama, religious drama, Nuo theatre, Opera of Mulian
briefs.desc: 戲曲除了在文學、音樂、表演等方面的藝術表現之外，其發展的過程，乃至今日的演出，仍有一脈維持與儀式與節俗密切的關係，且從民間到宮廷、從偶 戲到人戲、從華人原鄉到海外華人，「戲曲」與「祭／儀」之間，具有多種層次，可作為戲曲發展與傳播的重要專題。

briefs.name: 社會學方法論
briefs.tags: 社會學方法論, 研究方法, 研究設計, Sociological Methodology, Research Methods, Research Design
briefs.desc: 社會學方法論是研究方法訓練的基礎課，也是學習撰寫研究計畫書（research proposal）的實作課。本課程的目標有三：（1）訓練如 何就自身關懷提出研究謎題、進行研究設計；（2）了解不同研究法所連繫的方法論；（3）協助同學逐步發展出一份可行的研究計畫書。 我們將學習如何從確立現象開始，逐步形成問題意識、提煉謎題（puzzle）、進行文獻回顧、設計分析架構、選擇研究方法、設想研究貢 獻、安排寫作架構，最後完成一份可行的研究計畫書。

briefs.name: 記憶政治
briefs.tags: 集體記憶 collective memory、文化記憶 cultural memory、社會記憶 social memory、記憶之所 lieux de memoire、記憶行動主義 memory activism
briefs.desc: 這門課旨在探討記憶、歷史與遺忘所連繫的社群政治，課程分為四個部分：「記憶研究的社會起源」、「社會記憶與文化記憶」、 「歷史責任與記憶行動」、「記憶政治的對話」。

briefs.name: 當代社會理論選讀
briefs.tags: 分析社會學（analystic sociology, AS）, 批判實在論（critical realism, CR）, 建制民族誌(institutional ethnography), 南方社會理論（southern social theory）、全球知識流通（global circulation of knowledge）
briefs.desc: 在20-21世紀之交，社會理論的當代發展不僅更為多元，也出現跨學科的趨勢。在這個趨勢之中的一部分社會理論研究者，致力 將「理論」的任務定位在「增進社會學對經驗研究之解釋能力」。本課程目的在於，增進社會學研究生使用這類「理論」於自己 的經驗研究解釋之中。在這樣的理論（或說理論取徑）之中，我們選擇「分析社會學」（analystic sociology, AS）、「批判 實在論」（critical realism, CR）、「建制民族誌」（institutional ethnography, IE）作為主要內容。在介紹三種理論取 徑的基礎上，本課程也提供對它們的多元比較與後設反思。

briefs.name: 家庭社會學
briefs.tags: 家庭, 婚姻, 性別, 社會制度, 照顧, 市場, family, marriage, gender, social institution, care, market
briefs.desc: Family is a key institution in the society and tends to be seen as a “timeless” existence. However, family forms, practices, and relations are diverse and changing across time and space. What we consider as the “normal” family today could be reviewed as abnormal at other times and spaces. As an important social institution, family processes intersect and overlap with other dynamics of social life, and shape what a society is and how people carry out their lives. This course explores key concepts and debates about changing family life, family institution, and intimate relations. Issues of social changes (modernity and development), privilege, inequality (gender, sexuality, class, ethnicity, nationality, age), and the transformation of family institution will be the core inquiries of the course.

briefs.name: 教育社會學：經典與實作
briefs.nameEn: Sociology of Education: Classics and Practicum
briefs.tags: 教育實踐、社會不平等、教育制度、教育變遷、教育民族誌
briefs.desc: 這門課程的精神是：聚焦在教育社會學的理論經典和經驗研究，並帶領學習主體進行教育實踐和研究實作。這門課分成兩大部 份，第一部份為經典名著的選讀，研讀開展教育社會學視域的關鍵作品和民族誌。第二部份針對在地化的教育案例、改革和政 策變遷，進行梳理、分析和討論。一方面，透過經典作品對照臺灣在地社會的脈絡，可以激盪出深厚的對話，進一步啟發我們 從事豐富多元的研究想像。二方面，藉由取法不同的研究範例，作為學習主體在從事研究和教育實踐的參照點，針對自己的研 究關懷和生命經驗，研擬具體可行的研究方向或進行教育實踐。 本課程採取集體討論的進行方式，修課者有熱衷參與討論的責任和義務，我們會採取一種強互惠和群學利他的教學模式。本課 程目標在於：首先，瞭解教育社會學的基本課題和理論觀點。其次，從社會學的視角來思辨教育議題。最後，實踐教育社會學 的信念和基本關懷。

briefs.name: 中級社會統計
briefs.tags: 描述性統計、假設檢定、兩樣本的均數比較（t檢定）、ANOVA、卡方檢定、迴歸、複迴歸、迴歸診斷、類別資料分析
briefs.desc: 本課程只有一點點的預設能力，那就是對於描述性統計（均數、標準差）有一些了解，對於假 設檢定有基本的概念，對於數學符號（像是連加符 號）不會畏懼；學期一開始，我會帶大家回顧描述性統計、假設檢定、兩樣本的均數比較（t檢定）、ANOVA和卡方檢定。我希望這學期可以上 迴歸、複迴歸、和迴歸的診斷等。理想的話，我希望討論一點基本的類別資料分析。 其他相關資訊，請查詢本課程教學網站： http://mx.nthu.edu.tw/~mincchen 我會在我的課程elearn上隨時更新上課講義。

briefs.name: 科技與社會研究
briefs.tags: 科學，科技，科學與技術研究，知識，政治
briefs.desc: 本課程介紹科學與技術研究的背景與主要取徑。科學研究(Science Studies)，與科學與技術研究(Science and Technology Studies)、科技與社會(Science, Technology, and Society)等等研究領域的研究對象和取向多所重疊，不同的說法或是 強 調科技研發與普及過程的複雜性、或者強調介入與實踐面向的重要性。經過近半世紀的發展，該領域的理論語彙與個案研究已經 多不勝數。本課程希望達成三個目的。一是透過科學哲學和STS的觀點，瞭解科學如何進行; 二是瞭解主要的研究取徑和理論語 彙; 三是透過個案研究的探討，培養以科學技術活動為研究對象的操作能力。

briefs.name: 中國研究工作坊
briefs.tags: 中國研究（China Studies）, 工作坊（Workshop）, 演講（Lecture）, 摘要（abstract）, 通訊（Newsletter）
briefs.desc: 「中國研究工作坊」為清華社會所碩士班乙組一、二年級必修（零學分）課程。我們邀請當代中國研究相關領域 學者、專業人士，前來分享思路視角、研究成果及實踐經驗。針對特定領域或議題，進行深入分析與問答討論， 拓展視野，補充強化正式課程。修課同學需要每次出席，積極提問，參與討論，輪流撰寫演講摘要，並呈現為學 術紀要，投稿《當代中國研究通訊》。

briefs.name: 當代中國政治控制專題
briefs.nameEn: Seminar on Political Manipulation in Contemporary China
briefs.tags: 政治（politics）,社會（society）,體制（institutions）,控制（Manipulation）,當代中國（Contemporary China）
briefs.desc: 當代中國自改革開放以來，特別八九天安門事件後，經濟、政治、社會變遷，不少新興社群力量湧現。然而大致 未能升級、擴散，而隨著近年「新型舉國體制」、「總體國家安全觀」，紛紛隱沒於主旋律。儘管特定時空背景 下有「白紙」等事件，但大致未能對政權造成威脅。體制何以吸納、壓制社會與政治力量？當代中國政治控制機 制，恐怕很難以「新極權」一言蔽之。不同層級、身份群體、議題、事件，處於特定場域，受到機制操控，往往 具有結構相似性，許多手段蔓延、運用至周邊地區。課程試圖提供中國體制「政治控制」的基本輪廓。分為四個 相應重心：一、重要學術文獻閱讀；二、較近期經驗著作研討；三、田野語境和技藝的揣摩；四、依自身研究興 趣，對當代中國政治控制議題定向、追蹤，並逐漸養成興趣、習慣。

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文研究
briefs.desc: 在指導教授之指導下，就各別選定之題目進行有系統研究，期獲得在該領域知識與技術上之成果。

briefs.name: 論文研究
briefs.tags: 論文研究
